Ā, mā te tohunga e tahu ki runga ki te āta; he kai hoki nō tā Ihowā whakahere ahi.
"Ā, ki te mea he koati tāna whakahere, me tāpae ki te aroaro o Ihowā.
Ā, ka popoki tōna ringa ki tōna pane, ka patu ai ki mua o te tapenākara o te whakaminenga; ā, mā ngā tama a Ārona e tāuhiuhi ōna toto ki te āta ā tawhio noa.
"Ā, me tāpae atu e ia tētahi wāhi ōna hei whakahere ahi māna ki a Ihowā; ko te ngako e whiwhiwhiwhi ana ki ngā whēkau, me te ngako katoa o ngā whēkau,
me ngā whatukuhu e rua, me tō reira ngako, tērā i te hope, me te taupā i te ate, me ngā whatukuhu, me tango tērā e ia.
Ā, me tahu e te tohunga ki te āta he kai tēnā nō te whakahere ahi, hei kakara reka. Ko te ngako katoa mā Ihowā.
"Hei tikanga mau tonu tēnei mō ō koutou whakatupuranga, i ō koutou nohoanga katoa, kia kaua e kainga tētahi ngako, toto rānei, e koutou."
I kōrero anō a Ihowā ki a Mohi, i mea,
"Kōrero ki ngā tama a Īharaira, mea atu: Ki te pōhēhē tētahi tangata, ā, ka hara ki tētahi o ngā mea i whakahaua e Ihowā kia kaua e meatia, ā, ka mea i tētahi o aua mea.
"Ki te hara te tohunga i whakawahia, e tau ai he hē ki runga ki te iwi; nā, me whakahere e ia ki a Ihowā mō tōna hara i hara ai ia tētahi pūru, hei te kūao kohakore, hei whakahere hara.
Nā, me kawe e ia te pūru ki te whatitoka o te tapenākara o te whakaminenga, ki te aroaro o Ihowā; ā, ka popoki i tōna ringa ki te mātenga o te pūru, ka patu ai te pūru ki te aroaro o Ihowā.
Nā, me tango e te tohunga i whakawahia tētahi wāhi o ngā toto o te pūru, ā, ka kawe ki te tapenākara o te whakaminenga.
Ā, ka tou te tohunga i tōna maihao ki te toto, ā, kia whitu āna tāuhiuhinga i te toto ki te aroaro o Ihowā, ki mua o te ārai o te wāhi tapu.

Me pani anō e te tohunga tētahi wāhi o ngā toto ki ngā haona o te āta whakakakara reka, ki te aroaro o Ihowā, ki tērā i te tapenākara o te whakaminenga. Ka riringi ai i ngā toto katoa o te pūru ki te tūranga o te āta mō te tahunga tinana, ki tērā i te whatitoka o te tapenākara o te whakaminenga.
Ā, me tango e ia ngā ngako katoa o te pūru whakahere hara; te ngako e whiwhiwhiwhi ana ki ngā whēkau, me ngā ngako katoa o ngā whēkau,
me ngā whatukuhu e rua, me tō reira ngako, tērā i te hope, me te taupā o te ate, me ngā whatukuhu, me tango tērā e ia,
kia rite ki te tangohanga o tō te pūru o te patunga mō te pai. Ā, me tahu e te tohunga ki runga ki te āta mō te tahunga tinana.
Ko te hiako ia o te pūru, ko ōna kikokiko katoa, ko tōna pane, ko ōna i waewae, ko ōna whēkau, me tōna paru –
arā, ko te pūru katoa hoki – me kawe e ia ki waho o te puni, ki tētahi wāhi pokekore, ki te wāhi e ringihia ai ngā pungarehu, ka tahu ai ki te rākau ki te ahi; hei te ringihanga pungarehu tahu ai.

"Ā, ki te pōhēhē te whakaminenga katoa o Īharaira, ā, ka hara, ā, ka ngaro taua mea i ngā kanohi o te whakaminenga, ā, ka tika kē i tētahi o ngā whakahau a Ihowā tētahi o ā rātou mahi, he mea e kore e tika kia meatia, ā, ka whai hara rātou;
ā, ka kitea te hara i hara ai rātou, kātahi ka whakaherea e te whakaminenga tētahi pūru kūao mō te hara, me kawe hoki ki mua o te tapenākara o te whakaminenga.
Ka popoki ai ngā ringa o ngā kaumātua o te whakaminenga ki te pane o te pūru ki te aroaro o Ihowā; ā, hei te aroaro o Ihowā patu ai i te pūru.
"Ā, mā te tohunga i whakawahia e kawe tētahi wāhi o ngā toto o te pūru ki te tapenākara o te whakaminenga;
ka tou ai te tohunga i tōna maihao ki te toto, ā, kia whitu āna tāuhiuhinga ki te aroaro o Ihowā ki mua o te ārai.

Me pani anō e ia tētahi wāhi o te toto ki ngā haona o te āta i te aroaro o Ihowā, ki tērā i te tapenākara o te whakaminenga, ka riringi ai i ngā toto katoa ki te tūranga o te āta tahunga tinana, ki tērā i te whatitoka o te tapenākara o te whakaminenga.
Me tango anō e ia ōna ngako katoa, ka tahu ai ki runga ki te āta.
Ko tāna tēnā e mea ai ki te pūru; kia rite ki tāna i mea ai ki te pūru whakahere hara, kia pērā tāna meatanga ki tēnei; ā, me mea e te tohunga he whakamārie mō rātou, ā, ka murua tō rātou hara.
Ā, me kawe e ia te pūru ki waho o te puni, ka tahu, ka pērā anō me ia i tahu i te pūru tuatahi; ko te whakahere hara tēnā mō te whakaminenga.
"Ki te hara tētahi rangatira, ā, ka mahi i runga i te pōhēhē i tētahi o ngā mea i whakahaua e Ihowā, e tōna Atua, kia kaua e mahia, ā, ka whai hara,
ki te mōhiotia e ia tōna hara i hara ai, me kawe tāna whakahere, he koati, hei te toa, hei te mea kohakore.
Ā, ka popoki tōna ringa ki runga ki te mātenga o te koati, ka patu ai ki te wāhi e patua nei te tahunga tinana ki te aroaro o Ihowā; he whakahere hara tēnā.
Ā, me tango e te tohunga tētahi wāhi o te toto o te whakahere hara ki tōna maihao, ka pani ai ki ngā haona o te āta tahunga tinana, me riringi anō ōna toto ki te tūranga o te āta tahunga tinana.
Nā, me tahu e ia ōna ngako katoa ki te āta, me pērā me te ngako o ngā patunga mō te pai; ā, ka whakamārie te tohunga mōna, mō tōna hara, ā, ka murua.
"Ā, ki te pōhēhē tētahi tangata noa atu, ā, ka hara, nōna i mea i tētahi mea e tika kē ana i tētahi o ngā whakahau a Ihowā, he mea e kore e tika kia meatia, ā, ka whai hara;
ki te mōhiotia e ia tōna hara i hara ai, me kawe e ia tāna whakahere, he koati, he uha, he kohakore, mō tōna hara i hara ai.
Ā, ka popoki tōna ringa ki te mātenga o te whakahere hara, ka patu ai i te whakahere hara ki te wāhi mō te tahunga tinana.
Nā, ka tango te tohunga i tētahi wāhi o ōna toto ki tōna maihao, ka pani ai ki ngā haona o te āta tahunga tinana, ka riringi ai i ōna toto katoa ki te tūranga o te āta.

Me tango anō e ia ōna ngako katoa, me pērā me te ngako e tangohia ana i ngā patunga mō te pai; ā, me tahu e te tohunga ki runga ki te āta hei kakara reka ki a Ihowā. Nā, ka whakamārie te tohunga mōna, ā, ka murua tōna.
"Ā, ki te mea he reme tāna whakahere e kawea ana e ia mō te hara, me kawe e ia hei te uha, hei te mea kohakore.
Nā, ka popoki tōna ringa ki te mātenga o te whakahere hara, ā, ka patua hei whakahere hara ki te wāhi e patua nei e rātou te tahunga tinana.
Nā, me tango e te tohunga tētahi wāhi o te toto o te whakahere hara ki tōna maihao, ka pani ai ki ngā haona o te āta tahunga tinana, me riringi anō ōna toto katoa ki te tūranga o te āta.

Me tango anō e ia ōna ngako katoa, kia rite ki te tangohanga o te ngako o te reme o ngā patunga mō te pai; ka tahu ai e te tohunga ki runga ki te āta, ki runga ki ngā whakahere ahi ki a Ihowā. Nā, ka whakamārie te tohunga mō tōna hara i hara ai, ā, ka murua."
"Ki te hara tētahi, mōna i rongo ki te reo whakaoati, he kaiwhakaatu nei ia mō tāna i kite ai, i mōhio ai rānei, ki te kāhore e whakaaturia e ia, nā, me waha e ia tōna hara.

"Ki te pā tētahi ki te mea poke – ki te tinana rānei o te kīrehe poke, ki te tinana rānei o te kararehe poke, ki te tinana rānei o ngā mea ngōki – arā o ngā mea poke, ā, e huna ana i a ia, ā, ka poke ia, nā, ka whai hara ia.
"Ki te pā rānei ia ki te poke tangata, ki ngā tini poke e poke ai te tangata, ā, ka huna i a ia; ina mōhiotia e ia, ka whai hara ia.

"Ki te oati rānei tētahi, he mea puta ohorere i ōna ngutu, kia mahi i te kino, i te pai rānei, i ngā tini mea rānei e puaki ohorere mai i te tangata ina oati, ā, e huna ana i a ia; ina mōhiotia e ia, nā, ka whai hara ia i tētahi o ēnei mea.
"Ā, ki te mea kua whai hara ia i tētahi o ēnei mea, nā, me whāki tōna hara i taua mea;
ā, me kawe e ia tāna whakahere mō te hē ki a Ihowā, mō tōna hara i hara ai, he uha nō te kāhui, he reme, he kūao koati rānei, hei whakahere hara; ā, mā te tohunga e whakamārie mōna, mō tōna hara.

"Ā, ki te kāhore e taea e ia i ōna rawa he reme, me kawe e ia ki a Ihowā mō tōna hē i hē ai, kia rua ngā kūkupa, kia rua rānei ngā pī kūkupa; ko tētahi hei whakahere hara, ko tētahi hei tahunga tinana.
Me kawe rāua e ia ki te tohunga, ka whakahere ai e ia, ko te mea mō te whakahere hara ki mua, ka kikini ai i tōna pane i te ritenga o tōna kakī, otiia kaua e motuhia rawatia.
Nā, ka tāuhiuhi ai ia i tētahi wāhi o ngā toto o te whakahere hara ki te taha o te āta; ka whakatē ai i te toenga o te toto ki te tūranga o te āta; he whakahere hara tēnā.
Ā, ko te rua me tuku hei tahunga tinana, kia rite ki te tikanga; ā, ka whakamārie te tohunga mōna, mō tōna hara i hara ai, ā, ka murua.

"Ā, ki te kāhore e taea e ia i ōna rawa te kawe ngā kūkupa e rua, ngā pī kūkupa rānei e rua, nā, me kawe tāna whakahere e te tangata i hara, te whakatekau epa parāoa, hei whakahere hara; kaua e meatia ki te hinu, kaua anō e meatia he parakihe ki runga; he whakahere hara hoki.

Nā, me kawe e ia ki te tohunga, ā, ka aohia ake e te tohunga, kia kī tōna ringa, he whakamahara nō taua mea, ka tahu ai ki runga ki te āta, ki runga ki ngā whakahere ahi ki a Ihowā; he whakahere hara tēnā.
Ā, ka whakamārie te tohunga mōna, mō tōna hara i hara ai ki tētahi o ēnei mea, ā, ka murua. Ā, mā te tohunga te toenga, ānō he whakahere totokore."
I kōrero anō a Ihowā ki a Mohi, i mea:

"Ki te kino te mahi a tētahi, he hara pōhēhē, ki ngā mea tapu a Ihowā; nā, me kawe e ia tāna whakahere mō te hē ki a Ihowā, kia kotahi hipi toa, hei te mea kohakore, nō te kāhui hipi, me whakarite anō e koe ōna utu ki te hekere hiriwa, hekere o te wāhi tapu, hei whakahere mō te hē.
Ka utu ai i tōna hara ki te mea tapu, me tāpiri anō ki te wāhi whakarima, ka hōmai ki te tohunga; ā, ka whakamārie te tohunga mōna ki te hipi toa e whakaherea ana mō te hē, ā, ka murua tōna.
"Ā, ki te hara tētahi, ki te poka kē i tētahi o ngā whakahau a Ihowā, he mahi poka noa; ahakoa e kore e mōhiotia e ia, kua hara ia, ā, ka waha ia i tōna kino.

Ā, me kawe e ia he hipi toa ki te tohunga, he kohakore, nō te kāhui, kei tau te utu, hei whakahere mō te hē. Ā, ka whakamārie te tohunga mōna, mō tōna pōhēhē i pōhēhē ai ia, ā, kīhai nei i mātau, ā, ka murua tōna hē.
He whakahere tēnā mō te hē; he pono tōna hē ki a Ihowā."
I kōrero anō a Ihowā ki a Mohi, i mea:
"Ki te hara tētahi, ā, ka hē tāna ki a Ihowā, ā, ka teka hoki ki tōna hoa, he mea i tukua ki a ia kia tiakina, he whakaaetanga rānei, he mea rānei i pāhuatia, he whakahaere hē rānei ki tōna hoa;
i kitea rānei e ia te mea i ngaro, ā, ka kōrero teka ki taua mea, ka oati teka; i tētahi rānei o ēnei tini mea e mea ai te tangata, e whai hara ai.
"Nā, kua hara nei ia, kua hē, me whakahoki e ia te mea i pāhuatia, te mea rānei i murua e ia, te mea rānei i waiho ki a ia kia tiakina, te mea ngaro rānei i kitea e ia,
ngā mea katoa rānei i oati teka ai ia. Me utu e ia taua mea kia tino rite, ka tāpiri anō ki te wāhi whakarima; me hōmai e ia ki te tangata nōna, i te rā e kitea ai kua hara ia.
Ā, me kawe e ia tāna whakahere mō te hē ki a Ihowā, he hipi toa, he kohakore nō te kāhui, kei tau te utu, hei whakahere mō te hē, ki te tohunga.
Ā, mā te tohunga e whakamārie mōna ki te aroaro o Ihowā, ā, ka murua te hē o tāna i ngā mea katoa i mea ai ia, i hara ai."
I kōrero anō a Ihowā ki a Mohi, i mea:

"Whakahaua a Ārona rātou ko āna tama, mea atu: Ko te ture tēnei mō te tahunga tinana. Me uta te tahunga tinana ki runga ki te takuahi o te āta ā pau noa te pō, taea noatia te ata; kia kā tonu hoki te ahi o te āta ki runga ki a ia.

Ā, me kākahu e te tohunga tōna kākahu rīnena, me mau anō ōna tarau rīnena ki tōna kiri, ka kohi ai i ngā pungarehu i pau tahi me te tahunga tinana i te ahi i runga i te āta, ā, ka waiho i te taha o te āta.
Nā, ka whakarere atu ia i ōna kākahu, ka kākahu i ētahi atu kākahu, ā, ka mau i ngā pungarehu ki waho i te puni, ki te wāhi pokekore.

Kia kā tonu anō te ahi o te āta, kei pirau. Me whakaū anō e te tohunga ngā wahie ki runga, i tēnei ata, i tēnei ata; me āta whakatakoto anō e ia te tahunga tinana ki runga, ā, me tahu e ia te ngako o ngā whakahere mō te pai ki runga.
Kia kā tonu te ahi i runga i te āta; kei pirau."
"Nā, ko te ture tēnei mō te whakahere totokore. Mā ngā tama a Ārona e tāpae ki te aroaro o Ihowā, ki mua i te āta.

Me ao e ia, kia kī tōna ringa, i te parāoa pai o te whakahere totokore, i te hinu hoki, me te parakihe katoa anō hoki i runga i te whakahere totokore, ka tahu ai ki runga ki te āta hei kakara reka, hei whakamahara mō taua mea ki a Ihowā.
Ā, mā Ārona rātou ko āna tama e kai te toenga o taua mea; me kai kore rēwena ki te wāhi tapu; hei te marae o te tapenākara o te whakaminenga rātou kai ai.
E kore e tunua rēwenatia; kua hoatu e ahau taua mea hei wāhi mā rātou i roto i āku whakahere ahi. He tino tapu tēnā, rite tonu anō ki te whakahere hara, ki te whakahere mō te hē.
Hei kai tēnā mā ngā tāne katoa o ngā tama a Ārona, hei wāhi pūmau mā rātou puta noa i ō koutou whakatupuranga o ngā whakahere ahi a Ihowā; ka tapu ngā tāngata katoa e pā ana ki ēnā."
I kōrero anō a Ihowā ki a Mohi, i mea:

"Ko te whakahere tēnei mā Ārona rātou ko āna tama, ko tā rātou e whakahere ai ki a Ihowā i te rā e whakawahia ai ia: ko te whakatekau epa parāoa hei whakahere totokore, hei mea mau tonu, ko tētahi wāhi ōna i te ata, ko tētahi wāhi i te ahiahi.
Me hanga ki te hinu ki runga i te pāraharaha; ā, ka oti te tunu, ka kawe ki roto; ā, ka whakahere i ngā wāhi i tunua o te whakahere totokore, hei kakara reka ki a Ihowā.
Mā te tohunga i whakawahia i roto i āna tama hei whakakapi mōna e mahi; he tikanga pūmau, me tahu katoa ki a Ihowā.
Me tahu katoa ngā whakahere totokore katoa a te tohunga; kaua hei kainga."
I kōrero anō a Ihowā ki a Mohi, i mea:

"Kōrero ki a Ārona rātou ko āna tama, mea atu: Ko te ture tēnei mō te whakahere hara. Ko te wāhi e patua ai te tahunga tinana, ko reira patu ai i te whakahere hara, ki te aroaro o Ihowā; he tino tapu tēnā.
Ko te tohunga nāna i whakahere taua mea mō te hara, māna e kai; me kai ki te wāhi tapu, ki te marae o te tapenākara o te whakaminenga.
Ki te pā tētahi mea ki tōna kikokiko, ka tapu; ā, ki te maringi tētahi wāhi o ōna toto ki tētahi kākahu, me horoi ki te wāhi tapu te mea i maringi nei taua toto ki runga.
Ko te oko oneone ia i kōhuatia ai me wāhi; ā, ki te mea i kōhuatia ki te oko parāhi, nā, me mukumuku, ka horoi ai ki te wai.
Mā ngā tāne katoa i roto i ngā tohunga e kai; he mea tino tapu.
Kaua hei kainga te whakahere hara, e kawea nei tētahi wāhi o ōna toto ki roto ki te tapenākara o te whakaminenga hei whakamārie ki te wāhi tapu; me tahu ki te ahi."
"Nā, ko te ture tēnei mō te whakahere mō te hē; he tino tapu tēnā.
Hei te wāhi e patua ai te tahunga tinana patua ai e rātou te whakahere mō te hē; me tāuhiuhi anō e ia ōna toto ki te āta, ā tawhio noa.
Me whakahere anō e ia ōna ngako katoa; ko te hiawero mōmona me te ngako e whiwhiwhiwhi ana ki ngā whēkau,
me ngā whatukuhu e rua, me tō reira ngako, tērā i te hope, me te taupā i te ate, me ngā whatukuhu, me tango tērā e ia.
Ā, mā te tohunga e tahu ki runga ki te āta, hei whakahere ahi ki a Ihowā; he whakahere mō te hē tēnā.
Mā ngā tāne katoa i roto i ngā tohunga e kai tēnā; me kai ki te wāhi tapu; he mea tapu rawa tēnā.
"Ko te whakahere hara, ko te whakahere mō te hē, rite tonu rāua. Kotahi anō te ture mō ēnā; ka riro mā te tohunga nāna tēnā i mea hei whakamārie.
Ā, ko te tohunga nāna i whakahere te tahunga tinana a tētahi tangata, mā taua tohunga anō te hiako o te tahunga tinana i whakaherea e ia.
Me te whakahere totokore katoa, ngā mea e tunua ana ki te oumu, me ngā mea katoa e parāipanatia ana, e meatia ana rānei ki te pāraharaha, mā te tohunga ēnā nāna i whakahere.
Ko ngā whakahere totokore katoa ia i kōnatunatua ki te hinu, ngā mea maroke rānei, mā ngā tama katoa a Ārona; kia rite te wāhi mā tētahi, mā tētahi."
"Ā, ko te ture tēnei mō te patunga mō te pai e tāpaea ana ki a Ihowā.

"Ki te whakaherea hei whakawhetai, nā, me tāpae tahi me te patunga whakawhetai ngā keke rēwenakore i kōnatunatua ki te hinu, me ētahi mea angiangi anō hoki, hei ngā mea rēwenakore i pania ki te hinu, me ētahi keke parāoa pai i kōnatunatua ki te hinu, ā, tunua iho.
Me tāpae anō e ia, hei tāpiri mō ngā keke, ētahi taro rēwena hei whakahere māna, i runga anō i te patunga whakawhetai o āna whakahere mō te pai.
Ā, me tāpae tētahi o tēnā, arā o te whakahere katoa, hei whakahere hapahapai ki a Ihowā, ā, mā te tohunga tēnā, mā te kaitāuhiuhi o te toto o ngā whakahere mō te pai.
Nā, ko te kikokiko o āna whakahere mō te pai, arā whakawhetai, me kai i te rā anō i tāpaea ai; kei whakatoea tētahi wāhi mō te ata.
"Ki te mea ia he kupu taurangi te patunga o tāna whakahere, he whakahere noa ake rānei, me kai i te rā anō i whakaherea ai e ia tāna patunga; ā, i te aonga ake me kai te toenga.
Ko te wāhi ia o te kikokiko o te patunga i toe ki te rā tuatoru, me tahu ki te ahi.

Nā, ki te kainga he kikokiko o te patunga o āna whakahere mō te pai i te toru o ngā rā, e kore e manakohia, e kore anō e kīia nā te kaiwhakahere. Ka waiho hei mea whakarihariha, ā, ka waha tōna kino e te tangata nāna i kai.
"E kore anō hoki e kainga te kikokiko i pā ki te mea poke; me tahu ki te ahi. Ko te kikokiko ia me kai e ngā tāngata pokekore katoa,
ki te kainga ia e tētahi te kikokiko o te patunga mō te pai a Ihowā, me te mau anō tōna poke, ka hātepea atu tēnā wairua i roto i tōna iwi.

Me te tangata anō i pā ki te mea poke – ki te poke tangata, ki te kararehe poke rānei, ki tētahi poke whakarihariha rānei – ā, ka kai i te kiko o te patunga mō te pai a Ihowā, ka hātepea atu taua wairua i roto i tōna iwi."
I kōrero anō a Ihowā ki a Mohi, i mea:
"Kōrero ki ngā tama a Īharaira, mea atu: Kei kainga tētahi ngako, o te kau, o te hipi, o te koati.
Me te ngako o te mea mate māori, me te ngako o te mea i haea e te kīrehe, ka waiho mō ngā tini meatanga kē atu; e kore rawa ia e kainga.
Ā, ko te tangata e kai ana i te ngako o ngā kararehe, e meinga nei hei whakahere ahi mā Ihowā, inā, ka hātepea atu i roto i tōna iwi taua wairua nāna nei i kai.
Kaua anō te toto e kainga, o te manu, o te kararehe rānei, i ō koutou nohoanga katoa.
Ki te kai tētahi i te toto, ka hātepea atu taua wairua i roto i tōna iwi."
I kōrero anō a Ihowā ki a Mohi, i mea:
"Kī atu ki ngā tama a Īharaira, mea atu: Ki te tāpae tētahi i tāna patunga mō te pai ki a Ihowā, me kawe tāna whakahere ki a Ihowā, he wāhi nō tāna patunga mō te pai,
mā ōna ringa ake e kawe ngā whakahere ahi mā Ihowā; ko te ngako me te uma, me kawe tēnā e ia kia poipoia ai te uma hei whakahere poipoi ki te aroaro o Ihowā.
Ā, me tahu te ngako e te tohunga ki runga ki te āta; ko te uma ia mā Ārona rātou ko āna tama.
Ko te hūhā matau o ā koutou patunga mō te pai me hoatu ki te tohunga, hei whakahere hapahapai.
Me waiho te hūhā matau hei wāhi mā te tama a Ārona, māna nei e tāpae te toto me te ngako o ngā whakahere mō te pai.

Kua tangohia nei hoki e ahau i ngā tama a Īharaira te uma poipoi me te peke hapahapai, i roto i ā rātou patunga mō te pai, ā, kua hoatu ki te tohunga ki a Ārona rātou ko āna tama, i roto i te wāhi a ngā tama a Īharaira; he tikanga tūturu tēnei."
Nō te whakawahinga tēnei o Ārona, nō te whakawahinga hoki o āna tama, nō ngā whakahere ahi a Ihowā, o te rā i meinga ai rātou e ia kia whakatata ki a Ihowā, ki te mahi tohunga.
Ko ngā mea i whakahaua mai e Ihowā kia hōmai ki a rātou e ngā tama a Īharaira i te rā i whakawahia ai rātou e ia. Hei tikanga mau tonu tēnei i ō rātou whakatupuranga.
Ko te ture tēnei mō te tahunga tinana, mō te whakahere totokore, mō te whakahere hara, mō te whakahere mō te hē, mō ngā whakatohungatanga, mō ngā patunga mō te pai.
Ko tā Ihowā hoki i whakahau nei i Maunga Hinai ki a Mohi, i te rā i whakahaua ai e ia ngā tama a Īharaira kia tāpaea ā rātou whakahere ki a Ihowā, i te koraha o Hinai.
I kōrero anō a Ihowā ki a Mohi, i mea,
"Tīkina atu a Ārona rātou tahi ko āna tama, me ngā kākahu, me te hinu whakawahi, me te pūru mō te whakahere hara, me ngā hipi toa e rua, me te kete taro rēwenakore;
huihuia anō hoki e koe te whakaminenga katoa ki te whatitoka o te tapenākara o te whakaminenga."
Ā, rite tahi ki tā Ihowā i whakahau ai tā Mohi i mea ai; ā, huihuia ana te whakaminenga ki te whatitoka o te tapenākara o te whakaminenga.
Nā, ka mea a Mohi ki te whakaminenga, "Ko te mea tēnei i whakahaua e Ihowā kia meatia."
Nā, ka kawea mai a Ārona rātou ko āna tama e Mohi, ā, horoia ana rātou e ia ki te wai.

Ā, i whakakākahuria e ia te koti ki a ia, i whītikiria hoki te whītiki, i whakakākahuria atu hoki te koroka, i meatia atu anō hoki te epora ki a ia, ā, whītikiria ana ki a ia te whītiki whakairo o te epora, kia mau ai te epora ki a ia.
I whakamaua anō te kōuma ki a ia; ā, whakanohoia ana e ia ngā Urimi me ngā Tumime ki te kōuma.
Ā, i pōtaea e ia te pōtae tohunga ki tōna mātenga; i makā iho anō te pāraharaha kōura, te karauna tapu, ki te pōtae tohunga, ki te wāhi ki mua; ko tā Ihowā hoki i whakahau ai ki a Mohi.
Nā, ka mau a Mohi ki te hinu whakawahi, ā, whakawahia ana e ia te tapenākara, me ngā mea katoa i roto, hei whakatapu.
Ā, e whitu āna tāuhiuhinga atu i te hinu ki te āta, nā, whakawahia ana e ia te āta me ōna oko katoa, te takotoranga wai anō me tōna tūranga, kia tapu ai.
I ringihia anō e ia tētahi wāhi o te hinu whakawahi ki runga ki te mātenga o Ārona, ā, whakawahia ana ia kia tapu.

Ā, i ārahina mai e Mohi ngā tama a Ārona, ā, whakakākahuria ana ngā koti ki a rātou, whītikiria ana hoki ngā whītiki ki a rātou, pōtaea ana hoki ngā pōtae ki a rātou; ko tā Ihowā hoki i whakahau ai ki a Mohi.
Ā, i kawea anō e ia te pūru mō te whakahere hara; nā, ka popoki ngā ringa o Ārona rātou ko āna tama ki te mātenga o te pūru mō te whakahere hara,

ā, patua iho e ia. Ā, ka tango a Mohi i te toto, ā pania atu ana ki tōna maihao ki ngā haona o te āta ā tawhio noa, ā, horohoroa ana e ia te āta, ringihia ana hoki e ia te toto ki te tūranga o te āta, ā, whakatapua ana, hei whakamārie mōna.
Nā, ka tango ia i ngā ngako katoa o ngā whēkau, me te taupā o te ate, me ngā whatukuhu e rua, me tō reira ngako, ā, tahuna ana e Mohi ki te āta.
Ko te pūru ia me tōna hiako, ōna kikokiko, me tōna paru, i tahuna e ia ki te ahi i waho o te puni; i pērātia anō me tā Ihowā i whakahau ai ki a Mohi.
I kawea anō e ia te hipi toa mō te tahunga tinana, ā, ka popoki ngā ringa o Ārona rātou ko āna tama ki te mātenga o te hipi,
ā, patua iho e ia. Ā, tāuhiuhia atu ana te toto e Mohi ki te āta ā tawhio noa.
Nā, ka tapatapahia te hipi; ā, tahuna ana te pane e Mohi, me ngā tapahanga, me te ngako.

Nā, ka horoia e ia ngā whēkau, me ngā waewae ki te wai; ā, tahuna katoatia ana e Mohi te hipi ki runga ki te āta; he tahunga tinana tērā, he kakara reka, he whakahere ahi ki a Ihowā; ko tā Ihowā hoki i whakahau ai ki a Mohi.
Nā, ka kawea e ia te rua o ngā hipi toa, te hipi mō te whakatohungatanga; ā, ka popoki ngā ringa o Ārona rātou ko āna tama ki te mātenga o te hipi.

Ā patua iho e ia; nā, ka tangohia e Mohi tētahi wāhi o ōna toto, ā, pania ana e ia ki te matamata o te taringa matau o Ārona, ki te koromatua anō o tōna ringa matau, ki te koromatua anō hoki o tōna waewae matau.

Nā, ka ārahina e ia ngā tama a Ārona, ā, pania ana e Mohi tētahi wāhi o ngā toto ki te matamata o ō rātou taringa matau, ki ngā koromatua hoki o ō rātou ringa matau, ki ngā koromatua anō hoki o ō rātou waewae matau; ā, ka tāuhiuhia e Mohi te toto ki te āta ā tawhio noa.
Nā, ka tangohia e ia te ngako me te hiawero, me ngā ngako katoa o ngā whēkau, me te taupā o te ate, me ngā whatukuhu e rua, me tō reira ngako, me te hūhā matau.

I tangohia anō e ia i roto i te kete taro rēwenakore i te aroaro o Ihowā, kotahi keke rēwenakore, kotahi keke taro hinu me tētahi o ngā mea angiangi, ā, makā iho e ia ki runga ki te ngako, ki runga hoki ki te hūhā matau.
Ā, hoatutia katoatia ana e ia ki ngā ringa o Ārona, ki ngā ringa anō o āna tama, ā, poipoia ana hei whakahere poipoi ki te aroaro o Ihowā.
Nā, ka tangohia e Mohi i ō rātou ringa, ā, tahuna ana ki runga ki te āta, ki runga ki te tahunga tinana: hei whakatohunga; hei kakara reka, hei whakahere ahi ki a Ihowā.
Nā, ka tangohia e Mohi te uma, ā, poipoia ana e ia hei whakahere poipoi ki te aroaro o Ihowā; i a Mohi tēnā wāhi o te hipi toa o te whakatohungatanga; ko tā Ihowā hoki i whakahau ai ki a Mohi.

Nā, ka tango a Mohi i tētahi wāhi o te hinu whakawahi, o te toto anō i runga i te āta, ā, tāuhiuhia ana e ia ki a Ārona, ki ōna kākahu, ki a rātou tahi anō ko āna tama, ki ngā kākahu anō o āna tama; ā, whakatapua ana e ia a Ārona, ōna kākahu, āna tama, me ngā kākahu o āna tama.

Nā, ka mea a Mohi ki a Ārona rātou ko āna tama, "Kōhuatia te kikokiko ki te whatitoka o te tapenākara o te whakaminenga; kainga hoki ki reira me te taro i te kete o te whakatohungatanga; kia rite ki tāku i whakahau ai, i mea ai, ‘Me kai e Ārona rātou ko āna tama’;
ā, ko te toenga o te kikokiko, o te taro, me tahu ki te ahi.

Nā, kaua koutou e puta i te whatitoka o te tapenākara o te whakaminenga kia whitu rā anō ngā rā, kia taka rā anō ngā rā o tō koutou whakatohungatanga; e whitu hoki ngā rā e whakatohunga ai ia i a koutou.
Ko ngā mea i meatia ināianei, he mea whakahau mai nā Ihowā kia meatia, hei whakamārie mō koutou.

Ā, me noho koutou ki te whatitoka o te tapenākara o te whakaminenga i te ao, i te pō, kia whitu rā anō ngā rā, ki te tiaki i ngā mea a Ihowā, kei mate koutou; ko te mea hoki tēnei i whakahaua ki ahau."
Nā, ka meatia e Ārona, rātou ko āna tama, ngā whakahau katoa a Ihowā, i kōrerotia e Mohi.
Ā, i te waru o ngā rā ka karangatia e Mohi a Ārona rātou ko āna tama, ko ngā kaumātua o Īharaira;
ā, ka mea ia ki a Ārona, "Tīkina tētahi kūao kau māu, hei whakahere hara, me tētahi hipi toa hei tahunga tinana, hei te mea kohakore, ka whakahere ai ki te aroaro o Ihowā.
Ā, me kōrero koe ki ngā tama a Īharaira, me kī atu: ‘Tīkina he koati toa mā koutou hei whakahere hara; me tētahi kūao kau, me tētahi reme, hei te tau tahi, hei te mea kohakore, hei tahunga tinana;

me tētahi pūru, me tētahi hipi toa hei whakahere mō te pai, hei patunga tapu ki te aroaro o Ihowā; me tētahi whakahere totokore, hei te mea konatu ki te hinu; ko āianei hoki a Ihowā puta mai ai ki a koutou.’ "
Nā, ka kawea e rātou tā Mohi i whakahau ai ki te roro o te tapenākara o te whakaminenga; ā, ka whakatata katoa te whakaminenga, ka tū hoki ki te aroaro o Ihowā.
Nā, ka mea a Mohi, "Ko te mea tēnei i whakahaua mai nei e Ihowā kia meatia e koutou; ā, ka puta mai te korōria o Ihowā ki a koutou."

Ā, ka mea a Mohi ki a Ārona, "Whakatata ki te āta, mahia tāu whakahere hara, me tāu tahunga tinana, ka whakamārie ai mōu, mō te iwi hoki. Ka whakahere atu ai hoki i te whakahere a te iwi, ka whakamārie ai mō rātou, ko tā Ihowā hoki i whakahau ai."
Nā, ka haere a Ārona ki te āta, ā, patua ana e ia te kūao kau, te whakahere hara, te mea hoki mōna.
Ā, ka kawea e ngā tama a Ārona te toto ki a ia; ā, ka toua e ia tōna maihao ki te toto, ā, pania ana ki ngā haona o te āta, ringihia ana hoki te toto e ia ki te tūranga o te āta.
Ko te ngako ia, me ngā whatukuhu, me te taupā i te ate o te whakahere hara, i tahuna e ia ki runga ki te āta; ko tā Ihowā i whakahau ai ki a Mohi.
Ā, ko te kikokiko hoki, me te hiako, i tahuna e ia ki te ahi i waho o te puni.
Ā, patua ana e ia te tahunga tinana; ā, ka hōmai e ngā tama a Ārona te toto ki a ia, ā, tāuhiuhia ana e ia ki te āta ā tawhio noa.
Nā, ka hōmai e rātou te tahunga tinana ki a ia, tēnā tapahanga, tēnā tapahanga, me te pane; ā, tahuna ana e ia ki runga ki te āta.
Ā, i horoia anō e ia ngā whēkau me ngā waewae, ā, tahuna ana ki runga ki te tahunga tinana ki runga ki te āta.
I kawea anō e ia te whakahere a te iwi, ā, ka mau ki te koati, ki te whakahere hara mō te iwi, ā, patua ana e ia, whakaherea ana hoki mō te hara; i pērātia anō me te tuatahi.
I kawea anō e ia te tahunga tinana, ā, mahia ana e ia, pērātia ana i tō te tikanga.
I kawea anō e ia te whakahere totokore, ā, aohia ana tētahi wāhi e ia, kī tonu te ringa, ā, tahuna ana ki runga ki te āta, hei tāpiri mō te tahunga tinana o te ata.
I patua anō hoki e ia te pūru, me te hipi toa, hei patunga mō te pai mō te iwi; ā, ka hōmai e ngā tama a Ārona te toto ki a ia, ā, tāuhiuhia ana e ia ki te āta ā tawhio noa,
me te ngako o te pūru; ā, o te hipi toa – ko te hiawero mōmona, me te whiwhiwhiwhi o ngā whēkau, me ngā whatukuhu, me te taupā i te ate –
ā, i makā iho e rātou ngā ngako ki runga ki ngā uma, ā, tahuna ana e ia ngā ngako ki runga ki te āta.
I poipoia anō e Ārona ngā uma me te hūhā matau hei whakahere poipoi ki te aroaro o Ihowā; i pērātia anō me tā Mohi i whakahau ai.
Kātahi ka whakarewaina atu e Ārona ōna ringa ki te iwi, ā, manaakitia iho rātou e ia; nā, ka heke iho ia i te meatanga i te whakahere hara, i te tahunga tinana, i ngā whakahere mō te pai.
Nā, ka haere a Mohi rāua ko Ārona ki roto ki te tapenākara o te whakaminenga, ā, ka puta mai anō, ka manaaki hoki i te iwi; nā, ka puta mai te korōria o Ihowā ki te iwi katoa.
I puta mai anō he ahi i te aroaro o Ihowā, ā, pau ake te tahunga tinana, me ngā ngako, i runga i te āta; ā, nō te kitenga o te iwi katoa, ka hāmama rātou, ā, kūpapa ana ki raro.

Nā, ka mau a Nātapa rāua ko Apihu, ngā tama a Ārona, ki ā rāua tahu kakara, ā, makā ana he ahi ki roto, ā, whakatakotoria iho e rāua he whakakakara ki runga, nā, whakaherea ana e rāua he ahi kē ki te aroaro o Ihowā, he mea kīhai i whakahaua e ia ki a rāua.
Nā, ko te putanga mai o te ahi i te aroaro o Ihowā, ā, pau ake rāua, ā, mate iho rāua i te aroaro o Ihowā.

Nā, ka mea a Mohi ki a Ārona, "Ko te mea tēnei i kōrero rā a Ihowā, i mea rā, ‘Me whakatapu ahau e te hunga katoa e whakatata mai ana ki ahau, me whakakorōria anō hoki ahau ki te aroaro o te iwi katoa.’ " Ā, whakarongo puku ana a Ārona.
Nā, ka karanga a Mohi ki a Mihāera rāua ko Eritapana, ngā tama a Utiere matua kēkē o Ārona, ka mea ki a rāua, "Haere mai, maua atu ō kōrua tuākana i mua i te wāhi tapu, ki waho o te puni."
Nā, ka haere rāua, ka mau i a rāua i roto i ō rāua koti ki waho o te puni; i pērā anō rāua me tā Mohi i kī ai.

Nā, ka mea a Mohi ki a Ārona, rātou ko āna tama ko Ereātara, ko Itamara, "Kaua ngā makawe o ō koutou mātenga e waiho kia mahora noa, kaua anō hoki e haea ō koutou kākahu; kei mate koutou, kei rīria hoki te iwi katoa. Engari kia tangihia e ō koutou tēina, e te whare katoa o Īharaira, te tahunga i tahuna nei e Ihowā.
Kaua hoki koutou e puta i te whatitoka o te tapenākara o te whakaminenga, kei mate koutou; kei runga hoki i a koutou te hinu whakawahi a Ihowā." Nā, ka meatia e rātou tā Mohi i kōrero ai.
Nā, ka kōrero a Ihowā ki a Ārona, ka mea,
"Kaua e inumia he wāina, tētahi wai whakahaurangi rānei, e koutou tahi ko āu tama, ina haere ki te tapenākara o te whakaminenga, kei mate koutou. Hei tikanga pūmau tēnei ki ō koutou whakatupuranga.
Kia taea ai hoki te wehe, te tapu me te noa, te poke me te pokekore;
kia taea ai hoki te whakaako i ngā tama a Īharaira ki ngā tikanga katoa i kōrerotia e Ihowā ki a rātou, arā e Mohi."

I kōrero anō a Mohi ki a Ārona, ki āna tama anō i ora, ki a Ereātara, ki a Itamara: "Tīkina te whakahere totokore e toe ana o ngā whakahere ahi a Ihowā, ka kai rēwenakore ai ki te taha o te āta, he tino tapu hoki;
ā, me kai ki te wāhi tapu, ko taua wāhi hoki o ngā whakahere ahi a Ihowā māu, mā āu tama hoki; ko te mea tēnā i whakahaua ki ahau.

Ko te uma poipoi me te hūhā hapahapai me kai ki te wāhi pokekore, e koe, e koutou tahi ko āu tama, ko āu tamāhine; i whakaritea hoki ēnā hei wāhi māu, hei wāhi hoki mā āu tama, he mea hōmai nō roto i ngā patunga mō te pai a ngā tama a Īharaira."

Me kawe tahi mai e rātou te hūhā hapahapai, te uma poipoi, me te ngako mō ngā whakahere ahi, ā, ka poipoia hei whakahere poipoi ki te aroaro o Ihowā; ā, ka waiho mā koutou tahi ko āu tama; hei tikanga pūmau tēnei; ko tā Ihowā hoki i whakahau ai.
Nā, ka āta rapu a Mohi i te koati o te whakahere hara, nā, kua tahuna – nā, ka riri ia ki a Ereātara rāua ko Itamara, ki ngā tama a Ārona i ora, ka mea,

"He aha tē kainga ai e koutou te whakahere hara ki te wāhi tapu, he tino tapu nei hoki, ā, kua hōmai anō mā koutou, mā koutou hoki e waha te kino o te whakaminenga, e whakamārie hoki mō rātou ki te aroaro o Ihowā?
Titiro hoki, kāhore anō ōna toto i kawea ki roto ki te wāhi tapu; ko te tikanga kia kainga tēnā e koutou ki te wāhi tapu, ko tāku hoki i whakahau ai."

Nā, ka mea atu a Ārona ki a Mohi, "Nanā, nōnāianei i whakaherea ai e rātou tā rātou whakahere hara, me tā rātou tahunga tinana, ki te aroaro o Ihowā; ā, kua pā mai ēnei mea ki ahau! Ā, me i kainga te whakahere hara e ahau ināianei, tērā rānei e manakohia mai e Ihowā?"
Ā, ka rongo a Mohi, nā, ka whakaae.
Ā, i kōrero a Ihowā ki a Mohi rāua ko Ārona, i mea ki a rāua:
"Kōrero ki ngā tama a Īharaira, mea atu: Ko ngā kīrehe ēnei e kainga e koutou o ngā kararehe katoa i runga i te whenua.
Ko ngā mea katoa i roto i ngā kararehe e tararua ana te matimati, e tino mawehe ana hoki te tītorehanga, e whakahoki ake ana hoki i te kai, ko tēnā tā koutou e kai ai.

"Otiia, kaua e kainga ēnei o ngā mea e whakahoki ake ana i te kai, o ngā mea hoki e tararua ana te matimati: ko te kāmera, nō te mea e whakahoki ake ana anō ia i te kai, otiia kāhore i tararua te matimati; hei mea poke tēnā ki a koutou.
Me te koni, nō te mea e whakahoki ake ana anō ia i te kai, otiia kāhore i tararua te matimati; hei mea poke ia ki a koutou.
Me te hea, nō te mea e whakahoki ake ana anō ia i te kai, otiia kāhore i tararua te matimati; hei mea poke ia ki a koutou.
Me te poaka, ahakoa e tararua ana te matimati, e tino mawehe ana hoki te tītorehanga, kāhore e whakahokia ake te kai; hei mea poke ia ki a koutou.
Kaua e kainga tētahi wāhi o ō rātou kikokiko, kaua anō e pā ki ō rātou tinana mate; hei poke ēnā ki a koutou.
"Ko ēnei ā koutou e kai ai o ngā mea katoa o roto o ngā wai. Ko ngā mea katoa o ngā wai, o ngā moana, o ngā awa, he tara ō rātou, he unahi, ko ēnā ā koutou e kai ai.
Ā, ko ngā mea katoa kāhore he tara, kāhore he unahi, o ngā moana, o ngā awa, o roto o ngā mea katoa e tere ana i ngā wai, o ngā mea ora katoa o ngā wai; hei mea whakarihariha ēnā ki a koutou.
Inā, hei mea whakarihariha anō ēnā ki a koutou; kei kainga tētahi wāhi o ō rātou kikokiko e koutou, ā, me whakarihariha atu ki ō rātou tinana mate.
Ko ngā mea katoa o ngā wai kāhore he tara, kāhore he unahi, hei mea whakarihariha ēnā ki a koutou.
"Ko ēnei anō o ngā manu ā koutou e whakarihariha ai; e kore e kainga, he whakarihariha hoki: ko te ēkara, ko te wāwāhi-iwi, ko te ahipare,
ko te whatura, ko te kāiaia, me ngā mea pērā;
ko ngā raweni katoa, me ngā mea pērā;
me te otereti, me te kāhu pō, me te koekoeā, me te kāhu, me ngā mea pērā,
me te ruru nohinohi, me te kawau, me te ruru nui,
me te wani, me te perikana, me te kia ēkara,
me te tāka, me te heroni, me ngā mea pērā, me te hupou, me te pekapeka.
"Ko ngā mea ngōkingōki katoa e rere ā-manu ana, e whā ngā waewae hei haere, me whakarihariha atu e koutou.
Otiia, me kai anō ēnei e koutou o ngā mea ngōkingōki katoa e rere ā-manu ana, e whā nei ngā waewae hei haere, ā, he waewae anō ō rātou kei runga ake i ngā raparapa, hei mokowhiti i runga i te whenua.

Ko ēnei o rātou e kainga e koutou; ko te māwhitiwhiti, me ngā mea e rite ana ki a ia, me te tātarakihi, me ngā mea e rite ana ki a ia, me te pākauroharoha, me ngā mea e rite ana ki a ia, me te koeke, me ngā mea e rite ana ki a ia.
Ko ngā mea ngōkingōki kē atu ia, ko ngā mea rere ā-manu, e whā nei ō rātou waewae, me whakarihariha atu e koutou."
"He mea hoki ēnei e poke ai koutou; ki te pā tētahi ki ō rātou tinana mate, ka poke ā ahiahi noa.
Ā, ki te mauria e te tangata tētahi wāhi o ō rātou tinana mate, me horoi e ia ōna kākahu, ka poke hoki ia ā ahiahi noa.

"Ko ngā kararehe katoa e tararua ana te matimati, ā, kāhore anō i tino mawehe te tītorehanga, kāhore rānei e whakahoki ake i te kai, hei mea poke ki a koutou; ka poke ngā tāngata katoa e pā ana ki a rātou.

Nā, ko ngā mea katoa he tū ā-ringaringa nei ngā waewae e haere ai rātou, o roto o ngā kīrehe katoa e whā nei ngā waewae hei haere, hei mea poke ēnā ki a koutou; ki te pā tētahi ki ō rātou tinana mate, ka poke ia ā ahiahi noa.
Ā, ki te mauria e tētahi te tinana mate o tētahi o rātou, me horoi e ia ōna kākahu, ka poke hoki ia ā ahiahi noa; kia poke ēnā ki a koutou.
"Ka poke anō hoki ēnei ki a koutou o ngā mea ngōkingōki katoa e ngōkingōki ana i runga i te whenua: ko te wīhara, ko te kiore, me te tuatara, me ngā mea e rite ana ki a ia,
me te koka, me te korokotaera, me te mokomoko, me te moeone, me te kamiriona.
Kia poke ēnei ki a koutou o ngā mea ngōkingōki katoa; ki te pā atu tētahi ki a rātou, ina mate, ka poke ia ā ahiahi noa.

Ā, ki te taka tētahi o rātou, ina mate, ki runga ki tētahi mea, ka poke taua mea; ahakoa he oko rākau, he mea kākahu, hiako rānei, pēke rānei; ahakoa he oko aha rānei, aha rānei, e meatia ai tētahi mea, me maka ki te wai, ā, ka poke ā ahiahi noa; kātahi ka kore te poke.
Ā, ki te taka tētahi o rātou ki roto ki tētahi oko oneone, ahakoa he aha rānei, he aha rānei, kei roto, kua poke, ā, me wāhi.
Ki te maringi taua wai ki runga ki tētahi o ngā kai e kainga ana, ka poke; ka poke anō hoki ngā wai katoa e inumia ana i roto i aua oko katoa.
Ka poke anō hoki ngā mea katoa kua taka nei tētahi wāhi o ō rātou tinana mate ki runga; ahakoa oumu, tūranga kōhua rānei, me wāhi kia ngotangota; he mea poke hoki, ā, ka poke anō ki a koutou.
Otiia ki te mea he puna, he poka rānei, he nui nei te wai, kāhore ōna poke; ki te pā ia tētahi ki ō rātou tinana mate, ka poke.
Ki te taka anō hoki tētahi wāhi o ō rātou tinana mate ki ngā purapura e whakatōkia ana, e kore e poke.
Otiia, ki te mea kua oti te purapura te mea ki te wai, ā, ka taka tētahi wāhi o ō rātou tinana mate ki runga, ka poke ēnā ki a koutou.
"Ā, ki te mate māori tētahi o ngā kararehe e kainga ana e koutou; ki te pā tētahi ki tōna tinana mate, ka poke ia ā ahiahi noa.

Ā, ki te kai tētahi i tētahi wāhi o tōna tinana, me horoi e ia ōna kākahu, ka poke hoki ia ā ahiahi noa; ki te mauria hoki e tētahi tōna tinana, me horoi e ia ōna kākahu, ka poke hoki ia ā ahiahi noa.
"Hei mea whakarihariha ngā mea ngōkingōki katoa e ngōkingōki ana i runga i te whenua; e kore e kainga.

Ko ngā mea katoa ko te kōpū hei haere, me ngā mea katoa ko taua tū haere o ngā wae e whā, arā ko ngā mea katoa he maha ngā waewae, i roto i ngā mea ngōki katoa e ngōki nei i runga i te whenua, kaua ēnā e kainga; he mea whakarihariha hoki.
Kei waiho tētahi mea ngōkingōki, hei take e whakariharihangia ai koutou, hei mea rānei e poke ai, e noa ai.

Nō te mea hoki ko Ihowā ahau, ko tō koutou Atua; mō reira me whakatapu koutou e koutou, ā, ka tapu; he tapu hoki ahau; kaua anō hoki e whakapokea koutou ki tētahi mea ngōkingōki e ngōkingōki ana i runga i te whenua.
Ko Ihowā hoki ahau, i kawe mai nei i a koutou i te whenua o Īhipa, kia waiho ai ahau hei Atua mō koutou; mō reira kia tapu koutou, he tapu hoki ahau.
"Ko te ture tēnei mō te kararehe, mō te manu, mō ngā mea ora katoa e tere ana i ngā wai, mō ngā mea katoa hoki e ngōki ana i runga i te whenua.
Kia wehea ai te poke me te pokekore, te kararehe e kainga me te kararehe e kore e kainga."
I kōrero anō a Ihowā ki a Mohi, i mea:
"Kōrero ki ngā tama a Īharaira, mea atu: Ki te hapū tētahi wahine, ā, ka whānau he tāne, nā, kia whitu ngā rā e poke ai ia; kia rite tōna pokenga ki ngā rā o tōna mate paheke.
Ā, i te waru o ngā rā ka kotia te kiri matamata o te tamaiti.
Ā, me noho te wahine ki te toto o tōna purenga, kia toru tekau mā toru ngā rā. Kaua ia e pā ki tētahi mea tapu, e haere rānei ki te wāhi tapu, kia taka rā anō ngā rā mō tōna purenga.
Ki te mea ia ka whānau he kōtiro, kia rua ngā wiki e poke ai, kia rite ki ō tōna paheketanga; ā, kia ono tekau mā ono ngā rā e noho ai ia ki te toto o tōna purenga.

"Ā, ka rite ngā rā mō tōna purenga mō te tama, mō te kōtiro rānei, me kawe mai e ia he reme, hei te tau tahi, hei tahunga tinana, me te pī kūkupa, me te kūkupa rānei, hei whakahere hara ki te whatitoka o te tapenākara o te whakaminenga, ki te tohunga.
Ā, māna e whakahere ki te aroaro o Ihowā, ā, ka meinga he whakamārie mōna; ā, ka kore ōna poke i te rerenga o ōna toto. "Ko te ture tēnei mō te wahine kua whānau nei tāna tama, kōtiro rānei.

Ā, ki te kāhore e taea e ia i ōna rawa te kawe mai he reme, me kawe mai ngā kūkupa e rua, ngā pī kūkupa rānei e rua; ko tētahi hei tahunga tinana, ko tētahi hei whakahere hara; ā, mā te tohunga e whakamārie mōna, ā, ka kore ōna poke."
Ā, i kōrero a Ihowā ki a Mohi rāua ko Ārona, i mea,

"Ki te mea he puku tō te kiri o te kikokiko o tētahi tangata, he paku rānei, he wāhi tū ā-kanapa rānei, ā, ka rite, i te kiri o tōna kikokiko, ki te pānga mai o te repera; nā, me kawe ia ki a Ārona tohunga, ki tētahi rānei o āna tama, o ngā tohunga.

Nā, ka tirohia e te tohunga te mea i pā ki te kiri o te kikokiko; ā, ki te mea kua puta kē, kua mā te huruhuru o te wāhi i pāngia, ā, ki te titiro atu, kua hōhonu iho te mea i pā mai i te kiri o tōna kikokiko, he pānga mai tēnā nō te repera; ā, ka titiro te tohunga ki a ia, ā, ka mea he poke ia.

"Ā, ki te mea e mā ana te wāhi tū ā-kanapa o te kiri o tōna kikokiko, ā, ki te titiro atu kīhai i hōhonu iho i te kiri, ā, kīhai i puta kē, kīhai i mā te huruhuru o reira. Nā, ka tūtakina atu e te tohunga te tangata i pāngia, kia whitu ngā rā.

Ā, ka tirohia ia e te tohunga i te whitu o ngā rā; nā, kua tūturu te mea i pā mai rā, ki tāna titiro iho, ā, kīhai i hōrapa atu te mate ki te kiri; kātahi ka tūtakina atu anō ia e te tohunga, kia whitu atu anō rā.

Ā, ka tirohia anō ia e te tohunga i te whitu o ngā rā; ā, ki te mea kua āhua mangu te mea i pā mai rā, ā, kīhai i hōrapa atu te mate ki te kiri, nā, ka mea te tohunga, kāhore ōna poke; he paku kau. Ā, ka horoia e ia ōna kākahu, ā, ka kore ōna poke.
Mehemea ia kua nui te hōrapatanga atu o te paku ki te kiri, i muri i te tirohanga a te tohunga i a ia kia purea ai ia, me titiro anō te tohunga ki a ia.
Ā, ki te mea ka kite iho te tohunga, nā, kua hōrapa atu te paku ki te kiri, kātahi ka mea te tohunga, he poke ia; he repera tēnā.
"Ki te pāngia te tangata e te repera, nā, me kawe ia ki te tohunga.
Ā, ka tirohia e te tohunga, ki te mea kua mā te puku o te kiri; ā, kua puta kē te huruhuru, kua mā, he wāhi ora anō nō te kikokiko ora kei te puku;
he repera tawhito tēnā i te kiri o tōna kikokiko, me mea te tohunga he poke ia. E kore anō hoki ia e tūtakina atu; e poke ana hoki.
"Ā, ki te hōrapa noa atu te repera ki te kiri, ā, ka ngaro i te repera te kiri katoa o te tangata i pāngia, o tōna māhunga iho, ā tae noa ki tōna waewae, o ngā wāhi katoa e titiro ai te tohunga.
Nā, ka titiro iho te tohunga, ā, ki te mea kua kapi katoa ōna kikokiko i te repera; nā, ka mea ia, kāhore he poke o te tangata i pāngia; kua puta kē, kua mā katoa; kāhore ōna poke.
Otiia, ka poke ia i te rā e kitea ai e ora ana tētahi wāhi o ōna kikokiko.
Ā, me titiro iho anō te tohunga ki te kiko ora, ā, ka mea, he poke ia; he mea poke hoki te kikokiko ora; he repera hoki.
Otiia ki te hoki anō ki te mā te kikokiko ora, me haere ia ki te tohunga;
ā, ka titiro te tohunga ki a ia, ā, ki te mea kua puta kē te wāhi i pāngia kua mā, nā, ka mea te tohunga, he pokekore te tangata i pāngia; kāhore ōna poke.
"Me te kikokiko hoki, he whēwhē nei tō tōna kiri i mua, ā, kua ora,
ā, ka puta ake i te wāhi o te whēwhē he puku mā, he wāhi tū ā-kanapa rānei, he mea mā, āhua pūwhero, ā, ka whakakitea ki te tohunga;

ā, ki te mea, i te tirohanga a te tohunga, nā, kei raro iho i te kiri, ki te titiro atu, ā, kua puta kē, kua mā te huruhuru o reira. Kātahi ka mea te tohunga, he poke ia, he pānga mai tēnā nō te repera; e tupu ana i runga i te whēwhē.
Ki te tirohia ia e te tohunga, nā, kāhore he huruhuru mā o reira, ā, kāhore i raro i te kiri, engari e āhua mangu ana, nā, me tūtaki atu ia e te tohunga, kia whitu ngā rā.
Ā, ki te mea kua hōrapa nui atu ki te kiri, nā, ka mea te tohunga, he poke ia; he pānga mate tēnā.
Ki te tūturu ia te wāhi tū ā-kanapa ki taua wāhi, ā, kāhore e hōrapa atu, he nawe whēwhē tēnā; ā, ka mea te tohunga, kāhore ōna poke.
"Ki te mea rānei he wera anō nā te ahi kei te kiri o tētahi kikokiko, ā, he wāhi mā kanapa, he mea āhua whero, he mea mā rānei kei te kikokiko ora i wera nei;

nā, me titiro e te tohunga. Nā, ki te mea kua puta kē, kua mā te huruhuru o te wāhi kanapa, ā, ka hōhonu iho i te kiri ki te titiro atu; he repera tēnā e tupu ake ana i runga i te wera. Ā, me mea te tohunga, he poke ia; he pānga tēnā nō te repera.
Otiia ki te tirohia e te tohunga, nā, kāhore he huruhuru mā o te wāhi kanapa, ā, kāhore i raro i te kiri, otiia e āhua pōuri ana; nā, me tūtaki ia e te tohunga kia whitu ngā rā.
Ā, i te whitu o ngā rā me titiro te tohunga ki a ia; ā, ki te mea kua hōrapa nui atu ki te kiri, kātahi ka kīia ia e te tohunga, he poke; he pānga tēnā nō te repera.
Ā, ki te tūturu te wāhi tū ā-kanapa ki tēnā wāhi, ā, kāhore e hōrapa atu ki te kiri, otiia he āhua pōuri; he puku tēnā nō te weranga, ā, ka kīia ia e te tohunga he pokekore; he nawe wera hoki.
"Nā, he tāne, he wahine i pāngia te mātenga, te pāhau rānei,

me titiro te tohunga ki te mea i pā mai. Ā, ki te mea he hōhonu iho i te kiri ki tāna titiro; ā, he āhua mā kōwhai nei, he ririki te huruhuru; kātahi ka kīia ia e te tohunga, he poke. He pātito tēnā, he repera nō te mātenga, nō te pāhau.

Ā, ki te titiro te tohunga ki te pātito i pā nei, ā, kīhai i hōhonu iho i te kiri ki te titiro, ā, kāhore o reira huruhuru mangu. Nā, ka tūtakina atu e te tohunga te tangata i pāngia nei e te pātito, kia whitu ngā rā.
Ā, i te whitu o ngā rā ka titiro te tohunga ki te mate; ā, ki te kāhore i hōrapa atu te pātito, ā, kāhore ōna huruhuru mā kōwhai nei, ā, ki te titiro kāhore te pātito i hōhonu iho i te kiri.
Nā, ka heua ia, ko te pātito ia e kore e heua; ā, ka tūtakina atu e te tohunga te tangata i te pātito, kia whitu atu ngā rā.

Ā, i te whitu o ngā rā, me titiro te tohunga ki te pātito, ā, ki te kāhore i hōrapa te pātito ki te kiri, ā, kāhore anō e hōhonu iho i te kiri ki te titiro; kātahi ka kīia ia e te tohunga, he pokekore. Ā, ka horoia e ia ōna kākahu, ā, ka kore te poke.
"Otiia, ki te hōrapa nui te pātito ki te kiri i muri i te whakakorenga o tōna poke;
nā, me titiro anō te tohunga ki a ia; ā, ki te mea kua hōrapa tēnā te pātito ki te kiri, e kore e rapua e te tohunga te huruhuru mā kōwhai; he poke ia.
Ki te tūturu ia te pātito ki tāna titiro, ā, kua tupu te huruhuru mangu ki reira; kua mahu te pātito, kāhore ōna poke; ā, ka kīia e te tohunga he pokekore.
"Ki te mea he wāhi kanapa tō te kiri o te kikokiko o tētahi tangata, o tētahi wahine rānei, arā he wāhi kanapa mā nei;
nā, me titiro e te tohunga; ā, ki te mea he mā mangu nei ngā wāhi kanapa o te kiri o tō rātou kikokiko; he pāpaka tēnā e tupu ana i te kiri; kāhore ōna poke.
"Me te tangata hoki kua horo ngā huruhuru o tōna mātenga, he pākira ia, kāhore ōna poke.
Me te tangata hoki kua horo ngā huruhuru o te wāhi o tōna mātenga whaka tōna mata, he rae pākira ia; kāhore ōna poke.
Ā, ki te mea kua pāngia tētahi wāhi o te mātenga pākira, o te rae pākira rānei, he mea mā āhua whero nei, he repera tēnā e tupu ana i tōna mātenga pākira, i tōna rae pākira rānei.
Nā, me titiro ia e te tohunga; nā, ki te mā āhua whero te puku; i pā ki tōna mātenga pākira, ki tōna rae pākira rānei, ki te rite ki te putanga o te repera ki te kiri o te kikokiko;
he repera ia, he poke. Me tino mea te tohunga, he poke ia; ko tōna mātenga i pāngia.
"Ā, ko te repera i pāngia nei, me haehae ōna kākahu, kia roha noa atu ngā makawe o tōna māhunga, ka ārai i tōna ngutu o runga, ā, ka karanga, ‘He poke, he poke!’
Ka poke ia i ngā rā katoa e pāngia ai; he poke ia; me noho ko ia anake; ko waho o te puni te nohoanga mōna.
"Me te kākahu anō hoki i pāngia e te repera, ahakoa he kākahu huruhuru, he kākahu rīnena rānei;
ahakoa i te whenu, i te aho rānei; i ngā mea rīnena, huruhuru rānei; ahakoa i te hiako, i tētahi mea hiako rānei.

Ki te mea he mā kākāriki, he pūwhero rānei te wāhi i pāngia o te kākahu, o te hiako rānei, o te whenu rānei, o te aho rānei, o tētahi mea hiako rānei, he pānga tēnā nō te repera, ā, me whakakite ki te tohunga.
Nā, ka tirohia e te tohunga te wāhi i pāngia, ā, ka tūtakina atu e ia te mea i pāngia, kia whitu ngā rā.

Ā, i te whitu o ngā rā ka tirohia e ia te wāhi i pāngia; ki te mea kua hōrapa te mea i pā ki te kākahu, ki te whenu rānei, ki te aho rānei, ki tētahi hiako, ki tētahi mea rānei i hangā ki te hiako. He repera ngau kino te mea i pā; he mea poke tēnā.
Nā, ka tahuna e ia taua kākahu, ahakoa he whenu, he aho rānei, ahakoa he huruhuru, he rīnena rānei, ahakoa he mea hiako te mea i pāngia; he repera ngau kino tēnā; me tahu ki te ahi.
"Ā, ki te titiro te tohunga, nā, kīhai te mea i pā i hōrapa atu ki te kākahu, ki te whenu, ki te aho, ki tētahi mea hiako rānei.
Kātahi ka whakahau te tohunga kia horoia te mea i pāngia, ā, ka tūtakina atu e ia, kia whitu atu anō ngā rā.

Ā, me titiro e te tohunga te mea i pā mai, i muri i te horoinga; ā, ki te mea kīhai i rerekē te kara o te wāhi i pāngia, ā, kīhai i hōrapa atu te mea i pā mai; he poke tēnā. Me tahu e koe ki te ahi; kua ngaua a roto, ahakoa i tiwha te taha ki roto, te taha rānei ki waho.
"Ā, ki te mea ka kite te tohunga, nā, kua tāpouri te wāhi i pāngia i muri i te horoinga; kātahi ka haea atu e ia i roto i te kākahu, i te hiako rānei, i te whenu rānei, i te aho rānei.
Ā, ki te kitea anō i te kākahu, i te whenu rānei, i te aho rānei, i tētahi mea hiako rānei; he mea tupu tēnā; me tahu e koe ki te ahi taua mea i pāngia.
Ko te kākahu hoki, ko te whenu rānei, ko te aho rānei, ko te mea hiako rānei i horoia e koe, ā, kua riro te mate, nā, ka horoia anō, ā, ka kore ōna poke."
Ko te ture tēnei mō te pānga mai o te repera ki te kākahu huruhuru, ki te kākahu rīnena rānei, ki te whenu, ki te aho rānei, ki tētahi mea hiako rānei, mō te kī he pokekore, mō te kī rānei he poke.
Ā, i kōrero a Ihowā ki a Mohi, i mea:
"Ko te ture tēnei mō te repera, i te rā e purea ai: Me kawe ki te tohunga;
ā, ka haere te tohunga ki waho o te puni, ā, ka titiro te tohunga, ā, ki te mea kua ora te repera i pā ki taua tangata i reperatia;
kātahi ka whakahau te tohunga kia tīkina mā te tangata e purea ana kia rua ngā manu, hei ngā mea ora, hei ngā mea pokekore, me te rākau hīta, me te ngangana, me te hihopa.
Ā, ka whakahau te tohunga kia patua tētahi o ngā manu ki roto ki tētahi oko oneone, ki runga i te wai rere.
Nā, ko te manu ora me mau e ia, me te rākau hīta, me te ngangana, me te hihopa, ā, ka toua tahitia me te manu ora ki te toto o te manu i patua ki runga i te wai rere.
Ā, kia whitu āna tāuhiuhinga ki te tangata e purea ana i te repera, ā, ka kīia he pokekore, ā, ka tukua atu te manu ora ki te mata o te pārae.

"Ā, me horoi ōna kākahu e te tangata e purea ana, me heu katoa hoki ōna huruhuru; ka horoi anō i a ia ki te wai, ā, ka kore ōna poke. Ā muri iho, ka haere mai ki te puni; otiia kia whitu ngā rā e noho ai i waho i tōna tēneti.

Nā, i te whitu o ngā rā, me heu katoa ōna makawe o tōna mātenga, tōna pāhau, ōna tukemata, arā ōna huruhuru katoa, me heu. Me horoi hoki ōna kākahu, me horoi anō hoki ōna kikokiko ki te wai, ā, ka kore ōna poke.

"Ā, i te waru o ngā rā me tiki e ia ētahi reme toa, kia rua, hei ngā mea kohakore, me tētahi reme uha tau tahi, hei te mea kohakore, kia toru hoki ngā whakatekau parāoa hei whakahere totokore, hei te mea konatu ki te hinu, kia kotahi hoki te roko hinu.
Ā, mā te tohunga, mā te kaipure, e whakatū te tangata e purea ana, me aua mea hoki, ki te aroaro o Ihowā, ki te whatitoka o te tapenākara o te whakaminenga.
"Nā, ka mau te tohunga ki tētahi o ngā reme toa, ā, ka whakaherea hei whakahere mō te hē, me te roko hinu hoki, ā, ka poipoia hei whakahere poipoi ki te aroaro o Ihowā.

Me patu anō e ia te reme toa ki te wāhi e patua ai e ia te whakahere hara me te tahunga tinana, ki te wāhi tapu; i te mea mā te tohunga te whakahere hara, māna anō hoki te whakahere mō te hē; he mea tino tapu tēnā.

Nā, ka mau te tohunga ki tētahi wāhi o te toto o te whakahere mō te hē, ā, ka pania e te tohunga ki te matamata o te taringa matau o te tangata e purea ana, ki te koromatua hoki o tōna ringa matau, ki te koromatua anō hoki o tōna waewae matau.
"Nā, ka mau te tohunga ki tētahi wāhi o te roko hinu, ka riringi ki te kapu o tōna ake ringa mauī;
ā, ka toua e te tohunga tōna maihao matau ki te hinu i tōna ringa mauī, ā, kia whitu ngā tāuhiuhinga i te hinu e tōna maihao, ki te aroaro o Ihowā.

Ā, me pani e te tohunga tētahi wāhi o te toenga o te hinu i tōna ringa ki te matamata o te taringa matau o te tangata e purea ana, ki te koromatua hoki o tōna ringa matau, ki te koromatua anō hoki o tōna waewae matau ki runga i te toto o te whakahere mō te hē.
Ā, ko te toenga o te hinu i te ringa o te tohunga, me riringi ki te mātenga o te tangata e purea ana; ā, ka whakamārie te tohunga mōna ki te aroaro o Ihowā.
"Ā, ka whakaherea e te tohunga te whakahere hara, ka whakamārie hoki mō te tangata e purea ana, arā mō tōna poke; ā muri iho, ka patua e ia te tahunga tinana;
ā, ka whakaekea te tahunga tinana me te whakahere totokore e te tohunga ki te āta. Ā, ka whakamārie te tohunga mōna, ā, ka kore ōna poke.

"Ā, ki te mea he rawakore ia, ā, e kore ēnā mea e taea, nā, me tiki e ia kia kotahi reme toa hei whakahere mō te hē, hei mea poipoi, hei whakamārie mōna, kia kotahi anō hoki te whakatekau parāoa, hei te mea i kōnatunatua ki te hinu, hei whakahere totokore, me tētahi roko hinu;
me ētahi kūkupa kia rua, ētahi pī kūkupa rānei kia rua, ngā mea e taea e tōna ringa; ko tētahi hei whakahere hara, ko tētahi hei tahunga tinana.
"Ā, hei te waru o ngā rā ka kawe ai ki te tohunga hei purenga mōna, ki te whatitoka o te tapenākara o te whakaminenga, ki te aroaro o Ihowā.
Nā, ka mau te tohunga ki te reme mō te whakahere mō te hē, me te roko hinu, ā, ka poipoia e te tohunga hei whakahere poipoi ki te aroaro o Ihowā.

Ā, ka patua e ia te reme e whakaherea ana mō te hē, ā, ka tango te tohunga i tētahi wāhi o te toto o te whakahere mō te hē, ka pani ai ki te matamata o te taringa matau o te tangata e purea ana, ki te koromatua hoki o tōna ringa matau, ki te koromatua anō hoki o tōna waewae matau.
"Ā, me riringi e te tohunga tētahi wāhi o te hinu ki te kapu o tōna ake ringa mauī;
ā, ka tāuhiuhia e te tohunga ki tōna maihao matau tētahi wāhi o te hinu i tōna ringa mauī, kia whitu ngā meatanga ki te aroaro o Ihowā.

Ā, ka pania e te tohunga tētahi wāhi o te hinu i tōna ringa ki te matamata o te taringa matau o te tangata e purea ana, ki te koromatua hoki o tōna ringa matau, ki te koromatua anō hoki o tōna waewae matau, ki te wāhi i te toto o te whakahere mō te hē.
Ā, ko te toenga o te hinu i te ringa o te tohunga, me riringi ki te mātenga o te tangata e purea ana, hei whakamārie mōna ki te aroaro o Ihowā.
Ā, me whakahere tētahi o ngā kūkupa, o ngā pī kūkupa rānei, o ngā mea hoki i taea e tōna ringa;

āe rā, o ngā mea i taea e tōna ringa, ko tētahi hei whakahere hara, ko tētahi hei tahunga tinana, me te whakahere totokore hoki; ā, ka whakamārie te tohunga mō te tangata e purea ana, ki te aroaro o Ihowā."
Ko te ture tēnei mō te tangata i pāngia e te repera, e kore nei e taea e tōna ringa ngā mea mō tōna purenga.
I kōrero anō a Ihowā ki a Mohi rāua ko Ārona, i mea,
"E tae koutou ki te whenua o Kanaana e hoatu nei e ahau hei kāinga tupu mō koutou, ā, ka whakapāngia atu e ahau te repera ki tētahi whare o te whenua e nohoia e koutou;
ā, ka haere te tangata nōna te whare, ka kōrero ki te tohunga, ka mea, ‘Ki tāku titiro, me te mea kua pāngia te whare.’

Nā, ka whakahau te tohunga kia whakawāteatia te whare, i te mea kāhore anō te tohunga i haere noa kia kite i te mea i pā mai; kei poke ngā mea katoa o roto o te whare; ā, ka oti, ka haere te tohunga kia kite i te whare.
Nā, ka titiro ia ki te mea i pā mai, ā, ki te mea kua pāngia ngā tara o te whare, ā, kua whai kōputaputa he mea mā kākāriki, pūwhero rānei, ā, ki te titiro atu kua ngoto ki roto ki te tara.
Nā, ka puta te tohunga ki waho o te whare ki te kūwaha o te whare, ā, ka tūtakina te whare, kia whitu ngā rā.
Ā, ka haere mai anō te tohunga i te whitu o ngā rā, ā, ka titiro; ā, ki te mea kua hōrapa ki ngā pakitara o te whare te mea i pā mai;
nā, ka whakahau te tohunga kia tangohia ngā kōhatu i pāngia, kia makā ki te wāhi poke ki waho o te pā.
Ā, ka mea ia kia waruhia a roto o te whare ā taka noa, ā, me riringi e rātou te puehu i waruhia e rātou ki waho o te pā, ki te wāhi poke.
Ā, ka tīkina e rātou ētahi atu kōhatu, ka whakanoho atu ai ki te wāhi o aua kōhatu; me tiki anō e ia he moata kē, ka pani ai ki te whare.
"Ā, ki te hoki mai te mea i pā mai, ā, ka tupu ki te whare i muri i tāna tangohanga i ngā kōhatu, i tāna waruhanga i te whare, i te paninga hoki;
kātahi ka haere te tohunga, ā, ka titiro; ā, ki te mea kua hōrapa ki te whare te mea i pā mai, he repera ngau kino tō te whare; he poke.
Nā, ka wāwāhi i te whare, i ōna kōhatu, i ōna rākau, i te moata katoa o te whare; ā, ka kawea atu ki waho o te pā, ki te wāhi poke.
"Ki te haere hoki tētahi ki roto ki te whare, i te mea e tūtaki ana, ka poke ia ā ahiahi noa.
Ki te takoto hoki tētahi ki roto i te whare, me horoi e ia ōna kākahu; ki te kai anō hoki tētahi ki roto i te whare, me horoi anō e ia ōna kākahu.

"Ā, ki te haere te tohunga ki roto, ā, ka titiro, ā, kīhai i hōrapa ki te whare te mea i pā mai, i muri iho i te paninga o te whare. Nā, ka kīia e te tohunga he pokekore te whare, nō te mea kua kore taua mea i pā rā.
Ā, ka tīkina e ia ētahi manu, kia rua, hei horohoro mō te whare, he rākau hīta, he ngangana, he hihopa.
Ā, ka patua e ia tētahi o ngā manu ki roto ki te oko oneone, ki runga i te wai rere.
Nā, ka mau ki te rākau hīta, ki te hihopa, ki te ngangana, me te manu ora, ka tou ai ki te toto o te manu i patua, ki te wai rere hoki, nā, kia whitu āna tāuhiuhinga ki te whare.
Ā, ka horohoroa e ia te whare ki te toto o te manu, ki te wai rere hoki, ki te manu ora, ki te rākau hīta, ki te hihopa, ki te ngangana.
Engari, me tuku e ia te manu ora ki waho o te pā, ki te mata o te pārae; nā, ka whakamārie mō te whare; ā, ka kore ōna poke."
Ko te ture tēnei mō ngā pānga katoa o te repera: mō te pātito hoki,
mō te repera hoki o te kākahu, o te whare,
mō te puku, mō te paku, mō te wāhi tū ā-kanapa nei.
Hei whakaatu ko āhea poke ai, ko āhea pokekore ai; ko te ture tēnei mō te repera.
I kōrero anō a Ihowā ki a Mohi rāua ko Ārona, i mea:
"Kōrero ki ngā tama a Īharaira, mea atu ki a rātou: Ki te mea he rere tō tētahi tangata, nō roto i tōna kikokiko, e poke ana ia i tōna rere.
Ā, ko tōna poke tēnei i a ia e rere nei; ahakoa rere te rere o tōna kikokiko, ahakoa kua mimiti te rere o tōna kikokiko, he mea whakapoke tēnā i a ia.
"He poke ngā moenga katoa e takoto ai te tangata i te rere; ka poke anō hoki ngā mea katoa e noho ai ia.
Ki te pā hoki tētahi ki tōna moenga, me horoi e ia ōna kākahu, me ia anō hoki me horoi ki te wai, ka poke hoki ia ā ahiahi noa.
Ki te noho hoki tētahi ki runga ki tētahi mea i nohoia e te tangata i te rere, me horoi e ia ōna kākahu, me ia anō hoki me horoi ki te wai, ka poke hoki ia ā ahiahi noa.
"Ā, ki te pā tētahi ki te kikokiko o te tangata i te rere, me horoi e ia ōna kākahu, me ia anō hoki me horoi ki te wai, ka poke hoki ia ā ahiahi noa.
"Ā, ki te tuwha atu te tangata i te rere ki tētahi tangata pokekore, nā, me horoi e ia ōna kākahu, me ia anō hoki me horoi ki te wai, ka poke hoki ia ā ahiahi noa.
"Me te nohoanga hōiho i nohoia e te tangata he rere tōna, kua poke.

Nā, he mea nō raro i a ia, ko te tangata i pā atu, kua poke ā ahiahi noa; ki te mauria hoki e tētahi, tētahi o aua mea, me horoi ōna kākahu, me ia anō hoki me horoi ki te wai, ka poke hoki ā ahiahi noa.
"Nā, ko te tangata i pā tērā i te rere ki a ia, ā, kīhai i horoia ōna ringa ki te wai, me horoi ōna kākahu, me ia anō hoki me horoi ki te wai, ka poke hoki ia ā ahiahi noa.
"Me wāwāhi anō hoki te oko oneone i pāngia e te tangata he rere tōna; ko ngā oko rākau katoa ia me horoi ki te wai.

"Ā, e purea i tōna rere te tangata he rere tōna, nā, me tatau e ia ngā rangi e whitu mō tōna purenga, nā, ka horoia e ia ōna kākahu, me horoi anō hoki tōna kikokiko ki te wai rere, ā, ka kore ōna poke.
Ā, i te waru o ngā rā me tiki e ia, kia rua ngā kūkupa, kia rua rānei ngā pī kūkupa, ā, ka haere ki te aroaro o Ihowā ki te whatitoka o te tapenākara o te whakaminenga, ka hoatu ai ki te tohunga.
Kātahi ka whakaherea aua mea e te tohunga, tētahi hei whakahere hara, tētahi hoki hei tahunga tinana; ā, ka whakamārie te tohunga mōna ki te aroaro o Ihowā mō tōna rere.
"Ki te paheke mai hoki te purapura moenga o tētahi tangata, nā, me horoi e ia tōna tinana katoa ki te wai, ka poke hoki ia ā ahiahi noa.
Me horoi anō hoki ki te wai ngā kākahu katoa, me ngā hiako kei aua mea nei te purapura moenga, ka poke hoki aua mea ā ahiahi noa.
Ki te moe māori hoki tētahi tangata ki tētahi wahine, me horoi rāua ki te wai, ka poke hoki rāua ā ahiahi noa.
"Ā, ki te mea he rere tō tētahi wahine, ā, he toto te rere o tōna kikokiko, me whakamotuhake kia whitu ngā rā. Ka poke anō hoki ngā tāngata katoa e pā ana ki a ia ā ahiahi noa.
"Ka poke anō ngā mea katoa e takotoria ana e ia i tōna whakamotuhaketanga; ka poke anō ngā mea katoa e noho ai ia.
Ki te pā hoki tētahi ki tōna moenga, me horoi e ia ōna kākahu, a ia ake anō hoki me horoi ki te wai, ka poke hoki ia ā ahiahi noa.
Ki te pā atu hoki tētahi ki tētahi mea i noho ai ia, me horoi e ia ōna kākahu, a ia ake anō hoki me horoi ki te wai, ka poke hoki ia ā ahiahi noa.
Ahakoa i runga taua mea i te moenga, i runga rānei i tētahi mea e nohoia ana e ia, ki te pā atu tētahi, ka poke ia ā ahiahi noa.
"Ki te takoto hoki tētahi tangata ki a ia, ā, ka mau ki a ia ōna whakapoke, ka poke, e whitu ngā rā; ka poke katoa anō ngā moenga katoa e takoto ai ia.

"Ā, ki te maha ngā rā o te rerenga toto o tētahi wahine, ā, ehara i te wā e paheke ai, ki te roa atu rānei te rerenga i tō te wā e paheke ai; ka pērā anō me ngā rā o tōna paheketanga, ngā rā katoa e rere ai tōna whakapoke; ka poke ia.
Ka pērā anō ki a ia me te moenga o tōna paheketanga ngā moenga katoa e takoto ai ia i ngā rā katoa e rere ai; ka poke anō hoki ngā mea katoa e noho ai ia, ka rite ki te whakapoke o tōna paheketanga.
Ka poke anō hoki te tangata e pā ana ki aua mea, me horoi anō hoki e ia ōna kākahu, a ia ake anō hoki me horoi ki te wai, ka poke hoki ia ā ahiahi noa.
"Otiia ki te mea kua whakapokekoretia taua wahine i te rere, kātahi ka taua e ia ngā rangi e whitu, ā muri iho ka kore ōna poke.
Ā, i te waru o ngā rā me tiki e ia kia rua ngā kūkupa, kia rua rānei pī kūkupa māna, ā, ka kawea ki te tohunga, ki te whatitoka o te tapenākara o te whakaminenga.
Ā, me whakahere tētahi e te tohunga hei whakahere hara, me tētahi hoki hei tahunga tinana, ā, ka whakamārie te tohunga mōna ki te aroaro o Ihowā mō te rere o tōna whakapoke.
"Nā, me pēnā tā koutou wehe i ngā tama a Īharaira i ō rātou whakapoke; kei mate rātou i ō rātou poke, ina whakapokea e rātou tōku tapenākara e tū nā i roto i a rātou."
Ko te ture tēnei mō te tangata he rere tōna, mō te tangata hoki kua paheke atu tōna purapura moenga, ā poke iho;
mō te wahine hoki e paheke ana, mō te tangata hoki he rere tōna, mō te tāne rāua ko te wahine, mō te tangata hoki i takoto ki te wahine poke.
Ā, i kōrero a Ihowā ki a Mohi i muri i te matenga o ngā tama tokorua a Ārona, i te mea i whakahere nei rāua ki te aroaro o Ihowā, ā mate iho.

I kōrero anō a Ihowā ki a Mohi: "Kōrero ki a Ārona, ki tōu tuakana, kei haere i ngā wā katoa ki te wāhi tapu, ki roto i te ārai, i tērā i mua mai o te taupoki o te āka; kei mate; ka puta atu hoki ahau i roto i te kapua ki runga ki te taupoki.
"Ko ngā mea tēnei hei haerenga mō Ārona ki roto ki te wāhi tapu: ko te kūao pūru hei whakahere hara, me te hipi toa hei tahunga tinana.

Me kākahu e ia te koti rīnena tapu; hei tōna kikokiko ngā tarau rīnena, me whītiki anō ki a ia te whītiki rīnena, me pōtae anō te pōtae rīnena; ko ngā kākahu tapu ēnei; mō reira me horoi e ia tōna kikokiko ki te wai, ka kākahu ai.
Nā, ka mau ia ki ētahi koati kia rua a te whakaminenga o ngā tama a i Īharaira hei whakahere hara, kia kotahi hoki te hipi toa hei tahunga tinana.
"Ā, ka whakaherea e Ārona tāna pūru mō te whakahere hara, te mea hoki mōna, ā, ka whakamārie mōna, mō tōna whare hoki.
Nā, ka mau ia ki ngā koati e rua, ka tāpae ki te aroaro o Ihowā ki te whatitoka o te tapenākara o te whakaminenga.
Nā, ka makā he rota e Ārona mō ngā koati e rua, tētahi rota mō tā Ihowā, tētahi rota mō te koati haere noa.
Ā, ka kawea mai e Ārona te koati i puta nei tā Ihowā rota ki a ia, ā, ka whakaherea hei whakahere hara.
Ko te koati ia i puta nei te rota ki a ia hei koati haere noa, ka tāpaea oratia ki te aroaro o Ihowā, ki te whakamārie mōna, kia tukua ai ki te koraha hei koati haere noa.
"Ā, ka kawea e Ārona te pūru mō te whakahere hara, te mea mōna ake, ā, ka whakamārie mōna, mō tōna whare hoki, ā, ka patua te pūru mō te whakahere hara, te mea hoki mōna ake.
Nā, ka mau ki te tahu kakara, kī tonu i ngā waro ahi nō runga i te āta, i te aroaro o Ihowā; kia kī hoki ōna ringa i te whakakakara reka, tuki rawa kia ririki, ka kawe ai ki roto i te ārai.
Nā, ka maka i te whakakakara ki te ahi ki te aroaro o Ihowā, kia ngaro ai i te kapua whakakakara te taupoki i runga i te whakaaturanga, kei mate hoki ia.
Nā, ka tango i tētahi wāhi o te toto o te pūru, ā, ka tāuhiuhia e tōna maihao ki te taupoki ki te taha ki te rāwhiti; kia whitu ngā tāuhiuhinga a tōna maihao i te toto ki te taha ki mua o te taupoki.

"Kātahi ka patua e ia te koati o te whakahere hara, te mea mō te iwi, ā, ka kawea ōna toto ki roto i te ārai, ā, ka pērā tāna meatanga ki taua toto, me tāna ki te toto o te pūru, ā, ka tāuhiuhia e ia ki te taupoki, ki mua hoki o te taupoki.

Ā, ka whakamārie mō te wāhi tapu, mō te poke o ngā tama a Īharaira, mō ā rātou mahi tutū i ō rātou haranga katoa. Kia pērā hoki tāna meatanga mō te tapenākara o te whakaminenga e tū ana i roto i a rātou waenganui o tō rātou poke.

Kaua anō hoki he tangata mō roto te tapenākara o te whakaminenga, ina haere ia ki te whakamārie i roto i te wāhi tapu, ā puta noa mai ki waho, kia oti rā anō te whakamārie mōna, mō tōna whare, mō te whakaminenga katoa anō hoki o Īharaira.

"Nā, ka puta ia ki te āta, ki tērā i te aroaro o Ihowā, mea ai i tō reira whakamārie; ka tango hoki i tētahi wāhi o te toto o te pūru, o te toto hoki o te koati, ka pani ai ki ngā haona o te āta ā tawhio noa.
Kia whitu hoki ngā tāuhiuhinga a tōna maihao i te toto, ā, ka purea, ka whakatapua, kia mā ai i te poke o ngā tama a Īharaira.
"Ā, ka oti tāna whakamārie mō te wāhi tapu, mō te tapenākara o te whakaminenga, mō te āta, nā, me kawe mai e ia te koati ora.

Nā, ka popoki ngā ringa e rua o Ārona ki te mātenga o te koati ora, ka whāki ai i ngā kino katoa o ngā tama a Īharaira ki runga i a ia, i ā rātou mahi tutū katoa, me ō rātou hara katoa; me uta hoki ki runga ki te mātenga o te koati, ka tuku ai kia kawea ki te koraha e tētahi tangata e noho rite ana.
Nā, ka mauria e te koati ō rātou kino katoa i runga i a ia ki tētahi whenua mokemoke; ā, ka tukua atu te koati ki te koraha.
"Nā, ka haere a Ārona ki roto ki te tapenākara o te whakaminenga, ā, ka unuhia atu ngā kākahu rīnena i kākahuria e ia i tōna haerenga ki roto ki te wāhi tapu, ka waiho hoki ki reira.

Me horoi anō e ia tōna kikokiko ki te wai ki te wāhi tapu, ka kākahu ai i ōna kākahu, ā, ka puta mai ia ki waho, ka mea hoki i tāna tahunga tinana, i te tahunga tinana hoki a te iwi, hei whakamārie mōna, mō te iwi.
Me tahu anō e ia te ngako o te whakahere hara ki runga ki te āta.
"Ko te kaituku hoki o te koati hei koati haere noa, me horoi e ia ōna kākahu, me horoi anō tōna kikokiko ki te wai, ā muri iho, ka haere mai ki te puni.

Ā, ko te pūru mō te whakahere hara, me te koati mō te whakahere hara, nō rāua nei ngā toto i kawea ki roto ki te wāhi tapu hei whakamārie, me mau ki waho o te puni; ā, ka tahuna ki te ahi ō rāua hiako, ō rāua kikokiko, me tō rāua paru.
Nā, ko te kaitahu, me horoi ōna kākahu, me horoi anō tōna kikokiko ki te wai, ā muri iho, ka haere mai ki te puni.

"Hei tikanga pūmau anō tēnei mā koutou; i te whitu o ngā marama, i te tekau o ngā rā o te marama, me whakapōuri ō koutou wairua, kaua rawa tētahi mahi e mahia, e te tangata whenua, e te manene rānei i roto i a koutou.
Ko ā taua rangi hoki te tohunga whakamārie ai mō koutou, hei pure i a koutou i ō koutou hara katoa, kia mā ai koutou i te aroaro o Ihowā.
Hei hāpati okiokinga taua rā ki a koutou, me whakapōuri ō koutou wairua; hei tikanga pūmau.
Me whakamārie anō te tohunga e whakawahia nei ia, e whakatohungatia hoki hei tohunga i muri i tōna pāpā, me kākahu anō ngā kākahu rīnena, ngā kākahu tapu,
me whakamārie ia mō te wāhi tapu, me whakamārie anō mō te tapenākara o te whakaminenga, mō te āta hoki; me whakamārie anō mō ngā tohunga, mō ngā tāngata katoa hoki o te whakaminenga.
"Hei tikanga pūmau tēnei ki a koutou, kia whakamārie mō ngā tama a Īharaira, mō ō rātou hara katoa; kia kotahi meatanga i te tau." Nā, ka meinga e ia tā Ihowā i whakahau ai ki a Mohi.
I kōrero anō a Ihowā ki a Mohi, i mea:
"Kōrero ki a Ārona, ki āna tama, ki ngā tama katoa a Īharaira, mea atu ki a rātou: Ko te mea tēnei i whakahau ai a Ihowā, i mea ai:
Ki te patua e tētahi tangata o te whare o Īharaira he kau, he reme, he koati rānei, i roto i te puni, ki te patua rānei e ia ki waho o te puni,

ā, e kore e kawea ki te whatitoka o te tapenākara o te whakaminenga, kia whakaherea he whakahere ki a Ihowā ki mua i te tapenākara o Ihowā. Ka whakairia he toto ki taua tangata; kua whakaheke toto ia; ā, ka hātepea atu taua tangata i roto i tōna iwi.

He mea kia kawea ai e ngā tama a Īharaira ā rātou patunga e whakaherea ana e rātou i te mata o te pārae, kia kawea ai hoki ki a Ihowā, ki te whatitoka o te tapenākara o te whakaminenga, ki te tohunga, ka patu ai hei whakahere mō te pai ki a Ihowā.
Ā, ka tāuhiuhia te toto e te tohunga ki te āta a Ihowā i te whatitoka o te tapenākara o te whakaminenga, me tahu anō e ia te ngako hei kakara reka ki a Ihowā.
Ā, ka mutu ā rātou patunga tapu ki ngā rēwera i whāia nei e rātou, pūremu atu ai. Hei tikanga pūmau tēnei ki a rātou i ō rātou whakatupuranga.
"Me kī atu anō ki a rātou: Ki te whakaherea e tētahi tangata o te whare o Īharaira, o ngā manene rānei i roto i a koutou, tētahi tahunga tinana, patunga tapu rānei,
ā, e kore e kawea ki te whatitoka o te tapenākara o te whakaminenga, whakahere ai ki a Ihowā; inā, ka hātepea atu taua tangata i roto i tōna iwi."

"Ki te kainga hoki tētahi toto e tētahi tangata o te whare o Īharaira, o ngā manene rānei i roto i a koutou; ka ū atu tōku mata ki taua wairua i kainga ai te toto, ā, ka hātepea atu e ahau i roto i tōna iwi.
Kei roto hoki i te toto te oranga o te kikokiko; kua hoatu anō e ahau ki a koutou mō runga i te āta, hei whakamārie mō ō koutou wairua; ko te toto hoki, nā tōna ora, te mea hei whakamārie.
Koia ahau i mea ai ki ngā tama a Īharaira: Kaua tētahi o koutou e kai toto, kaua anō hoki te manene i roto i a koutou e kai toto.
"Ki te whai hoki tētahi o ngā tama a Īharaira, o ngā manene rānei i roto i a koutou, ā, ka mau tētahi kīrehe, tētahi manu rānei e tika ana kia kainga; me riringi ōna toto, ka tanu ai ki te puehu.

Nō te mea ko te toto o te kikokiko e kotahi katoa āna me te ora o te kikokiko; koia ahau i mea ai ki ngā tama a Īharaira: Kaua rawa e kainga te toto o tētahi kikokiko; ko te toto hoki te ora o ngā kikokiko katoa; ki te kainga e tētahi, ka hātepea atu.

"Ki te kainga hoki e tētahi te mea i mate māori, te mea rānei i haea e te kīrehe, ahakoa tangata whenua, iwi kē rānei, me horoi ōna kākahu, me ia anō me horoi ki te wai, ka poke hoki ā ahiahi noa; kātahi ka kore te poke.
Ā, ki te kāhore e horoia e ia, ki te kāhore hoki e horoia tōna tinana, nā, ka waha e ia tōna kino."
I kōrero anō a Ihowā ki a Mohi, i mea,
"Kōrero ki ngā tama a Īharaira, mea atu ki a rātou: Ko Ihowā ahau, ko tō koutou Atua.

Kei rite ā koutou mahi ki ngā mahi a te whenua o Īhipa, i noho nā koutou. Kei rite hoki ā koutou mahi ki ngā mahi a te whenua o Kanaana, e kawea nei koutou e ahau ki reira. Kei haere i runga i ā rātou tikanga.
Me mahi āku whakaritenga, kia mau ki āku tikanga, me haere hoki i reira; ko Ihowā ahau, ko tō koutou Atua.
Inā, kia mau ki āku tikanga, ki āku whakaritenga; ki te mahia hoki ēnā e te tangata, mā reira e ora ai. Ko Ihowā ahau.
"Kaua tētahi o koutou e whakatata ki tētahi o ōna whanaunga tupu, hura ai i tō rātou kiri tahanga: Ko Ihowā ahau.
"Kei hurahia e koe tōu pāpā, tōu whaea rānei, kia takoto tahanga; ko tōu whaea ia; kei hurahia e koe kia takoto tahanga.
"Kei hurahia e koe kia takoto tahanga te wahine a tōu pāpā; ko te wāhi takoto tahanga ia o tōu pāpā.

"Kei hurahia e koe kia takoto tahanga tōu tuahine, te tamāhine a tōu pāpā, te tamāhine rānei a tōu whaea, ahakoa i whānau ki te kāinga, i whānau rānei ki tētahi atu wāhi; kei hurahia rāua e koe kia takoto tahanga.
"Kei hurahia e koe kia takoto tahanga te tamāhine a tāu tama, te tamāhine rānei a tāu tamāhine, kei hurahia rāua e koe kia takoto tahanga; nōu hoki te wāhi o rāua i takoto tahanga nā.
"Kei takoto tahanga i a koe te tamāhine a te wahine a tōu pāpā, te whānau a tōu pāpā, he tuahine ia nōu, kei hurahia ia e koe kia takoto tahanga.
"Kei hurahia te tuahine o tōu pāpā kia takoto tahanga; he whanaunga tupu ia nō tōu pāpā.
"Kei hurahia e koe te tuakana, teina rānei, o tōu whaea kia takoto tahanga; he whanaunga tupu hoki ia nō tōu whaea.
"Kei hurahia e koe kia takoto tahanga te teina, tuakana rānei, o tōu pāpā, kei whakatata koe ki tāna wahine; ko tōu whaea kēkē ia.
"Kei hurahia e koe tāu hunaonga kia takoto tahanga; ko te wahine ia a tāu tama, kei hurahia ia e koe kia takoto tahanga.
"Kei hurahia e koe kia takoto tahanga te wahine a tōu tuakana, teina rānei; nō tōu tuakana, teina rānei, taua wāhi i takoto tahanga nā.

"Kei hurahia e koe kia takoto tahanga te wahine rāua ko tāna tamāhine, kaua anō e tangohia te tamāhine a tāna tama, te tamāhine rānei a tāna tamāhine, hura ai i a ia kia takoto tahanga; he whanaunga pū hoki rātou ki a ia; he mea kino tēnā.
"Kaua anō hoki e tangohia he wahine ki te taha o tōna tuakana, teina rānei, hei whakatetetete ki a ia; kaua ia e hurahia kia takoto tahanga, me te ora anō hoki tērā.
"Kaua anō hoki e whakatata ki te wahine ki te hura i a ia kia takoto tahanga, i a ia e poke ana i te paheketanga.
"Kaua anō hoki e takoto pūremu ki te wahine a tōu hoa, whakapoke ai i a koe ki a ia.
"Kaua anō e tukua tētahi o ōu uri kia haere nā waenga ahi hei mea ki a Moreke, kaua anō e whakanoatia te ingoa o tōu Atua. Ko Ihowā ahau.
"Kei takotoria wahinetia te tāne; he mea whakarihariha tēnā.
"Kaua anō hoki e takoto ki tētahi kararehe, whakapoke ai i a koe ki taua mea. Kaua hoki tētahi wahine e tū ki te aroaro o tētahi kararehe, takoto tahi ai rāua; he mea anuanu tēnā.
"Kei poke koutou i tētahi o ēnei mea; e poke ana hoki i ēnei mea katoa ngā iwi ka peia nei e ahau i tō koutou aroaro.
Kua poke anō hoki te whenua; koia ahau i mea ai kia tau iho tōna kino ki runga ki a ia; ā, e whakaruaki ana te whenua i ōna tāngata.
Mō reira kia mau ki āku tikanga ki āku whakaritenga whakawā; kaua anō e mahia tētahi o ēnei mea whakarihariha e te tangata whenua, e te manene rānei i roto i a koutou
(nō te mea kua mahia ēnei mea whakarihariha katoa e ngā tāngata whenua ō mua i a koutou, ā, poke iho te whenua);
kei whakaruakina anō hoki koutou e te whenua, ina poke i a koutou, pērā me ngā iwi e whakaruakina nei i tō koutou aroaro.
"Ki te mahia hoki tētahi o ēnei mea whakarihariha e tētahi tangata, inā, ka hātepea atu ngā wairua e pēnā i roto i tō rātou iwi.
Nō reira kia mau ki āku i whakahau atu ai, kei mahia e koutou tētahi o ēnei ritenga whakarihariha i mahia nei i mua i a koutou, kei poke hoki koutou i aua mea. Ko Ihowā ahau, ko tō koutou Atua."
I kōrero anō a Ihowā ki a Mohi, i mea,
"Kōrero ki te whakaminenga katoa o ngā tama a Īharaira, mea atu ki a rātou: Kia tapu koutou; he tapu hoki ahau, a Ihowā, tō koutou Atua.
"Me wehi tērā, tērā, ki tōna whaea, ki tōna pāpā, kia mau hoki ki āku hāpati: ko Ihowā ahau, ko tō koutou Atua.
"Kei tahuri ki te whakapakoko, kei whakarewaina he atua mā koutou. Ko Ihowā ahau, ko tō koutou Atua.
"Ki te whakaherea anō he patunga mō te pai ki a Ihowā, hei te patunga e manakohia ai koutou.
Me kai i te rangi anō i whakaherea ai, i te aonga ake anō hoki; ā, ki te toe tētahi wāhi ki te toru o ngā rā, me tahu ki te ahi.
Ki te kainga hoki tētahi wāhi i te toru o ngā rā, ka whakariharihangia; e kore e manakohia.
Ā, ka waha ō rātou hara e ngā tāngata katoa i kainga ai, nō te mea kua whakanoatia te mea tapu a Ihowā; ā, ka hātepea atu taua tangata i roto i tōna iwi.
"Ina kotia e koutou ngā hua o tō koutou whenua, kaua e kotia rawatia ngā kokonga o tāu māra, kaua anō hoki e hamua ngā toenga o āu hua.
Kaua hoki e hamua tāu māra wāina, kaua anō e kohia ngā karepe taka o tāu māra wāina; me waiho mā te rawakore, mā te tangata iwi kē. Ko Ihowā ahau, ko tō koutou Atua.
"Kaua e tāhae; kaua hoki e teka, kaua anō e tinihanga tētahi ki tētahi.
Kei oatitia tekatia hoki tōku ingoa, kaua anō hoki e whakanoatia te ingoa o tōu Atua. Ko Ihowā ahau.
"Kaua e tūkinotia tōu hoa; kaua hoki e pāhuatia. "Kaua ngā utu o te kaimahi e takoto tonu ki a koe i te pō, ā tae noa ki te ata.
"Kaua e kangā te turi, kaua anō e makā he whakatūtuki ki te aroaro o te matapō; engari me wehi ki tōu Atua. Ko Ihowā ahau.
"Kei whakahaere hē ina whakawā; kaua e whakaaro ki te kanohi o te rawakore, kaua hoki e whakahōnoretia te kanohi o te nui; me whakawā koe mō tōu hoa i runga i te tika.
"Kaua e kōpikopiko i roto i tōu iwi kawekawe kōrero ai; kaua anō hoki e tū kia whakahekea te toto o tōu hoa. Ko Ihowā ahau.
"Kei kino koe ki tōu teina i roto i tōu ngākau; rīria mārietia tōu hoa, kaua e waiho he hara i runga i a ia.
"Kaua e rapu utu, kaua hoki e mauāhara ki ngā tamariki a tōu iwi; engari arohaina tōu hoa ānō ko koe. Ko Ihowā ahau.

"Kia mau ki āku tikanga. Kaua e whakatupuria he uri mō āu kararehe ki tērā atu tū kararehe. Kaua e whakauruurua ngā purapura e whakatōngia e koe ki tāu māra. Kaua anō hoki e meatia ki a koe he kākahu ko tētahi wāhi he rīnena, ko tētahi he huruhuru.

"Ki te takoto pūremu hoki tētahi ki te wahine pononga kua oti te taumau mā te tāne, ki te mea kīhai i utua, i whakahokia, kīhai anō hoki i tukua kia haere noa atu; ka whiua rāua. E kore rāua e whakamatea, nō te mea kīhai ia i tukua kia haere noa atu.
Ā, me kawe e te tāne tāna whakahere mō te hē ki a Ihowā, ki te whatitoka o te tapenākara o te whakaminenga, he hipi toa hei whakahere mō te hē.
Ā, ka whakamārie te tohunga mōna ki te hipi toa, ki te whakahere mō te hē, ki te aroaro o Ihowā, mō tōna hara i hara ai; ā, ka murua tōna hara i hara ai.
"E tae hoki koutou ki te whenua, ā, ka whakatōngia e koutou ngā rākau kai katoa; me waiho ngā hua hei mea kokotikore. Kia toru ngā tau e waiho ai e koutou hei mea kokotikore; e kore e kainga.
I te whā ia o ngā tau ka tapu ngā hua katoa o reira, hei whakamoemiti ki a Ihowā.
Engari i te rima o ngā tau me kai e koutou ngā hua o reira, ā, ka maha ake ōna hua mā koutou. Ko Ihowā ahau, ko tō koutou Atua.
"Kaua e kainga tototia tētahi mea. Kaua anō hoki e rapu tikanga i ngā tohu, i ngā kapua.
"Kaua e whakaporotakatia ngā taha o ō koutou māhunga, kaua anō hoki e whakaahuatia kinotia ngā taha o tōu pāhau.
Kaua e haea ō koutou kikokiko mō te tūpāpaku, kaua anō hoki e tāia he tohu ki a koutou. Ko Ihowā ahau.
"Kaua e whakanoatia tāu tamāhine, e meinga hei wahine kairau; kei riro te whenua i te kairau, ā, ka kī te whenua i te kino.
"Kia mau ki āku hāpati, kia hopohopo hoki ki tōku wāhi tapu. Ko Ihowā ahau.
"Kaua e whakaaro atu ki ngā waka atua, kaua anō hoki e whai atu ki ngā mata māori, whakapokea ai e rātou. Ko Ihowā ahau, ko tō koutou Atua.
"Me whakatika ake koe i te aroaro o te mātenga hina, me whakahōnore hoki te mata o te koroheke, me wehi anō hoki ki tōu Atua. Ko Ihowā ahau.
"Ki te noho hoki te tangata iwi kē ki a koe, ki tōu whenua, kaua koutou e mahi i te kino ki a ia.
Ki tā koutou kia rite ki tētahi o ō koutou tangata whenua te manene e noho ana i a koutou, arohaina ia ānō ko koe; he manene hoki koutou i mua, i te whenua o Īhipa. Ko Ihowā ahau, ko tō koutou Atua.
"Kei hē tā koutou whakahaere ina whakawā, i te rūri rānei, i te pāuna taimaha rānei, i te mēhua rānei.
Kia tika ā koutou pāuna, kia tika ngā whakataimaha, kia tika te epa, kia tika hoki te hine. Ko Ihowā ahau, ko tō koutou Atua, i kawe mai nei i a koutou i te whenua o Īhipa.
"Mō reira kia mau ki āku tikanga katoa, me āku whakaritenga katoa, mahia anō hoki. Ko Ihowā ahau."
I kōrero anō a Ihowā ki a Mohi, i mea:

"Me kōrero anō koe ki ngā tama a Īharaira: Ahakoa nō ngā tama a Īharaira, nō te manene rānei e noho ana i a Īharaira, te tangata i hoatu e ia tōna uri ki a Moreke, inā, me whakamate ia; me āki e ngā tāngata whenua ki te kōhatu.
