Ka ū atu anō hoki tōku mata ki taua tangata, ā, ka hātepea atu e ahau i roto i tōna iwi; mōna i hoatu i tōna uri ki a Moreke, whakapoke ai i tōku wāhi tapu, whakanoa ai hoki i tōku ingoa tapu.
Ā, ki te hunā e ngā tāngata whenua ō rātou kanohi, kei kite i taua tangata, ina hoatu e ia tōna uri ki a Moreke, ā, e kore e whakamate i a ia;
ko reira ū atu ai tōku mata ki taua tangata, ki ōna whanaunga hoki, ā, ka hātepea atu e ahau i roto i tō rātou iwi, a ia, me ngā tāngata katoa e whai ana i a ia, pūremu atu ai, pūremu ai ki a Moreke.
"Ki te tahuri anō tētahi wairua ki ngā waka atua, ki ngā mata māori, whai atu ai, pūremu atu ai ki a rātou, ka ū atu anō tōku mata ki taua wairua, ā, ka hātepea atu i roto i tōna iwi.
"Engari whakatapua koutou, kia tapu anō hoki; ko Ihowā hoki ahau, ko tō koutou Atua.
Ā, kia mau ki āku tikanga, me mahi anō hoki; ko Ihowā ahau e whakatapu nei i a koutou.
"Ki te kangā hoki e tētahi tōna pāpā, tōna whaea rānei, me whakamate rawa; kua kanga e ia tōna pāpā, whaea rānei; ko runga anō i a ia ōna toto.
"Ā, ki te pūremu tētahi ki te wahine a te tangata, me whakamate rawa te kaipūremu ki te wahine a tōna hoa, te kaipūremu rāua ko te wahine i pūremutia.
"Me te tangata hoki i takoto ki te wahine a tōna pāpā, kua hurahia e ia tōna pāpā kia takoto tahanga; me whakamate rāua tokorua, ko runga i a rāua ō rāua toto.
"Ki te takoto hoki te tangata ki tāna hunaonga wahine, me whakamate rawa rāua tokorua; he mahi anuanu tā rāua; ko runga i a rāua ō rāua toto.
"Ki te takoto hoki he tāngata ki a rāua whakatāne ki te pērā me te takoto ki te wahine, he mahi whakarihariha tā rāua, me whakamate rawa rāua; ko runga i a rāua ō rāua toto.
"Ki te tango hoki te tangata i te wahine rāua ko tōna whaea, he mea kino tēnā. Me tahu rātou ki te ahi, te tāne me ngā wāhine; kei whai kino koutou i roto i a koutou.
"Ki te takoto hoki te tangata ki te kararehe, me whakamate rawa ia; me whakamate anō hoki te kararehe.
"Ki te whakatata hoki te wahine ki tētahi kararehe, ā, ka takoto ki a ia, me whakamate e koe te wahine rāua ko te kararehe; me whakamate rawa rāua, ko runga i a rāua ō rāua toto.

"Ki te tango hoki te tangata i tōna tuahine, i te tamāhine a tōna pāpā, i te tamāhine rānei a tōna whaea, ā, ka kite i a ia e takoto tahanga ana, ā, ka kite anō te wahine i a ia e takoto tahanga ana. He mea kino tēnā; ā, ka hātepea atu rāua i te tirohanga a ngā tamariki o tō rāua iwi. Nāna hoki i hura tōna tuahine kia takoto tahanga; ka waha e ia tōna kino.

"Ki te takoto hoki te tangata ki te wahine i a ia e paheke ana, ā, ka hura i a ia kia takoto tahanga; kua takoto kau i a ia tōna puna, kua whakaaturia anō e te wahine te puna o ōna toto; ā, ka hātepea atu rāua i roto i tō rāua iwi.
"Kaua anō e hurahia kia takoto tahanga te teina, tuakana rānei, o tōu whaea, te tuahine rānei o tōu pāpā. E hurahia ana hoki e ia tōna whanaunga tupu; ka waha e rāua tō rāua kino.
"Ki te takoto hoki he tangata ki te wahine a tōna matua kēkē, kua hurahia e ia kia takoto tahanga tōna matua kēkē. Ka waha e rāua tō rāua hara; ka mate urikore rāua.
"Ki te tango hoki te tangata i te wahine a tōna tuakana, teina rānei, he mea poke tēnā. Kua hurahia e ia tōna tuakana, teina rānei, kia takoto tahanga; e kore rāua e whai tamariki.
"Engari kia mau ki āku tikanga katoa me āku whakaritenga katoa, me mahi anō hoki; kei whakaruakina koutou e te whenua ka kawea nei koutou e ahau ki reira noho ai.
Kaua anō e haere i runga i ngā ritenga o te iwi ka peia nei e ahau i tō koutou aroaro; nā rātou hoki ēnei mahi katoa, koia i whakarihariha ai ahau ki a rātou,

i mea ai hoki ki a koutou: Ka riro tō rātou whenua i a koutou, ka hoatu hoki e ahau ki a koutou hei kāinga pūmau, he whenua e rerengia ana e te waiū, e te honi. Ko Ihowā ahau, ko tō koutou Atua, i wehe mai nei i a koutou i roto i ngā iwi.

"Mō reira me wehe kē e koutou ngā kararehe pokekore me ngā mea poke, ngā manu hoki, ngā mea poke me ngā mea pokekore kei ai hei take whakarihariha mō ō koutou wairua tētahi kararehe, manu rānei, tētahi mea rānei e ngahue ana i te whenua, o ngā mea i wehea atu e ahau i a koutou hei mea poke.
Ā, ka tapu koutou ki ahau; nō te mea he tapu ahau, a Ihowā, ā, kua wehea mai koutou e ahau i roto i ngā iwi, kia waiho māku.
"Me whakamate rawa anō hoki te tangata, te wahine rānei, he atua māori tōna; me te mata māori hoki. Me āki rāua ki te kōhatu; ko runga i a rāua ō rāua toto."
I mea anō a Ihowā ki a Mohi: "Kōrero ki ngā tohunga, ki ngā tama a Ārona, mea atu ki a rātou: Kaua tētahi e whakapoke i a ia mō te tūpāpaku o tōna iwi;
engari, mō tōna whanaunga, mō te mea e tata ana ki a ia, mō tōna whaea, mō tōna pāpā, mō tāna tama, mō tāna tamāhine, mō tōna tuakana, teina rānei,
mō tōna tuahine hoki, ki te mea he wāhina, he mea e tata ana ki a ia, ā, kāhore āna tāne; e āhei ana kia poke ia mōna.
Kaua ia, he ariki nei nō tōna iwi, e whakapoke i a ia kia noa.
"Kaua e whakatiwhaia ō rātou mātenga, kaua hoki e heua ngā taha o ō rātou pāhau, kaua anō hoki e haea tō rātou kikokiko.
Kia tapu rātou ki tō rātou Atua, kaua hoki e whakanoatia te ingoa o tō rātou Atua; nō te mea ko rātou hei whakahere i ngā whakahere ahi a Ihowā, i te kai a tō rātou Atua; mō reira kia tapu rātou.
"Kaua rātou e tango i te wahine kairau, i te mea noa rānei, hei wahine; kaua anō hoki rātou e tango i te wahine i whakarērea e tāna tāne; he tangata tapu hoki ia nā tōna Atua.
Mō reira me whakatapu ia e koe, māna hoki e whakahere te kai a tōu Atua; kia tapu ia ki a koe; he tapu hoki ahau, a Ihowā, tōu kaiwhakatapu.
"Me te tamāhine hoki a tētahi tohunga, ki te whakanoa ia i a ia, ki te kairau, kua whakanoatia e ia tōna pāpā; me tahu ki te ahi.

"Me te tino tohunga hoki i roto i ōna tēina, te tangata i ringihia nei tōna mātenga ki te hinu whakawahi, ā, i whakatohungatia hei kākahu i ngā kākahu, kaua e tukua e ia ōna makawe kia mahora noa, kaua anō hoki e haea ōna kākahu.
Kaua hoki ia e haere atu ki tētahi tūpāpaku mate, kaua anō hoki ia e whakapoke i a ia mō tōna pāpā, mō tōna whaea rānei.
Kaua hoki ia e haere ki waho o te wāhi tapu, kei noa i a ia te wāhi tapu o tōna Atua; kei runga hoki i a ia te karauna o te hinu whakawahi o tōna Atua. Ko Ihowā ahau.
"Me tango anō hoki e ia he wahine i tōna wāhinatanga.
He pouaru, he wahine rānei i whakarērea, he wahine noa rānei, he wahine kairau rānei, kaua ēnei e tangohia e ia. Engari, me tango e ia he wāhina i roto i tōna iwi ake hei wahine,
kaua hoki e whakanoatia e ia ōna uri i roto i tōna iwi: ko Ihowā hoki ahau te whakatapu nei i a ia."
I kōrero anō a Ihowā ki a Mohi, i mea,
"Kōrero ki a Ārona, mea atu: Ki te mea he koha tō tētahi o ōu uri i ō rātou whakatupuranga, kaua ia e whakatata mai ki te whakahere i te kai a tōna Atua.
Kaua hoki e whakatata mai tētahi tangata he koha tōna: te matapō, te kopa, te tangata he ihu parehe tōna, i hira ake rānei tētahi wāhi ōna,
te tangata rānei i whati te waewae, i whati rānei te ringa,
te tuarā piko rānei, te mea i pūwhenua te tupu, ki te papahewa, rānei tōna kanohi, ki te mea rānei he pāpaka, he hakihaki rānei tōna, ki te mea rānei kua kōmurumurua ōna mea.

Kaua tētahi o ngā uri o te tohunga, o Ārona, ki te mea he koha tōna, e whakatata mai ki te whakahere i ngā whakahere ahi a Ihowā; he koha tōna, kaua ia e whakatata ki te whakahere i te kai a tōna Atua.
Me kai e ia te kai a tōna Atua, te mea tapu rawa, me te mea tapu.
Otiia kaua ia e haere ki te ārai, e whakatata rānei ki te āta; he koha hoki tōna; kei noa i a ia ōku wāhi tapu. Ko Ihowā hoki ahau te whakatapu nei i a rātou."
Ko ngā kōrero ēnei a Mohi ki a Ārona rātou ko āna tama, ki ngā tama katoa anō hoki a Īharaira.
I kōrero anō a Ihowā ki a Mohi, i mea,
"Kōrero ki a Ārona rātou ko āna tama kia wehea rātou i ngā mea tapu a ngā tama a Īharaira, e whakatapua ana e rātou māku kei noa tōku ingoa tapu. Ko Ihowā ahau.

"Mea atu ki a rātou: Ki te whakatata tētahi o ō koutou uri katoa, puta noa i ō koutou whakatupuranga, ki ngā mea tapu e whakatapua ana e ngā tama a Īharaira mā Ihowā, me te mau anō tōna poke, ka hātepea atu taua wairua i tōku aroaro. Ko Ihowā ahau.

"Ki te mea he repera tētahi o ngā uri o Ārona, ki te mea rānei he rere tōna; kei kainga e ia ngā mea tapu; kia kore rā anō ōna poke. Ki te pā hoki tētahi ki te mea i poke i te tūpāpaku, ki te tangata rānei kua paheke atu tōna purapura moenga;
ki te pā rānei tētahi ki te mea ngōki, e poke ai ia, ki te tangata rānei e poke ai ia, ahakoa he aha rānei, he aha rānei, tōna poke.
Ka poke ā ahiahi noa te tangata i pā ki taua mea, kaua anō hoki ia e kai i ngā mea tapu, ki te kāhore i horoia e ia tōna kikokiko ki te wai.
Ā, ka tō te rā, ka kore ōna poke; ā muri iho, ka kai i ngā mea tapu, nō te mea ko tāna kai tēnā.
He mea mate māori, i haea rānei e te kīrehe, kaua tēnā e kainga e ia, kei poke. Ko Ihowā ahau.
Inā, kia mau rātou ki tāku i whakarite ai, kei whai hara, ā, ka mate ki te whakanoatia e rātou. Ko Ihowā ahau te whakatapu nei i a rātou.
"Kaua tētahi manene e kai i te mea tapu. Kaua te tangata e noho ana ki te tohunga, te kaimahi rānei, e kai i te mea tapu.
Otiia, ki te hokona tētahi tangata e te tohunga ki tāna moni, e kai anō ia; me ngā tāngata anō i whānau ki tōna whare, e kai anō rātou i tāna kai.
He tamāhine hoki nā te tohunga kua riro i te tangata iwi kē, kaua ia e kai i te whakahere poipoi o ngā mea tapu.

Otiia, ki te mea he pouaru te tamāhine a te tohunga, i whakarērea atu rānei, ā, kāhore āna tamariki, kua hoki mai anō ki te whare o tōna pāpā, kua pērā me ia i tōna taitamāhinetanga, e kai anō ia i te kai a tōna pāpā; kaua ia te tangata kē e kai.
"Ā, ki te kai pōhēhē te tangata i te mea tapu, me tāpiri e ia te whakarima o taua mea, ā, ka hōmai tahi me te mea tapu ki te tohunga.
Kei whakanoatia e rātou ngā mea tapu a ngā tama a Īharaira, e whakaherea ana mā Ihowā;
kei meinga rātou kia whakawaha i te kino o te hē, ina kai i ā rātou mea tapu. Ko Ihowā hoki ahau te whakatapu nei i a rātou."
I kōrero anō a Ihowā ki a Mohi, i mea,

"Kōrero ki a Ārona, ki āna tama, ki ngā tama katoa anō a Īharaira, mea atu ki a rātou: Ko te tangata o te whare o Īharaira, o ngā manene rānei i roto i a Īharaira, e mea ana ki te tāpae i tāna whakahere, he kī taurangi, he mea tuku noa rānei nāna, tā rātou e tāpae ai ki a Ihowā hei tahunga tinana;
kia manakohia ai koutou, ko tā koutou e tāpae ai hei te toa kohakore, nō roto i ngā kau, i ngā hipi rānei, i ngā koati rānei.
Kaua rawa ia e whakaherea tētahi mea he koha tōna; nō te mea e kore e manakohia hei mea mā koutou.

"Ki te whakaherea anō hoki e tētahi he patunga mō te pai ki a Ihowā, hei whakamana mō te kī taurangi, hei whakahere tuku noa ake rānei, he kau, he hipi rānei, hei te mea kohakore, kia manakohia ai; kei whai koha.
He matapō, he whati, he kopa, kua whai puku, he pāpaka, he mea hakihaki rānei – kaua ēnā e whakaherea mā Ihowā, kaua anō e hōmai hei whakahere ahi ki runga ki te āta mā Ihowā.
He pūru he reme rānei, e hira ake ana, kua kore rānei tētahi wāhi ōna, e whakaherea anō tēnā e koe hei whakahere noa ake; otiia e kore e manakohia mō te kī taurangi.
Kaua e whakaherea mā Ihowā te mea i romia, te mea rānei i kurua, i unuhia rānei, i pokaia rānei; kaua anō hoki e pēnā i tō koutou whenua.
Kaua anō hoki tētahi o ēnei e tāpaea hei kai mā tō koutou Atua, ina hōmai e te tangata iwi kē; he whakahē hoki kei roto, he koha kei roto. E kore ēnei e manakohia hei mea mā koutou."
I kōrero anō a Ihowā ki a Mohi, i mea,
"Ka whānau he kau, he hipi, he koati rānei, kia whitu ngā rā e waiho ai ki tōna whaea; ā, i te waru o ngā rā, i ō muri iho hoki, ka manakohia hei whakahere ahi mā Ihowā.
Otiia, ahakoa he kau, he hipi rānei, kaua rāua ko tāna kūao e patua i te rangi kotahi.
"Ka patua anō e koutou he patunga whakawhetai ki a Ihowā, hei te patunga e manakohia ai koutou.
Me kai i taua rangi anō; kaua e waiho tētahi wāhi ki te ata. Ko Ihowā ahau.
"Nā, kia mau ki āku whakahau, mahia hoki. Ko Ihowā ahau.
Kaua anō e whakanoatia tōku ingoa tapu; engari me whakatapu ahau i roto i ngā tama a Īharaira. Ko Ihowā ahau te whakatapu nei i a koutou,
i whakaputa mai nei hoki i a koutou i te whenua o Īhipa, kia waiho ai hei Atua mō koutou. Ko Ihowā ahau."
I kōrero anō a Ihowā ki a Mohi, i mea,
"Kōrero ki ngā tama a Īharaira, mea atu ki a rātou: Ko ngā hākari nunui a Ihowā, e karangatia e koutou hei huihuinga tapu, ko ēnei āku hākari."
"E ono ngā rā e mahia ai te mahi; ko te whitu ia o ngā rā he hāpati okiokinga, he huihuinga tapu. Kaua tētahi mahi e mahia; he hāpati tēnā nō Ihowā, i ō koutou nohoanga katoa.
"Ko ngā hākari nunui ēnei a Ihowā, ko ngā huihuinga tapu e karangatia e koutou i ngā wā e rite ai.
Kei te marama tuatahi, kei te tekau mā whā o te mārama, i te ahiahi, ko te Kapenga a Ihowā,
ā, i te tekau mā rima o ngā rā o taua marama anō ko te Hākari Taro Rēwenakore a Ihowā; e whitu ngā rā e kai ai koutou i te taro rēwenakore.
Hei te rā tuatahi he huihuinga tapu mā koutou; kaua tētahi mahi a te kaimahi e mahia.
Engari, kia whitu ngā rā e whakahere ai koutou i te whakahere ahi mā Ihowā; ā, i te whitu o ngā rā he huihuinga tapu; kaua e mahia tētahi mahi a te kaimahi."
I kōrero anō a Ihowā ki a Mohi, i mea,

"Kōrero ki ngā tama a Īharaira, mea atu ki a rātou: E tae koutou ki te whenua e hoatu e ahau ki a koutou, ā, ka kotia ōna hua, me kawe mai tētahi paihere o ngā hua mataati o tā koutou kotinga ki te tohunga.
Ā, māna e poipoi te paihere ki te aroaro o Ihowā, kia manakohia ai mō koutou; me poipoi e te tohunga i te aonga ake o te hāpati.
Me whakahere anō hoki i te rā e poipoia ai e koutou te paihere, he reme toa, hei te mea kohakore, hei te tau tahi, hei tahunga tinana ki a Ihowā.
Ā, ko te whakahere totokore, kia rua ngā whakatekau o te epa parāoa, he mea konatu ki te hinu, hei whakahere ahi mā Ihowā, hei kakara reka; me wāina hoki tōna ringihanga, ko te whakawhā o te hine.

Kaua anō hoki e kai i te taro, i te mea pāhūhū, i ngā puku hou rānei, kia taea rā anō te tino rā e kawea ai te whakahere ki tō koutou Atua. He tikanga pūmau mā ō koutou whakatupuranga i ō koutou nohoanga katoa."
"Me tatau anō e koutou i te aonga ake o te hāpati, i te rā i kawea ai te paihere mō te whakahere poipoi; kia tino rite ngā hāpati e whitu.
Kia tae rā anō ki te aonga ake o te whitu o ngā hāpati tā koutou tatau i ngā rā e rima tekau; ka whakahere ai koutou i te whakahere totokore, i te mea hou ki a Ihowā.
Me kawe mai e koutou i roto i ō koutou nohoanga, kia rua ngā taro poipoi e rua nei ō rāua whakatekau o te epa; he mea parāoa, he mea i tunua rēwenatia, ā, ko ngā tūāpora ēnā mā Ihowā.

Me whakahere tahi anō me te taro kia whitu ngā reme, hei te mea kohakore, hei te tau tahi, me tētahi pūru kūao, me ngā hipi toa e rua. Hei tahunga tinana ēnā ki a Ihowā, te whakahere totokore anō hoki, me ngā ringihanga, hei whakahere ahi, hei kakara reka ki a Ihowā.
Nā, ka whakaherea tētahi koati toa hei whakahere hara, kia rua anō hoki ngā reme toa, hei te tau tahi, hei patunga mō te pai.
Me poipoi ngātahi e te tohunga me te taro o ngā tūāpora, hei whakahere poipoi, ki te aroaro o Ihowā, me ngā reme e rua; ka tapu ēnā ki a Ihowā mā te tohunga.
Me karanga anō i taua tino rā he huihuinga tapu mā koutou; kaua e mahia tētahi mahi a te kaimahi. He tikanga pūmau i ō koutou nohoanga katoa, mā ō koutou whakatupuranga.

"Ā, ka kotia ngā hua o tō koutou whenua, kaua e tino whakapotoa ngā kokonga o tāu māra ina kotia e koe, kaua anō hoki e hamua ngā toenga o āu hua; me waiho mā te rawakore, mā te manene. Ko Ihowā ahau, ko tō koutou Atua."
I kōrero anō a Ihowā ki a Mohi, i mea,
"Kōrero ki ngā tama a Īharaira, mea atu: Hei te whitu o ngā marama, hei te tuatahi o te marama, he hāpati mā koutou, he whakamaharatanga, he whakatangihanga tētere, he huihuinga tapu.
Kaua e mahia tētahi mahi a te kaimahi; engari me whakahere he whakahere ahi mā Ihowā."
I kōrero anō a Ihowā ki a Mohi, i mea,
"Ko te tekau anō hoki o tēnei marama, o te whitu, hei Rā Whakamārietanga; hei huihuinga tapu tēnā mā koutou. Me whakapōuri hoki ō koutou wairua; me whakahere anō hoki he whakahere ahi ki a Ihowā;
ā, kaua rawa e mahia he mahi i taua rangi; he Rā Whakamārie hoki tēnā, e meinga ai he whakamārie mō koutou ki te aroaro o Ihowā, o tō koutou Atua.
Nā, ko te wairua e kore e whakapōuritia i taua rā, ka hātepea atu i roto i tōna iwi.
Ki te mahia hoki e tētahi wairua tētahi mahi i taua rā, ka whakangaromia e ahau taua wairua i roto i tōna iwi.
Kei mahia tētahi mahi, he tikanga pūmau tēnā mā ō koutou whakatupuranga i ō koutou nohoanga katoa.
Hei hāpati okiokinga tēnā mō koutou, me whakapōuri ō koutou wairua; me whakahāpati tā koutou hāpati i te iwa o te marama i te ahiahi; i te ahiahi ā tae noa ki tētahi ahiahi."
I kōrero anō a Ihowā ki a Mohi, i mea,
"Kōrero ki ngā tama a Īharaira, mea atu: Ko te kotahi tekau mā rima o ngā rā o tēnei marama, o te whitu, te Hākari Whare Wharau ki a Ihowā, kia whitu ngā rā.
Hei te rā tuatahi he huihuinga tapu; kaua e mahia tētahi mahi a te kaimahi.

E whitu ngā rā e whakahere ai koutou i te whakahere ahi ki a Ihowā; hei te rā waru he huihui tapu mō koutou; ā, ka whakahere he whakahere ahi ki a Ihowā; he huihui nui tēnā, kaua te mahi a te kaimahi e mahia.

"Ko ngā hākari ēnei a Ihowā e karangatia e koutou hei huihui tapu, hei whakaherenga mō te whakahere ahi ki a Ihowā, mō te tahunga tinana, mō te whakahere totokore, mō te patunga tapu, mō ngā ringihanga, tēnei mea i tōna rangi, tēnei mea i tōna rangi.
Hāunga ngā hāpati a Ihowā, hāunga ā koutou mea hōmai noa, hāunga ā koutou kī taurangi katoa, hāunga ā koutou whakahere tuku noa katoa e hōmai ana ki a Ihowā.

"I te tekau mā rima hoki o ngā rā o te whitu o ngā marama, ina poto i a koutou te kohikohi ngā hua o te whenua, me whakarite e koutou he hākari ki a Ihowā, kia whitu ngā rā. Ko te rā tuatahi hei hāpati, ko te rā tuawaru hoki hei hāpati.

Nā, i te rā tuatahi ka mau ki ngā peka rākau papai, ki ngā peka nīkau, ki ngā peka hoki o ngā rākau pūruru, ki ngā wirou o te awa; ā, ka koa koutou ki te aroaro o Ihowā, o tō koutou Atua, kia whitu ngā rā.
Kia whitu hoki ngā rā o te tau e whakarite ai koutou i te hākari ki a Ihowā. Hei tikanga pūmau tēnei, puta noa i ō koutou whakatupuranga; ko ā te whitu o ngā marama whakaritea ai e koutou.
Kia whitu ngā rā e noho ai koutou i roto i ngā wharau; ko ngā tāngata whenua katoa o Īharaira me noho i roto i ngā wharau.
Kia mōhio ai ō koutou whakatupuranga i meinga e ahau ngā tama a Īharaira kia noho i roto i ngā wharau, i tāku whakaputanga mai i a rātou i te whenua o Īhipa. Ko Ihowā ahau, ko tō koutou Atua."
Nā, ka kōrerotia atu e Mohi ngā hākari a Ihowā ki ngā tama a Īharaira.
I kōrero anō a Ihowā ki a Mohi, i mea,
"Whakahaua ngā tama a Īharaira kia kawea e rātou ki a koe, he hinu ōriwa, hei te mea parakore, hei te mea tuki, mō te whakamārama, kia kā tonu ai ngā rama.

Me whakapai tonu tēnā e Ārona ki waho o te ārai o te whakaaturanga, i roto i te tapenākara o te whakaminenga, ki te aroaro o Ihowā, i te ahiahi ā tae noa ki te ata; he tikanga pūmau, mā ō koutou whakatupuranga.
Me whakapai tonu e ia ngā rama i runga i te tūranga parakore o ngā rama ki te aroaro o Ihowā."
"Me tiki anō e koe he parāoa pai, ka tunu ai kia tekau mā rua ngā keke; kia rua ngā whakatekau o te epa ki te keke kotahi.
Ka whakatakoto ai e koe, kia rua ngā rārangi, kia ono ki te rārangi kotahi, ki runga ki te tēpu parakore i te aroaro o Ihowā.
Me maka anō hoki e koe he parakihe parakore ki runga i tētahi rārangi, i tētahi rārangi, kia ai taua mea i runga i te taro hei whakamahara, hei whakahere ahi ki a Ihowā.
Me whakarārangi tonu e ia, i tēnei hāpati, i tēnei hāpati, ki te aroaro o Ihowā, he mea mō ngā tama a Īharaira; hei kawenata pūmau.
Ā, mā Ārona rātou ko āna tama tēnā; me kai e rātou ki te wāhi tapu; he tino tapu hoki tēnā māna i roto i ngā whakahere ahi a Ihowā; hei tikanga pūmau."

Ā, i haere atu i roto i ngā tama a Īharaira tētahi tama a tētahi wahine o Īharaira, ko tōna pāpā nō Īhipa; nā, ka whawhai tēnei tama a te wahine o Īharaira ki tētahi tangata o Īharaira i roto i te puni.
Nā, ka kohukohu te tama a te wahine o Īharaira i te ingoa o Ihowā, ka kanga hoki. Ā, kawea ana ia e rātou ki a Mohi, ā, ko te ingoa o tōna whaea ko Heromiti, he tamāhine nā Tipiri, nō te iwi o Rāna.
Nā, ka hoatu ia e rātou kia tiakina, mā te kupu hoki a Ihowā te tikanga ki a rātou.
Nā, ka kōrero a Ihowā ki a Mohi, ka mea:
"Kawea te tangata i kanga rā ki waho o te puni; ā, ko ngā tāngata katoa i rongo i a ia, me popoki ō rātou ringa ki tōna mātenga, ka āki ai te whakaminenga katoa i a ia ki te kōhatu.
Me kōrero anō e koe ki ngā tama a Īharaira, me kī atu: Ki te kanga tētahi tangata i tōna Atua, ka waha e ia tōna hara.

Ā, ko te tangata e kohukohu i te ingoa o Ihowā, me tino whakamate ia; me tino āki ia e te whakaminenga ki te kōhatu. Ko te manene rāua tahi ko te tangata whenua ka whakamatea, ina kohukohua e ia te ingoa o Ihowā.
"Ki te whakamate hoki tētahi i tētahi tangata me tino whakamate anō ia.
Ki te whakamate hoki tētahi i te kararehe, me utu e ia; he kararehe mō te kararehe.
Ki te mate hoki i te tangata tētahi wāhi o tōna hoa; me mea ki a ia tāna i mea ai:
he whati mō te whati, he kanohi mō te kanohi, he niho mō te niho; ko te mate i meatia e ia ki te tangata, me mea anō ki a ia.
Ki te whakamate hoki tētahi i te kararehe, me utu e ia; ki te whakamate hoki tētahi i te tangata, me whakamate anō ia.
Kia kotahi anō tā koutou whakawā mō te manene, mō te tangata whenua. Ko Ihowā hoki ahau, ko tō koutou Atua."

Nā, ka kōrero a Mohi ki ngā tama a Īharaira, ā, kawea ana e rātou ki waho o te puni te tangata nāna te kanga, ā, ākina ana hoki ki te kāmaka. Ā, meatia ana e ngā tama a Īharaira tā Ihowā i whakahau ai ki a Mohi.
I kōrero anō a Ihowā ki a Mohi i Maunga Hinai, i mea,
"Kōrero ki ngā tama a Īharaira, mea atu ki a rātou: E tae koutou ki te whenua e hoatu e ahau ki a koutou, nā, ka whakahāpati te whenua i tētahi hāpati ki a Ihowā.
E ono ngā tau e whakatōngia ai e koe tāu māra, e ono hoki ngā tau e tapatapahia ai e koe tāu māra wāina, e kohia ai hoki ōna hua;
ko te whitu ia o ngā tau hāpati okiokinga mō te whenua, hei hāpati ki a Ihowā. Kaua e whakatōngia tāu māra, e tapatapahia rānei tāu māra wāina.
Kaua e kotia te mea i tupu noa ake i tērā kotinga āu, kaua anō e whakia ngā karepe o tāu wāina kīhai nei i mahia; he tau okiokinga hoki tēnā mō te whenua.
Ā, hei kai mā koutou te hāpati o te whenua – māu, mā tāu pononga tāne, mā tāu pononga wahine, mā tāu kaimahi, mā tōu manene hoki e noho ana i a koe;
mā āu kararehe hoki, mā te kīrehe hoki o tōu whenua, ōna hua katoa, hei kai."
"Ā, me tatau e koe kia whitu ngā tau hāpati, kia whitu ngā whitu o ngā tau; ā, ko taua takiwā, ko ngā tau hāpati e whitu, ka kīia e koe e whā tekau mā iwa tau.

Kātahi ka whakatangihia e koe te tētere tangi nui i te tekau o ngā rā o te whitu o ngā marama – ko ā te Rā Whakamārietanga – mea ai koutou kia pakū atu te tangi o te tētere puta noa i tō koutou whenua.

Ā, me whakatapu te rima tekau o ngā tau, ka karanga ai i te haere noa puta noa i te whenua mā ngā tāngata katoa o te whenua; hei Tiupiri nui tēnā mā koutou; ā, me hoki koutou ki tōna kāinga, ki tōna kāinga, me hoki anō ki ōna whanaunga, ki ōna whanaunga.
Ko tēnā tau, ko te rima tekau, hei Tiupiri mā koutou: kaua e rui, kaua e kokoti i te mea tupu noa ake o tēnā tau, kaua hoki e whakia ngā wāina kīhai i mahia.
Ko te Tiupiri hoki ia; kia tapu ki a koutou; ko ōna hua o te māra hei kai mā koutou.
"Me hoki koutou i tēnei tau Tiupiri, ki tōna kāinga, ki tōna kāinga.
Ki te hokona atu anō e koe tētahi mea ki tōu hoa, ki te hokona mai rānei tētahi mea e te ringa o tōu hoa, kaua e tūkinotia tētahi e tētahi.
Kia rite āu utu ki tōu hoa ki te maha o ngā tau i muri i te Tiupiri; kia rite anō ki te maha o ngā tau hua tāna hoko ki a koe.
Kia rite tāu whakanui i te utu o taua mea ki te maha o ngā tau, kia rite hoki tāu whakaiti i ōna utu ki te torutoru o ngā tau; e rite ana hoki ki te maha o ngā tau hua tāna hoko ki a koe.
Ā, kaua e tūkino tētahi ki tētahi, engari e wehi koe ki tōu Atua. Ko Ihowā hoki ahau, ko tō koutou Atua."
"Mō reira me mahi e koutou āku tikanga, me pupuru āku whakaritenga, me mahi hoki; ā, ka noho hūmārie koutou i runga i te whenua.
Ā, ka tukua ōna hua e te whenua, ā, ka kai koutou, ka mākona, ka noho hūmārie hoki ki reira.
Ā, ki te mea koutou, ‘He aha he kai mā tātou i te whitu o ngā tau? Titiro hoki, e kore tātou e rui, e kore hoki e kohi i ā tātou hua.’
Māku rā e whakahau iho tāku manaaki ki a koutou i te ono o ngā tau, ā, ka whai hua mō ngā tau e toru.
Ā, ka rui koutou i te waru o ngā tau, ka kai anō i ngā hua pakoko; ā tae noa ki te iwa o ngā tau, me kai ngā mea pakoko, kia riro rā anō ngā hua o tēnā tau."
"Kaua e hokona te whenua, he mea oti tonu atu; nōku hoki te whenua; he manene hoki koutou, he noho noa ki ahau.
Me whakaae hoki ki te utu e hoki ai te whenua, i tō koutou whenua katoa.
"Ki te rawakoretia tōu teina, ā, ka hokona e ia tētahi wāhi o tōna kāinga, me haere mai tōna whanaunga e tata rawa ana ki a ia, ka utu i te mea i hokona atu e tōna teina kia hoki ai.
Ā, ki te kāhore he kaiutu a tētahi tangata, ā, ka whiwhi taonga ia, ā, ka taea anō e ia te utu.
Nā, me tatau e ia ngā tau i hokona ai, ā, ka whakahoki i te tuhene ki te tangata i hokona atu ai; ā, ka hoki ai ia ki tōna kāinga.

Otiia, ki te kāhore e taea e ia te whakahoki mai ki a ia anō, nā, me waiho tāna i hoko ai ki te ringa o te tangata nāna i hoko, ā tae noa ki te tau Tiupiri. Ā, i te Tiupiri ka riro, ā, ka hoki ia ki tōna kāinga.
"Ki te hokona e te tangata he whare nohoanga i te pā taiepa, e āhei ia te utu kia hoki mai anō i roto i te tau kotahi i muri i te rironga; kotahi tino tau hei whakahokinga māna.
Ā, ki te kāhore e utua, ā tino taka noa te tau, kātahi ka whakapūmautia mō ake tonu atu te whare i te pā taiepa mō te tangata nāna i hoko, puta noa i ōna whakatupuranga; e kore e riro i te Tiupiri.
Ko ngā whare ia o ngā kāinga, kāhore nei he taiepa ā tawhio noa, ka kīia e rite ana ki ngā pārae o te whenua; ka hoki anō ēnā ina utua, ka riro anō i te Tiupiri.
"Ko ngā pā ia o ngā Rīwaiti, me ngā whare o ngā pā e nohoia ana e rātou, e hoki ki ngā Rīwaiti, ahakoa utua i tēhea wā.
Ā, mehemea nā tētahi o ngā Rīwaiti i utu – nā, ka riro te whare i hokona rā me tōna pā i te Tiupiri – ko ngā whare hoki o ngā pā o ngā Rīwaiti tō rātou kāinga pūmau i roto i ngā tama a Īharaira.
Ko te māra ia i te taha o ō rātou pā kaua e hokona; nō te mea he wāhi pūmau tēnā nō rātou."
"Ā, ki te rawakoretia tōu teina, ā, ka wiri tōna ringa i roto i a koe; me atawhai e koe; me noho manene ia, me noho noa rānei i a koe.
Kaua e tangohia i a ia he moni whakatuputupu, he whakanuinga rānei; engari me wehi koe ki tōu Atua; kia noho ai tōu teina i a koe.
Kaua tāu moni e hoatu ki a ia hei mea whakatuputupu, kaua anō hoki āu kai e hoatu ki a ia, me te whakaaro anō ki tētahi whakanuinga ake.
Ko Ihowā ahau, ko tō koutou Atua, i kawe mai nei i a koutou i te whenua o Īhipa, e mea nei kia hoatu te whenua o Kanaana, ki a koutou kia waiho anō ahau hei Atua mō koutou."
"Ā, ki te rawakoretia tōu teina e noho ana i roto i a koe, ā, ka hokona ki a koe; kaua ia e whakamahia e koe ki te mahi pononga.
Kia rite ia i roto i a koe ki te kaimahi, ki te noho noa. Ka mahi anō ia ki a koe, ā tae noa ki te tau Tiupiri.
Ko reira ia mawehe ai i a koe, rātou ko āna tamariki, ā, ka hoki ki ōna whanaunga, ka hoki anō ki te kāinga o ōna mātua.
Ko rātou hoki āku pononga, i whakaputaina mai ai e ahau i te whenua o Īhipa; kaua rātou e hokona hei pononga.
Kaua e taikaha tāu whakarangatira ki a ia; engari me wehi ki tōu Atua.
"Tēnā ko ngā pononga tāne me ngā pononga wāhine māu; me hoko e koe i ngā iwi i tētahi taha ōu, i tētahi taha he pononga tāne, he pononga wāhine māu.

Mā koutou anō hoki e hoko ētahi o ngā tamariki a ngā manene e noho ana i roto i a koutou, ētahi hoki o roto o ō rātou hapū i roto i a koutou, o ngā mea i whānau i a rātou ki tō koutou whenua; ā, puritia iho mā koutou.

Me waiho hoki ēnā e koutou hei taonga tupu e tukua iho kia puritia e ā koutou tama i muri i a koutou; hei pononga rātou mā koutou ake ake. Kaua ia e taikaha tā koutou whakarangatira ki a koutou anō, ki ō koutou tēina, ki ngā tama a Īharaira.

"Ki te whai rawa hoki te manene, noho noa rānei, i roto i a koe, ā, ka rawakoretia tōu teina i tōna taha, ā, ka hoko i a ia ki te manene, ki te noho noa rānei i roto i a koe, ki te toronga rānei o te hapū o te manene;
e whakahokia anō ia mō te utu i muri i tōna hokonga; mā tētahi o ōna tēina ia e whakahoki,
mā tōna matua kēkē, mā te tamaiti rānei a tōna matua kēkē ia e whakahoki, mā tētahi rānei o ōna whanaunga tupu o tōna hapū ia e whakahoki; māna anō rānei ia e whakahoki, ki te taea e ia.

Nā, ka tatau ia, rāua ko te tangata nāna ia i hoko, ka tīmata i te tau i hokona ai ia ki a ia, tae noa ki te tau Tiupiri; ā, ka rite te utu e hokona ai ia ki te maha o ngā tau; kia rite ki ō te kaimahi ōna rā ki a ia.
Ki te maha ake ngā tau, kia rite ki ēnā te utu mō tōna hokinga e whakahokia atu e ia i roto i te moni i hokona ai ia.
Ā, ki te torutoru ngā tau e toe ana ki te tau Tiupiri, nā, ka tatau rāua; ā, kia rite ki ōna tau te utu e whakahokia e ia ki a ia.
Ko tōna noho ki a ia kia rite ki tā te kaimahi e utua ana i te tau; kaua hoki tērā e whakatupu rangatira nanakia ki a ia i tāu tirohanga.
"Ā, ki te kāhore ia e hokona i ēnei tikanga, nā, me haere atu ia i te tau Tiupiri, rātou tahi ko āna tamariki.
He pononga hoki ki ahau ngā tama a Īharaira; ko āku pononga rātou i whakaputaina mai e ahau i te whenua o Īhipa: ko Ihowā ahau, ko tō koutou Atua."

"Kei hanga koutou he whakapakoko mā koutou, kei whakaara rānei he whakapakoko, he mea whaowhao, he pou rānei, kaua anō hoki he kōhatu āhua ki tō koutou whenua hei koropikotanga atu; ko Ihowā hoki ahau, ko tō koutou Atua.
Kia mau ki āku hāpati, kia hopohopo anō ki tōku wāhi tapu. Ko Ihowā ahau.
"Ki te haere koutou i runga i āku tikanga, ā, ka pupuri i āku whakahau, ka mahi hoki.
Nā, ka hoatu e ahau he ua ki a koutou i tōna pō anō, ā, ka tukua ōna hua e te whenua, ā, ka hua ngā hua o ngā rākau o te pārae.
Ā, ka tutuki atu tā koutou patunga wīti ki te whakinga wāina, me te whakinga wāina ki te wā ruinga; ā, ka kai koutou i tā koutou taro, ka mākona, ka ū anō te noho ki tō koutou whenua.

"Ā, ka tukua iho e ahau te āta noho ki te whenua, ā, ka takoto iho koutou, kāhore anō hoki he tangata hei mea i a koutou kia wehi. Ka whakakāhoretia atu anō hoki e ahau ngā kīrehe kino i te whenua, e kore anō hoki te hoari e tika nā waenga o tō koutou whenua.
Ā, ka whāia e koutou ō koutou hoariri, ā, ka hinga rātou i te hoari ki tō koutou aroaro.
Ka whāia hoki te rau kotahi e te tokorima o koutou, ā, ka whati ngā mano kotahi tekau i te rau kotahi o koutou; nā, ka hinga ō koutou hoariri i te hoari ki tō koutou aroaro.
"Ka whai whakaaro hoki ahau ki a koutou, ā, ka meinga koutou kia hua, kia tini; ā, ka pūmau tāku kawenata ki a koutou.
Ā, ka kai koutou i te kai kua roa e pakoko ana, ā, ka whakaputa i te pakoko ki waho mō te hua hou.
Ā, ka whakatūria e ahau tāku tapenākara ki waenganui i a koutou, e kore anō tōku wairua e whakarihariha ki a koutou.
Ka hāereere anō hoki ahau i roto i a koutou, ā, hei Atua ahau mō koutou, ko koutou hoki hei iwi māku.
Ko Ihowā ahau, ko tō koutou Atua i kawe mai nei i a koutou i te whenua o Īhipa, kei waiho hei pononga mā rātou; motu pū hoki i ahau ngā here o tō koutou ioka, ā, meinga ana koutou kia haere tū."
"Tēnā ko tēnei, ka kore koutou e whakarongo ki ahau, ka kore e mahi i ēnei whakahau katoa;
ā, ka whakahāwea ki āku tikanga, ka whakarihariha rānei ō koutou wairua ki āku whakaritenga, ā, kāhore e mahia āku whakahau katoa, engari ka whakatakā tāku kawenata.

Nā, ka meinga anō hoki tēnei e ahau ki a koutou; ka meinga e ahau hei rangatira mō koutou te pāwera, te kohi, me te kirikā, hei ngau i ngā kanohi, hei whakapōuri i te ngākau. Ā, ka maumau tā koutou rui i ā koutou purapura; nō te mea ka kainga e ō koutou hoariri.
Ā, ka ū atu tōku mata ki a koutou, ā, ka patua koutou i te aroaro o ō koutou hoariri, ka meinga hei kīngi mō koutou te hunga e kino ana ki a koutou; ā, ka rere koutou, ahakoa kāhore he kaiwhai.
"Ā, ki te kāhore tonu koutou e rongo ki ahau i ēnei meatanga, nā, e whitu atu āku pakinga i a koutou mō ō koutou hara.
Ka whati anō i ahau te whakapehapeha o tō koutou kaha; ā, ka meinga tō koutou rangi kia whakarino, tō koutou whenua hoki kia whakaparāhi.
Ā, ka poto kau ō koutou uaua; nō te mea e kore tō koutou whenua e tuku ake i ōna hua, e kore anō hoki e hua ngā hua o ngā rākau o te whenua.
"Ā, ki te anga kē atu tā koutou haere i ahau, ki te kore e rongo ki ahau; nā, ka hoatu e ahau kia whitu atu anō ngā whiu ki a koutou, kia rite ki ō koutou hara.
Ka tukua anō e ahau te kīrehe koraha ki a koutou, hei kāwhaki i ā koutou tama, hei whakamōtī i ā koutou kararehe, hei mea i a koutou kia torutoru; ā, ka ururuatia ō koutou huanui.
"Ā, ki te kāhore koutou e hoki ake ki te pai i ēnei meatanga āku, ā, ka anga kē atu koutou i ahau;
heoi, ka anga kē atu hoki ahau i a koutou; ā, ka whiua koutou e ahau, e ahau anō nei, kia whitu atu anō, mō ō koutou hara.

Ā, ka kawea e ahau he hoari ki a koutou, hei tohe i te utu mō tāku kawenata. Ā, ka huihui koutou ki roto ki ō koutou pā; ā, ka tukua e ahau te mate urutā ki a koutou; ā, ka hoatu koutou ki te ringa o te hoariri.

Ki te whati i ahau tā koutou tokotoko, arā te taro, ka tunua tā koutou taro e ngā wāhine kotahi tekau ki te oumu kotahi, ā, ka whakahokia e rātou tā koutou taro, he mea pāuna; ā, ka kai koutou, ā, e kore e mākona.
"Ā, ki te kāhore koutou e rongo ki ahau i ēnei meatanga katoa, ā, ka anga kē atu anō koutou i ahau.
Kātahi ahau ka tahuri kino atu i a koutou; ā, māku nei anō koutou e papaki, e whitu atu pakinga, mō ō koutou hara.
Ā, e kai koutou i te kikokiko o ā koutou tama, ka kainga hoki e koutou te kikokiko o ā koutou tamāhine.

Ā, ka ngaro i ahau ā koutou wāhi teitei, ka tapahia anō hoki ā koutou whakapakoko, ka makā ō koutou tinana ki runga ki ngā tinana o ā koutou whakapakoko; ā, ka whakarihariha anō hoki tōku wairua ki a koutou.
Ka ururua anō i ahau ō koutou pā, ka hoki ō koutou wāhi tapu, e kore anō hoki ahau e hongi ki ā koutou kakara reka.
Ā, ka tūhea i ahau te whenua; e mīharotia ai e ō koutou hoariri e noho ana i reira.
Ā, ka whakamararatia koutou ki roto ki ngā tauiwi, ka maunu hoki i ahau te hoari hei whai i a koutou. Ā, ka tūheatia tō koutou whenua, ka ururuatia hoki ō koutou pā.
"Ko reira koa ai te whenua i ōna hāpati, i ngā rā katoa ōna e takoto tūhea ana, i a koutou hoki i te whenua o ō koutou hoariri; ko reira hoki te whenua okioki ai, koa ai hoki i ōna hāpati.
Ka okioki i ngā rā katoa o tōna tūheatanga; ko te okioki kīhai i a ia i ō koutou hāpati, i a koutou e noho ana i reira.

"Tēnā ko ngā mōrehu o koutou ka ungā e ahau he whakangohe ki ō rātou ngākau i ngā whenua o ō rātou hoariri; ā, ka whati rātou i te ngaehe rau rākau e āia ana; ā, ka rere rātou, ānō e rere ana i te hoari; ā, ka hinga ahakoa kāhore he kaiwhai.
Ā, ka tutetute rātou tētahi ki tētahi, ānō e whāia ana e te hoari, i te mea kāhore he kaiwhai. Ā, ka kore he tūranga ake mō koutou ki te aroaro o ō koutou hoariri.
Ā, ka ngaro koutou i ngā tauiwi, ka pau anō i te whenua o ō koutou hoariri.
Ā, ko ngā toenga o koutou, ka memeha haere i roto i tō rātou kino i ngā whenua o ō koutou hoariri; ka memeha haere rātou i roto i ngā kino ō rātou ko ō rātou mātua.
"Ā, ka whākina e rātou tō rātou kino, me te kino o ō rātou mātua, i tō rātou haranga i hara ai ki ahau, me tō rātou haerenga kētanga atu i tāku –
i anga kē atu ai ahau i a rātou, i kawea ai rātou ki te whenua o ō rātou hoariri; ki te iro i reira ō rātou ngākau kokotikore, ā, ka whakaae ki te pakinga mō tō rātou kino.
Kātahi ahau ka mahara ki tāku kawenata ki a Hākopa; ki tāku kawenata hoki ki a Īhaka; ka mahara anō ki tāku kawenata ki a Āperahama; ka mahara ki te whenua.

Ka mahue anō te whenua i a rātou, ā, ka koa ki ōna hāpati, i a ia e takoto tūhea ana, i te mea kāhore nei rātou: me rātou hoki, ka whakaae ki te whiu mō tō rātou kino. Mō tēnei hoki, āe rā mō tēnei, i whakahāwea rātou ki āku whakaritenga, ā, i whakarihariha tō rātou wairua ki āku tikanga.

"Nā, ahakoa he pēnā, e kore ahau e whakakāhore ki a rātou, i a rātou i te whenua o ō rātou hoariri, e kore anō e whakarihariha ki a rātou, e huna rawa i a rātou, e whakataka rānei i tāku kawenata ki a rātou. Ko Ihowā hoki ahau, ko tō rātou Atua.
Engari, he mea mō rātou, ka mahara ahau ki te kawenata o ō rātou tūpuna, i kawea mai nei e ahau i te whenua o Īhipa i te tirohanga a ngā tauiwi, ki ahau hei Atua mō rātou. Ko ahau a Ihowā."
Ko ngā tikanga ēnei, me ngā whakaritenga, me ngā ture i whakatakotoria e Ihowā ki waenganui ōna, o ngā tama a Īharaira, ki Maunga Hinai, he mea nā te ringa o Mohi.
I kōrero anō a Ihowā ki a Mohi, i mea,
"Kōrero ki ngā tama a Īharaira, mea atu ki a rātou: Ki te motuhia e te tangata, he mea kī taurangi, mā Ihowā ngā tāngata, me whakarite e koe ngā moni.
Ā, kia pēnei tāu whakarite mō te tāne e rua tekau ōna tau, he maha ake rānei, ā, ono tekau noa ngā tau, arā kia rima tekau ngā hekere hiriwa e whakaritea e koe, hei te hekere o te wāhi tapu.
Ā, ki te mea he wahine, kia toru tekau ngā hekere e whakaritea e koe.
Ā, ki te mea e rima ōna tau, tae noa atu rānei ki te rua tekau tau, nā, kia rua tekau ngā hekere e whakaritea e koe mō te tāne, kia tekau hoki ngā hekere mō te wahine.
Ā, ki te mea kotahi tōna marama ā tae noa atu rānei ki te rima ōna tau, nā, kia rima ngā hekere hiriwa e whakaritea e koe mō te tāne, kia toru ngā hekere hiriwa e whakaritea e koe mō te wahine.
Ā, ki te mea e ono tekau ōna tau, he maha atu rānei; ki te mea he tāne, kia kotahi tekau mā rima ngā hekere e whakaritea e koe, kia kotahi tekau hoki ngā hekere mō te wahine.

Ā, ki te iti iho ōna rawa i āu i whakarite ai, nā, me tū ia ki te aroaro o te tohunga, ā, me whakarite ōna utu e te tohunga. Kei ngā mea e taea atu e te ringa o te tangata nāna te kī taurangi te tikanga mō tā te tohunga e whakarite ai hei utu mōna.
"Ā, mehemea he kararehe nō reira nei te whakahere a te tangata ki a Ihowā, ka tapu katoa ngā mea o tēnā i hōmai e ia mā Ihowā.

Kaua e whakareretia kētia e ia, e whakawhitia rānei, he pai mō te kino, he kino rānei mō te pai. Ā, ki te tūpono ka whakawhitia e ia he kararehe ki tētahi kararehe, nā, ka tapu taua mea me te mea i whakawhitia ai.
Ā, ki te mea he poke te kararehe, he mea e kore e whakaherea tētahi pērā mā Ihowā, nā, ka whakatūria e ia te kararehe ki te aroaro o te tohunga.
Ā, me whakarite ōna utu e te tohunga, ahakoa pai, ahakoa kino; me waiho i tāu i whakarite ai, e te tohunga.
Otiia, ki te mea ia kia utua kia hoki ai, nā, me tāpiri tōna wāhi whakarima ki tāu i whakarite ai.
"Ki te whakatapua anō e te tangata tōna whare kia tapu ki a Ihowā, nā, me whakarite ōna utu e te tohunga, ahakoa pai, ahakoa kino; ko tā te tohunga e whakarite ai, ka tūturu ki reira.
Ā, ki te mea te kaiwhakatapu kia utua kia hoki ai tōna whare, nā, me tāpiri tōna whakarima o te moni i whakaritea e koe, ā, ka riro i a ia.
"Ā, ki te whakatapua e te tangata mō Ihowā tētahi wāhi māra o tōna kāinga, nā, kia rite ki ngā purapura mō reira tāu whakaritenga utu: kotahi te homa pārei hei purapura, kia rima tekau hekere hiriwa.
Ki te mea nō te tau Tiupiri tāna whakatapunga i tāna māra, ka tūturu anō ki tāu utu i whakarite ai.
Mehemea ia nō muri i te Tiupiri tāna whakatapunga i tāna māra, nā, mā te tohunga e tatau ngā moni ki a ia, kia rite ki ngā tau e toe ana ki te tau Tiupiri, ka tango ai i roto i tāu i whakarite ai.
Ā, ki te mea te kaiwhakatapu o te māra kia utua kia hoki atu ai, nā, me tāpiri tōna whakarima o te moni i whakaritea e koe, ā, ka whakatūturutia māna.
Ā, ki te kāhore ia e utu kia hoki ai te māra, ki te mea rānei i hokona e ia te māra ki te tangata kē, e kore e utua kia hoki atu i muri iho.
Engari ka tapu te māra ki a Ihowā, ina riro atu i te Tiupiri, he māra hoki i oti rawa; hei kāinga tēnā mō te tohunga.
"Ki te whakatapua ia e tētahi ki a Ihowā he māra i hokona mai e ia, ehara nei i te māra tupu nāna;
kātahi ka taua e te tohunga ki a ia ngā utu i whakaritea e koe mō te takiwā atu ki te tau Tiupiri. Ā, ka hōmai e ia tāu i whakarite ai i taua rangi, he mea tapu hoki nā Ihowā.
Ko ā te tau Tiupiri hoki ai te māra ki te tangata i hokona mai nei i a ia, arā ki te tangata nōna te tūturutanga o te whenua.
Hei te hekere o te wāhi tapu te tikanga mō āu whakaritenga katoa; e rua tekau ngā kera o te hekere kotahi.
"Ko te mātāmua ia o ngā kararehe, i meinga nei hei mātāmua ki a Ihowā, kaua ēnā e whakatapua e te tangata; ahakoa kau, hipi rānei; nā Ihowā ēnā.

Ā, ki te mea nō ngā kararehe poke, nā, kia rite ki tāu whakaritenga tāna utu mō te whakahokinga atu, me tāpiri anō e ia tōna whakarima; ā, ki te kāhore e utua, e whakahokia, nā, me hoko; kia rite ngā utu ki āu i whakarite ai.

"Kaua ia e hokona, e utua rānei kia hoki atu te mea i oti rawa, i tukua pūtia mai e te tangata ki a Ihowā i roto i ōna taonga katoa, te tangata rānei, te kararehe rānei, te māra rānei o tōna kāinga tupu; he tino tapu ki a Ihowā ngā mea katoa i oti.
"Ki te tukua pūtia mai tētahi tangata, he mea oti rawa, e kore e utua, e whakahokia; me whakamate rawa.
"Me ngā whakatekau katoa o te whenua, o te purapura rānei o te whenua, o ngā hua rānei o te rākau, nā Ihowā ēnā; he tapu ki a Ihowā.
Ā, ki te mea te tangata kia utua, kia hoki ai ētahi o āna whakatekau; me tāpiri mai tētahi o ōna wāhi whakarima.
Ā, ko ngā whakatekau katoa o ngā kau, o ngā hipi, o ngā mea katoa e haere mai ana i raro i te tokotoko, ka tapu tēnā whakatekau ki a Ihowā.
Kaua e tirohia iho e ia, wehe ai i te pai i te kino, kaua anō hoki e whakawhitia; ā, ki te whakawhitia e ia, nā, ka tapu taua mea me tōna utu anō; e kore e utua kia hoki."
Ko ngā whakahau ēnei ki ngā tama a Īharaira i whakahaua e Ihowā ki a Mohi ki Maunga Hinai.

Ā, i kōrero a Ihowā ki a Mohi i te i koraha o Hinai i roto i te tapenākara o te whakaminenga, i te rā tuatahi o te rua o ngā marama, i te rua o ngā tau o tō rātou haerenga mai i te whenua o Īhipa, i mea:
"Tirohia te tokomaha o te whakaminenga katoa o ngā tama a Īharaira, i ō rātou hapū, i ngā whare o ō rātou mātua, tatau rawa i ngā ingoa o ngā tāne katoa, tēnei pane, tēnei pane ō rātou.
Ko ngā mea e rua tekau, he maha atu rānei ngā tau, ko ngā mea hoki e kaha ana i roto i a Īharaira ki te haere ki te whawhai, mā kōrua ko Ārona rātou e tatau, tēnei ope, tēnei ope.
Kia kotahi hoki te tangata o tēnei iwi, o tēnei iwi, hei hoa mō kōrua; arā ko ngā upoko o tēnei whare, o tēnei whare o ō rātou mātua.
Ko ngā ingoa hoki ēnei o ngā tāngata e tū tahi me kōrua: Nō Reupena; ko Erituru, tama a Hereuru.
Nō Himiona; ko Herumiere, tama a Turiharai.
Nō Hūrā; ko Nāhahona, tama a Aminarapa.
Nō Ihākara; ko Netanēre, tama a Tuara.
Nō Hepurona; ko Eriapa, tama a Herona.
Nō ngā tama a Hōhepa: nō Ēparaima; ko Erihama, tama a Amihuru; nō Mānahi; ko Kamariere, tama a Peraturu.
Nō Pineamine; ko Apirana, tama a Kirioni.
Nō Rāna; ko Ahiētere, tama a Amiharai.
Nō Āhera; ko Pakiere, tama a Okorana.
Nō Kara; ko Eriāhapa, tama a Teuere.
Nō Napatari; ko Ahira, tama a Enana."
Ko ngā mea whai ingoa ēnei o te whakaminenga, ko ngā ariki o ngā iwi o ō rātou mātua; ko rātou ngā upoko o ngā mano i roto i a Īharaira.
Nā, ka tīkina e Mohi rāua ko Ārona ēnei tāngata nō rātou ngā ingoa kua whakahuatia nei,

ā, huihuia ana e rātou te whakaminenga katoa i te rā tuatahi o te rua o ngā marama. Ā, ka whakaaturia e rātou ō rātou whakapapa, tēnei hapū, tēnei hapū, me ngā whare o ō rātou mātua, tatau rawa ngā ingoa, he pane, he pane, ngā mea e rua tekau, he maha atu rānei ō rātou tau.
Rite tonu ki tā Ihowā i whakahau ai ki a Mohi tāna tauanga i a rātou i te koraha o Hinai.

Ā, ko ngā tama a Reupena, mātāmua a Īharaira: i ō rātou toronga, i ō rātou hapū, i ngā whare o ō rātou mātua, tatau rawa ngā ingoa, he pane, he pane, o ngā tāne katoa e rua tekau. He maha atu rānei ngā tau, o ngā mea katoa i kaha ki te haere ki te whawhai.
Ko ngā mea o rātou, o te iwi o Reupena, i taua, e whā tekau mā ono mano e rima rau.

Nō ngā tama a Himiona: i ō rātou toronga, i ō rātou hapū, i ngā whare o ō rātou mātua, ko ngā mea o rātou i taua, tatau rawa ngā ingoa, he pane, he pane, o ngā tāne katoa e rua tekau he maha atu rānei ngā tau, o ngā mea katoa i kaha ki te haere ki te whawhai.
Ko ngā mea i taua o rātou, o te iwi o Himiona, e rima tekau mā iwa mano e toru rau.

Nō ngā tama a Kara: i ō rātou toronga, i ō rātou hapū, i ngā whare o ō rātou mātua, tatau rawa ngā ingoa o ngā mea e rua tekau, he maha atu rānei ngā tau, o ngā mea katoa i kaha ki te haere ki te whawhai.
Ko ngā mea i taua o rātou, o te iwi o Kara, e whā tekau mā rima mano e ono rau e rima tekau.

Nō ngā tama a Hūrā: i ō rātou toronga, i ō rātou hapū, i ngā whare o ō rātou mātua, tatau rawa ngā ingoa o ngā mea e rua tekau, he maha atu rānei ō rātou tau, o ngā mea katoa i kaha ki te haere ki te whawhai.
Ko ngā mea i taua o rātou, o te iwi o Hūrā, e whitu tekau mā whā mano e ono rau.

Nō ngā tama a Ihākara: i ō rātou toronga, i ō rātou hapū, i ngā whare o ō rātou mātua, tatau rawa ngā ingoa o ngā mea e rua tekau, he maha atu rānei ō rātou tau, o ngā mea katoa i kaha ki te haere ki te whawhai.
Ko ngā mea i taua o rātou, o te iwi o Ihākara, e rima tekau mā whā mano e whā rau.

Nō ngā tama a Hepurona: i ō rātou toronga, i ō rātou hapū, i ngā whare o ō rātou mātua, tatau rawa ngā ingoa o ngā mea e rua tekau, he maha atu rānei ō rātou tau, o ngā mea katoa i kaha ki te haere ki te whawhai.
Ko ngā mea i taua o rātou, o te iwi o Hepurona, e rima tekau mā whitu mano e whā rau.

Nō ngā tama a Hōhepa: arā nō ngā tama a Ēparaima: i ō rātou torōna, i ō rātou hapū, i ngā whare o ō rātou Matua, tatau rawa ngā ingoa o ngā mea e rua tekau, he maha atu rānei ō rātou tau, o ngā mea katoa i kaha ki te haere ki te whawhai.
Ko ngā mea i taua o rātou, o te iwi o Ēparaima, e whā tekau mano e rima rau.

Nō ngā tama a Mānahi: i ō rātou toronga, i ō rātou hapū, i ngā whare o ō rātou mātua, tatau rawa ngā ingoa o ngā mea e rua tekau, he maha atu rānei ō rātou tau, o ngā mea katoa i kaha ki te haere ki te whawhai.
Ko ngā mea i taua o rātou, o te iwi o Mānahi, e toru tekau mā rua mano e rua rau.

Nō ngā tama a Pineamine: i ō rātou toronga, i ō rātou hapū, i ngā whare o ō rātou mātua, tatau rawa ngā ingoa o ngā mea e rua tekau, he maha atu rānei ō rātou tau, o ngā mea katoa i kaha ki te haere ki te whawhai.
Ko ngā mea i taua o rātou, o te iwi o Pineamine, e toru tekau mā rima mano e whā rau.

Nō ngā tama a Rāna: i ō rātou toronga, i ō rātou hapū, i ngā whare o ō rātou mātua, tatau rawa ngā ingoa o ngā mea e rua tekau, he maha atu rānei ō rātou tau, o ngā mea katoa i kaha ki te haere ki te whawhai.
Ko ngā mea i taua o rātou, o te iwi o Rāna, e ono tekau mā rua mano e whitu rau.

Nō ngā tama a Āhera: i ō rātou toronga, i ō rātou hapū, i ngā whare o ō rātou mātua, tatau rawa ngā ingoa o ngā mea e rua tekau, he maha atu rānei ō rātou tau, o ngā mea katoa i kaha ki te haere ki te whawhai.
Ko ngā mea i taua o rātou, o te iwi o Āhera, e whā tekau mā tahi mano e rima rau.

Nō ngā tama a Napatari: i ō rātou toronga, i ō rātou hapū, i ngā whare o ō rātou mātua, tatau rawa ngā ingoa o ngā mea e rua tekau, he maha atu rānei ō rātou tau, o ngā mea katoa i kaha ki te haere ki te whawhai.
Ko ngā mea i taua o rātou, o te iwi o Napatari, e rima tekau mā toru mano e whā rau.
Ko ngā mea ēnei i taua nei e Mohi, e Ārona rātou ko ngā ariki kotahi tekau mā rua o Īharaira; takikotahi te tangata o rātou ki te whare o ōna mātua.
Ā, ko aua tāngata i taua o ngā tama a Īharaira, i ngā whare o ō rātou mātua, ngā mea e rua tekau, he maha atu rānei ō rātou tau i roto i a Īharaira i kaha ki te haere ki te whawhai –
ko aua tāngata katoa i taua e ono rau e toru mano e rima rau e rima tekau.
Ko ngā Rīwaiti ia, i te iwi o ō rātou mātua, kīhai i taua i roto i a rātou.
Nā Ihowā hoki i kōrero ki a Mohi, i mea:
"Otiia kaua e taua te iwi o Rīwai, kaua anō e tirohia tō rātou tokomaha i roto i ngā tama a Īharaira.

Engari me whakarite ngā Rīwaiti mō te tapenākara o te whakaaturanga, mō ōna oko katoa, mō ōna mea katoa hoki. Mā rātou te tapenākara e amo, me ōna oko katoa; ā, me mahi ki reira, me noho hoki ki tētahi taha, ki tētahi taha o te tapenākara.
Ā, ka maunu atu te tapenākara, mā ngā Rīwaiti e wāhi iho; ka whakatūria anō hoki te tapenākara, mā ngā Rīwaiti e whakatū; ā, ko te tangata kē e whakatata atu, ka whakamatea.
Me whakatū anō ō rātou tēneti e ngā tama a Īharaira ki tōna puni, ki tōna puni, ki tōna kara, ki tōna kara, puta noa i ō rātou ope.

Ko ngā Rīwaiti ia, me whakatū o rātou ki tētahi taha, ki tētahi taha o te tapenākara o te whakaaturanga, kei puta he riri ki te whakaminenga o ngā tama a Īharaira; ā, mā ngā Rīwaiti e tiaki te tapenākara o te whakaaturanga."
Nā, i pērā ngā tama a Īharaira; rite tonu ki tā Ihowā katoa i whakahau ai ki a Mohi tā rātou mahi.
I kōrero anō a Ihowā ki a Mohi rāua ko Ārona, i mea:

"Me whakatū tōna tēneti e ngā tama a Īharaira, ki te taha o tōna kara, o tōna kara, ki ngā tohu o ngā whare o ō rātou mātua; hei te takiwā atu ki te tapenākara o te whakaminenga te tūranga o ō rātou tēneti ā tawhio noa."
Ki te taha ki te rāwhiti, arā ki te putanga mai o te rā, whakatū ai ngā tāngata o te kara o te puni o Hūrā, me ō rātou ope. Ko Nāhahona tama a Aminarapa hei rangatira mō ngā tama a Hūrā.
Ā, ko tōna ope, ko ngā mea o rātou i taua, e whitu tekau mā whā mano e ono rau.
Nā, ko ngā mea e whakatū tēneti ki tua atu i a ia ko te iwi o Ihākara; ā, ko Netanēre tama a Tuara hei rangatira mō ngā tama a Ihākara;
ko tōna ope, ko ngā mea o rātou i taua, e rima tekau mā whā mano e whā rau.
Ā, ko te iwi o Hepurona: ā, ko Eriapa tama a Herona, hei rangatira mō ngā tama a Hepurona;
ā, ko tōna ope, ko ngā mea o rātou i taua, e rima tekau mā whitu mano e whā rau.
Ko ngā tāngata katoa i taua o te puni o Hūrā kotahi rau e waru tekau mā ono mano e whā rau, i ō rātou ope. Ko ēnei e haere wawe.
Hei te taha ki te tonga te kara o te puni o Reupena, me ō rātou ope. Ā, ko Erituru tama a Hereuru, hei rangatira mō ngā tama a Reupena;
ā, ko tōna ope, ko ngā mea o rātou i taua, e whā tekau mā ono mano e rima rau.
Ā, me whakatū ki tōna taha ko te iwi o Himiona; ā, ko Herumiere tama a Turiharai, hei rangatira mō ngā tama a Himiona.
Ko tōna ope, ko ngā mea o rātou i taua, e rima tekau mā iwa mano e toru rau.
Ko reira te iwi o Kara; ā, ko Eriāhapa tama a Reuere, hei rangatira mō ngā tama a Kara;
ā, ko tōna ope, ko ngā mea o rātou i taua, e whā tekau mā rima mano e ono rau e rima tekau.
Ko ngā tāngata katoa i taua o te puni o Reupena kotahi rau e rima tekau mā tahi mano e whā rau e rima tekau, i ō rātou ope. Me haere rātou hei tuarua mō ngā matua.

Ko reira maunu atu ai te tapenākara o te whakaminenga, ko te puni o ngā Rīwaiti ki waenganui o ngā puni; kia rite tō rātou haerenga ki tō rātou nohoanga iho, ia tangata ki tōna wāhi, i te taha anō o ō rātou kara.
Hei te taha ki te hauāuru te kara o te puni o Ēparaima, me ō rātou ope. Ko te rangatira mō ngā tama a Ēparaima, ko Erihama, tama a Amihuru;
ā, ko tōna ope, ko ngā mea o rātou i taua, e whā tekau mano e rima rau.
Ā, ki tōna taha ko te iwi o Mānahi; ā, ko te rangatira mō ngā tama a Mānahi ko Kamariere, tama a Peraturu;
ā, ko tōna ope, ko ngā mea o rātou i taua, e toru tekau mā rua mano e rua rau.
Ko reira te iwi o Pineamine; ā, ko te rangatira mō ngā tama a Pineamine ko Apirana tama a Kirioni;
ā, ko tōna ope, ko ngā mea o rātou i taua, e toru tekau mā rima mano e whā rau.
Ko ngā tāngata katoa i taua o te puni o Ēparaima kotahi rau e waru mano, kotahi rau, i ō rātou ope. Ā, ka hāpainga rātou hei tuatoru mō ngā matua.
Hei te taha ki te raki te kara o te puni o Rāna, me ō rātou ope; ā, ko te rangatira mō ngā tama a Rāna ko Ahiētere tama a Amiharai;
ā, ko tōna ope, ko ngā mea o rātou i taua, e ono tekau mā rua mano e whitu rau.
Nā, me whakatū ki tōna taha ko te iwi o Āhera; ā, ko te rangatira mō ngā tama a Āhera ko Pakiere tama a Okorana;
ā, ko tōna ope, ko ngā mea o rātou i taua, e whā tekau mā tahi mano e rima rau.
Ko reira te iwi o Napatari; ā, ko te rangatira mō ngā tama a Napatari ko Ahira tama a Enana;
ā, ko tōna ope, ko ngā mea o rātou i taua, e rima tekau mā toru mano e whā rau.
Ko ngā mea katoa i taua o te puni o Rāna kotahi rau e rima tekau mā whitu mano e ono rau. Hei muri rawa rātou haere ai, me ō rātou kara.
Ko ēnei o ngā tama a Īharaira i taua, i ngā whare o ō rātou mātua; taua ake o ngā puni, i ō rātou ope, e ono rau e toru mano e rima rau e rima tekau.
Ko ngā Rīwaiti ia, kīhai i taua i roto i ngā tama a Īharaira; ko tā Ihowā hoki tēnā i whakahau ai ki a Mohi.

Nā, ka pērātia e ngā tama a Īharaira; ka pērātia katoatia i tā Ihowā i whakahau ai ki a Mohi: Tā rātou whakanoho ki te taha o ā rātou kara, tō rātou hāpainga atu, tēnei, tēnei, i roto i tōna hapū anō, rite tonu ki ngā whare o ō rātou mātua.
Nā, ko ngā whakatupuranga anō hoki ēnei o Ārona rāua ko Mohi i te rā i kōrero ai a Ihowā ki a Mohi i Maunga Hinai.
Ko ngā ingoa hoki ēnei o ngā tama a Ārona: ko Nātapa, ko te mātāmua, rātou ko Apihu, ko Ereātara, ko Itamara.
Nō ngā ingoa ēnei Ārona, o ngā tohunga i whakawahia, i whakatohungatia nei e ia hei tohunga.

I mate hoki a Nātapa rāua ko Apihu ki te aroaro o Ihowā, i tā rāua whakaherenga i te ahi kē ki te aroaro o Ihowā, ki te koraha o Hinai, kāhore anō hoki ā rāua tamariki; ā, i mahi a Ereātara rāua ko Itamara i ngā mahi a te tohunga i te tirohanga mai a tō rāua pāpā, a Ārona.
Ā, i kōrero a Ihowā ki a Mohi, i mea:
"Whakatātaia mai te iwi o Rīwai, whakatūria hoki ki te aroaro o Ārona tohunga, kia mahi ai rātou ki a ia.
Ā, mā rātou e tiaki ngā mea hei tiakanga māna, hei tiakanga hoki mā te whakaminenga katoa, ki mua i te tapenākara o te whakaminenga, e mahi hoki ngā mahi o te tapenākara.
Mā rātou anō e tiaki ngā mea katoa o te tapenākara o te whakaminenga, me ngā mea hei tiakanga mā ngā tama a Īharaira, kia mahi ai hoki ngā mahi o te tapenākara.
Ā, me hoatu e koe ngā Rīwaiti ki a Ārona rātou ko āna tama e hoatutia katoatia ana rātou ki a ia mō ngā tama a Īharaira.
Me whakarite anō e koe a Ārona rātou ko āna tama, ā, ka ū rātou ki tā rātou mahi tohunga; ko te tangata kē e whakatata mai ka whakamatea."
I kōrero anō a Ihowā ki a Mohi, i mea:
"Ko ahau nei, nanā, kua tango ahau i ngā Rīwaiti i roto i ngā tama a Īharaira hei utu mō ngā mātāmua katoa e oroko puta mai ana i te kōpū i roto i ngā tama a Īharaira. Māku hoki ngā Rīwaiti,

nō te mea, nāku ngā mātāmua katoa; nō te rā anō i patu ai ahau i ngā mātāmua katoa o te whenua o Īhipa tāku whakatapunga i ngā mātāmua katoa a Īharaira māku, i ā te tangata, i ā te kararehe; māku ērā. Ko Ihowā ahau."
I kōrero anō a Ihowā ki a Mohi, i te koraha o Hinai, i mea:
Taua ngā tama a Rīwai, tēnei whare, tēnei whare o ō rātou mātua, tēnei hapū, tēnei hapū o rātou; me tatau rātou e koe, ngā tāne katoa kotahi nei te marama, ahu atu.
Nā, ka taua rātou e Mohi ka pērātia me tā Ihowā i kī ai, i whakahau ai.
Ā, ko ngā tama ēnei a Rīwai me ō rātou ingoa: ko Kerehona, ko Kohata, ko Merari.
Ā, ko ngā ingoa ēnei o ngā tama a Kerehona, o tēnei hapū, o tēnei hapū o rātou: ko Ripini rāua ko Himei.
Me ngā tama a Kohata, o tēnei hapū, o tēnei hapū o rātou: ko Āmarama, ko Itihara, ko Heperona, ko Utiere.
Me ngā tama a Merari, o tēnei hapū, o tēnei hapū o rātou: ko Māhari, ko Muhi. Ko ngā hapū ēnei o ngā Rīwaiti, o tēnei whare, o tēnei whare o ō rātou mātua.
Nā, Kerehona te hapū o ngā Ripini, me te hapū o ngā Himei; ko ngā hapū ēnei o ngā Kerehoni.
Ko ngā mea o rātou i taua, ko te tokomaha o ngā tāne katoa, kotahi nei te marama ahu atu, ko ngā mea o rātou i taua e whitu mano e rima rau.
Hei muri i te tapenākara, hei te taha ki te hauāuru, te puni o ngā Kerehoni.
Ko Eriāhapa hoki, ko te tama a Raere, hei ariki mō te whare o te matua o ngā Kerehoni.
Ā, ko tā ngā tama a Kerehona e tiaki ai i roto i te tapenākara o te whakaminenga, ko te tapenākara, ko te tēneti, me tōna hīpoki, ko te pā o te whatitoka o te tapenākara o te whakaminenga,
me ngā pā o te marae, me te pā o te whatitoka o te marae, o tērā i te tapenākara, i te āta hoki ā tawhio noa, me ōna aho hoki mō ōna meatanga katoa.
Nā, Kohata hoki te hapū o ngā Amarami, me te hapū o ngā Itihari, me te hapū o ngā Heperoni, me te hapū o ngā Utieri; ko ngā hapū ēnei o ngā Kohati.
Ko te tokomaha o ngā tāne katoa, kotahi nei te marama, ahu atu, e waru mano e ono rau, ko rātou ngā kaitiaki o te wāhi tapu.
Hei te taha whaka te tonga o te tapenākara he puni mō ngā hapū o ngā tama a Kohata.
Ā, ko Eritapana, tama a Utiere, hei ariki mō te whare o te matua o ngā hapū o ngā Kohati.
Ā, ko tā rātou e tiaki ai ko te āka, ko te tēpu, ko te tūranga rama, ko ngā āta, ko ngā oko o te wāhi tapu, arā ko ngā mea e minita ai rātou, me te pā ārai, me ngā mea katoa o ēnā mahinga.
Ā, ko Ereātara tama a Ārona tohunga hei ariki mō ngā ariki o ngā Rīwaiti, māna hoki e tirotiro ngā kaitiaki e tiaki ana i te wāhi tapu.
Nā Merari te hapū o ngā Māhari, me te hapū o ngā Muhi: ko ngā hapū ēnei o Merari.
Ā, ko ngā mea o rātou i taua, ko te tokomaha o ngā tāne katoa, kotahi nei te marama ahu atu, e ono mano e rua rau.
Ā, ko Turiere, ko te tama a Apihaira hei ariki mō te whare o te matua o ngā hapū o Merari; hei te taha ki te raki o te tapenākara he puni mō ēnei.
Ko tā ngā tama hoki a Merari e tūpato ai, e tiaki ai, ko ngā papa o te tapenākara, me ōna kaho, me ōna pou, me ngā tūranga pou, me ngā mea katoa o aua mea, me ngā mea katoa o ēnā mahinga;
me ngā pou o te marae ā tawhio noa, me ngā tūranga, me ngā titi, me ngā aho.

Ā, ko ēnei e noho ki mua i te tapenākara, ki te rāwhiti, ki mua i te tapenākara o te whakaminenga, ki te putanga mai o te rā, ko Mohi rātou ko Ārona, ko āna tama, hei tiaki i te wāhi tapu, i ngā mea hei tiakanga mā ngā tama a Īharaira; ā, ko te tangata kē e whakatata mai, ka whakamatea.
Ko ngā Rīwaiti katoa i taua, ko ērā i taua rā e Mohi rāua ko Ārona, i tā Ihowā whakahau, i ō rātou hapū, ko ngā tāne katoa kotahi nei te marama ahu atu, e rua tekau mā rua mano.
Ā, i mea a Ihowā ki a Mohi, "Taua ngā tāne mātāmua katoa o ngā tama a Īharaira, ngā mea kotahi nei te marama, me ngā mea i maha atu, tuhituhia hoki te maha o ō rātou ingoa.

Ā, me tango ngā Rīwaiti māku – ko Ihowā ahau – hei utu mō ngā mātāmua katoa o ngā tama a Īharaira; me ngā kararehe a ngā Rīwaiti hei utu mō ngā mātāmua katoa i roto i ngā kararehe a ngā tama a Īharaira."
Nā, ka taua e Mohi, ka pērātia me tā Ihowā i whakahau ai ki a ia, ngā mātāmua katoa i roto i ngā tama a Īharaira.
Ā, ko ngā tāne mātāmua katoa, ko te maha o ngā ingoa, kotahi nei te marama ā ahu atu, ko ngā mea o rātou i taua, e rua tekau mā rua mano e rua rau e whitu tekau mā toru.
Ā, i kōrero a Ihowā ki a Mohi, i mea,
"Tangohia ngā Rīwaiti hei utu mō ngā tāne mātāmua katoa i roto i ngā tama a Īharaira, me ngā kararehe a ngā Rīwaiti hei utu mō ā rātou kararehe; ā, māku ngā Rīwaiti. Ko Ihowā ahau.
Nā, hei whakahoki atu, hei utu mō te rua rau e whitu tekau mā toru, mō ngā mātāmua o ngā tama a Īharaira i hira ake i te tokomaha o ngā Rīwaiti;
me tango e koe kia rima hekere mō tēnei pane, mō tēnei pane; kia rite ki te hekere o te wāhi tapu āu e tango ai; e rua tekau ngā kera o te hekere kotahi.
Me hoatu te moni e utua ai ngā tuhene o rātou ki a Ārona rātou ko āna tama."
Nā, ka tango a Mohi i te moni whakahoki i ngā tāngata i hira ake i ērā i utua ki ngā Rīwaiti;
i tangohia e ia te moni i ngā mātāmua a ngā tama a Īharaira; kotahi mano e toru rau e ono tekau mā rima hekere; he pērā me te hekere o te wāhi tapu;
ā, i hoatu e Mohi te moni a te hunga i utua ki a Ārona rātou ko āna tama, i pērā me tā Ihowā i kī ai, me tā Ihowā i whakahau ai ki a Mohi.
I kōrero anō a Ihowā ki a Mohi rāua ko Ārona, i mea:
"Taua ngā tama a Kohata, i roto i ngā tama a Rīwai, tēnei hapū, tēnei hapū o rātou, i ngā whare o ō rātou mātua,
ngā mea e toru tekau, he maha atu rānei ō rātou tau, ā tae noa ki ngā mea e rima tekau ō rātou tau, ngā mea katoa e uru ana ki te mahi, ki te mea i ngā mea o te tapenākara o te whakaminenga.
"Ko te mahi tēnei mā ngā tama a Kohata i roto i te tapenākara o te whakaminenga, ko ngā mea tino tapu.
Ā, ka maunu te puni, me haere a Ārona ki roto, rātou ko āna tama, ka tuku i te ārai hīpoki ki raro, ā, ka hīpoki iho ki te āka o te whakaaturanga.
Nā, ka makā iho te hīpoki ki runga, arā ngā hiako pateri, ā, ka uhi iho i tētahi kākahu ki runga, he mea purū katoa, ka kuhu i ngā amo.
"Me uhi anō ki te kākahu purū te tēpu taro aroaro, ka whakatakoto ai i ngā rīhi ki runga, me ngā koko, me ngā peihana, me ngā kapu hei ringihanga; hei runga anō hoki te taro pūmau takoto ai.
Ka uhi ki te kākahu ngangana, ka hīpoki ai ki te hiako pateri hei hīpoki mō runga, ka kuhu i ōna amo.
"Nā, ka mau rātou ki tētahi kākahu purū, ka hīpoki ai i te tūranga whakamārama, i ōna rama hoki, i ōna kuku, i ōna oko ngārahu, i ōna oko hinu katoa, i ngā mea e minita ai rātou ki reira.
Ka hoatu ai me ōna mea katoa ki roto ki te tākai, hei te mea hiako pateri, ka whakaeke ai ki runga ki te amo.
"Ā, me uhi iho e rātou he kākahu purū ki runga ki te āta kōura, ka hīpoki ai ki tētahi hīpoki hiako pateri, ka kuhu ai i ōna amo.
"Nā, ka mau ki ngā mea e minita ai rātou i te wāhi tapu, ka hoatu ki roto ki te kākahu purū, ka hīpoki ki tētahi hīpoki hiako pateri, ka whakaeke ki te amo.
"Nā, ka tahi atu rātou i ngā pungarehu o te āta, ka hīpoki ai ki te kākahu pāpura.

Me whakatakoto anō ki runga ōna oko katoa e minita ai rātou ki reira, ngā tahu kakara, ngā mārau kikokiko, ngā koko pungarehu, ngā peihana, ngā mea katoa o te āta; ka hīpoki ai ki te hīpoki hiako pateri, ka kuhu ai i ōna amo.

"Ā, ka oti i a Ārona rātou ko āna tama te hīpoki te wāhi tapu, me ngā mea katoa o te wāhi tapu, ina tata te puni te maunu; ka mutu, nā, ka haere mai ngā tama a Kohata ki te kauhoa. Otiia, kaua rātou e pā ki tētahi mea tapu kei mate rātou. Ko ēnei ngā mea a ngā tama a Kohata e mau ai o te tapenākara o te whakaminenga.

"Ā, ko tā Ereātara, ko tā te tama a te tohunga, a Ārona, e whakaaro ai, ko te hinu mō te whakamārama, ko te whakakakara reka, ko te whakahere totokore o tēnei rā, o tēnei rā, ko te hinu whakawahi, me te tirotiro i te tapenākara katoa, i ngā mea katoa hoki o reira, i te wāhi tapu, i ōna mea hoki.
"I kōrero anō a Ihowā ki a Mohi rāua ko Ārona, i mea:
Kei hātepea atu e koutou te iwi o ngā hapū o ngā Kohati i roto i ngā Rīwaiti.

Engari, ko tēnei tā koutou e mea ai ki a rātou, kia ora ai rātou, kei mate, ina whakatata ki ngā mea tino tapu: me haere a Ārona rātou ko āna tama ki roto, ka whakarite ai i a rātou ki tāna mahi, ki tāna mahi, ki tāna amohanga, ki tāna amohanga.
Otiia, kaua rātou e haere ki roto ki te mātakitaki i te wāhi tapu ahakoa he wā poto, kei mate rātou."
I kōrero anō a Ihowā ki a Mohi, i mea,
"Taua hoki ngā tama a Kerehona, i ngā whare o ō rātou mātua, i ō rātou hapū.

Ko ngā mea e toru tekau, he maha atu rānei ngā tau, ā tae noa ki ngā mea e rima tekau ō rātou tau, āu e tatau ai; ko ngā mea katoa hoki e uru ana ki te mahi i ngā mahi o te tapenākara o te whakaminenga.
"Ko te mahi tēnei mā ngā hapū o ngā Kerehoni, ko te mahi, ko te amo.
Mā rātou hoki e amo ngā pā o te tapenākara, te tapenākara hoki o te whakaminenga, tōna hīpoki, me te hīpoki hiako pateri i waho ake, me te pā o te whatitoka o te tapenākara o te whakaminenga;

me ngā pā o te marae, me te pā mō te whatitoka o te kūwaha o te marae, o tērā i te tapenākara, i te āta ā tawhio noa, me ngā aho, me ngā mea katoa mō te mahinga o aua mea, me ngā mea katoa i hangā mō aua mea; ko tā rātou mahi tēnā.

Kei a Ārona rātou ko āna tama te tikanga mō ngā mahi katoa a ngā tama a ngā Kerehoni, mō ā rātou amohanga katoa, mō ā rātou mahi katoa; mā koutou hoki e whakarite ki a rātou te tikanga mō ngā mea katoa e amo ai rātou.
Ko te mahi tēnei mā ngā hapū o ngā tama a Kerehona i te tapenākara o te whakaminenga; ā, ko ngā tikanga mā rātou kei a Itamara tama a te tohunga, a Ārona."
"Ko ngā tama a Merari, me tatau rātou e koe i ō rātou hapū, i ngā whare o ō rātou mātua;

ko ngā mea e toru tekau, he maha atu rānei ō rātou tau, ā tae noa ki ngā mea e rima tekau ō rātou tau, āu e tatau ai, ko ngā tāngata katoa e uru ana ki te mahi, ki te mahi i te mahi o te tapenākara o te whakaminenga.
Ā, ko te tikanga anō tēnei mō tā rātou e amo ai, i ā rātou mahinga katoa i te tapenākara o te whakaminenga; ko ngā papa o te tapenākara, me ōna kaho, me ōna pou, me ōna tūranga pou;

me ngā pou o te marae ā tawhio noa, me ngā tūranga pou, me ngā titi, me ngā aho, me ngā mea katoa o aua mea, me ngā mea katoa o ēnā mahinga: me tatau ā-ingoa ngā mea kei a rātou nei te tikanga mō te amo.
Ko te mahi tēnei a ngā hapū o ngā tama a Merari, i ā rātou mahinga katoa i te tapenākara o te whakaminenga, i raro i te ringa o Itamara tama a te tohunga, a Ārona."
Nā, ka taua e Mohi rātou ko Ārona, ko ngā ariki o te whakaminenga, ngā tama a ngā Kohati, i ō rātou hapū, i ngā whare anō o ō rātou mātua,
ngā mea e toru tekau, he maha atu rānei ō rātou tau, ā tae noa ki ngā mea e rima tekau ō rātou tau, ngā tāngata katoa i uru ki te mahi, ki te mahi i te tapenākara o te whakaminenga.
Ā, taua ake o rātou, i ō rātou hapū, e rua mano e whitu rau e rima tekau.
Ko ēnei i taua o ngā hapū o ngā Kohati, ko ngā tāngata hei mahi i te tapenākara o te whakaminenga, i taua nei e Mohi rāua ko Ārona, pērā me tā Ihowā i whakahau ai, nā te ringa o Mohi.
Ā, taua ake o ngā tama a Kerehona i ō rātou hapū, i ngā whare o ō rātou mātua,
ngā mea e toru tekau, he maha atu rānei ō rātou tau, ā tae noa ki ngā mea e rima tekau ō rātou tau, ngā mea katoa i uru ki te mahi, ki te mahi i te tapenākara o te whakaminenga,
taua ake o rātou i ō rātou hapū, i ngā whare o ō rātou mātua, e rua mano e ono rau e toru tekau.
Ko ēnei i taua o ngā hapū o ngā tama a Kerehona, o ngā tāngata katoa hei mahi i te tapenākara o te whakaminenga, i taua nei e Mohi rāua ko Ārona, pērā me tā Ihowā i whakahau ai.
Ā, taua ake o ngā hapū o ngā tama a Merari, i ō rātou hapū, i ngā whare o ō rātou mātua,
ngā mea hoki e toru tekau, he maha atu rānei ō rātou tau, ā tae noa ki ngā mea e rima tekau ō rātou tau, ngā tāngata katoa i uru ki te mahi, hei mahi i te tapenākara o te whakaminenga,
taua ake o rātou i ō rātou hapū, e toru mano e rua rau.
Ko ēnei i taua o ngā hapū o ngā tama a Merari, i taua nei e Mohi rāua ko Ārona, pērā me tā Ihowā i whakahau ai, nā te ringa o Mohi.
Ko ngā tāngata katoa o ngā Rīwaiti i taua, a Mohi rātou ko Ārona, ko ngā ariki o Īharaira i tatau ai, i ō rātou hapū, i ngā whare o ō rātou mātua,

ko ngā mea hoki e toru tekau, he maha atu rānei ō rātou tau, ā tae noa ki ngā mea e rima tekau ō rātou tau, ko ngā tāngata katoa i uru ki te mahi i ngā mahi e mahia ana, ki te mahi hoki, ki te amoamo i roto i te tapenākara o te whakaminenga;
taua ake o rātou e waru mano e rima rau e waru tekau.
Rite tonu ki tā Ihowā i whakahau ai te tauanga o rātou e te ringa o Mohi, tēnei, tēnei, me tāna mahi, me tāna amo. Nā, poto ake rātou te tatau e ia, te pērā me tā Ihowā i whakahau ai ki a Mohi.
I kōrero anō a Ihowā ki a Mohi, i mea,
"Whakahaua ngā tama a Īharaira kia motuhia kētia atu ngā repera katoa i roto i te puni, ngā tāngata katoa e rere ana te pirau, me ngā tāngata katoa e poke ana i te tūpāpaku.
Ko te tāne, ko te wahine, me ngare atu, me ngare e koutou ki waho o te puni; kei poke i a rātou ō rātou puni e nohoia nei e ahau."
Nā, pērātia ana e ngā tama a Īharaira, ā, motuhia kētia ana rātou i roto i te puni; rite tonu ki tā Ihowā i kōrero ai ki a Mohi tā ngā tama a Īharaira i mea ai.
I kōrero anō a Ihowā ki a Mohi, i mea:
"Mea atu ki ngā tama a Īharaira: Ki te mahia e te tangata, e te wahine rānei, tētahi mea e hara ai te tangata, hei mahi i te kino ki a Ihowā, ā, ka hē taua wairua;
nā, me whāki tō rātou hara i hara ai. Me whakahoki e ia te mea i hē ai ia, te tino mea, me tāpiri anō ki tōna whakarima, ka hoatu ai ki te tangata i hara nei ia ki a ia.
Otiia ki te kāhore he whanaunga o taua tangata hei hoatutanga mō te utu, me hoatu te utu mō te hara ki a Ihowā, arā ki te tohunga; hei tāpiri mō te hipi whakamārie hei whakamārie mōna.
Nā, ko ngā whakahere hapahapai katoa o ngā mea tapu katoa a ngā tama a Īharaira, e kawea ana ki te tohunga, māna ērā.
Māna ake ngā mea tapu a te tangata; ko tā te tangata e hoatu ai ki te tohunga, māna tēnā."
I kōrero anō a Ihowā ki a Mohi, i mea,
"Kōrero ki ngā tama a Īharaira, mea atu ki a rātou: Ki te peka kē te wahine a tētahi tangata, ā, ka hara ki a ia,
ā, ka takoto, ka pūremu tētahi ki a ia, ā, ka ngaro i ngā kanohi o tāna tahu, ka huna, ā, ka poke te wahine, kāhore anō hoki he kaiwhakaatu mō tōna hē, kāhore anō ia i mau rawa.
Ā, ka tau ki a ia te wairua hae, ā, ka hae ia ki tāna wahine, ā, ka poke te wahine. Ki te tau rānei ki a ia te wairua hae, ā, ka hae ia ki tāna wahine kīhai nei i poke;

kātahi ka kawe taua tangata i tāna wahine ki te tohunga, me kawe anō e ia tā te wahine whakahere hei mea mōna, te whakatekau epa parāoa pārei. Kaua he hinu e ringihia ki runga, kaua anō he parakihe e hoatu ki runga; he whakahere totokore hoki mō te hae, he whakahere whakamahara, hei whakamahara ki te kino.
"Nā, ka nekehia mai ia e te tohunga, ā, ka whakatūria ki te aroaro o Ihowā.
Ā, ka mau te tohunga ki te wai tapu i te oko oneone; ka mau anō te tohunga ki tētahi wāhi o te puehu o te papa o te tapenākara, ka maka ai ki te wai.

Nā, ka whakatūria e te tohunga te wahine ki te aroaro o Ihowā, ā, ka tuku ngā makawe o te wahine kia mahora noa, ka hoatu ai i te whakahere whakamahara ki ōna ringa, arā i te whakahere totokore mō te hae. Hei te ringa ia o te tohunga te wai kawa e tau ai te kanga.

Nā, ka whakaoati te tohunga i a ia, ā, ka mea ki te wahine, ‘Ki te mea kāhore anō tētahi tangata i takoto ki a koe, ki te kāhore anō hoki koe i peka atu, i poke, i te mea i raro koe i tāu tāne, kia ora koe i tēnei wai kawa e tau ai te kanga.
Ki te mea ia kua peka kē koe, i te mea i raro koe i tāu tāne, ā, kua poke koe, ā, kua takoto ki a koe tētahi tangata ehara nei i te tāne nāu,’

– kātahi ka whakaoati te tohunga i te wahine ki te oati kanga, ā, ka mea te tohunga ki te wahine – ‘mā Ihowā koe e mea hei kanga, hei oati i roto i tōu iwi, ina mea a Ihowā kia pirau tōu hūhā, kia pupuhi hoki tōu puku;
ā, ka tae ki roto ki ōu whēkau tēnei wai e tau ai te kanga, e pupuhi ai tōu puku, e pirau ai tōu hūhā.’ "Me kī te wahine, ‘Āmine, Āmine.’
"Ā, me tuhituhi ēnei kanga e te tohunga ki te pukapuka, ka horoi atu anō e ia ki roto ki te wai kawa.
Nā, ka whakainumia e ia te wahine ki te wai kawa e tau ai te kanga, ā, ka tae te wai e tau ai te kanga ki roto ki a ia, ka kawa.
"Me tango hoki e te tohunga te whakahere mō te hae i te ringa o te wahine, ā, ka poipoia te whakahere ki te aroaro o Ihowā, ka whakaherea ki runga ki te āta.
Nā, ka aohia e te tohunga tētahi wāhi o te whakahere, kia kī te ringa, ko tōna whakamaharatanga hoki, ā, ka tahuna ki runga ki te āta, ā muri iho ka whakainumia te wahine ki te wai.

Ā, ka oti ia te whakainu ki te wai, nā, ki te mea kua poke ia, kua hara ki tāna tahu, nā, ka tae ki roto ki a ia te wai e tau ai te kanga, ka kawa, ā, ka pupuhi tōna puku, ka pirau hoki tōna hūhā. Ā, hei mea kanga tēnā wahine i roto i tōna iwi.
Ā, ki te mea kīhai i poke te wahine, ā, e mā ana; nā, ka ora, ā, ka whai tamariki.
"Ko te ture tēnei mō ngā hae, mehemea te wahine, kei raro nei ia i tāna tāne, ka peka kē, ā, ka poke;
ina tau iho rānei te wairua hae ki tētahi, ā, ka hae ia ki tāna wahine. Nā, me whakatū taua wahine e ia ki te aroaro o Ihowā; nā, ka mahia e te tohunga tēnei ture katoa ki a ia.
Nā, ka kore he hē mō te tangata, ā, ka waha e taua wahine tōna kino."
I kōrero anō a Ihowā ki a Mohi, i mea,
"Kōrero ki ngā tama a Īharaira, mea atu ki a rātou: E momotu te tangata, te wahine rānei i a ia, he kī taurangi nā te Natari, mōna kia wehea mā Ihowā;

me wehe ia i a ia kei tata ki te wāina, ki te wai whakahaurangi rānei, kaua hoki ia e inu i te winika wāina, i te winika whakahaurangi, kaua hoki e inu i te wai karepe, ā, kaua e kai i te karepe hou, maroke rānei.
I ngā rā katoa e wehea ai ia kaua ia e kai i tētahi mea nō te wāina te mea i hangā ai, ahakoa nganga, ahakoa peha.

"I ngā rā katoa o tāna kī taurangi wehe i a ia, kaua te heu e pā ki tōna mātenga; kia tutuki rā anō ngā rā e wehea ai ia ki a Ihowā, ka tapu ia, ā, me tuku e ia ngā makawe o tōna mātenga kia tupu, kia roroa.
I ngā rā katoa e wehe ai ia i a ia ki a Ihowā kaua ia e whakatata ki te tūpāpaku.
Kaua ia e whakapoke i a ia mō tōna pāpā, mō tōna whaea, mō tōna tuakana, teina rānei, mō tōna tuahine, ina mate rātou; nō te mea kei runga i tōna mātenga te wehenga a tōna Atua.
Ka tapu ia ki a Ihowā i ngā rā katoa e wehea ai ia.
"Ā, ki te mate tētahi tangata ki tōna taha, he mea pā whakarere, ā, kua poke i a ia tōna mātenga i wehea nei; nā, me heu e ia tōna mātenga i te rā e purea ai ia, me heu e ia i te whitu o ngā rā.
Ā, i te waru o ngā rā me kawe mai e ia he kūkupa kia rua, he pī kūkupa rānei kia rua, ki te tohunga, ki te whatitoka o te tapenākara o te whakaminenga.
Ā, me whakahere tētahi e te tohunga hei whakahere hara, me tētahi hei tahunga tinana, ā, ka whakamārie mōna, nōna hoki i whai hara i te tūpāpaku, ka whakatapua anō tōna mātenga i taua rā anō.
Ā, me whakatapu e ia ki a Ihowā ngā rā o tōna wehenga, me kawe mai anō he reme toa, he tau tahi, hei whakahere mō te hē. Ko ngā rā ia ō mua ka whakatakā, nō te mea kua poke tōna wehenga.
"Ā, ko te ture tēnei mō te Natari, ina rite ngā rā e wehea ai ia: me kawe ia ki te whatitoka o te tapenākara o te whakaminenga;

ā, me whakahere e ia tāna whakahere ki a Ihowā, kia kotahi te reme toa tau tahi, hei te mea kohakore, hei tahunga tinana, me tētahi reme uha tau tahi, hei te mea kohakore, hei whakahere hara, me tētahi hipi toa kohakore, hei whakahere mō te pai,

me tētahi kete taro rēwenakore, me ngā keke parāoa pai i kōnatunatua ki te hinu, me ētahi me angiangi anō hoki, hei ngā mea rēwenakore i pania ki te hinu, me te whakahere totokore, me ngā ringihanga o aua mea.
"Ā, me kawe aua mea e te tohunga ki te aroaro o Ihowā, ā, ka whakaherea tāna whakahere hara, me tāna tahunga tinana;
me whakahere anō e ia te hipi toa, hei patunga mō te pai ki a Ihowā, me te kete taro rēwenakore; me whakahere anō e te tohunga tāna whakahere totokore, me tāna ringihanga.

"Ā, me heu e te Natari tōna mātenga, i wehea nei, ki te whatitoka o te tapenākara o te whakaminenga, ka tango ai i ngā makawe o tōna mātenga i wehea nei, ā, ka maka ki te ahi, ki tērā i raro i te patunga mō te pai.

"Ā, me tango e te tohunga te peke o te hipi toa, ina oti te kōhua, me tētahi o ngā keke rēwenakore i te kete, me tētahi o ngā keke angiangi, o ngā mea rēwenakore, ā, ka hoatu e ia ki ngā ringa o te Natari, i muri i te heunga o ōna makawe i wehea nei.
Nā, ka poipoia e te tohunga hei whakahere poipoi ki te aroaro o Ihowā. Ka tapu tēnei mā te tohunga, me te uma poipoi, me te hūhā hapahapai; ā muri iho ka inu wāina te Natari.

"Ko te ture tēnei mō te Natari, nāna te kī wehe, mō tāna whakahere hoki ki a Ihowā ina wehea, hei tāpiri mō tā tōna ringa i whiwhi ai. Kia rite ki tāna kī i kī ai; kei te ture o tōna wehenga te tikanga mō tāna e mea ai."
I kōrero anō a Ihowā ki a Mohi, i mea,
"Kōrero ki a Ārona rātou ko āna tama, mea atu: Kia pēnei tā koutou manaaki i ngā tama a Īharaira; mea atu ki a rātou,
‘Mā Ihowā koe e manaaki, māna koe e tiaki;
Mā Ihowā e mea kia tīaho tōna mata ki a koe, māna anō hoki koe e atawhai;
Mā Ihowā tōna kanohi e whakaara ki a koe, māna anō e tuku te rangimārie ki a koe.’
"Ā, ka karangatia e rātou tōku ingoa ki runga ki ngā tama a Īharaira; ā, māku rātou e manaaki."
Ā, i te rā i oti ai i a Mohi te tapenākara te whakaara, i whakawahia ai, i whakatapua ai hoki te tapenākara me ōna mea katoa, te āta, me ōna mea katoa, ā, ka oti te whakawahi, te whakatapu.
Nā, ka whakahere ngā ariki o Īharaira, ngā upoko o ngā whare o ō rātou mātua; ko rātou ngā ariki o ngā iwi, i a rātou hoki ngā tikanga mō te hunga i taua.

Ā, ka kawea mai e rātou tā rātou whakahere ki te aroaro o Ihowā, e ono ngā kāta whai taupoki, kotahi tekau mā rua ngā kau; tokorua ngā ariki kotahi anō te kāta, kotahi anō hoki te pūru a tētahi, a tētahi; ā, whakatūtūria ana e rātou ki te aronga o te tapenākara.
Ā, i kōrero a Ihowā ki a Mohi, i mea,
"Tangohia tā rātou, hei mea mō te mahi o te tapenākara o te whakaminenga; ā, me hoatu e koe ki ngā Rīwaiti, kia rite ki te mahi a tēnei, a tēnei."
Nā, tangohia ana e Mohi ngā kāta me ngā kau, ā, hoatu ana e ia ki ngā Rīwaiti.
E rua ngā kāta, e whā ngā kau i hoatu e ia ki ngā tama a Kerehona, he mea whakarite ki tā rātou mahi.
E whā ngā kāta, e waru ngā kau i hoatu e ia ki ngā tama a Merari, he mea whakarite ki tā rātou mahi, i te ringa o Itamara tama a te tohunga, a Ārona.
Ki ngā tama ia a Kohata, kīhai i hoatu e ia; nō te mea ko te mahi o te wāhi tapu mā rātou ko te kauhoa i runga i ō rātou pokohiwi.
Ā, i whakahere anō ngā ariki hei tāinga kawa mō te āta i te rā i whakawahia ai, i whakahere ngā ariki i ā rātou whakahere ki mua i te āta.
Nā, ka mea a Ihowā ki a Mohi, "Me hoatu e rātou ā rātou whakahere, tēnā ariki i tōna rā, tēnā ariki i tōna rā, hei tāinga kawa mō te āta."
Nā, ko te tangata nāna te whakahere i te rā tuatahi, ko Nāhahona tama a Aminarapa, nō te iwi o Hūrā.

Ā, ko tāna whakahere, he rīhi hiriwa, kotahi rau e toru tekau hekere te taimaha, he peihana, hiriwa, e whitu tekau ōna hekere, he hekere wāhi tapu; kī tonu rāua i te parāoa pai i kōnatunatua ki te hinu hei whakahere totokore;
kotahi koko kōura, tekau ōna hekere, kī tonu i te whakakakara;
kotahi pūru, he kūao, kotahi hipi toa, kotahi reme toa, he tau tahi, hei tahunga tinana;
kotahi koati toa hei whakahere hara;
e rua hoki ngā pūru hei patunga mō te pai, e rima hipi toa, e rima koati toa, e rima reme toa, he tau tahi; ko te whakahere tēnei a Nāhahona tama a Aminarapa.
I te rā tuarua nā Netanēre te whakahere; he tama ia nā Tuara, he ariki nō Ihākara.

Ko tāna whakahere i whakahere ai, he rīhi hiriwa, kotahi rau e toru tekau hekere te taimaha, he peihana hiriwa, e whitu tekau ōna hekere, he hekere wāhi tapu; kī tonu aua mea e rua i te parāoa pai i kōnatunatua ki te hinu hei whakahere totokore;
he koko kōura, tekau ōna hekere, kī tonu i te whakakakara;
kotahi pūru, he kūao, kotahi hipi toa, kotahi reme toa, he tau tahi, hei tahunga tinana;
kotahi koati toa hei whakahere hara;
e rua hoki ngā pūru hei patunga mō te pai, e rima hipi toa, e rima koati toa, e rima reme toa, he tau tahi. Ko te whakahere tēnei a Netanēre tama a Tuara.
I te rā tuatoru nā Eriapa, nā te tama a Herona, he ariki nō ngā tama a Hepurona.

Ko tāna whakahere he rīhi hiriwa, kotahi rau e toru tekau hekere te taimaha, he peihana, hiriwa, e whitu tekau ōna hekere, he hekere wāhi tapu; kī tonu rāua i te parāoa pai i kōnatunatua ki te hinu hei whakahere totokore;
kotahi koko kōura, tekau ōna hekere, kī tonu i te whakakakara;
kotahi pūru, he kūao, kotahi hipi toa, kotahi reme toa, he tau tahi, hei tahunga tinana;
kotahi koati toa hei whakahere hara;
e rua hoki ngā pūru hei patunga mō te pai, e rima ngā hipi toa, e rima koati toa, e rima reme toa, he tau tahi. Ko te whakahere tēnei a Eriapa tama a Herona.
I te rā tuawhā nā Erituru, nā te tama a Hereuru, he ariki nō ngā tama a Reupena.

Ko tāna whakahere he rīhi hiriwa, kotahi rau e toru tekau hekere te taimaha, he peihana hiriwa, e whitu tekau ōna hekere, he hekere wāhi tapu; kī tonu rāua i te parāoa pai i kōnatunatua ki te hinu, hei whakahere totokore;
he koko kōura, tekau ōna hekere, kī tonu i te whakakakara.
Kotahi pūru, he kūao, kotahi hipi toa, kotahi reme toa, he tau tahi, hei tahunga tinana;
kotahi koati toa hei whakahere hara;
e rua ngā pūru hei patunga mō te pai, e rima ngā hipi toa, e rima koati toa, e rima reme toa, he tau tahi; ko te whakahere tēnei a Erituru tama a Hereuru.
I te rā tuarima, nā Herumiere, nā te tama a Turiharai, he ariki nō ngā tama a Himiona.

He rīhi hiriwa tāna whakahere, kotahi rau e toru tekau hekere tōna taimaha, he peihana hiriwa, e whitu tekau ōna hekere, he hekere wāhi tapu; kī tonu rāua i te parāoa pai i kōnatunatua ki te hinu hei whakahere totokore;
kotahi koko kōura, tekau ōna hekere, kī tonu i te whakakakara;
kotahi pūru, he kūao, kotahi hipi toa, kotahi reme toa, he tau tahi, hei tahunga tinana;
kotahi koati toa hei whakahere hara;
e rua hoki ngā pūru hei patunga mō te pai, e rima hipi toa, e rima koati toa, e rima reme toa, he tau tahi. Ko te whakahere tēnei a Herumiere tama a Turiharai.
I te rā tuaono nā Eriāhapa, tama a Teuere, he ariki nō ngā tama a Kara.
