Tēnā ko ahau, i a rātou e mate ana, he kahu taratara tōku, waikauwere ana tōku wairua, kīhai i kai; ā, hoki mai ana tāku īnoi ki tōku uma.
Ko tōku āhua me te mea he hoa ia, he teina nōku; kūpapa noa iho ahau, ānō he tangata e tangi ana ki tōna whaea.
I tōku paheketanga ia koa ana rātou, huihui ana; huihui ana ngā tāngata kino noa iho hei hoariri mōku, kīhai anō ahau i mōhio, haehae ana rātou i ahau, kīhai hoki i mutu.
Rite tonu ki ngā kaiwhakakata o ngā hākari, tetēā ana ō rātou niho ki ahau.
E te Ariki, kia pēhea te roa o tāu titiro kau mai? Whakaorangia tōku wairua i ā rātou whakangaromanga, tāku e aroha nei, i ngā raiona.
Ka whakawhetai ahau ki a koe i roto i te whakaminenga nui, ka whakamoemiti ki a koe i roto i te iwi maha.
Kei hari pokanoa ki ahau ōku hoariri; kei whakakini te kanohi o te hunga e kino noa ana ki ahau.
Ehara hoki tā rātou i te kōrero mō te rangimārie; heoi kei te whakatakoto kupu tinihanga rātou mō te hunga āta noho o te whenua.
Inā, hāmama ana ō rātou māngai ki ahau, e kī ana, "Ha, ha, kua kite tō mātou kanohi!"
Kua kite koe, e Ihowā; kaua rā e wahangū, e te Ariki, kei matara i ahau.
Oho ake, e ara ki te whakarite i tōku whakawā, ki tāku tautohe, e tōku Atua, e tōku Ariki.
Kia rite ki tōu tika te whakarite mōku, e Ihowā, e tōku Atua: kei koa anō rātou ki ahau.
Kei mea rātou i roto i ō rātou ngākau, "Ha, ko tā mātou tēnā i pai ai." Kei mea rātou, "Kua horomia ia e tātou."
Kia whakamā, kia numinumi ngātahi, te hunga e koa ana ina hē ahau; kia whakakākahuria ki te whakamā, ki te numinumi, te hunga e whakakake ana ki ahau.
Kia hāmama i te hari, kia koa te hunga e pai ana ki tāku mahi tika; āe, kia mea tonu, "Kia whakanuia a Ihowā e whakapai nei ki te ora o tāna pononga."
Ā, ka kōrerotia e tōku arero tāu mahi tika, me te whakamoemiti ki a koe i te rā roa.
E mea ana te mahi kino a te tangata hara i roto i tōku ngākau, kāhore he wehi ki te Atua i mua i ōna kanohi.
E whakapai ana hoki ōna kanohi ake ki a ia anō, e kore e kitea tōna hara, e kore e kinongia.
He kino ngā kupu a tōna māngai, he rauhanga hoki, kua mahue i a ia te mahara, te mahi i te pai.
He mahi nanakia tāna e whakaaro ai i runga i tōna moenga; ehara i te pai te ara e tūria ana e ia, kāhore ōna whakarihariha ki te kino.
Kei ngā rangi, e Ihowā, tāu mahi tohu; tutuki noa atu tōu pono ki ngā kapua.
Rite tonu tōu tika ki ngā maunga o te Atua; he rire nui āu whakaritenga; ko koe, e Ihowā, te kaiwhakaora i te tangata, i te kararehe.
Anō te pai o tōu aroha, e te Atua; ka okioki ngā tama a te tangata i raro i te taumarumarutanga iho o ōu pākau.
Ka mākona rātou i ngā mea mōmona o tōu whare; ka whakainumia anō e koe ki te awa o āu mea whakahari.
Kei a koe hoki te puna o te ora; mā tōu mārama ka kite ai mātou i te mārama.
Kia roa tōu aroha ki te hunga e mātau ana ki a koe, tōu tika hoki ki te hunga ngākau tika.
Kei puta mai ki ahau te waewae whakapakari; kei āia atu ahau e te ringa o te hunga hara.
Hinga iho i reira ngā kaimahi i te kino; kua turakina iho, tē āhei te ara ake.
Kaua e mamae ki te hunga kino, kaua e hae ki ngā kaimahi i te hē,
nō te mea ka hohoro rātou te kotia, te pērātia me te tarutaru, ā, ka memenge me he otaota hou.
Whakawhirinaki ki a Ihowā, mahia te pai; e noho ki te whenua, ā, e aru i muri i te pono.
Whakaahuareka ki a Ihowā, ā, ka hōmai e ia ki a koe tā tōu ngākau i hiahia ai.
Tukua tōu ara ki a Ihowā; whakawhirinaki hoki ki a ia, ā, māna e mahi.
Māna hoki e whakaputa tōu tika, ānō he mārama, ōu ritenga me te mea ko te rā e tū ana.
Okioki ki a Ihowā, tatari mārie ki a ia; kei mamae ki te tangata e tere ana i tōna ara, ki te tangata e taea ana e ia ngā whakaaro kino.
Kāti te riri, whakarērea hoki te ārita. Kei mamae koe, kei tākina kia mahi i te kino.
Nō te mea ka hātepea atu te hunga kino; ko te hunga ia e tatari ana ki a Ihowā, ka riro i a rātou te whenua.
Kia potopoto ake nei hoki, ā, ka kore noa iho te hunga kino; āe rā, ka āta tirohia e koe tōna wāhi, ā, kore kau noa iho ia.
Nā, ka riro te whenua i te hunga māhaki; ā, ka hari rātou i te roa o te āta noho.
E whakangārahu ana te tangata kino mō te tangata tika; pakiri ana ōna niho ki a ia.
Ka kata te Ariki ki a ia, nō te mea ka kite ia e tata ana tōna rā.
Kua unuhia te hoari e te hunga kino, kua piko tā rātou kōpere, hei turaki i te ware, i te rawakore, hei kōhuru i te hunga e tika ana, i te ara.
Ka tapoko tā rātou hoari ki ō rātou ngākau; ā, ka whatia ā rātou kōpere.
Engari te wāhi iti a te tangata tika i ngā taonga o ngā tāngata kino tokomaha.
Ka whatia hoki ngā ringa o te hunga kino; ū tonu ia i a Ihowā te hunga tika.
E mātau ana a Ihowā ki ngā rā o te hunga tika; ā, ka pūmau tō rātou kāinga ake ake.
E kore rātou e whakamā i te wā o te hē, ka mākona anō rātou i ngā rā o te hemokai.
Ka ngaro ia te hunga kino, ā, ka rite ngā hoariri o Ihowā ki te mōmona o te tarutaru; ka mahea atu rātou – ka mahea atu me he paowa.
E tango ana te tangata kino i te taonga tārewa, kāhore hoki āna utu; ko te tangata tika ia he aroha tōna, he hōmai.
Ka riro hoki te whenua i āna e manaaki ai; ka hātepea anō āna e kanga ai.
Ka ū i a Ihowā ngā hīkoinga o te tangata tika; e paingia ana hoki e ia tōna ara.
Ahakoa hinga, e kore e tino takoto rawa; ka ū hoki ia i te ringa o Ihowā.
He tamariki ahau i mua, ā, kua koroheke nei, heoi, kāhore ahau i kite i te tangata tika e whakarērea ana, i ōna uri hoki e pīnono taro ana.
I te rā roa he atawhai tonu tāna, he ohaoha; ka manaakitia hoki ōna uri.
Whakarērea te kino, mahia te pai, ka noho tonu ai.
E aroha ana hoki a Ihowā ki te ritenga pai; e kore anō e whakarere i tāna hunga tapu. E tiakina tonutia ana rātou ake ake; ka hātepea atu ia ngā uri o te hunga kino.
Ka riro te whenua i te hunga tika, ka nohoia hoki a reira e rātou ake ake.
He kupu mōhio tā te māngai o te tangata tika; he ritenga pai tā tōna arero e kōrero ai.
Kei tōna ngākau te ture a tōna Atua; e kore e paheke tētahi o ōna hīkoinga.
E tau ana te titiro a te tangata kino ki te tangata tika, ā, e whai ana kia whakamatea ia.
E kore a Ihowā e whakarere i a ia ki tōna ringa; e kore anō ia e whakatau hē ki a ia ina whakawākia.
Tāria a Ihowā, kia mau ki tāna ara, ā, ka whakanuia koe e ia, ka whakawhiwhia hoki ki te whenua; e hātepea atu te hunga kino, ka kite koe.
I kite ahau i te tangata kino e kake ana, e tautorotoro ana me te rākau matomato i tōna oneone tupu.
Heoi, pahure noa ake tētahi, ā, kore kau noa iho; āe, i rapua ia e ahau, ā, kīhai i kitea.
Waitohutia te tangata tika, tirohia iho te tangata kore hē; nō te mea he mārie te tukunga iho ki taua tangata.
Tēnā ko te hunga kino, ka ngaro ngātahi atu rātou; te tukunga iho ki te hunga kino, ka hātepea atu rātou.
Nā Ihowā ia te whakaoranga o te hunga tika; ko ia tō rātou pā kaha i te wā o te hē.
Mā Ihowā rātou e āwhina, ko ia hoki hei tauārai mō rātou; ko ia hei tauārai mō rātou i te hunga kino, ka whakaorangia rātou e ia, mō rātou ka whakawhirinaki ki a ia.
E Ihowā, kaua e whakatūpehupehu mai ki ahau ina riri koe, kaua anō ahau e pākia ina ārita koe.
Titi tonu hoki āu pere ki ahau; kaha rawa te pēhi a tōu ringa i ahau.
Kāhore he wāhi ora o ōku kikokiko, nā tōu riri hoki; kāhore anō e āta takoto ōku wheua, nōku i hara nei.
Kua taupokina iho hoki tōku mātenga e ōku kino; ānō he pīkaunga taimaha e pēhi rawa ana i ahau.
E piro ana ōku whiunga, kua pirau i tāku mahi pōauau.
E whakawiria ana ahau, piko rawa; e tangi haere ana i te roa o te rā.
Kei te tahuna hoki tōku hope, kapi tonu; kāhore hoki he wāhi ora o ōku kikokiko.
Kua kore ōku kaha, marū rawa ahau; hāmama ana tāku auē i te mamae o tōku ngākau.
E te Ariki, kei tōu aroaro ōku hiahia katoa; kāhore hoki e ngaro i a koe tāku auē.
Kihakiha kau tōku ngākau, kua hemo tōku kaha; me te mārama o ōku kanohi, kua kore hoki ēnā ōku.
Matara noa atu i tōku mate te tūranga mai o ngā tāngata i aroha mai ki ahau, o ōku hoa hoki; i tawhiti anō ōku whanaunga e tū kē mai ana.
E whakatakoto māhanga ana mōku te hunga e whai ana i ahau kia whakamatea; he nanakia anō ngā kupu a te hunga e rapu ana i te hē mōku; he whakaaro tinihanga anō ā rātou ā pau noa te rā.
Ko ahau ia, i rite ki te turi, kīhai i rongo, ki te tangata wahangū, kāhore nei e hamumu tōna māngai.
Nā, rite tonu ahau ki te tangata kāhore nei e rongo, kāhore nei he whakatūpehupehu i tōna māngai.
E tūmanako nei hoki ahau ki a koe, e Ihowā; ka whakahoki kupu mai anō koe, e te Ariki, e tōku Atua.
I mea hoki ahau, "Kei koa mai rātou ki ahau; ka paheke tōku waewae, ka whakahīhī rātou ki ahau."
Ko ahau hoki, meāke kopa, ā, kei mua tonu i ahau tōku pōuri.
Ka whāki hoki ahau i tōku kino, ka pōuri mō tōku hara.
Ko ōku hoariri ia hauhau tonu, kaha tonu; kua tokomaha anō te hunga e kino noa ana ki ahau.
He hoariri anō ki ahau te hunga e utu ana i te pai ki te kino; mōku e whai ana i te pai.
Kaua ahau e whakarērea, e Ihowā, e tōku Atua; kei mamao atu koe i ahau.
Hohoro ki te āwhina i ahau, e te Ariki, e tōku whakaoranga.
I mea ahau, "Ka āta whakaaro ahau ki ōku ara, kei hara tōku arero; ka tiakina tōku māngai, paraire rawa, i te mea kei tōku aroaro te tangata kino.
I whakamoroki ahau, i wahangū, kīhai i puaki tāku kupu, ahakoa pai; ā, ka oho tōku mamae.
Werawera ana tōku ngākau i roto i ahau; i ahau e whakaaro ana ka kā te ahi, ā, ka kōrero tōku arero:
"E Ihowā, meinga ahau kia mātau ki tōku mutunga, ki te maha hoki o ōku rā, e hia rānei; kia mātau ai ahau he mea memeha noa ahau.
Nanā, he whānuitanga ringa ōku rā kua hōmai nei e koe; he kāhore noa iho anō ōku tau i tōu aroaro. Ahakoa ū noa te tū o ngā tāngata katoa, he mea memeha kau. Hera
He pono kei roto i te ātārangi te tangata e kōpikopiko noa ana; he pono e ohorere noa ana rātou; e āmi ana ia i te taonga, ā, kāhore e mātau mā wai rānei e kohi.
"Nā, he aha tāku e tatari atu nei, e te Ariki? Ko koe tāku e tūmanako ai.
Whakaorangia ahau i āku mahi tutū katoa; kaua ahau e waiho hei tāwainga mā te wairangi.
Wahangū ana ahau; kīhai i kuihi tōku māngai; he meatanga hoki tēnei nāu.
Nekehia atu i ahau tāu whiu; ka ngaro ahau i te pakinga a tōu ringa.
"Ka pākia e koe te tangata, ka whakatūpehupehutia mō te hara, ka meinga e koe tōna ātaahua kia memeha, kia pērā me te pūrehurehu. He pono he mea teka noa ngā tāngata katoa. Hera
"Whakarongo ki tāku īnoi e Ihowā, kia tītaha mai tōu taringa ki tāku karanga; kei wahangū koe ki ōku roimata. He heke hoki ahau nāu, he manene, he pērā me ōku mātua katoa.
Kia āta hanga ki ahau, kia tā ai tōku manawa, keiwhā haere atu ahau, i konei, ā, ka kāhore noa iho."
I tatari mārie ahau ki a Ihowā; ā, anga ana ia ki ahau, whakarongo ana ki tāku karanga.
Nā, kei te tango ake ia i ahau i te poka whakamataku, i te paru tāoruoru; kei te whakatū i ōku waewae ki runga ki te kōhatu, kei te whakaū i ōku hīkoinga.
Ā, hōmai ana e ia he waiata hou ki tōku māngai, he whakamoemiti ki tō tātou Atua. He tokomaha e kite, ā, ka wehi, ka whakawhirinaki ki a Ihowā.
Ka hari te tangata kua waiho nei e ia a Ihowā hei whakawhirinakitanga mōna; ā, kāhore e tahuri ki te hunga whakakake, ki te hunga hoki e peka ana ki te teka.

E Ihowā, e tōku Atua, he tini āu mahi whakamīharo i mahia e koe, me ōu whakaaro ki a mātou. E kore e taea te kōrero whakatepe atu ki a koe; me i mea ahau kia whakakitea, kia kōrerotia, e kore e taea te tatau.
Kīhai i matenuitia e koe te patunga tapu, me te whakahere; pokaia ana e koe ōku taringa. Kīhai koe i mea mai ki te tahunga tinana, ki te whakahere hara.
Nā, ko tāku meatanga atu, "Nā, kua tae mai ahau; kei roto i te pukapuka te tuhituhi mōku.
Ko taku pai ko te mea i tāu e pai ai, e tōku Atua; āe rā, kei tōku ngākau tāu ture."
Kua kauwhautia e ahau te tika i roto i te whakaminenga nui; nanā, kīhai i kopia ōku ngutu, tēnā koe te mātau ana, e Ihowā.
Kīhai i hunā e ahau tōu tika i roto i tōku ngākau; kua kōrerotia e ahau tōu pono me tāu whakaoranga; kīhai, i hunā e ahau tōu aroha me tōu pono i te whakaminenga nui.
Kei kaiponuhia tōu aroha ki ahau, e Ihowā; mā tōu atawhai me tōu pono ahau e tiaki i ngā wā katoa.
Tā te mea kua karapotia ahau e ngā kino e kore e taea te tatau; mau pū ahau i ōku kino, tē āhei te titiro ake; he tini kē i ngā makawe o tōku mātenga; ā, hemo iho tōku ngākau.
Kia pai, e Ihowā, ki te whakaora i ahau; e Ihowā, hohoro ki te āwhina i ahau.
Kia whakamā, kia pororaru ngātahi te hunga e rapu ana i tōku wairua kia whakamatea; kia whakahokia ki muri, kia whakamā te hunga e hiahia ana kia hē ahau.
Kia hunā, hei utu mō tō rātou whakamā te hunga e mea mai ana ki ahau, "Ha, ha!"
Kia hari, kia koa ki a koe te hunga katoa e rapu ana i a koe; kia mea tonu te hunga e pai ana ki tāu whakaoranga, "Kia whakanuia a Ihowā."
Ko ahau ia, he iti, he rawakore; heoi e whakaaro ana te Ariki ki ahau. Ko koe tōku āwhina, tōku kaiwhakaora; kaua rā e whakaroa, e tōku Atua.
Ka hari te tangata e whakaaro ana ki te rawakore; e whakaorangia ia e Ihowā i te rā o te hē.
Mā Ihowā ia e tiaki, e whakaora; ka whakaharitia ia i runga i te whenua. E kore anō e tukua e koe ki ngā hiahia o ōna hoariri.
Mā Ihowā ia e whakakaha, i a ia e whakaruhi ana i runga i te moenga: māu anō e whakapai katoa tōna moenga i a ia e mate ana.
I mea ahau, "E Ihowā, tohungia ahau; rongoātia tōku wairua; kua hara hoki ahau ki a koe."
He kino te kōrero a ōku hoariri mōku, e mea ana, "Āhea rānei ia mate ai, pirau ai tōna ingoa?"
Ā, ki te haere mai ia kia kite i ahau, ka kōrero horihori ia; e āmi ana tōna ngākau i te kino māna; i tōna putanga ki waho, kōrerotia ana e ia.
E kōmuhumuhu ana mōku te hunga katoa e kino ana ki ahau; e whakatakoto ana i te kino mōku.
E ai tā rātou, "E piri ana te mate kino ki a ia; ā, ka takoto nei ia, heoi anō tōna aranga ake."
Āe, ko tōku hoa ake anō, i whakawhirinaki ai ahau, i kai nei i tāku taro, kua hiki ake tōna rekereke ki ahau.
Ko koe ia, e Ihowā, kia aroha ki ahau; ā, whakaarahia ahau, kia utua ai rātou e ahau.
Nā konei ahau i mātau ai e pai ana koe ki ahau, nō te mea kāhore tōku hoariri e whakamanamana ki ahau.
Ko ahau ia, ko koe e whakamau ake ana i ahau i runga i tōku ngākau tapatahi; e whakatū ake ana hoki i ahau ki tōu aroaro ake tonu atu.
Kia whakapaingia a Ihowā, te Atua o Īharaira inamata riro anō, ake tonu atu anō hoki. Āmine, āe Āmine.
Rite tonu ki te hāta e kihakiha nei ki ngā manga wai tōku ngākau e kihakiha nei ki a koe, e te Atua.
E hiainu ana tōku wairua ki te Atua, ki te Atua ora; āhea ahau tae ai, puta ai ki te aroaro o te Atua?
Ko ōku roimata tāku kai i te ao, i te pō, i a rātou e mea tonu mai nei ki ahau, "Kei hea tōu Atua?"

Ka mahara ahau ki ēnei mea; me te wai tōku ngākau e maringi ana i roto i ahau: i haere hoki ahau i roto i te huihui, i haere tahi mātou ki te whare o te Atua, he hari te reo, he whakamoemiti, me te huihui e mea hākari ana.
He aha koe i piko ai, e tōku wairua? I ohorere ai i roto i ahau? Tūmanako ki te Atua; tērā anō ahau e whakawhetai ki a ia, mō te ora o tōna mata,
e tōku Atua. Kua piko tōku wairua i roto i ahau; koia ahau ka mahara ai ki a koe i te whenua o Horano, o ngā Heremoni, i Maunga Mitara.
Rarā ana tētahi rire ki tētahi rire i te haruru o āu āwhiowhio wai; tika ana āu ngaru katoa me āu tūātea i runga i ahau.
Ahakoa rā e whakahaua mai anō e Ihowā tōna atawhai i te awatea; ā, he waiata tāku ki a ia i te pō, he īnoi ki te Atua o tōku ora.
Ka mea ahau ki te Atua, "E tōku kōhatu, he aha koe i wareware ai ki ahau? He aha ahau ka haere pōuri ai i te tūkino a te hoariri?"
Ānō he hoari i roto i ōku wheua te tāwai a ōku hoariri; i a rātou e mea mai nei ki ahau i ngā rā katoa, "Kei hea tōu Atua?"
He aha koe i piko ai, e tōku wairua? He aha koe i ohorere ai i roto i ahau? Tūmanako ki te Atua; tērā anō ahau e whakawhetai ki a ia, ko te ora nei ia o tōku mata, ko tōku Atua.
E te Atua, whakaritea tāku whakawā, whakatikaia āku kōrero ki te iwi atuakore; whakaorangia ahau i te tangata tinihanga e mahi nei i te hē.
Ko koe hoki te Atua o tōku kaha; he aha ahau ka pangā nei e koe? He aha ahau ka haere pōuri ai i te tūkino a te hoariri?
Tukua mai tōu mārama me tōu pono hei ārahi i ahau; hei kawe i ahau ki tōu maunga tapu, ki ōu tapenākara.
Ā, ka haere ahau ki te āta a te Atua, ki te Atua, ki tōku hari nui; āe, ka whakamoemiti ki a koe, e te Atua, e tōku Atua, i runga i te hāpa.
He aha koe i piko ai, e tōku wairua? He aha koe i ohorere ai i roto i ahau? Tūmanako ki te Atua; tērā anō ahau e whakawhetai ki a ia, ko te ora nei ia o tōku mata, ko tōku Atua.
E te Atua, kua rongo ō mātou taringa, kua kōrerotia ki a mātou e ō mātou mātua, ngā mahi i mahia e koe i ō rātou rā, i ngā rā ō mua:
nāu ngā tauiwi i pana ki tōu ringa, nāu rātou i whakatō; nāu ngā iwi i whiu, ā, whakamararatia ana rātou.

Ehara hoki i te mea, nā tā rātou hoari i whiwhi ai rātou ki te whenua, ehara tō rātou tākakau i te mea i ora ai rātou; engari nā tōu matau, nā tōu tākakau hoki, nā te mārama anō o tōu mata, he pai hoki nōu ki a rātou.
E te Atua, ko koe tōku Kīngi; whakahaua he whakaora mō Hākopa.
Māu ka turaki ai mātou i ō mātou hoariri; mā tōu ingoa ka takahia ai e mātou te hunga e whakatika ana ki a mātou.
E kore hoki ahau e whakawhirinaki ki tāku kōpere; e kore anō tāku hoari e whakaora i ahau.
Nāu hoki mātou i ora ai i ō mātou hoariri; nāu anō i whakamā ai te hunga i kino ki a mātou.
Ko te Atua tā mātou e whakamanamana ai i te roa o te rā; ka whakamoemiti anō mātou ki tōu ingoa ake ake. Hera
Otirā, kua pangā nei mātou e koe, kua meinga kia whakamā; kāhore hoki koe kia haere tahi me ā mātou taua.
Kua meinga mātou kia hoki whakamuri mai i te hoariri; kei te pāhua anō i ētahi mā rātou te hunga e kino ana ki a mātou.
Kua hoatu mātou e koe, ānō he hipi e kainga ana; kua marara ki roto ki ngā tauiwi.
E hokona ana e koe tāu iwi, ā, hore he utu; kāhore hoki koe e whiwhi rawa i te utu mō rātou.
E meinga ana mātou e koe hei tāwainga mā ō mātou hoa kāinga; hei whakahāweatanga, hei whakakatanga mai mā te hunga i tētahi taha, i tētahi taha o mātou.
E meinga ana mātou e koe hei whakatauki mā ngā tauiwi; hei rurutanga mātenga mā ngā iwi.
Kei mua tonu i ahau tōku whakamā; kua taupokina ahau e te pāwera o tōku mata;
i te reo o te kaitāwai, o te kaikohukohu; i te hoariri, i te kairapu utu.
Kua pā katoa tēnei ki a mātou; heoi kāhore mātou i wareware ki a koe, kīhai anō i teka ki tāu kawenata.
Kāhore tō mātou ngākau i tahuri whakamuri; kīhai anō ō mātou hīkoinga i peka kē i tāu ara.
I marū ai mātou i a koe i te wāhi o ngā tarakona; ā, taupoki rawa ki te ātārangi o te mate.
Mehemea kua wareware mātou ki te ingoa o tō mātou Atua, kua totoro rānei ō mātou ringa ki te atua kē;
e kore rānei tēnei e āta tirohia e te Atua? E mātau ana hoki ia ki ngā mea ngaro o te ngākau.
Mōu nei hoki mātou i patua ai i te rā roa nei; kīia iho mātou he hipi e patua ana.
E ara, he aha koe ka moe ai, e te Ariki? Whakatika, kaua mātou e pangā tonutia.
He aha koe ka huna ai i tōu mata? Ka wareware ai ki tō mātou mamae, ki tō mātou tūkinotanga?
Kua piko nei hoki tō mātou wairua ki raro ki te puehu; piri rawa tō mātou kōpū ki te whenua.
E ara, hei āwhina i a mātou; kia mahara ki tōu aroha, ā, hokona mātou.
E pupuke ake ana te mea pai i roto i tōku ngākau; ka kōrerotia e ahau āku i tito ai mō te kīngi; he pene tōku arero nā te kaituhituhi hohoro.
Engari koe he ātaahua i ngā tama a te tangata; kua ringihia ōu ngutu ki te āhuareka; nā reira i manaakitia ai koe e te Atua ake ake.
Whītikiria tāu hoari ki tōu hūwhā, e te Nui Rawa, tōu korōria me tōu hōnore.
Aratakina hoki tōu hōiho i runga i tōu hōnore, i te kaha, hei mea hoki mō te pono, mō te māhaki, mō te tika, ā, mā tōu matau koe e whakaako ki ngā mea whakamataku.
He koi āu pere; ka hinga ngā iwi ki raro i a koe; kei roto rātou i te ngākau o ngā hoariri o te kīngi.
He pūmau, e te Atua, tōu torōna ake ake; he hēpeta tika te hēpeta o tōu kīngitanga.
Kua aroha koe ki te tika, kua kino ki te hara; nā reira, nui atu i tō ōu hoa te whakawahinga a te Atua, a tōu Atua i a koe ki te hinu o te hari.
Ko tōu kākahu katoa he kakara maira, he aroe, he kahia. Ko ngā mea aho, whakatangitangi o ngā whare rei nāna koe i whakaahuareka.
Kei roto i āu wāhine hōnore ngā tamāhine kīngi; kei tōu matau te kuīni e tū ana, nō Ōpira te kōura.
Whakarongo, e kō, titiro, tahuri iho tōu taringa; ā, kia wareware koe ki tōu iwi, ki te whare anō o tōu pāpā.
Pēnei ka matenuitia e te kīngi tōu ātaahua; ko ia hoki tōu Ariki; ā, me koropiko ki a ia.
Ko reira anō te tamāhine o Tāira me te ohaoha; ka whai anō ngā tāngata taonga o te iwi kia manakohia e koe.
Kei roto te tamāhine a te kīngi, he korōria kau, he mea whakairo ki te kōura tōna kākahu.
He mea whakapaipai ki te ngira tōna kākahu e kawea ai ia ki te kīngi; ka ārahina ki a koe ngā wāhina, ōna takahoa e whai ana i a ia.
He hari, he koa ina kawea mai rātou; ka tomo ki te whare o te kīngi.
Ko āu tamariki hei whakakapi mō ōu mātua; ka meinga anō rātou e koe hei kāwana mō te whenua katoa.
Ka meinga e ahau tōu ingoa kia maharatia e ngā whakatupuranga katoa; e whakamoemititia ai koe e ngā iwi ā ake ake.
Ko te Atua tō tātou piringa, tō tātou kaha; he kaiāwhina e tino tata ana i ngā wā o te hē.
Nā reira kore ake tō tātou wehi, ahakoa nekehia te whenua, ahakoa kāhakina ngā maunga ki waenga moana;
ahakoa rarā, taupatupatu noa ōna wai, ahakoa wiri ngā maunga i tōna huamo. Hera
He awa tēnā ko ōna manga hei whakahari i te pā o te Atua, i te wāhi tapu o ngā tapenākara o te Runga Rawa.
Kei waenganui ōna te Atua, e kore ia e whakakorikoria; mā te Atua ia e āwhina i te putanga anō o te ata.
I nanā ngā tauiwi, i whakakorikoria ngā rangatiratanga; puaki ana tōna reo, rewa ana te whenua.
Kei a tātou a Ihowā o ngā mano, ko te Atua o Hākopa tō tātou piringa. Hera
Haere mai, tirohia ngā mahi a Ihowā, ngā whakangaromanga i whakaputaina e ia ki te whenua.
E whakamutua ana e ia ngā whāinga ā te pito rā anō o te whenua; whati ana i a ia te kōpere, poro pū te tao, tahuna ake e ia te hāriata ki te kāpura.
"Kia āta noho, ā, kia mātau ko ahau te Atua; e whakanuia ahau i waenganui i ngā tauiwi, e whakanuia ahau i te whenua."
Kei a tātou a Ihowā o ngā mano; ko te Atua o Hākopa tō tātou piringa. Hera
Pākia ō koutou ringa, e ngā iwi katoa; hāmama ki te Atua, kia hari te reo.
Nō te mea he wehi a Ihowā, te Runga Rawa, he kīngi nui ia nō te whenua katoa.
Māna e riro ai ngā iwi ki raro i a tātou, me ngā tautāngata ki raro ki ō tātou waewae.
Māna e whiriwhiri tō tātou nohoanga mō tātou, te mea pai rawa o Hākopa, o tāna i aroha ai. Hera
Kua kake atu te Atua i roto i te hāmama, a Ihowā i roto i te tangi o te tētere.
Hīmene ki te Atua, hīmene atu; hīmene ki tō tātou Kīngi, hīmene atu.
Ko te Atua hoki te Kīngi o te whenua katoa; hīmene atu i runga i te mōhio.
Ko te Atua te Kīngi o ngā tauiwi; e noho ana te Atua i runga i te torōna o tōna tapu.
Kua huihui ngā rangatira o ngā iwi, hei iwi mō te Atua o Āperahama. Nā te Atua hoki ngā whakangungu rākau o te whenua; kua whakanuia rawatia ia.
He nui a Ihowā, kia nui hoki te whakamoemiti ki a ia i te pā o tō tātou Atua, i te maunga o tōna tapu;
ātaahua ana te tairanga o Maunga Hiona, ko tā te ao katoa e koa ai; kei te taha ki te raki te pā o te Kīngi nui.
E mātauria ana te Atua i roto i ōna whare papai hei piringa.
Nā, huihui tahi mai ana ngā kīngi, haere tahi atu ana rātou.
I kite rātou, mīharo iho; raruraru ana, hohoro tonu atu.
Pā ana te wehi ki a rātou i reira, te mamae, ānō he wahine e whānau ana.
E wāhia ana e koe ngā kaipuke o Tarahihi ki te marangai.
Rite tonu ki tā mātou i rongo ai, tā mātou i kite ai i roto i te pā o Ihowā o ngā mano, i te pā o tō tātou Atua; mā te Atua e whakapūmau ake ake. Hera
I whakaaroaro mātou ki tōu atawhai, e te Atua, i waenganui o tōu temepara.
E te Atua, rite tahi ki tōu ingoa te whakamoemiti mōu, tae noa atu ki ngā pito o te whenua; kī tonu tōu matau i te tika.
Kia hari a Maunga Hiona, kia koa ngā tamāhine a Hūrā i āu whakaritenga.
Taiāwhiotia a Hiona, haere, ā kōpiko noa mai; taua ōna pourewa,
maharatia ōna pekerangi, tirohia ōna whare papai; hei kōrerotanga mā koutou ki ēnei ake whakatupuranga.
Ko tēnei Atua hoki te Atua mō tātou ake ake. Ko ia hei kaiārahi i a tātou ā mate noa.
Whakarongo ki tēnei, e ngā iwi katoa; tahuri mai ō koutou taringa, e ngā tāngata katoa o te ao.
E ngā tāngata iti, koutou ko ngā tāngata rahi, e te tangata taonga kōrua ko te rawakore.
Ka whakapuakina he mātauranga e tōku māngai; ā, he āta ngārahu te whakaaro o tōku ngākau.
Ka tītaha tōku taringa ki te kupu whakarite; ka puaki tāku pepeha i runga i te hāpa.
Kia wehi ahau ki te aha i ngā rā o te kino, ina karapotia ahau e te kino kei ōku rekereke?
Ko te hunga e whakawhirinaki ana ki ō rātou taonga, e whakamanamana ana ki te nui o ō rātou rawa.
E kore tētahi o rātou e āhei te hoko i tōna teina, te hoatu rānei i tētahi utu mōna ki te Atua.
He nui hoki te utu mō tō rātou wairua, ā, me whakarere atu ake ake;
kia ora tonu ai ia ake ake, kia kaua e kite i te pirau.
E kite ana hoki ia e matemate ana ngā tāngata whakaaro nui, e ngaro ngātahi ana te pōauau me te whakaarokore, ā, mahue iho ō rātou taonga ki ētahi atu.
Ki tō rātou whakaaro puku, tērā e pūmau tonu ō rātou whare me ō rātou nohoanga, ki ngā whakatupuranga katoa; huaina iho ō rātou whenua ki ō rātou ingoa.
Heoi, kāhore te tangata e noho tonu i roto i te hōnore; ko tōna rite kei ngā kararehe ka mōtī nei.
Ko tō rātou ara tēnei, arā ko tō rātou pōauau; heoi e whakapai ana tō rātou uri ki ā rātou kōrero. Hera

Kei te hipi te rite; ko te wāhi mō rātou ko te rēinga; ko te mate hei hēpara mō rātou, hei rangatira anō te hunga tika mō rātou i te ata; ko tō rātou ātaahua mā te rēinga e whakamōtī, kia kore ai he whare mōna.
Mā te Atua ia tōku wairua e hoko mai i te rēinga; ko ia hoki hei tukunga atu mōku. Hera
Kaua e wehi ua whai taonga te tangata, ina nui haere te korōria o tōna whare.
Kāhore hoki āna mea e mau atu ai ia ina mate; e kore tōna korōria e tuku iho i muri i a ia.
Whakapai noa ia i tōna wairua i a ia e ora ana; ā, ka whakamoemititia koe ua pai āu mahi ki a koe anō.
Ka haere ia ki te whakatupuranga o ōna tūpuna; e kore rawa rātou e kite i te mārama.
Ko te tangata e whakahōnoretia ana, ā, kāhore e whai whakaaro, kei ngā kararehe ka mōtī nei tōna rite.
Kua puaki te kupu a te Atua, a te Atua tonu, a Ihowā, ā, karangatia ana e ia te whenua i te putanga mai o te rā, tae noa ki tōna torengitanga.
Kua tīaho mai te Atua i roto i Hiona, i te tino o te ātaahua.
Ka haere mai tō tātou Atua, e kore anō e wahangū; ka kai te kāpura i tōna aroaro, ā, ka hūkerikeri te āwhā ki tētahi taha ōna, ki tētahi taha.
Ka karangatia e ia ngā rangi i runga, me te whenua hoki, ki te whakaritenga mō tōna iwi.
"Huihuia mai ki ahau tāku hunga tapu, te hunga i whakarite kawenata ki ahau i runga i te patunga tapu."
Ā, mā ngā rangi e whakakite tōna tika; ko te Atua ake nei hoki te kaiwhakawā. Hera
"Whakarongo, e tōku iwi, ā, ka kōrero ahau; e Īharaira, ka whakaatu ahau ki a koe; ko ahau te Atua, ko tōu Atua.
E kore ahau e riri ki a koe mō āu patunga tapu; ā, kei tōku aroaro tonu āu tahunga tinana.
E kore ahau e tango i tētahi pūru i roto i tōu whare, i ētahi koati toa rānei i roto i āu taiepa.
Nāku nei hoki ngā kīrehe katoa o te ngahere, ngā kararehe i runga i te mano o ngā pukepuke.
E mātau ana ahau ki ngā manu katoa o ngā maunga; nāku anō ngā kīrehe o te pārae.
"Me he matekai tōku, e kore ahau e kōrero ki a koe; nāku nei hoki te ao, me ōna tini mea.
E kai koia ahau i te kikokiko o ngā pūru, e inu rānei i te toto o ngā koati?
Ko te whakawhetai hei patunga tapu māu ki te Atua; whakamanā hoki āu kupu taurangi ki te Runga Rawa.
Ā, karanga ki ahau i te rā o te hē; māku koe e whakaora, ā, ka whakakorōriatia ahau e koe."
Ki te tangata hara ia ka mea te Atua: "He aha māu te whakapuaki i āku tikanga, te whakahua rānei i tāku kawenata e tōu māngai?
Kua kino nei hoki koe ki te ako, ā, e ākiri ana i āku kupu ki muri i a koe.
I tōu kitenga i te tāhae, nā, whakaae ana koe ki a ia; ā, whai tahi ana me te hunga pūremu.
"Kua tukua e koe tōu māngai ki te kino; ā, e tito hīanga ana tōu arero.
Noho ana koe, ka kōrero kino ki tōu teina; ngautuarā tonu iho koe ki te tama a tōu whaea.
Ko āu mahi ēnei, ā, wahangū tonu ahau; i mea koe he pēnā pū ahau me koe. Otirā, ka rīria koe e ahau, ka whakarārangitia anō aua mea ki tōu aroaro.
"Nā, whakaaroa tēnei, e te hunga kua wareware ki te Atua; kei haehaea koutou e ahau, ā, kāhore he kaiwhakaora.
Ko te whakamoemiti te patunga tapu e whai korōria ai ahau; ko te tangata hoki he tika nei tōna ara ka whakakitea e ahau ki a ia te whakaoranga a te Atua."
Tohungia ahau, e te Atua, kia rite ki tōu atawhai; kia rite ki tōu aroha nui te murunga o ōku hē.
Horoia rawatia tōku kino; kia mā hoki tōku hara.
E whāki ana hoki ahau i āku mahi tutū; kei tōku aroaro tonu tōku hara.
He hara ki a koe, ki a koe anake, tōku; i meatia anō tēnei hē ki tōu aroaro; kia tika ai koe i tāu kōrerotanga, kia mā ai hoki ina whakawā.
Nā, i whakaahuatia ahau i roto i te kino, i runga anō i te hara tōku whakahapūtanga ki roto ki tōku whaea.
Nā, ko tāu e matenui ai ko te pono i ngā wāhi o roto, ā, ka whakaakona ōku wāhi ngaro e koe ki te whakaaro nui.
Purea ahau ki te hihopa, ā, ka mā ahau; horoia ahau, ā, ka mā kē atu i te hukarere.
Meinga kia rongo ahau i te hari, i te koa, ā, ka whakamanamana ngā iwi i whatia nei e koe.
Hunā tōu mata ki ōku hara; ā, murua katoatia ōku kino.
Hangā, e te Atua, he ngākau mā ki roto ki ahau; whakahoutia hoki ki roto ki ahau he wairua tika.
Kaua ahau e makā i tōu aroaro; kaua hoki tōu Wairua Tapu e tangohia i ahau.
Whakahokia mai ki ahau te hari o tāu whakaoranga; tautokona hoki ahau ki te wairua kakama.
Ko reira ahau whakaako ai i āu ara ki te hunga tutū; ā, ka tahuri te hunga hara ki a koe.
Whakaorangia ahau i te hara toto, e te Atua, e te Atua o tōku whakaoranga, ā, ka waiatatia āu mahi tika e tōku arero.
Whakatuwheratia ōku ngutu, e te Ariki; ā, ka puaki i tōku māngai te whakamoemiti ki a koe.
Kāhore nei hoki koe e aro ki te patunga tapu, pēnei kua hoatu e ahau. Kāhore koe e āhuareka ki te tahunga tinana.
Ko ngā patunga tapu mā te Atua he wairua marū; e kore koe e whakahāwea e te Atua, ki te ngākau marū, ki te ngākau iro.
Kia pai koe ki te atawhai i Hiona; hangā ngā taiepa o Hiruhārama.
Ko reira koe pai ai ki ngā patunga tapu o te tika, ki ngā tahunga tinana, he mea whakaeke katoa; ko reira rātou whakaeke ai i ngā pūru ki runga ki tōu āta.
He aha koe ka whakapakari ai ki te kino, e te tangata nui? He pūmau tonu te atawhai o te Atua.
E whakatakoto ana tōu arero i ngā mea nanakia, e mahi hīanga ana, ānō he heu koi.
E arohaina rawatia ana e koe te kino i te pai, te teka i te kōrero tika. Hera
E te arero hīanga, e arohaina ana e koe ngā kupu horomiti katoa.
Ka whakangaro hoki te Atua i a koe ake tonu atu; ka tangohia atu koe e ia, ka tākiritia atu i tōu nohoanga, ka hūtia atu hoki koe i te whenua o te ora. Hera
E kite hoki te hunga tika, ā, ka wehi; ka kata hoki ki a ia, ka mea,
"Inanā, ko te tangata tēnei kīhai nei i waiho e ia te Atua hei kaha mōna; otiia, whakawhirinaki ana ki te tini o āna taonga, whakapakari ana i runga i tāna mahi kino."
Ko ahau ia, e rite ana ki te ōriwa matomato i roto i te whare o te Atua; ka whakawhirinaki ahau ki te mahi tohu a te Atua ake ake.
Ka whakamoemiti tonu ahau ki a koe, nāu hoki tēnei i mea; ka tūmanako anō ki tōu ingoa; he mea pai hoki, ki te aroaro o tāu hunga tapu.
Kua kī te wairangi i roto i tōna ngākau, "Kāhore he Atua." Kua pirau rātou, he kino whakahouhou tā rātou mahi; kāhore tētahi e mahi ana i te pai.
I titiro iho te Atua i te rangi ki ngā tama a te tangata, kia kite me kāhore tētahi e mahara ana, e rapu ana i te Atua.
Kua hoki ki muri rātou katoa, kua pirau tahi; kāhore tētahi e mahi ana i te pai, kāhore kia kotahi.
E kore rānei e mōhio ngā kaimahi i te kino, e kai nei i tōku iwi, me te mea e kai taro ana; ā, kāhore e karanga ki te Atua?

Wehi noa iho rātou i reira, i te wāhi kāhore he wehi. Nō te mea kua tītaria e te Atua ngā wheua o te tangata i whakapaea ai koe; kua whakamā rātou i a koe, nō te mea kua whakahāweatia rātou e te Atua.
Auē, me i puta mai te whakaoranga o Īharaira i Hiona! Kia whakahokia mai e te Atua tāna iwi i te whakarau, ka whakamanamana a Hākopa, ka hari a Īharaira.
E te Atua, kia whakaorangia ahau e tōu ingoa; kia whakawākia hoki ahau e tōu kaha.
E te Atua, whakarongo ki tāku īnoi, tahuri mai tōu taringa ki ngā kupu a tōku māngai.
Nō te mea kua whakatika mai ngā tāngata iwi kē ki ahau, ā, e whāia ana tōku wairua e te hunga tūkino; kāhore i waiho e rātou te Atua ki tō rātou aroaro. Hera
Tēnei te Atua hei kaiāwhina mōku; kei roto te Ariki i te hunga e tautoko ake ana i tōku wairua.
Māna e utu te kino o ōku hoariri; hunā rātou, he pono nei hoki koe.
Ka kakama ahau ki te mea patunga tapu ki a koe, ka whakamoemiti ki tōu ingoa, e Ihowā, he mea pai hoki.
Kua whakaorangia hoki ahau e ia i roto i ngā hē katoa; ā, kua titiro tōku kanohi ki te mea e hiahia ana ahau ki ōku hoariri.
E te Atua, tahuri mai tōu taringa ki tāku īnoi; kei whakangaro atu koe, ina tangi ahau.
Anga mai ki ahau, whakahokia mai he kupu ki ahau; pōkaikaha noa iho ahau i ahau e tangi nei, e hāmama nei;
i te reo hoki o te hoariri, i te tūkino a te tangata kino. Nō te mea e utaina ana e rātou he hara ki runga ki ahau, ā, e kino ana ki ahau, e riri ana.
Mamae pū tōku ngākau i roto i ahau; kua taka ki runga ki ahau ngā wehi whakamate.
Kua pā ki ahau te wehi me te wiri; ā, pōkia iho ahau e te whakamataku.
Nā, ko tāku meatanga, "Auē, te whai pākau ahau me he kūkupa; pēnei ka rere atu ahau, ā, ka whai okiokinga.
Kātahi ahau ka rere ki tawhiti; ā, noho rawa atu i te koraha. Hera
Ka hohoro tōku rere atu i te hau, i te āwhā."
Whakangaromia, e te Ariki, wehea ō rātou arero; kua kitea hoki e ahau te tūkino me te tutū o roto o te pā.
Hāereere ana rātou i te ao, i te pō, i runga i ōna taiepa, ā tawhio noa; he kino kei roto, he hīanga.
He hara kei waenganui ōna; kāhore ōna ara e mahue i te tinihanga, i te hīanga.
Ehara hoki i te hoariri nāna ahau i tāwai; pēnei e taea e ahau te whakaririka; ehara hoki i te hoa whawhai nōku i whakakake ki ahau; pēnei kua piri ahau, kei kitea e ia.
Nāu ia, nā te tangata i rite ki ahau, nā tōku takahoa, nā tāku i mōhio ai.
Āhuareka tonu tā tāua kōrerorero; haere tahi ana hoki tāua i roto i te rōpū ki te whare o te Atua.
Kia mau ohorere rātou i te mate, kia heke ora ki te rēinga; he hara hoki kei ō rātou nohoanga, kei waenganui i a rātou.
Ko ahau, ka karanga ahau ki te Atua; ā, mā Ihowā ahau e whakaora.
I te ahiahi, i te ata, i te poutūmārōtanga, ka īnoi ahau, ka tangi; ā, ka whakarongo ia ki tōku reo.
Whakaorangia ana e ia tōku wairua i runga i te rangimārie i ahau e whakaekea ana; he tokomaha hoki ōku hoa whawhai.
Ka whakarongo te Atua, nō tua iho nei tōna nohoanga, ā, ka whakahoki i tā rātou. Hera Ko te hunga kāhore ō rātou whakawhitiwhitinga, ā, kāhore ō rātou wehi ki te Atua.
Kua totoro ōna ringa ki te hunga kua mau nei tā rātou rongo ki a ia; kua whakatakā e ia tāna kawenata.
Māeneene atu tōna māngai i te pata, he whawhai ia kei roto i tōna ngākau; ngāwari atu āna kupu i te hinu, kāhore, he hoari kua oti te unu.
Makā ki runga ki a Ihowā tāu pīkaunga, ā, māna koe e whakaū ake; e kore e tukua e ia te hunga tika kia whakangāueuetia ake ake.
Māu ia rātou e mea, e te Atua, kia heke ki te poka o te pirau; e kore ngā tāngata toto, ngā tāngata hīanga e tutuki ki te hāwhe o ō rātou rā. Ko ahau ia, ka whakawhirinaki ki a koe.
Tohungia ahau e te Atua, ka horomia hoki ahau e te tangata; e tūkino ana ia ki ahau i te rā roa nei, i a ia e ngangare tonu nei.
E whai ana ōku hoariri i te rā roa nei, kia horomia ahau; he tokomaha nei hoki e whakahī ana, e whawhai mai ana ki ahau.
Ka whakawhirinaki ahau ki a koe i te wā e mataku ai ahau.
Mā te Atua ahau ka whakamoemiti ki tāna kupu; e whakawhirinaki ana ahau ki te Atua, e kore ahau e wehi. He aha tā te kikokiko e mea ai ki ahau?
E whakariroia kētia ana e rātou āku kupu i ngā rā katoa; heoi anō tā rātou e whakaaro ai ko te kino mōku.
E huihui ana rātou, e piri ana; e titiro matatau ana ki ōku hīkoinga, i a rātou e whanga nei ki tōku wairua.
Mā te hē koia rātou ka mawhiti ai? Kia riri koe, e te Atua, whakatakā iho hoki ngā iwi.
E taua ana e koe ōku kōpikopikotanga; rongoātia ōku roimata ki roto ki tāu ipu; kāhore ianei i tāu pukapuka?
I te rā e karanga ai ahau ka hoki whakamuri ōku hoariri; e mātau ana ahau ki tēnei, kei ahau hoki te Atua.
Mā te Atua ahau ka whakamoemiti ai ki tāna kupu; mā Ihowā ahau ka whakamoemiti ai ki tāna kupu.
E whakawhirinaki ana ahau ki te Atua; e kore ahau e wehi. He aha tā te tangata e mea ai ki ahau?
Kei ahau ngā kupu taurangi ki a koe, e te Atua; me tuku e ahau ngā whakamoemiti ki a koe.
Nāu hoki tōku wairua i whakaora kei mate; e kore ianei koe e whakaū i ōku waewae kei paheke, kia haere ai ahau i te aroaro o te Atua i roto i te mārama o te hunga ora.
Tohungia ahau, e te Atua, tohungia ahau, e whakawhirinaki ana hoki tōku wairua ki a koe; āe, ka piri ahau ki raro ki te taumarumarutanga o ōu pākau, kia pahemo rā anō ēnei mate.
Ka karanga ahau ki te Atua, ki te Runga Rawa, ki te Atua e oti ai āku mea katoa.
Ka ungā mai e ia he kaiwhakaora mōku i te rangi, ina tāwai te tangata e mea ana kia horomia ahau. Hera Ka ungā mai e te Atua tāna mahi tohu me tōna pono.
Kei waenganui tōku wairua i ngā raiona; e takoto ana ahau i waenganui i te hunga e kāia ana e te ahi; i ngā tama hoki a te tangata, he tao nei ō rātou niho, he pere, he hoari koi anō ō rātou arero.
Kia whakanuia koe, e te Atua, ki runga ake i ngā rangi; hei runga atu i te whenua katoa tōu korōria.
Kua whakatakotoria e rātou he kupenga mō ōku takahanga, kua piko tōku wairua; kua keria e rātou he poka ki tōku aroaro, ā, taka iho ko rātou anō ki roto. Hera
Pūmau tonu tōku ngākau, e te Atua, pūmau tonu tōku ngākau; ka waiata ahau, āe, ka hīmene ahau.
E ara, e tōku korōria! E ara, e te hātere, e te hāpa; ka ara wawe anō ahau.
Ka whakamoemiti ahau ki a koe, e te Ariki, i waenganui i ngā iwi; ka hīmene ki a koe i waenganui i ngā tauiwi.
He nui hoki tāu mahi tohu, ā tutuki noa ki ngā rangi, me tōu pono ā tutuki noa ki ngā kapua.
Kia whakanuia koe, e te Atua, ki runga i ngā rangi; hei runga i te whenua katoa tōu korōria.
He kōrero puku rānei tā koutou i te pono? He tika rānei tā koutou whakarite, e ngā tama a te tangata?
He pono, e mahia ana e koutou te hē i roto i te ngākau, e pāunatia ana e koutou te tutū a ō koutou ringa i runga i te whenua.
He tangata kē te hunga hara nō te kōpū mai anō; whānau kau kua kotiti kē, kua kōrero teka.
Ko tō rātou paihana he rite ki tō te nākahi, kei te neke turi e puru nei i tōna taringa;
e kore nei e whakarongo ki te reo o te kaiwhakawai, ahakoa tino mātau ia ki te whakawai.
Whatia, e te Atua, ō rātou niho i roto i ō rātou māngai; kōwhakia, e Ihowā, ngā niho nunui o ngā kūao raiona.
Kia mimiti rātou, ānō he wai e heke atu ana; ka whakatikaia āna pere, kia rite ki te mea kua pōutoa.
Kia memeha haere, ā, kia pahure, ānō he ngata; kia rite ki te mea mate roto a te wahine, kāhore nei i kite i te rā.
E kore e tukua kia rongo ā koutou kōhua i ngā tātarāmoa, ka kāhakina rātou e ia i roto i te āwhiowhio, te mea kaiota, te mea e wera ana.
Ka hari te tangata tika ua kite i te utu; ka horoia e ia ōna waewae ki ngā toto o te tangata hara.
Ā, ka mea te tangata, "Koia, ka whai utu te tangata tika; inā, he Atua anō tēnei e whakawā ana i te whenua."
Whakaorangia ahau, e tōku Atua, i ōku hoariri; whakateiteitia ake ahau i te hunga e whakatika ana ki ahau.
Whakaorangia ahau i ngā kaimahi i te kino; kia ora ahau i te hunga toto.
Kei te whanga nei hoki rātou mō tōku wairua; e whakamine ana te hunga kaha ki te whawhai ki ahau; kāhore nei ōku tutū, kāhore ōku hara, e Ihowā.
Hore ōku kino, oma ana rātou, kei te takatū; e ara hei āwhina mōku, titiro mai hoki.
Āe rā, maranga, e Ihowā, e te Atua o ngā mano, e te Atua o Īharaira, tirohia iho ngā tauiwi katoa: kaua e tohungia tētahi o te hunga kino, e poka kē nei. Hera
Ka hoki mai rātou i te ahiahi, kei te tau, ānō he kurī, taiāwhiotia ana e rātou te pā.
Nanā, kei te kūpā ō rātou māngai, he hoari kei ō rātou ngutu; ki tā rātou, "Ko wai e rongo?"
Ko tāu ia, e Ihowā, he kata ki a rātou; hei tāwainga māu ngā tauiwi katoa.
E tōku kaha, ka tatari ahau ki a koe; ko te Atua hoki tōku pā.
Kei mua i ahau tōku Atua aroha; mā te Atua ahau ka kite i tāku i hiahia ai ki ōku hoariri.
Kaua rātou e whakamatea, kei wareware tōku iwi; kia whakamararatia rātou e tōu kaha; whakatakā iho rātou, e te Ariki, e tō mātou whakangungu rākau.
Mō te hara o tō rātou māngai, mō ngā kupu a ō rātou ngutu, hopukia rātou i runga i tō rātou whakakake, mō tā rātou kōrero, he kanga, he teka.
Whakamōtītia i runga i te riri, kia kāhore ai rātou; ā, kia mātau rātou ko te Atua te Kāwana o Hākopa puta noa ki ngā pito o te whenua. Hera
I te ahiahi tukua rātou kia hoki, tukua rātou kia tau, ānō he kurī, kia taiāwhio rātou i te pā.
Ka kōpikopiko noa rātou ki te rapu kai, ā, ka tauwhanga i te pō roa ina kore rātou e mākona.
Ko ahau ia, ka waiatatia e ahau tōu kaha; āe, i te ata ka hāmamatia e ahau tāu mahi tohu. Ko koe hoki tōku pā, tōku piringa i te rā o tōku pōuri.
Ka hīmene ahau ki a koe, e tōku kaha; ko te Atua nei hoki tōku pā, tōku Atua aroha.
E te Atua, kua panga mātou e koe, kua oti mātou te whakamarara e koe, kua riri koe; tahuri mai anō ki a mātou!
Wiri ana te whenua i a koe, kua ngātata i a koe; whakakapia ōna wāhi pakaru, e rū ana hoki.
He mea pakeke kua whakakitea e koe ki tāu iwi, kua oti mātou te whakainu e koe ki te wāina e wiri ai.
Kua hōmai e koe he kara ki te hunga e wehi ana i a koe; kia whakakitea hei mea mō te pono. Hera
Hei mea e mawhiti ai āu e aroha ai; mā tōu matau e whakaora, whakahokia mai hoki he kupu ki ahau.
Kua kōrero te Atua i runga i tōna tapu; "Ka hari ahau, ka kotikoti i Hekeme, ka roherohe hoki i te raorao o Hukota.
Nōku Kireara, nōku anō a Mānahi, ko Ēparaima anō hoki te kaha o tōku mātenga; ko Hūrā tāku kaiwhakatakoto ture;
ko Moapa tāku oko horoi; ka makā e ahau tōku hū ki runga ki Ēroma; e Pirihitia, ko ahau hei whakamanamana māu."
Mā wai ahau e kawe ki te pā kaha? Nā wai ahau i ārahi ki Ēroma?
He teka rānei, e te Atua, kua pangā mātou e koe? Kāhore hoki koe, e te Atua, e haere tahi me ā mātou taua.
Hōmai he āwhina mō mātou ki ō mātou hoariri; he teka noa hoki te āwhina a te tangata.
Mā te Atua tātou ka toa ai; māna hoki e takahi ki raro ō tātou hoa whawhai.
Whakarongo, e te Atua, ki tāku karanga; tahuri mai ki tāku īnoi.
Ka karanga ahau ki a koe i te pito o te whenua, ina pēhia tōku ngākau. Ārahina ahau ki te kōhatu e tiketike ake ana i ahau.
He piringa hoki koe mōku; he pā kaha i te hoariri.
Ka noho ahau ki tōu tapenākara ake ake, ka okioki ki ōu pākau hei piringa. Hera
Kua rongo nei hoki koe, e te Atua i āku kupu taurangi, kua hōmai e koe te wāhi o te hunga e wehi ana ki tōu ingoa.
Ka whakaraneatia e koe ngā rā o te kīngi; ōna tau ki ngā whakatupuranga katoa.
E noho ia i te aroaro o te Atua ake ake; whakaritea mai he aroha, he pono, hei tiaki i a ia.
Pēnei ka hīmene ahau ki tōu ingoa ake ake; ka whakamanā e ahau āku kupu taurangi i tēnei rā, i tēnei rā.
Ko te Atua anake tāku e tatari nei; kei a ia te whakaoranga mōku.
Ko ia anake tōku kōhatu, tōku whakaoranga, tōku pā hoki, e kore e nui tōku ngāueuetanga.
Kia pēhea te roa o tā koutou tatau ki te tangata, kia whakamatea ai e koutou, e koutou katoa, ka rite ki te taiepa e tūngou ana, ki te wāwā ka tata te hinga?
Heoi anō tā rātou e rūnanga ai ko te turaki i a ia i tōna wāhi teitei; E āhuareka ana ki te teka; e manaaki ana ō rātou māngai, ā, e kanga ana a roto i a rātou. Hera
Tatari, e tōku wairua, ki te Atua anake; ko ia tāku e tūmanako nei.
Ko ia anake tōku kōhatu, tōku whakaoranga, tōku pā hoki; e kore ahau e whakangāueuetia.
Kei te Atua te whakaoranga mōku, te korōria anō mōku; kei te Atua te kōhatu o tōku kaha, tōku piringa.
Whakawhirinaki ki a ia i ngā wā katoa, e te iwi, ringihia tō koutou ngākau ki tōna aroaro; hei piringa mō tātou te Atua. Hera
He pono he mea memeha noa ngā ware, he teka noa ngā rangatira; ki te pāunatia rātou, māmā noa ake rātou tahi i te horihori.
Kaua e whakawhirinaki ki te tūkino, kei wairangi hoki ki te pāhua; ki te tini haere ngā taonga, kei whakamanawa tō koutou ngākau ki reira.
Kotahi kōrerotanga a te Atua, ka rua ōku rongonga i tēnei: nō te Atua te kaha,
nāu anō, e te Ariki, te mahi tohu; rite tonu hoki ki tāna mahi tāu utu ki te tangata.
E te Atua, nōku koe Atua; ka moata tāku rapu i a koe. E hiainu ana tōku wairua ki a koe, e hiahia ana ōku kikokiko ki a koe, i te whenua maroke, ruha noa, kāhore nei he wai.
Koia i titiro atu ai ahau ki a koe i te wāhi tapu, kia kite ai i tōu kaha, i tōu korōria.
Pai atu tōu aroha i te ora; mō reira ka whakamoemiti ōku ngutu ki a koe.
Inā, ka whakapai ahau ki a koe i ahau anō e ora nei; ka totoro atu ōku ringa i runga i tōu ingoa.
Ka mākona tōku wairua, ānō i te hinu wheua, i te ngako, ā, ka hari ōku ngutu ina whakamoemiti tōku māngai ki a koe.
Ina mahara ahau ki a koe i runga i tōku moenga, ina whakaaro ki a koe i ngā mataaratanga o te pō.
Ko koe hoki tōku kaiāwhina; nā, ka hari ahau ki te taumarumarutanga iho o ōu pākau.
Piri tonu tōku wairua ki a koe e tautoko ake ana tōu matau i ahau.
Ko te hunga e whai ana i tōku wairua kia whakangaromia, ka riro rātou ki ngā wāhi o raro rawa o te whenua.
Ka tukua atu rātou ki te kaha o te hoari; hei wāhi rātou mā ngā pokiha.
Tēnā ko te kīngi, ka hari ia ki te Atua; ka whakamanamana ngā tāngata katoa ko ia nei tā rātou oati; ā, ka purua te māngai o te hunga katoa e kōrero teka ana.
Whakarongo ki tōku reo, e te Atua, ina īnoi atu ahau; tiakina tōku ora i te wehi o te hoariri.
Hunā ahau i te whakaaro ngaro o te hunga kino, i te ngangau a ngā kaimahi i te hē.
Kua whakakoi nei i ō rātou arero, ānō he hoari, kua whakatika nei i ā rātou pere, arā i ngā kupu kikino.
Hei kōperenga pukutanga mā rātou ki te tangata tika; kitea rawatia ake kua kōpere ki a ia, kāhore hoki he wehi.
E whakamāia ana rātou i a rātou anō ki te mea kino; e rūnanga ana kia whakatakotoria pukutia he rore, e mea ana, "Ko wai e kite i a rātou?"
E rapu hara ana rātou; e mea ana, "Kua āta rapu mārie tātou." Taea noatia te hōhonutanga o te whakaaro o ia tangata, ā, ko te ngākau he hōhonu.
Mā te Atua ia e kōpere he pere ki a rātou kitea rawatia ake kua tū rātou.
Heoi, ka meinga rātou kia tapatu, ko tō rātou arero ake anō ka tū atu ki a rātou; ā, ka rūrū i tō rātou mātenga te hunga katoa e kite i a rātou.
Ka wehi anō hoki ngā tāngata katoa, ka whakapuaki i te mahi a te Atua; ka āta maharatia hoki e rātou tāna mahi.
Ka koa te tangata tika ki a Ihowā, ka whakawhirinaki hoki ki a ia; ka whakamanamana anō te hunga ngākau tika katoa.
E tāria ana koe, e te Atua, e te whakamoemiti i Hiona; ā, ka whakamanā te kupu taurangi ki a koe.
E te kaiwhakarongo īnoi, e haere ngā kikokiko katoa ki a koe.
E kaha ake ana i ahau ngā kino; ā mātou mahi tutū, māu ēnā e hīpoki.
Ka hari te tangata e whiriwhiria e koe, e meatia e koe kia tata atu ki a koe, kia noho i roto i ōu marae. Ka mākona mātou i te pai o tōu whare, o tōu temepara tapu.
He mea whakawehi, he tapu, tāu utu kupu ki a mātou, e te Atua o tō mātou whakaoranga, e te okiokinga o ngā pito katoa o te whenua, o te hunga hoki i tawhiti i runga o te moana;
e whakaū nei i ngā maunga, he kaha hoki nōna; tōna whītiki nei he kaha.
E whakamārie nei i te haruru o ngā moana, i te haruru o ō rātou ngaru, i te ngangau hoki o ngā iwi.
Ka wehi anō ki āu tohu te hunga e noho ana i ngā pito rawa; hari ana i a koe ngā pūtake o te ata, o te ahiahi.

E tirotirohia ana e koe te whenua, e whakamākūkūria ana, e whakamōmonatia nuitia ana e koe; kī tonu te awa o te Atua i te wai; oti rawa ake te whakapai e koe, kua rite mai i a koe he wīti mō aua wāhi.
Mākūkū rawa i a koe ōna moa, pē ana i a koe ōna tupuke; e whakangāwaritia ana e koe ki ngā ua; e manaakitia ana e koe tōna pihinga ake.
E karaunatia ana e koe te tau ki tōu pai; e māturuturu ana hoki te mōmonatanga o ōu ara.
E māturuturu ana ki ngā wāhi kai o te koraha; ā, whītikiria ana ngā pukepuke ki te koa.
He hipi te kākahu o ngā wāhi kai; ngaro ana ngā raorao i te wīti. Hāmama ana rātou i te hari, waiata ana.
Hāmama, e te whenua katoa, ki te Atua!
Hīmenetia te korōria o tōna ingoa, kia whai korōria te whakamoemiti ki a ia.
Mea atu ki te Atua, "Anō te wehi o āu mahi! Mā te nui o tōu kaha e ngohengohe ai ōu hoariri ki a koe.
E koropiko katoa te whenua ki a koe; ka hīmene ki a koe; ka hīmene rātou ki tōu ingoa." Hera
Haere mai kia kite i ngā mahi a te Atua: mataku rawa tāna mahi ki ngā tama a te tangata.
Nāna i mea te moana hei tuawhenua; haere ā-waewae ana rātou rā roto i te awa; hari ana mātou ki a ia i reira.
Ko tōna kāwanatanga tūturu tonu i runga i tōna kaha; e titiro ana ōna kanohi ki ngā tauiwi; kei whakakake te hunga tutū. Hera
Whakapaingia tō tātou Atua, e ngā iwi; kia rangona te reo whakamoemiti ki a ia.
Nāna nei hoki i mau ai tō tātou wairua ki te ora, kāhore hoki e tukua e ia ō tātou waewae kia nekehia.
Kua whakamātauria hoki mātou e koe, e te Atua; whakarewaia ana mātou e koe, ānō he hiriwa e whakarewaia ana.
Kua kawea nei mātou e koe ki roto ki te kupenga; whakapīkaua ana e koe te mea whakamamae ki ō mātou hope.
I meinga anō e koe ō mātou upoko kia ekengia hōihotia e te tangata; i rā roto mātou i te kāpura, i te wai; heoi whakaputaina mai ana mātou e koe ki te wāhi mōmona.
Ka tomo ahau me ngā tahunga tinana ki tōu whare; ka whakamana ahau i āku kupu taurangi ki a koe,
ērā i puaki i ōku ngutu, i kōrerotia e tōku māngai i ahau e pōuri ana.
Ka whakaekea e ahau māu ngā mea mōmona hei tahunga tinana, ngātahi anō me te mea kakara o ngā hipi toa; ka tukua e ahau he pūru, he koati. Hera
Haere mai, whakarongo, e koutou katoa e wehi ana ki te Atua, ā, māku e whakapuaki tāna i mea ai ki tōku wairua.
I tangi tōku māngai ki a ia; i whakanuia anō ia e tōku arero.
Ki te whakaaroa e tōku ngākau te hē, e kore te Ariki e whakarongo mai.
Nei rā he pono kua whakarongo te Atua, kua tahuri ia ki tōku reo īnoi.
Kia whakapaingia te Atua, kīhai nei i whakapeau kē i tāku īnoi, i tāna atawhai hoki ki ahau.
Mā te Atua tātou e atawhai, māna tātou e manaaki; māna e mea kia tīaho tōna mata ki a tātou; Hera
kia mātauria ai tāu ara ki runga ki te whenua, tāu whakaoranga i roto i ngā tauiwi katoa.
Kia whakamoemiti ngā iwi ki a koe, e te Atua, kia whakamoemiti ngā iwi katoa ki a koe.
Kia koa ngā tauiwi, kia waiata i te hari; nō te mea ka tika tāu whakawā mō ngā iwi, ā, ka kāwana koe i ngā tauiwi o te whenua. Hera
Kia whakamoemiti ngā iwi ki a koe, e te Atua, kia whakamoemiti ngā iwi katoa ki a koe.
Kua tuku mai nei te whenua i ōna hua; ā, ka manaaki te Atua, tō tātou Atua, i a tātou.
Ka manaaki te Atua i a tātou; ā, ka wehi ngā pito katoa o te whenua i a ia.
Kia ara te Atua, kia marara ōna hoariri; kia whati hoki i tōna aroaro te hunga e kino ana ki a ia.
Āia atu rātou, pērātia me te paowa e āia ana; kia rite ki te ware pī e rewa ana i te kāpura te ngaromanga o te hunga kino i te aroaro o te Atua.
Kia koa ia te hunga tika kia hari i te aroaro o te Atua; āe rā, kia tino hari pū rātou.
Waiata ki te Atua, hīmenetia tōna ingoa; opehia ake he huanui mō tana hāriata i ngā koraha – tōna ingoa ko IHA – kia hari hoki ki tōna aroaro.
Hei matua mō ngā pani, hei kaiwhakarite mō ngā pouaru, te Atua i tōna nohoanga tapu.
E whakanohoia ana e te Atua te mokemoke ki te whare, e whakaputaina ana e ia ngā herehere ki te ora; ko te hunga tutū ia e noho i te wāhi waikore.
E te Atua, i tōu haerenga atu i mua i tāu iwi; i tōu haerenga i te koraha; Hera
i wiri te whenua, i tūturu iho anō ngā rangi i te aroaro o te Atua; me taua Hinai anō i te aroaro o te Atua, o te Atua o Īharaira.
I tāia mai, e koe, e te Atua, he ua nui; ā, i tōu kāinga e ruwha ana ka whakaūkia e koe.
I noho tāu whakaminenga ki reira; nā tōu pai, e te Atua, i mea kai ai koe mā ngā rawakore.
Ka hōmai e Ihowā te kupu; he ope nui ngā wāhine whakapuaki:
"Whati rawa ngā kīngi o ngā taua!" Ā, ko te wahine i noho i te whare, kei te tuwha i ngā parakete.
I a koutou ka takoto noa i ngā takotoranga hipi, he rite ki ngā pākau o te kūkupa kua paparuatia nei ki te hiriwa, ōna hou ki te kōura whero.
I te whakamararatanga a te Kaha Rawa i ngā kīngi i reira, koia anō kei te hukarere o Taramono te mā.
He maunga Atua a Maunga Pahana; he maunga tiketike a Maunga Pahana.
He aha koutou ka titiro tītaha ai, e ngā maunga tiketike, ki te maunga i hiahiatia nei e te Atua kia nohoia e ia, āe, ka nohoia e Ihowā ake ake?
Ko ngā hāriata a te Atua, e rua tekau mano, mano mano iho; kei roto i a rātou te Ariki, me te mea ko Hinai, ko te wāhi tapu.
Kua kake koe ki runga, kua whakaraua e koe te whakarau; kua riro i a koe he ohaoha mō te tangata; āe, mō te hunga tutū anō, kia noho ai a Ihowā, te Atua ki a rātou.
Kia whakapaingia te Ariki, e whakawaha nei i tā tātou pīkaunga i tēnei rā, i tēnei rā, te Atua o tō tātou whakaoranga. Hera
Ko tō tātou Atua te Atua o te whakaoranga; nā Ihowā anō, nā te Ariki, ngā putanga ake i te mate.
Ka marū ia i te Atua te mātenga o ōna hoariri; me te tumuaki huruhuru o te tangata e haere tonu ana i āna kino.
I mea te Ariki, "Ka whakahokia mai e ahau i Pahana, ka whakahokia mai e ahau tāku iwi i ngā rire o te moana;
kia toua ai tōu waewae ki te toto, kia whiwhi ai te arero o āu kurī ki tāna wāhi o ōu hoariri."
I kite rātou, e te Atua, i ōu haerenga, i ngā haerenga o tōku Atua, o tōku Kīngi, i te wāhi tapu.
Ko ngā kaiwaiata i haere i mua, i muri ko ngā kaiwhakatangi, i waenganui ko ngā kōtiro e patupatu ana i ngā timipera.
"Whakapaingia te Atua i roto i ngā whakaminenga, te Ariki hoki, e ngā mea i puta mai i te mātāpuna o Īharaira!"
Kei reira a Pineamine, te whakaotinga, tō rātou ariki, ngā rangatira o Hūrā, me tō rātou rōpū, ngā rangatira o Hepurona, me ngā rangatira o Napatari.
Kua oti he kaha mōu te whakahau iho e tōu Atua; whakaūkia, e te Atua, tāu i mea ai mō mātou.
Ka maua mai e ngā kīngi he hākari ki a koe, mō tōu temepara i Hiruhārama.
Rīria te kīrehe o ngā kākaho, te huinga pūru, me ngā kūao kau a ngā iwi, me te takahi i ngā pīhi hiriwa ki raro; whakamararatia ngā iwi e āhuareka ana ki te whāinga.
E puta mai ngā rangatira i Īhipa; meāke hohoro te totoro o ngā ringa o Etiopia ki te Atua.
Waiata ki te Atua, e ngā rangatiratanga o te whenua; hīmene ki te Ariki; Hera
ki a ia, ko tōna hāriata nei ko ngā rangi o ngā rangi, nōnamata; nā, ka puaki tōna reo, he reo kaha.
Waiho te kaha i te Atua, kei runga nei i a Īharaira tāna mahi rangatira; kei ngā kapua hoki tōna kaha.
Ka wehingia koe, e te Atua, i roto i ōu wāhi tapu; ko te Atua o Īharaira te kaihōmai i te kaha, i te mana, ki tōna iwi. Whakapaingia te Atua!
Whakaorangia ahau e te Atua, ka tae mai hoki ngā wai ki roto ki tōku wairua.
Ka tapoko ahau ki te oru hōhonu, ki te wāhi kāhore nei he tūnga; kua tae ahau ki ngā wai hōhonu, ngaro iho ahau i ngā waipuke.
Kua ruwha ahau i tāku tangi; kua maroke tōku korokoro. Pakoko kau ōku kanohi i ahau e tatari nei ki tōku Atua.

Tini kē i ngā makawe o tōku mātenga te hunga e kino noa ana ki ahau; he kaha rawa te hunga e mauāhara noa ana ki ahau, e mea nei kia whakamatea ahau. Utua ana e ahau i reira ngā mea kīhai i tangohia e ahau.
E te Atua, e mātau ana koe ki tōku kūware; kāhore hoki ōku hē e ngaro i a koe.
E te Ariki, e Ihowā o ngā mano kaua te hunga e tatari ana ki a koe e whakamā i ahau; e te Atua o Īharaira, kei numinumi kau i ahau te hunga e rapu ana i a koe.
Mōu hoki ahau i waiho ai hei tāwainga; ngaro iho tōku mata i te whakamā.
He tangata kē ahau ki ōku hoa ake; hei tautangata ki ngā tama a tōku whaea.
Ka pau hoki ahau i te aroha ki tōu whare; kua tau anō ki ahau ngā tāwai a te hunga e tāwai ana ki a koe.
I ahau i tangi, i whakatiki hei whiu i tōku wairua, ka waiho tēnā hei tāwainga mōku.
I kākahu hoki ahau i te kākahu taratara mōku, ā, i waiho hei whakatauki mā rātou.
Kei te kōrero kino mōku te hunga e noho ana i te kūwaha; waiatatia ana ahau e te hunga haurangi wāina.
Ko ahau ia, ki a koe tāku īnoi, e Ihowā, i te wā e manakohia ai; whakahokia mai he kupu ki ahau, e te Atua, i runga i te nui o tōu aroha, o te pono o tāu whakaoranga.
Whakaorangia ahau i roto i te oru, kei toremi; kia ora ahau i te hunga e kino ana ki ahau, i ngā wai hōhonu anō hoki.
Kei ngaro ahau i te waipuke, kei horomia e te rire; kei kopia anō te waha o te poka ki runga ki ahau.
E Ihowā whakahokia mai he kupu ki ahau; he pai hoki tōu atawhai: tahuri mai ki ahau, kia rite ki te nui o āu arohatanga.
Ā, kaua e hunā tōu mata ki tāu pononga; e pōuri ana hoki ahau: hohoro te whakahoki kupu mai ki ahau.
Whakatata mai ki tōku wairua, hokona; whakaorangia ahau, e mahi nei ōku hoariri.
E mātau ana koe ki tōku tāwainga, ki tōku whakamā, ki tōku numinumi; tōu aroaro ōku hoariri katoa.
Marū noa tōku ngākau i te tāwai; ā, kī tonu ahau i te pōuri; i titiro ahau ki tētahi hei aroha mai, ā, kore ake; ki ētahi hei whakamārie, ā, kīhai i kitea.
I hōmai he au hei kai māku; i tōku matewaitanga anō i whakainumia ahau ki te winika.
Kia meinga tā rātou tēpu i tō rātou aroaro hei māhanga; hei rore hoki i tō rātou wā rangimārie.
Kia whakapōuritia ō rātou kanohi, kei kite rātou; kia wiri tonu hoki ō rātou hope.
Ringihia atu tōu riri ki runga ki a rātou, kia mau hoki rātou i tōu ārita, i tōu weriweri.
Kia ururuatia tō rātou nohoanga; kaua tētahi e noho ki ō rātou tēneti.
Mō rātou i tūkino i te tangata i whiua nei e koe; ā, kōrerotia ana e rātou te pōuri o te hunga i werohia e koe.
Tāpiritia he kino ki runga ki tō rātou kino; kaua hoki rātou e tukua kia tomo ki tōu tika.
Kia murua atu rātou i te pukapuka o te ora, kaua anō e tuhituhia ki roto ki te hunga tika.
Ko ahau ia, he rawakore, he pōuri; kia whakateiteitia ake ahau, e te Atua, e tāu whakaoranga.
Ka whakamoemiti tāku waiata ki te ingoa o te Atua, ka whakanui anō tāku whakawhetai i a ia.
Pai rawa tēnei ki a Ihowā i te pūru, i te kau, i te mea whai haona, whai maikuku.
Kua kite te hunga māhaki, kua hari; ka ora anō ō koutou ngākau, e te hunga e rapu nei i te Atua.
Nō te mea ka rongo a Ihowā ki ngā rawakore, e kore anō e whakahāwea ki āna herehere.
Kia whakamoemiti te rangi me te whenua ki a ia, ngā moana, me ngā mea katoa e tere ana i roto.
Nō te mea tērā e whakaorangia e te Atua a Hiona, ka hangā anō e ia ngā pā o Hūrā; ā, ka noho rātou ki reira, ka riro hoki a reira i a rātou;
ā, ka nohoia a reira e ngā uri o āna pononga; hei kāinga tupu anō a reira mō te hunga e aroha ana ki tōna ingoa.
Kia hohoro, e te Atua, ki te whakaora i ahau; e Ihowā, hohoro ki te āwhina i ahau.
Kia whakamā, kia pororaru ngātahi te hunga e rapu ana i tōku wairua. Kia whakahokia ki muri, kia whakamā te hunga e hiahia ana kia hē ahau.
Kia whakahokia ki muri mō tō rātou whakamā, te hunga e mea ana ki ahau, "Ha, ha!"
Kia hari, kia koa, ki a koe te hunga katoa e rapu ana i a koe. Kia mea tonu te hunga e pai ana ki tāu whakaoranga, "Kia whakanuia te Atua!"
Ko ahau ia, he iti, he rawakore; hohoro mai, e te Atua, ki ahau. Ko koe tōku āwhina, tōku kaiwhakaora; kaua rā e whakaroa, e Ihowā.
Ko koe tāku e whakawhirinaki ai, e Ihowā; kei whakamā ahau ake ake.
Whakaorangia ahau, i runga i tōu tika, kia mawhiti anō ahau; tahuri mai tōu taringa ki ahau, whakaorangia hoki ahau.
Kia ai koe hei teko e noho ai ahau, hei hokihokinga tonutanga atu mōku; kua kīia iho ahau e koe kia whakaorangia, ko koe nei hoki tōku kōhatu, tōku pourewa.
Whakaorangia ahau, e tōku Atua, i te ringa o te tangata kino, i te ringa o te whanokē, o te nanakia.
Ko koe nei hoki, e te Ariki, e Ihowā, tāku e tūmanako atu nei, tāku e whakawhirinaki nei nō tōku tamarikitanga ake anō.
Nāu ahau i tautoko ake nō te kōpū mai anō; nāu ahau i tango mai i roto i ngā whēkau o tōku whaea. Ko koe tāku e whakamoemiti tonu ai.
He mīharotanga ahau nā te tini; ko koe ia tōku piringa kaha.
Kia kī tōku māngai i te whakamoemiti ki a koe, i tōu hōnore i te roa o te rā.
Kaua ahau e pangā ā te wā o te koroheketanga, kaua ahau e whakarērea ina hemo tōku kaha.
E kōrerotia ana hoki ahau e ōku hoariri, ā, e rūnanga tahi ana te hunga e whanga ana ki tōku wairua.
E mea ana, "Kua whakarērea ia e te Atua; whāia, hopukia; kāhore hoki tētahi hei whakaora."
E te Atua, kei matara atu koe i ahau; e tōku Atua, hohoro ki te āwhina i ahau.
Kia whakamā, kia pau ngā hoariri o tōku wairua; kia hīpokina ki te tāwai, ki te whakamā, te hunga e rapu ana i te hē mōku.
Ko ahau ia, ka tūmanako tonu; ka hono tonu anō te whakamoemiti ki a koe.
Mā tōku māngai e whakakite tōu tika, tāu whakaoranga i te roa o te rā; kāhore hoki ahau e mōhio e hia rānei.
Ka haere ahau i runga i te kaha o te Ariki, o Ihowā, ka whakahuatia e ahau tōu tika, tōu anake.
E te Atua, he mea whakaako ahau nāu, nō tōku tamarikitanga ake; ā, he whakapuaki tāku i āu mahi whakamīharo ā mohoa noa nei.
Nā, kaua ahau e whakarērea, e te Atua, ā koroheke noa, hina noa ahau, kia whakakitea rā anō e ahau tōu kaha ki tēnei whakatupuranga, tōu nui ki ngā tāngata katoa e puta mai ā mua.
Kei runga rawa anō tōu tika, e te Atua, he nui nei hoki āu mahi; e te Atua, ko wai te rite ki a koe?
He nui, he kino ngā pōuritanga ngākau i whakakitea mai e koe ki a mātou; tērā anō koe ka whakahauora i a mātou, ka whakahoki ake anō i a mātou i ngā wāhi hōhonu o te whenua.
Whakaraneatia e koe tōku nui, ā, tahuri mai anō ka whakamārie i ahau.
Ka whakamoemiti ahau ki a koe i runga i te hātere, arā ki tōu pono, e tōku Atua; ka hīmene ahau ki a koe i runga i te hāpa, e te Mea Tapu o Īharaira.
Ka tino hari ōku ngutu ua hīmene ahau ki a koe; me tōku wairua anō i hokona nei e koe.
Ka kōrerotia hoki e tōku arero tōu tika i te roa o te rā; kua whakamā nei hoki, kua numinumi kau te hunga i rapu i te hē mōku.
Hōmai e te Atua, āu whakaritenga ki te kīngi, me tōu tika ki te tama a te kīngi.
Māna e whakawā tōu iwi i runga i te tika, āu rawakore i runga i te whakawā tika.
Ka kawea mai e ngā maunga te rongo mau ki te iwi, e ngā pukepuke i runga i te tika.
Ka whakawā ia mō ngā ware o te iwi; ka whakaorangia e ia ngā tamariki a te rawakore; mongamonga noa i a ia te kaitūkino.
I te rā e mau ana, i te marama hoki, ka pērā te mau o tō rātou wehi ki a koe i ngā whakatupuranga katoa.
E heke iho ia ānō he ua ki runga ki te kotinga tarutaru, me ngā ua e whakamākūkū nei i te whenua.
Ka tupu te tangata tika i ōna rā; tōna roa anō o te āta noho, ā, kore noa te marama.
Ka kīngi ia i tēnei moana, ā tae noa ki tētahi moana, i te awa, ā ngā pito atu anō o te whenua.
Ka piko ki tōna aroaro te hunga o te koraha; ā, ka mitimiti ōna hoariri i te puehu.
Ka maua mai he hākari e ngā kīngi o Tarahihi, o ngā motu; ka kawea mai he tahua e ngā kīngi o Hēpā, o Tepa.
Āe, ka koropiko ngā kīngi katoa ki a ia; ka mahi ngā iwi katoa ki a ia.
Ka ora hoki i a ia te rawakore ua tangi atu, te ware hoki me te tangata kāhore nei ōna kaiāwhina.
E tohu ia i te tangata iti, i te rawakore; ka ora anō i a ia ngā wairua o ngā rawakore.
Ka hokona e ia tō rātou wairua i roto i te tūkino, i te tutū, he mea utu nui hoki ō rātou toto ki tāna titiro.
Ā, e ora rātou! Ka hoatu anō ki a ia he kōura nō Hēpā. Ka tukua tonutia hoki te īnoi mōna; ka whakapaingia ia i tēnei rā, i tēnei rā.
He kutanga wīti tērā i runga i te whenua, i te tihi o ngā maunga; ngarue ana ōna hua, ānō ko Repanōna, ā, ka rite te tupu o ngā tāngata o te pā ki tō te tarutaru o te whenua.
Ka mau tonu tōna ingoa ake ake; ka rite tōna ingoa ki te rā te pūmau. Kei roto i a ia te manaaki mō te tangata; ka kōrerotia tōna koa e ngā iwi katoa.
Kia whakapaingia a Ihowā, te Atua, te Atua o Īharaira; ko ia nei anake hei mahi i ngā mahi whakamīharo.
Kia whakapaingia anō tōna ingoa korōria mō ake tonu atu; kia kī katoa hoki te whenua i tōna korōria. Āmine, āe Āmine.
Ko te mutunga tēnei o ngā īnoi a Rāwiri, a te tama a Hehe.
He pono, he pai te Atua ki a Īharaira; ki te hunga ngākau mā.
Ko ahau ia, wāhi iti kua tapepa ōku waewae; me i kotahi kua paheke ōku takahanga.
I hae hoki ahau ki te hunga whakahī, i tōku kitenga i te tangata hara e kake ana.
Kāhore hoki he whakawiringa a te mate i a rātou; he mārō anō ō rātou uaua.
Kāhore ngā mea whakapōuri tāngata e pā ki a rātou; kāhore anō rātou e whiua tahitia me te mano tāngata.
Nā reira, ānō he hei te whakakake e awhi nei i a rātou, ānō he kākahu te tutū e hīpokina nei rātou.
Pupuhi ana ō rātou kanohi i te ngako; nui ake ngā mea i a rātou i a ō rātou ngākau i hiahia ai.
E whakahī ana rātou, e kōrero kino ana mō te whakatoi; kei runga noa ake ā rātou kōrero.
Tutuki tonu tō rātou māngai ki ngā rangi; e kōpikopiko ana hoki tō rātou arero i runga i te whenua.
Koia tōna iwi i hoki mai ai ki konei; ā, e whakawiria ana he wai mō rātou, kī tonu te kapu.
E mea ana rātou, "Mā te aha e mātau ai te Atua? He mātauranga koia tō te Runga Rawa?"
Nanā, ko te hunga kino tēnei, kei runga tonu i te whenua rangatira, e hua ana ō rātou taonga.
He pono he maumau tāku mea i tōku ngākau kia mā, tāku horoi hoki i ōku ringa ki te harakore.
E whiua ana hoki ahau i te roa o te rā, e pākia ana i ngā ata katoa.
Me i kī ahau, "Ka pēnei tāku kōrero," nā, e tinihanga ana ahau ki te whakatupuranga o āu tamariki.
I tāku meatanga kia mātauria tēnei, ka kite ahau he mahi whakauaua rawa;
tae noa ahau ki te wāhi tapu o te Atua, kātahi ahau ka mōhio ki tō rātou mutunga.
He pono i whakatūria rātou e koe ki ngā wāhi pāhekeheke; ā, whakatakā ana e koe ki te ngaromanga.
Anō te pānga whakareretanga o tō rātou hunanga, kua pau rawa i ngā wehi!
Ka rite ki te rekanga kanohi, ina ara ake te tangata, tāu whakahāwea ki tō rātou āhua, e te Ariki, ina ara ake koe.
Nā, mamae noa iho tōku ngākau, ā, hukihuki ana ōku whatumanawa.
He whakaarokore hoki ahau, he kūware; me te mea he kīrehe ahau i tōu aroaro.
Ahakoa rā kei a koe tonu ahau; e puritia ana e koe tōku ringa matau.
Mā tōu whakaaro ahau e ārahi; muri iho ka riro ahau i a koe ki te korōria.
Ko wai hoki tōku i te rangi ko koe anake? Kāhore atu hoki ōku i te whenua e hiahia ai, ko koe anake.
Hemo iho ōku kikokiko me tōku ngākau; ko te Atua ia te kaha o tōku ngākau, tōku wāhi ake ake.
Nā, ko te hunga e mamao atu ana i a koe ka mate; ka ngaro i a koe te hunga pūremu katoa e whakarere nei i a koe.
Ko ahau ia, he pai ki ahau te whakatata ki te Atua; kua waiho e ahau te Ariki, a Ihowā, hei whakawhirinakitanga mōku, kia whakapuakina ai e ahau āu mahi katoa.
E te Atua, he aha i pangā ai mātou e koe ake ake? He aha i pongere ai tōu riri ki ngā hipi o tāu māra?
Mahara ki tāu whakaminenga i hokona e koe i mua, i utua e koe hei iwi mō tōu kāinga tupu; ā, ki tēnei Maunga Hiona i nohoia nei e koe.
Hiki ake ōu waewae ki ngā whakangaromanga e mau tonu nei, ki ngā mahi kino katoa a te hoariri ki te wāhi tapu.
Kua hāmama nei ōu hoariri i waenganui i āu whakaminenga; kua whakatūria e rātou ā rātou kara hei tohu.
E rite ana rātou ki ngā tāngata e hāpai ana i te tītaha ki te puia rākau.
Ināianei ia e tukitukia ana e rātou ōna mea whakairo, pākaruhia iho ana ki te tītaha, ki te hama.
Kua toua tōu wāhi tapu ki te kāpura, kua noa i a rātou te nohoanga o tōu ingoa, kei te whenua e takoto ana.
I mea tō rātou ngākau, "Me whakangaro rātou ā poto ake." Kua tahuna e rātou ngā whare huihui katoa o te Atua i te whenua.
Kāhore mātou e kite i ō mātou tohu, kāhore atu he poropiti, kāhore hoki tētahi o mātou e mātau ana kia pēhea ake te roa.
E te Atua, kia pēhea ake te roa o te tāwai a te hoariri? Ka kohukohu tonu rānei te hoariri ki tōu ingoa ake ake?
He aha i pēpeke ai tōu ringa, tōu matau? Unuhia i roto i tōu uma, whakamōtītia rātou.
Ko te Atua ia tōku Kīngi o tua iho, e mahi whakaora ana i waenganui i te whenua.
Nāu, nā tōu kaha i wawae te moana; pakaru ana i a koe ngā mātenga o ngā tarakona i ngā wai.
Mongamonga noa i a koe ngā mātenga o rewiatana; ā, hoatu ana ia e koe hei kai mā te iwi o te koraha.
I wāhia e koe te puna me te roma; mimiti ake i a koe ngā awa nunui.
Nāu te ao, nāu hoki te pō; nāu i whakarite te marama me te rā.
Nāu i whakatū ngā rohe katoa o te whenua; te raumati me te hōtoke, he mea whakarite ēnā nāu.
Kia mahara ki tēnei, kua tāwai te hoariri, e Ihowā; kua kohukohu te hunga pōauau ki tōu ingoa.
Kaua e tukua te wairua o tāu kūkupa ki te kīrehe; kei wareware ake ake ki te whakaminenga o āu rawakore.
Whakaaroa te kawenata; kua kikī hoki ngā wāhi pōuri o te whenua i ngā nohoanga nanakia.
Kei hoki whakamā mai te tangata e tūkinotia ana; kia whakamoemititia tōu ingoa e te ware, e te rawakore.
E ara, e te Atua, tohea tāu tohe; mahara ki tā te tangata pōauau tāwai ki a koe ā pau noa te rā.
Kei wareware ki te reo o ōu hoariri; e kake tonu ana te ngangau a te hunga e whakatika ana ki a koe.
Ka whakawhetai tonu mātou ki a koe, e te Atua, ka whakawhetai tonu mātou; kei te tata mai hoki tōu ingoa. E kōrerotia ana e te tangata āu mahi whakamīharo.
"Ka kitea e ahau te wā e rite ana, ka tika tāku whakawā.
Kūteretere noa iho te whenua me ōna tāngata katoa; nāku i whakatū ōna pou. Hera
I mea ahau ki te hunga whakakake, ‘Kāti rā te whakakake,’ ki te hunga hara anō, ‘Kaua e whakaarahia te haona;
kaua tō koutou haona e whakaarahia ki runga, kāti te whakamārō i te kakī ina kōrero.’ "
Nō te mea kāhore he aranga i te rāwhiti, kāhore i te hauāuru, kāhore hoki i te tonga.
Ko te Atua ia te kaiwhakawā; ko tēnei e whakaititia iho ana e ia, ko tērā e whakaarahia ake ana.
Kei te ringa hoki o Ihowā he kapu, pāhuka tonu te wāina; kī tonu, whakananu rawa, hei ringihanga māna; ko ngā nganga ia, mā te hunga kino katoa o te whenua e tatau, e inu.
Ko ahau ia, ka kauwhau tonu; ka hīmene ki te Atua o Hākopa.
Ā, ka kotia e ahau ngā haona katoa o te hunga kino; ka whakaarahia ake ia ngā haona o te tangata tika.
E mātauria ana te Atua i roto i a Hūrā, he nui tōna ingoa i roto i a Īharaira.
Kei Harema hoki tōna tapenākara; kei Hiona tōna nohoanga.
I whati i a ia i reira ngā pere o te kōpere, te whakangungu rākau, te hoari, me ngā mea mō te whawhai. Hera
Tērā atu tōu korōria, tōu nui, i tō ngā maunga kīrehe.
Kua pāhuatia te hunga ngākau toa, moe ana rātou i tā rātou moe; kīhai anō i whai ringa tētahi o ngā mārohirohi.
Nā tāu whakatūpehupehu, e te Atua o Hākopa, i parangia ai te hāriata me te hōiho e te moe.
Ko koe, inā, ko koe e wehingia; ko wai hoki e tū ki tōu aroaro ina riri koe?
Nāu i rangona iho ai te whakawā i te rangi; wehi ana te whenua, whakaririka kau ana,
i te aranga ake o te Atua ki te whakawā, ki te whakaora i te hunga māhaki katoa o te whenua. Hera
He pono ka whai korōria koe i te riri o te tangata; mau anō e whītiki te toenga o te riri.
Whakapuakina te kupu taurangi ki a Ihowā, ki tō koutou Atua, whakamanā hoki; e te hunga katoa i tētahi taha ōna, i tētahi taha, mauria he hākari ki a ia, ka tika hoki te wehi ki a ia.
Māna e poro atu te wairua o ngā rangatira; e matakuria ana ia e ngā kīngi o te whenua.
Ki te Atua tōku reo, e karanga nei ahau, ki te Atua tōku reo, ā, tērā e tahuri mai tōna taringa ki ahau.
I rapu ahau ki te Ariki i te rā o tōku pōuri; mārō tonu tōku ringa i te pō, kīhai anō i pēpeke; kīhai tōku wairua i pai kia whakamārietia.
E mahara ana ahau ki te Atua, ā, e pōuri ana; kei te whakaaroaro, ā, ngaro iho tōku wairua. Hera
E puritia ana e koe ōku kanohi kia mataara tonu; he pōuri ahau, tē āhei te kōrero.
Ka hoki ōku whakaaro ki ngā rā onamata, ki ngā tau o tua iho.
E whakamahara ana ahau ki tāku waiata i te pō, e kōrerorero ana ki tōku ngākau, e rapurapu ana tōku wairua.
"Tērā rānei te Ariki e panga tonu ake ake, ā, heoi anō rānei āna manakohanga mai?
Kua kāhore rānei tāna mahi tohu mō ake tonu atu? Kua whati rānei tāna kupu ā ake ake?
Kua wareware rānei te Atua ki te atawhai? Kua riri rānei ia, ā, tūtakina atu ana e ia tōna aroha?" Hera
Nā, ka mea ahau, "Ko tōku ngoikore tēnei: otirā ka mahara ahau ki ngā tau o te ringa matau o te Runga Rawa."
Ka mahara ahau ki ngā mahi a Ihowā; āe rā, ka mahara ahau ki āu mea whakamīharo o tua iho.
Ka whakaaro hoki ahau ki āu meatanga katoa, ka pūrākau ki āu mahi.
E te Atua, kei te wāhi tapu tōu ara. Ko wai te atua nui hei rite ki te Atua?
Ko koe te Atua e mahi nei i ngā mea whakamīharo; kua whakapuakina e koe tōu kaha i waenganui o ngā iwi.
Hokona ana e tōu ringa tāu iwi, ngā tama a Hākopa rāua ko Hōhepa. Hera
I kite ngā wai i a koe, e te Atua, i kite ngā wai i a koe, mataku ana; i oho anō ngā rire.
Ringihia ana he wai e ngā kapua, puaki ana te haruru o ngā rangi; rererere ana āu pere.
I roto i te āwhiowhio te haruru o tāu whatitiri; mārama noa te ao i ngā uira; wiri ana te whenua, oioi ana.
I te moana tōu ara, i ngā wai nui tōu huarahi, e kore anō e kitea ōu takahanga.
He mea ārahi e koe tāu iwi ānō he kāhui, arā e te ringa o Mohi rāua ko Ārona.
Kia anga mai te taringa, e tōku iwi, ki tāku ture; tahuri mai ō koutou taringa ki ngā kupu a tōku māngai.
Ka puaki te kupu whakarite i tōku māngai, ka kōrerotia e ahau ngā mea ngaro onamata –
i rongo nei, i mātau nei tātou, kōrero ai hoki ō tātou mātua ki a tātou.
E kore e hunā e mātou i ā rātou tamariki; me whakaatu ki tō muri whakatupuranga ngā whakamoemiti ki a Ihowā, me tōna kaha, me āna mahi whakamīharo i mea ai ia.
Kua pūmau hoki i a ia he whakaaturanga i roto i a Hākopa, kua takoto he ture i roto i a Īharaira; ā, whakahaua mai ana e ia ō tātou tūpuna, kia whakaakona ki ā rātou tamariki;
kia mātauria ai e tō muri whakatupuranga, e ngā tamariki e whānau, e ara ake ā mua, mō tā rātou whakaatu ki ā rātou tamariki.
Kia ū ai tā rātou tūmanako ki te Atua, kei wareware hoki ki ngā mahi a te Atua; engari kia mau ki āna whakahau.
Kei rite hoki ki ō rātou tūpuna, ki te whakatupuranga whakakeke, tutū, ki te whakatupuranga kīhai nei i whakatikatika i tō rātou ngākau, kīhai hoki i ū tō rātou wairua ki te Atua.
He hunga mau patu ngā tama a Ēparaima, he hunga hāpai kōpere, heoi tahuri ana rātou i te rā o te tatauranga.
Kīhai i puritia e rātou te kawenata a te Atua; kīhai anō i pai ki te haere i tāna ture.
Heoi, kua wareware ki āna mahi, me āna mea whakamīharo i whakakitea e ia ki a rātou.
He mea whakamīharo āna mahi i te aroaro o ō rātou tūpuna, i te whenua o Īhipa, i te pārae o Toana.
Tapahia ana e ia te moana, ā, meinga ana rātou kia whiti; tū ake i a ia ngā wai ānō he pūranga.
He mea ārahi rātou e ia i te awatea ki te kapua; i te roa hoki o te pō ki te mārama o te ahi.
I wāhia e ia ngā kōhatu i te koraha; ā, me te mea nō ngā rire nui tana wai hei inu mā rātou.
Puta mai ana i a ia he awa i roto i te kāmaka; meinga ana ngā wai kia heke, ānō he waipuke.
Heoi, ka hara anō rātou ki a ia; whakatoi ana ki te Runga Rawa i te koraha.
Nā, kei te whakamātautau tō rātou ngākau i te Atua, kei te īnoi kai mā tō rātou hiahia.
I kōrero kino anō rātou ki te Atua, i mea; "E āhei rānei i te Atua te taka he tēpu ki te koraha?
Nanā, ko tāna patunga i te kōhatu, ka pakaru mai te wai, ā, puke ana ngā awa; e taea anō rānei e ia te hōmai taro, e pae rānei i a ia he kikokiko mā tāna iwi?"
Nā, ko te rongonga o Ihowā, nā, ka riri; ā, toro ana te kāpura ki a Hākopa, puta ake ana te riri ki a Īharaira;
mō rātou kīhai i whakapono ki te Atua, kīhai anō i whakawhirinaki ki tāna whakaoranga.
Nāna nei hoki i whakahau ngā kapua i runga, i whakatuwhera ngā tatau o te rangi;
ā, whakauaina iho te mana ki runga ki a rātou hei kai; hōmai ana hoki e ia te wīti o te rangi mā rātou.
Kai ana te tangata i tā te anahera kai; i tukua e ia he kai mā rātou, ā mākona noa.
I whakaohokia e ia te marangai i te rangi; i tākina anō te tonga e tōna kaha.
Ā, whakauaina iho e ia te kikokiko ki a rātou ānō he puehu; he manu whai pākau ānō he one nō te moana.
Ā, whakangahorotia iho e ia ki waenganui i tō rātou puni; ki ō rātou nohoanga ā tawhio noa.
Nā, kai ana rātou, tino mākona; i tukua hoki e ia ki a rātou tā rātou i hiahia ai.
Kīhai rātou i ngaruru ki tā rātou i hiahia ai; ā, i roto tonu tā rātou kai i ō rātou māngai,
nā, ka pā te riri o te Atua ki a rātou, ā, patua iho e ia te hunga tetere o rātou; piko ana i a ia ngā taitamariki o Īharaira.
Ahakoa pā katoa tēnei, i hara anō rātou; kīhai anō i whakapono ki āna mahi whakamīharo.
I whakapaua ai e ia ō rātou rā ki te horihori, ō rātou tau ki te pōtatutatu.
Ka patua rātou e ia, nā, ka rapu rātou i a ia, ā, ka hoki, ka ui wawe ki te Atua.
Ka mahara hoki ko te Atua tō rātou kōhatu, ko te Atua, ko te Runga Rawa, tō rātou kaihoko.
Otiia kei te patipati ō rātou māngai ki a ia, ā, teka ana ō rātou arero ki a ia.
Kīhai hoki tō rātou ngākau i tika ki a ia; kīhai anō rātou i ū ki tāna kawenata.
Ko tāna ia, he aroha; hīpokina ana e ia te hē, kīhai anō i whakangaro. Āe rā, he maha āna whakahokinga iho i tōna riri, ā, kīhai i oho katoa tōna riri.
I mahara hoki ia he kikokiko nei rātou; he hau e pahure atu ana, ā, e kore e hoki mai.
Anō te tini o ā rātou whakatoinga i a ia i te koraha, o ā rātou whakapōuritanga i a ia i te tahora!
Hoki whakamuri ana rātou, whakamātautau ana i te Atua; whakatoia ana e rātou te Mea Tapu o Īharaira.
Kīhai rātou i mahara ki tōna ringa, ki te rā i whakaorangia ai rātou e ia i te hoariri;
ki tāna meatanga i āna tohu ki Īhipa, i āna merekara ki te pārae o Toana.
I puta kē ai i a ia ō rātou awa hei toto, me ō rātou manga wai, tē inu ai rātou.
I tonoa ai e ia he huihuinga namu ki a rātou, ā, pau iho rātou; he poroka, i hunā ai rātou.
Ā, hoatu ana e ia ō rātou hua ki te moka; me tō rātou māuiui ki te māwhitiwhiti.
Whakamatea ana e ia ā rātou wāina ki te whatu, ā rātou rākau hikamora ki te haupapa.
Tukua ana e ia ā rātou kararehe mā te whatu, ā rātou kāhui mā ngā uira.
I tukua whakareretia e ia ki a rātou tōna riri, āritarita, weriweri, me te raruraru; he whakaeke nā ngā anahera kino.
Ā, whakatikaia ana e ia he ara mō tōna riri; kīhai i tohungia tō rātou wairua kei mate, otiia, tukua ana e ia tō rātou ora ki te mate urutā.
Nā, patua iho e ia ngā mātāmua i Īhipa, te muanga o tō rātou kaha i ngā tēneti o Hama.
Otirā, ārahina ana e ia āna ake tāngata ānō he hipi; whakahaerea ana rātou e ia i te koraha anō he kāhui.
Nā, ka ārahina mārietia rātou e ia, tē wehi rātou; ko ō rātou hoariri ia taupokina iho e te moana.
Nā, ka kawea rātou e ia ki te rohe o tōna wāhi tapu, ki tēnei maunga, i hokona nei e tōna matau.
Peia ana e ia ngā tauiwi i tō rātou aroaro; ā, wehea ana e ia he kāinga mō rātou ki te aho, whakanohoia iho ngā hapū o Īharaira ki ō rātou tēneti.
Heoi, ka whakamātauria, ka whakatoia e rātou te Atua, te Runga Rawa; kīhai hoki i mau ki āna whakaaturanga;
ā, hoki whakamuri ana, mahi hīanga ana, pērā ana me ō rātou mātua; parori kē ana rātou, he pērā me te kōpere tinihanga.
Nā, ko ō rātou wāhi tiketike hei whakapātaritari i a ia; ko ō rātou whakapakoko hei mea i a ia kia hae.
I te rongonga o te Atua, ka riri, ka tino whakarihariha hoki ki a Īharaira.
Ā, mahue ake i a ia te tapenākara o Hiro, te tēneti i whakatūria e ia ki waenganui i ngā tāngata;
ā, tukua ana e ia tōna kaha hei whakarau, tōna korōria ki te ringa o te hoariri.
I tukua atu anō e ia tāna iwi mā te hoari; ā, i riri ki tōna kāinga tupu.
Pau ake ā rātou taitama i te ahi; kīhai anō ā rātou kōtiro i mārenatia.
I hinga ō rātou tohunga i te hoari; kīhai hoki i tangi ā rātou pouaru.
Nā, ka maranga te Ariki ānō ko tētahi i te moe, me te tangata kaha e hāmama ana i te wāina.
Ā, patua iho e ia a muri o ōna hoariri, meinga ana rātou e ia hei taunutanga mō ake tonu atu.
I whakakāhore anō ia ki te tēneti o Hōhepa; ā, kīhai i whiriwhiri i te hapū o Ēparaima;
heoi, ko te hapū o Hūrā tāna i whiriwhiri ai, ko Maunga Hiona tāna i aroha ai.
Ā, whakatūria ana e ia tōna wāhi tapu kia pērā me ngā wāhi teitei; me te whenua i whakapūmautia e ia mō ake tonu atu.
I whiriwhiria anō e ia a Rāwiri, tāna pononga, he mea tango nāna i ngā kāinga hipi;
mauria ana mai e ia i te whai i ngā hipi whāereere, hei whāngai i a Hākopa, i tāna iwi, i a Īharaira hoki, i tōna kāinga tupu.
Ā, rite tonu ki te tapatahi o tōna ngākau tāna whāngai i a rātou; he ārahi mōhio hoki tā tōna ringa i a rātou.
E te Atua, kua tae mai ngā tauiwi ki tōu kāinga tupu; kua noa i a rātou tōu temepara tapu, kua waiho a Hiruhārama kia pūranga kau ana.
Ko ngā tinana mate o āu pononga kua hoatu e rātou hei kai mā ngā manu o te rangi, ko te kikokiko o tāu hunga tapu mā ngā kīrehe o te whenua.
Ko ō rātou toto, ringihia ake e rātou ānō he wai, ki ngā taha o Hiruhārama; kāhore hoki he tangata hei tanu i a rātou.
Kua waiho mātou hei tāwainga mā ō mātou hoa, hei katanga mā te hunga i tētahi taha, i tētahi taha o mātou.
Kia pēhea te roa, e Ihowā? E riri tonu rānei koe ake ake? E ngiha tonu rānei tōu hae me he kāpura?
Ringihia tōu riri ki ngā tauiwi kāhore nei e mātau ki a koe, ki ngā rangatiratanga kāhore nei e karanga ki tōu ingoa.
Kua pau hoki a Hākopa i a rātou, kua ururua i a rātou tōna nohoanga.
Kaua rā e maharatia ngā kino o ō mātou tūpuna; kia hohoro tōu aroha ki mua i a mātou; kua whakaititia rawatia hoki mātou.
