E tango ana te tangata kino i te mea whakapati i te uma, hei whakapeau kē i ngā ara o te whakarite whakawā.
Kei te aroaro o te tangata mātau ngā whakaaro nui; kei ngā pito ia o te whenua ngā kanohi o te whakaarokore.
Ko te tamaiti whakaarokore he mea whakapōuri i tōna pāpā, he mea whakakawa i te ngākau o tōna whaea.
Ehara anō hoki i te mea pai kia whiua te tangata tika, kia patua rānei ngā rangatira mō te tika.
He mātauranga tō te tangata e tohu ana i āna kupu; ā, he whakaaro tō te tangata i te wairua manawanui.
Ko te wairangi nei anō, ki te whakarongo puku, ka kīia he whakaaro nui; ki te kokopi ōna ngutu, ka kīia ia he tūpato.
Ko te tangata tū kē, e whai ana i tā tōna ake hiahia, e ngangau ana ki ngā whakaaro tōtika katoa.
Kāhore o te whakaarokore āhuareka ki te mātauranga; engari kia whakakitea e ia tōna ngākau.
I te taenga mai o te tangata kino ka tae mai anō te whakahāwea, me te tāwai hei hoa mō te whakamā.
He wai hōhonu ngā kupu a te māngai o te tangata; he awa e rere ana te puna o te whakaaro nui.
Ehara i te mea pai te whakapai ki te kanohi o te tangata kino, te whakapeau kē rānei i tā te tangata tika ina whakawā.
E uru ana ngā ngutu o te whakaarokore ki te totohe, e karanga ana tōna māngai ki ngā whiu.
Hei huna anō mōna te māngai o te whakaarokore; ā, ko ōna ngutu hei rore mō tōna wairua.
Ānō he kai reka ngā kupu a te kawe kōrero; tae tonu iho ki ngā wāhi o roto rawa o te kōpū.
Ko te tangata anō hoki e māngere ana ki tāna mahi, hei teina ia ki te tangata maumau.
Hei pourewa kaha te ingoa o Ihowā; rere ana te tangata tika ki reira, ā, ora ake.
Ko ngā rawa o te tangata taonga hei pā kaha mōna, hei pā tiketike ki tōna whakaaro.
I mua ake o te whakangaromanga ka whakakake te ngākau o te tangata; i mua ake anō hoki o te hōnore ko te ngākau pāpaku.
Ko te tangata e whakahoki kupu ana i te mea kāhore anō ia i rongo noa, he mahi wairangi tērā nāna, he hanga whakamā.
E whakamanawanui te wairua o te tangata ki tōna mate; tēnā ko te wairua marū, ko wai e kaha ki tērā?
Ka whiwhi te ngākau o te tangata mātau ki te mōhio; e rapu ana hoki te taringa o ngā whakaaro nui ki te mōhio.
Mā te mea tuku noa a te tangata ka wātea ai he wāhi mōna, ka kawea hoki ia e tērā ki te aroaro o ngā tāngata nunui.
Ko te tangata nāna te kupu tuatahi i te whakawā me te mea kei a ia te tika; nā, ka haere mai tōna hoa, kei te rapu i te tikanga o tāna.
Mā te rota e mutu ai ngā tautohe, ā, ko tērā hei tauārai i waenganui o te hunga kaha.
Ko te tuakana, teina rānei, i whakatakariritia, pakeke atu i te pā kaha; ā, ko aua tū ngangare me he tūtaki tatau nō te whare rangatira.
Ka kī te kōpū o te tangata i ngā hua o tōna māngai, ka mākona ia i ngā hua o ōna ngutu.
Ko te mate, ko te ora kei te arero; ko te hunga e aroha ana ki tērā ka kai i ōna hua.
Ko te tangata kua kite i te wahine māna, kua kite i te mea pai, kua whiwhi hoki ki tā Ihowā whakapai.
He īnoi tā te rawakore hanga he taikaha ia te whakahoki a te tangata taonga.
Ko te tangata tini ngā hoa aroha e whai ana i te hē mōna; tērā anō ia te hoa aroha, nui atu i tō te tuakana, i tō te teina, tōna piri mai.
He pai kē te rawakore e haere ana i runga i tōna tapatahi, i te ngutu whanokē, i te whakaarokore.
Nā, ehara hoki i te mea pai kia kaua he mātauranga mō te wairua; ā, ko te tangata e hohoro ana ōna waewae, ka hara.
E whakaparoritia ana te ara o te tangata e tōna wairangi; e amuamu ana hoki tōna ngākau ki a Ihowā.
Mā te rawa ka tokomaha atu ai ngā hoa aroha; e wehea atu ana ia, te rawakore i tōna hoa aroha.
E kore te kaiwhakapae teka e whakaharakoretia; e kore hoki e mawhiti te tangata kōrero teka.
He tokomaha e whai kia manakohia e te tangata ringa mahora; he hoa aroha hoki ngā tāngata katoa nō te tangata e hōmai mea ana.
E kino ana ngā tēina katoa o te rawakore ki a ia; nā, nui kē atu te mataratanga atu o ōna hoa i a ia! Whai noa āna kupu i a rātou, heoi kua riro rātou.
Ko te tangata e mea ana ki te whakaaro nui mōna, e aroha ana ki tōna wairua ake; ko te tangata e pupuri ana i te mātauranga, ka tūtaki ki te pai.
E kore te kaiwhakapae teka e whakaharakoretia; ka hunā hoki te tangata kōrero teka.
E kore e tau te noho rangatira ki te whakaarokore; he makere rawa te noho ko te pononga hei rangatira mō ngā rangatira.
Ko te ngārahu tūpato ka pupuri i tōna riri; ā, hei whakakorōria mōna te whakarere noa iho i te hē.
Ko te riri o te kīngi rite tonu ki te hāmama o te raiona; ko tana manako ia ānō he tōmairangi i runga i te tarutaru.
He aituā mō tōna pāpā te tamaiti whakaarokore; ā, ko ngā ngangare a te wahine, me te māturuturu pūputu tonu.
He whare, he taonga i tuku iho i ngā mātua; ko te hoa wahine mahara i a Ihowā.
Mā te māngere e mea kia moe i te moe reka; ka matekai hoki te wairua o te rōrā.
Ko te tangata e pupuri ana i te whakahau e pupuri ana i tōna wairua; engari, ko te tangata kore whakaaro ki ōna ara ka mate.
Ko te tangata e ohaoha ana ki te rawakore e whakatārewa moni ana ki a Ihowā, ā, ka utua ki a ia tāna mahi atawhai.
Pākia tāu tama, i te mea kua whai manakohanga; kaua hoki tōu ngākau e whai tonu i te whakangaromanga mōna.
Ko te tangata riri nui māna e waha tōna hē; ki te whakaora hoki koe i a ia, ka waiho tonu tēnā hei mahi māu.
Whakarongo ki te kupu tohutohu, tahuri mai hoki ki te ako, kia whai whakaaro ai koe i tōu mutunga iho.
He maha ngā whakaaro i roto i te ngākau o te tangata; e tū tonu ana ia tā Ihowā tikanga.
Ko te hiahia o te tangata te aronga o tana atawhai; engari te rawakore i te tangata teka.
Ko te wehi ki a Ihowā te ara ki te ora; ā, ko te tangata kei a ia tērā, ka noho mākona; e kore tētahi hē e pā ki a ia.
E kuhua ana e te māngere tōna ringa ki te rīhi, e kore rawa nei e whakahokia e ia ki tōna māngai.
Pākia te tangata whakahī, ā, ka tūpato ngā kūware; ākona hoki te tangata mahara, ā, ka mōhio ia ki te mātauranga.
Ko te tangata e pāhua ana i tōna pāpā, e pei atu ana hoki i tōna whaea, he tama ia e whakamā ai, e ingoa kino ai hoki.
Kāti, e tāku tama, te whakarongo ki te ako hei mea kau e kotiti atu ai i ngā kupu o te mātauranga.
E whakahī ana te kaiwhakaatu hē ki te whakawā; e horomia ana hoki te kino e te māngai o te hunga kino.
Kua rite he whakawā mō ngā whakahī, he whiu mō te tuarā o ngā whakaarokore.
Ko tā te wāina he whakahī, ko tā te wai kaha he ngangau; ā, ko te hunga katoa e whakapōhēhētia ana e tērā, kāhore ō rātou whakaaro nui.
Ānō he raiona e hāmama ana te wehi o te kīngi; ko te tangata e whakaoho ana i a ia kia riri, e hara ana ki tōna wairua ake.
He whakahōnore mō te tangata te noho wātea mai i te ngangare; engari ko ngā wairangi he kōwhetewhete tonu.
Kāhore te māngere e parau, he mea ki te hōtoke; nō reira ka pākiki kai māna i te kotinga wīti, ā, kāhore e whiwhi.
He wai hōhonu te whakaaro i roto i te ngākau o te tangata; e utuhia anō ia e te tangata mātau.
Ko tā te tini o te tangata he kauwhau i tōna atawhai ake; ko wai ia e kite i te tangata pono?
Ko te tangata tika, e haere ana i runga i tōna tapatahi, ka manaakitia āna tamariki i muri i a ia.
Ko te kīngi e noho ana i runga i te torōna whakawā, tītaritaria ana e ōna kanohi ngā hē katoa.
Ko wai e mea, "Kua mā i ahau tōku ngākau, kua tahia atu ōku hara"?
Ko ngā pāuna huhua, ko ngā mēhua huhua, he rite tahi taua rua, he mea whakarihariha anake ki a Ihowā.
He tamariki nei anō ka mōhiotia ki āna hanga, he mā rānei, he tika rānei tāna mahi.
Ko te taringa rongo, ko te kanohi titiro, nā Ihowā rāua ngātahi i hanga.
Kaua e matenuitia te moe, kei rawakoretia koe; titiro ōu kanohi, ā, ka mākona koe i te taro.
"Ehara ehara," e ai tā te kaihoko; tōna haerenga atu ia, kei te whakamanamana.
He kōura tēnā me te tini o te rupi; engari he taonga utu nui ngā ngutu o te mātauranga.
Tangohia te kākahu o te kaiwhakakapi mō te tangata kē; puritia hoki te tangata i taunahatia hei whakakapi mō ngā tāngata kē.
He reka ki te tangata te taro o te teka; muri iho ka kī tōna māngai i te kirikiri.
Mā te rūnanga ka ū ai ngā whakaaro; kia pai hoki te ngārahu ina anga ki te whawhai.
Ko te tangata e kōpikopiko ana ki te kawekawe kōrero, ka whākina e ia ngā kōrero ngaro; nā reira kaua e raweke atu ki te tangata ngutu hāmama.
Ko te tangata e kanga ana i tōna pāpā, i tōna whaea, ka tineia tōna rama i roto i te pōuri kerekere.
I te tīmatanga e hohoro mai pea te taonga; e kore ia tōna mutunga e whakapaingia.
Kaua e mea, "Ka utua e ahau te kino"; tāria tā Ihowā, ā, kei a ia he oranga mōu.
He mea whakarihariha ki a Ihowā ngā taimaha rerekē; ā, e kore hoki te pāuna tinihanga e pai.
Nā Ihowā ngā hāereerenga o te tangata; nā, mā te aha te tangata ka mātau ai ki tōna ara?
Hei rore ki te tangata te oho noa ake ki te mea, "He tapu!" ā, i muri i ngā kī taurangi, kia uiui.
Ka tītaritaria e te kīngi whakaaro nui te hunga kino, ā, ka hurihia hoki e ia te wīra patu wīti ki runga ki a rātou.
He rama nā Ihowā te manawa o te tangata, e rapu ana i ngā mea katoa i roto rawa i te kōpū.
Hei kaitiaki mō te kīngi te atawhai me te pono; e tautokona ake ana hoki tōna torōna e te atawhai.
Ko te korōria o ngā taitama ko tō rātou kaha; ā, ko te ātaahua o ngā kaumātua ko te upoko hina.
E tahia atu ana te kino e ngā kārawarawa o te patunga; ā, e tae rawa ana ngā whiu ki ngā wāhi o roto rawa o te kōpū.
Kei roto te ngākau o te kīngi i te ringa o Ihowā ānō he awa rerenga wai; e whakaangahia ana e ia ki ngā wāhi katoa e pai ai ia.
Ko ngā ara katoa o te tangata, tika kau ki ōna kanohi ake; ko Ihowā ia hei pāuna i ngā ngākau.
Ko te mahi i te tika, i te whakawā, ki tā Ihowā, pai atu i te patunga tapu.
He kanohi whakakake, he ngākau whakapehapeha, ā, ko te rama hoki o te hunga kino, he hara kau.
Ko ngā whakaaro o te tangata uaua e ahu anake ana ki te hua o te taonga; ko te hunga tākare katoa ia e whawhai kau ana ki te mūhore.
E rite ana tā te arero teka āmi i te taonga ki te mamaoa e āia noatia ana; ko te hunga e rapu ana i ērā e rapu ana i te mate.
Mā te pāhua a te hunga kino e tahi atu rātou; mō rātou kāhore e pai ki te whakawā.
He ara tino kōpikopiko tō te tangata e waha ana i te hara; tēnā ko te tangata mā, he tika tāna mahi.
He pai kē te noho i te kokonga o te tuanui, i te noho tahi me te wahine ngangare i roto i te whare māhorahora.
Ko tā te wairua o te tangata kino he hiahia ki te kino; e kore ōna kanohi e manako ki tōna hoa.
Ki te whiua te tangata whakahī, ka whai whakaaro te kūware; ā, ki te whakaakona te tangata whakaaro nui, ka whiwhi ia ki te mātauranga.
Ka āta whakaaroa e te tangata tika te whare o te tangata kino; te pēheatanga e whakatakā ai te hunga kino ki te mate mō rātou.
Ko te tangata e puru ana i ōna taringa ki te karanga a te rawakore, tērā hoki ia e karanga, heoi e kore e whakarangona.
Mā te mea hōmai puku ka mārie ai te riri, mā te moni whakapati hoki i roto i te uma ka mārie ai te āritarita kaha.
He mahi koa nā te tangata tika te whakawā; mō ngā kaimahi ia i te kino, ko te whakangaromanga.
Ko te tangata e kotiti kē ana i te huarahi o te mahara, ka noho ia i te whakaminenga o ngā tūpāpaku.
Ko te tangata matenui ki ngā āhuareka, ka rawakore; ā, ko te tangata e matenui ana ki te wāina, ki te hinu, e kore e whai taonga.
Hei utu te tangata kino mō te tangata tika; ā, ka haere mai te tangata kōpeka hei whakakapi mō te tangata tū tika.
He pai kē te noho i te koraha, i te noho tahi me te wahine tohetohe, wahine pukukino.
Kei te nohoanga o te tangata whakaaro nui te taonga mōmōhanga me te hinu; heoi maumauria ake e te wairangi.
Ko te tangata e whai ana i te tika, i te atawhai, ka whiwhi ki te ora, ki te tika, ki te hōnore.
Ka pikitia e te tangata whakaaro nui te pā o ngā mārohirohi, ka taka hoki i a ia te kaha i whakawhirinaki ai rātou.
Ko te tangata e tiaki ana i tōna māngai, i tōna arero, e tiaki ana i tōna wairua kei raru.
Ko te tangata whakakake, whakapehapeha, ko te tangata whakahī tōna ingoa, e mahi ana ia i runga i te whakahirahira o tōna whakamanamana.
Ka mate te tangata māngere i tōna hiahia anō; e kore hoki ōna ringa e pai ki te mahi.
Tērā te hanga he kaiapo tonu ā pau noa te rā; ko tā te tangata tika ia he hōmai, kāhore hoki āna kaiponu.
He mea whakarihariha te whakahere a te tangata kino; tērā noa ake ina hē te whakaaro i kawea mai ai e ia.
Ka mate te kaiwhakaatu teka; nā, ko te tangata whakarongo, ka kōrero, kāhore he kaiwhakahē.
Ka whakamārō te tangata kino i tōna mata; tēnā ko te tangata tika, ka whakapai i ōna ara.
I tō Ihowā aroaro kāhore he whakaaro nui, kāhore he mātauranga, kāhore he kupu mōhio, e tū.
Kua rite noa ake he hōiho mō te rā o te whawhai; kei a Ihowā ia te whakaoranga.
Engari te ingoa pai e whiriwhiria rawatia i ngā taonga nui, me te manakohanga aroha i te hiriwa, i te kōura.
Ka tūtataki te tangata taonga rāua ko te rawakore; ko Ihowā te kaihanga ō rātou katoa.
Ko te tangata tūpato, ka kitea atu e ia te hē, ka huna i a ia; ko ngā kūware, haere tonu atu, mamae tonu atu.
Ko te hua o te māhaki, ā, ko te wehi ki a Ihowā, he taonga, he hōnore, he ora.
He tātarāmoa, he māhanga kei te ara o te whanokē; ko te tangata ia e tiaki ana i tōna wairua, ka matara atu i ēnā.
Whakatupuria ake te tamaiti i te ara e haere ai ia, ā, ka kaumātua, e kore e mahue i a ia.
E whakatakoto tikanga ana te tangata taonga mō ngā rawakore; ā, ko te tangata i te nama, hei pononga ia mā te tangata nāna i whakatārewa mai.
Ko te kairui o te kino, ka kokoti i te hē; ā, ka kāhore noa iho te patu o tōna riri.
Ko te kanohi ohaoha, ka manaakitia tērā; e hoatu ana hoki e ia tētahi wāhi o tāna taro mā te rawakore.
Peia atu te tangata whakahī, ā, ka riro te ngangare; ka mutu anō hoki te totohe me te whakahāwea.
Ko te tangata e matenui ana ki te ngākau mā, ko te kīngi he hoa mōna, mō te āhuareka o ōna ngutu.
Mā ngā kanohi o Ihowā e tiaki te tangata whai mātauranga, e whakatakā ana hoki e ia ngā kupu a te tangata kōpeka.
E mea ana te māngere, "He raiona kei waho; ka whakamatea ahau ki ngā huarahi!"
He poka hōhonu te māngai o ngā wāhine kē; ka taka ki roto tā Ihowā tangata e whakarihariha ai.
Paihere rawa te wairangi ki roto ki te ngākau o te tamaiti, otiia, mā te rākau o te whiu e pei kia matara atu i a ia.
Ko te tangata e tūkino ana i te rawakore kia maha atu ai he taonga māna, me te tangata hoki e hoatu mea ana ki te tangata taonga, ka tutuki rāua ki te mūhore kau.
Anga mai tōu taringa, whakarongo mai hoki ki ngā kupu a te hunga whakaaro nui, kia tahuri mai hoki tōu ngākau ki tōku mātauranga.
He mea āhuareka hoki, mehemea ka puritia e koe i roto i tōu kōpū, ki te ū ngātahi rāua ki runga ki ōu ngutu.
Kia okioki ai koe ki a Ihowā, koia i whakakitea ai e ahau aua mea ki a koe i tēnei rā – ki a koe nā anō.
He teka ianei hira rawa ngā mea kua tuhituhia atu nei e ahau ki a koe, he kupu ako, he kupu mōhio;
kia mōhio ai koe ki te tūturutanga o ngā kupu o te pono, kia whakahokia ai e koe he kupu pono ki te hunga e ngare ana i a koe?
Kaua e pāhuatia te rawakore, nō te mea he rawakore ia, kaua hoki e whakatupuria kinotia te tangata iti i te kūwaha.
Nō te mea ka tohea e Ihowā tā rātou tohe, ka pāhuatia anō hoki e ia te wairua o te hunga e pāhua ana i a rātou.
Kaua e whakahoa ki te tangata pukuriri; kei haere tahi hoki koe i te tangata āritarita;
kei ākona e koe ōna ara, ā, ka riro i a koe he māhanga mō tōu wairua.
Kei uru koe ki roto ki te hunga papaki ringa, ki ngā kaiwhakakapi tūranga rānei mō te moni tārewa;
ki te kāhore āu mea hei utu, hei aha i tangohia ai e ia tōu moenga i raro i a koe?
Kaua e whakanekehia atu te rohe tawhito i whakatakotoria e ōu mātua.
Kei te kite rānei koe i tētahi tangata e uaua ana ki tāna mahi? Ka tū ia ki te aroaro o ngā kīngi; e kore ia e tū ki te aroaro o ngā ware.
Ki te noho tahi kōrua ko te rangatira ki te kai, āta whakaaroa mārietia tērā i tōu aroaro;
whakapākia he māripi ki tōu korokoro, ki te mea he tangata kakai koe.
Kaua e hiahia ki āna mea reka; he kai tinihanga hoki ērā.
Kaua e tāruke ki te mea taonga; kāti tāu mea ki tōu mātauranga.
E anga mai rānei ōu kanohi ki taua mea korekore nei? He pono hoki ka whai parirau te taonga, koia ānō kei te ēkara, rere ana whaka te rangi.
Kaua e kainga te kai a te tangata kanohi kino, kei minamina hoki koe ki āna mea reka.
Ko tāna hoki e mea ai i roto i a ia, pērā tonu ia, "E kai, e inu!" koia tāna kupu ki a koe; kāhore ia ōna ngākau ki a koe.
Ko te kongakonga i kainga e koe, ka ruakina e koe, ka maumauria anō hoki āu kupu reka.
Kaua e kōrero ki ngā taringa o te kūware; ka whakahāwea hoki ia ki te whakaaro nui o āu kupu.
Kei whakanekehia e koe te rohe tawhito; kei haere koe ki ngā māra a te pani;
nō te mea he kaha tō rātou kaiwhakaora; ka tohea e ia tā rātou tohe ki a koe.
Anga atu tōu ngākau ki te ako, me ōu taringa ki ngā kupu o te mātauranga.
Kaua e tohungia te whiu ki te tamaiti; ki te patua hoki ia e koe ki te rākau, e kore ia e mate.
Tātātia ia e koe ki te rākau, ā, ka whakaorangia e koe tōna wairua i te rēinga.
E tāku tama, ki te whakaaro nui tōu ngākau, ka koa hoki tōku ngākau, āe rā, tōku nei anō;
āe rā, ka hari ōku whatumanawa, ina kōrero ōu ngutu i ngā mea tika.
Kei hae tōu ngākau ki te hunga hara; engari kia wehi koe ki a Ihowā, ā pau noa te rā.
He pono hoki tērā ānō he whakautu; e kore anō hoki tāu i tūmanako ai e hātepea atu.
Whakarongo rā, e tāku tama, kia whai whakaaro hoki koe, ā, whakatikaia tōu ngākau i te ara.
Kei uru ki te hunga kakai wāina; ki te hunga pukukai kikokiko;
nō te mea ka tutuki tahi te tangata inuinu rāua ko te tangata kakai ki te rawakore; he tawhetawhe hoki te kākahu a te momoe mō te tangata.
Whakarongo ki tōu pāpā nāna koe; kaua hoki e whakahāwea ki tōu whaea ina rūruhi ia.
Hokona te pono, kaua hoki e whakawhitiwhitia; āe rā, te whakaaro nui, te ako hoki, me te mātauranga.
Nui atu hoki te koa o te pāpā o te tangata tika; ā, ko te tangata e whānau he tama whakaaro nui māna, ka hari ia ki a ia.
Kia hari tōu pāpā rāua ko tōu whaea, inā, kia koa te wahine i whānau ai koe.
E tāku tama, hōmai tōu ngākau ki ahau, kia manako anō hoki ōu kanohi ki āku ara.
Nō te mea he rua hōhonu te wahine kairau; he poka kūiti te wahine kē.
Āe rā, ka whanga ia ānō he kaipāhua, ā, ka whakatokomahatia e ia ngā tāngata poka kē.
Ko wai e auē? Ko wai e tangi? Ko wai e totohe? Ko wai e ngangautia? Ko wai e marū, he mea takekore? Ko wai e whero tonu ōna kanohi?
Ko te hunga e noho roa ana ki te wāina; ko te hunga e haere ana ki te rapu i te wāina whakaranu.
Kaua e titiro ki te wāina i te mea e whero ana, ina puta tōna kara i roto i te kapu, ina mania tōna heke.
Tōna tukunga iho ānō he nākahi e ngau ana, koia anō kei te wero a te neke.
E kite hoki ōu kanohi i ngā mea rerekē, ā, ka puta he kupu rerekē i tōu ngākau.
Āe rā, ka rite koe ki te tangata e takoto ana i waenga moana, ki te tangata rānei e takoto ana i te tihi o te rewa.
Ā, ka mea koe, "Patua ana ahau e rātou, ā, kīhai ahau i mamae; tātātia ana ahau e rātou, ā, kīhai ahau i mōhio. Āhea ahau ara ake ai? Ka rapua anō e ahau."
Kei hae koe ki te hunga kino, kaua hoki e hiahia hei hoa mō rātou.
Ko tā tō rātou ngākau hoki e whakaaro ai, he tūkino, ko tā ō rātou ngutu e kōrero ai, he whanokē.
Mā te whakaaro nui ka hangā ai te whare, ā, mā te mātauranga ka ū ai.
Mā te mōhio hoki ka kī ai ngā rūma i ngā taonga utu nui katoa, i ngā mea āhuareka.
He kaha te tangata whakaaro nui; āe, e whakanuia ana e te tangata mōhio te kaha.
Nā, kia pai te ngārahu ina anga koe ki te whawhai; kei te tokomaha hoki o ngā kaiwhakatakoto whakaaro te ora.
He tiketike rawa te whakaaro nui mō te wairangi; e kore e kuihi tōna māngai i te kūwaha.
Ko te tangata e whakaaro ana ki te kino, ka kīia he whanokē.
He hara te whakaaro wairangi; he mea whakarihariha anō ki te tangata te tangata whakahī.
Ki te ngoikore koe i te rā o te hē, he iti tōu kaha.
Whakaorangia te hunga e kawea atu ana ki te mate, ā, puritia mai hoki e koe te hunga e meatia ana kia whakamatea.

Ki te mea koe, "Nanā, kīhai tēnei i mōhiotia e mātou"; kāhore ianei te kaipāuna ngākau i te whakaaro ki tērā? Ā, ko te kaitiaki o tōu wairua, kāhore rānei ia e mōhio, e kore rānei e hōmai e ia ki te tangata kia rite ki tāna mahi?
Kainga, e tāku tama, te honi, he pai hoki; me te honikoma, he mea reka hoki ki tōu māngai.
Ka mōhio ai koe ki te whakaaro nui, he mea ki tōu wairua; ki te kitea e koe, he tukunga iho anō tōna, e kore hoki tāu i tūmanako ai e hātepea.
Kaua, e te tangata kino, e whanga ki te nohoanga o te tangata tika; kei tūkino koe ki tōna takotoranga.
E hinga ana hoki te tangata tika, e whitu hinganga, ka ara ake anō; ka whakatakā ia te hunga kino e te hē.
Kaua e harakoa ki te hinga tōu hoariri, kaua hoki tōu ngākau e hari ina taka ia;
kei kite a Ihowā, ā, ka hē ki tāna titiro, ā, ka tahuri atu tōna riri i a ia.
Kei mamae koe, he mea mō ngā kaimahi i te kino, kei hae hoki ki te hunga kino.
Kāhore hoki he mutunga pai ki te tangata kino; ka keto hoki te rama a te hunga kino.
E tāku tama, e wehi ki a Ihowā, ki te kīngi hoki; ā, kaua e whakauru noa atu ki te hunga e mea ana ki te whakaputa kē.
Nō te mea ka puta tata te aituā mō rātou; ā, ko wai ka mōhio ki te whakangaromanga ō rāua tokorua?
He whakatauki anō hoki ēnei nā te hunga whakaaro nui: Ehara i te mea pai kia whakaaro ki te kanohi tāngata ina whakawā.
Ko te tangata e mea ana ki te tangata kino, "He tika koe," ka kanga ngā iwi ki a ia, ka whakarihariha ngā tauiwi ki a ia.
Otiia ka koa ngā ngākau o te hunga e rīria ai tōna hē, ka tau iho anō hoki te manaaki pai ki runga ki a rātou.
Ka kihia e ia ngā ngutu e whakahoki ana i ngā kupu tika.
Meinga kia takoto pai tāu mahi i waho, kia rite hoki hei meatanga māu i te māra; muri iho ka hanga i tōu whare.
Kaua koe e tū hei kaiwhakaatu hē mō tōu hoa, i te mea kāhore he take; ā, kaua e tinihanga ki ōu ngutu.
Kaua e kī, "Ka meatia anō e ahau ki a ia tāna i mea ai ki ahau; ka rite ki tā te tangata mahi tāku e whakahoki ai ki a ia."
I haere ahau i te taha o te māra a te māngere, i te taha hoki o te māra wāina a te tangata kāhore ōna mahara;
nā, kua tupuria katoatia e te tātarāmoa, kapi tonu te mata o te māra i te ongaonga, ā, ko tō reira taiepa kōhatu kua oti te wāhi.
Kātahi ahau ka titiro, ka āta whakaaroaro; ka kite ahau, ā, ka hopu mai hei ako mōku.
Kia iti ake nei te wāhi e parangia ai, kia iti ake nei te moe, kia iti ake te kōtuituitanga o ngā ringa ka moe ai.
Ka pērā te haerenga mai o tōu mūhore ānō he kaipāhua; o tōu rawakore hoki ānō he tangata mau patu.
He whakatauki anō ēnei nā Horomona, he mea tuhi e ngā tāngata a Hetekia kīngi o Hūrā.
Ko tō te Atua whakakorōria, he huna mea; ko tō ngā kīngi whakakorōria he rapu mea.
Ko te rangi mō te tiketike, ko te whenua mō te hōhonu, ā, ko te ngākau o ngā kīngi, tē taea te rapu.
Tahia atu te para i te hiriwa, ā, ka puta mai he oko mā te kaitahi para;
tangohia atu te tangata kino i te aroaro o te kīngi, ā, ka ū tōna torōna i runga i te tika.
Kei whakaputa i a koe ki mua i te aroaro o te kīngi, kei tū hoki ki te wāhi o ngā metararahi.
He pai kē hoki kia kīia mai ki a koe, "Haere mai ki runga nei," i te mea kia whakahokia iho koe ki raro i te aroaro o te rangatira. I kitea nei e ōu kanohi
kei hohoro te haere ki te ngangare, kei kore e kitea e koe tāu e mea ai i tōna mutunga iho, ina meinga koe e tōu hoa kia whakamā.
Tohea tāu tohe ki tōu hoa tonu, ā, kaua e whākina te mea huna a tētahi:
kei kohukohutia koe e te tangata i rongo, ā, kore ake tōu ingoa kino e tahuri atu.
He kupu i tika te kōrero, ko tōna rite kei ngā āporo kōura i roto i ngā kete hiriwa.
He pērā i te whakakai kōura, i te whakapaipai kōura parakore koia anō te ako a te whakaaro nui ki te taringa rongo.
Rite tonu ki te mātao o te hukarere i te kotinga wīti te karere pono ki ōna kaingare; ka ora hoki i a ia te ngākau o ōna ariki.
He pērā i ngā kapua me te hau uakore, koia anō te rite o te tangata e whakamanamana ana ki āna hākari horihori.
Mā te roa e whakamanawanui ana ka whakaae mai ai te kīngi, ā, mā te arero ngāwari ka mangungu ai te wheua.
Kua kitea e koe he honi, kainga ko te wāhi e mākona ai koe; kei kī rawa koe i taua mea, ka ruakina e koe.
Kia takitahi tōu waewae ki te whare o tōu hoa; kei hōhā ia ki a koe, ā, ka kino ki a koe.
Ko te tangata e whakaatu teka ana mō tōna hoa, he patu ia, he hoari, ā, he pere koi.
Ko te whakawhirinaki ki te tangata tinihanga i te wā o te raru, e rite ana ki te niho whati, ki te waewae kua takoki.
Ko te tangata e waiata ana ki te ngākau pōuri, e rite ana ki te tangata e whakarere ana i te kākahu i te rangi māeke, ki te winika hoki i runga i te hōura.
Ki te matekai tōu hoariri whāngaia ki te taro; ki te matewai whakainumia ki te wai;
ka pūrangatia hoki e koe he waro kāpura ki tōna māhunga, ā, ka utua tāu e Ihowā.
E mauria ana mai e te hauraro he ua; e pērātia ana hoki e te arero ngautuarā, he kanohi pukuriri.
He pai kē te noho i te kokonga o te tuanui, i te noho tahi me te wahine ngangare i roto i te whare māhorahora.
He rongo pai nō te whenua tawhiti, tōna rite kei ngā wai mātao ki te wairua matewai.
Me te manawa-whenua i takatakahia, me te puna i whakaparuparutia, koia anō te tangata tika e hinga ana i te aroaro o te tangata kino.
Ehara i te mea pai te kai nui i te honi; waihoki ko ā te tangata rapu i tō rātou ake korōria ehara i te korōria.
Ko te tangata e kore nei e pēhi i tōna wairua, e rite ana ki te pā kua pakaru, kāhore ōna taiepa.
He pērā i te hukarere i te raumati, i te ua hoki i te kotinga wīti, te kore e tau o te hōnore mō te wairangi.
He pērā i te manu e rererere noa ana, i te warou i ōna rerenga te kanga pokanoa; e kore e whakatau.
He whiu mō te hōiho, he paraire mō te kāihe, ā, he rākau mō te tuarā o ngā wairangi.
Kei rite ki tōna whakaarokore tāu whakautu ki te wairangi, kei rite hoki a koe nā ki a ia.
Kia rite ki tōna whakaarokore tāu whakautu ki te wairangi, kei mea ia he whakaaro nui ia.
Ko te tangata e tuku kōrero ana mā te ringa o te wairangi, e tapahi ana i ōna waewae anō, e inumia ana hoki te hē.
E tautau noa ana ngā waewae o te kopa; he pērā hoki te whakatauki i te māngai o te wairangi.
Ko te takai mea whakapaipai i roto i te pūranga kōhatu, ko tōna rite kei te tangata e whakakorōria ana i te wairangi.
E rite ana ki te tātarāmoa e wero nei i te ringa o te haurangi, koia anō te whakatauki i te māngai o ngā wairangi.
Ka rite ki te kaikōpere i tū ai te katoa, te tangata e utu ana i te wairangi me te tangata hoki e utu ana i ngā tira haere.
Ka rite ki te kurī e hoki nei ki tōna ruaki, te wairangi e tuarua ana i tōna pōauau.
Ka kite koe i te tangata e mea ana ki a ia he whakaaro nui? Ki tā te whakaaro tērā e rahi ake tā te wairangi i tāna.
E kī ana te māngere, "He raiona kei te ara; he raiona kei ngā waharoa."
He pērā i te tatau e tāhurihuri rā i runga i ōna īnihi, koia anō te māngere i runga i tōna moenga.
E kuhua ana e te māngere tōna ringa ki te rīhi; he mahi ngenge rawa ki a ia te whakahoki mai ki tōna māngai.
He nui kē ake te whakaaro nui o te māngere, ki tāna nei whakaaro, i tō ngā tāngata tokowhitu e whakaatu ana i te tikanga.
Ko te tangata e haere atu ana, e pokanoa ana ki te whawhai ehara nei i a ia, ko tōna rite kei te tangata e hopu ana i te kurī ki ōna taringa.
Rite tonu ki te haurangi e makamaka ana i ngā mea mura, i ngā pere, i te mate,
te tangata e tinihanga ana ki tōna hoa, e mea ana, "He teka ianei he tākaro tāku?"
Ki te kāhore he wahie, ka mate te ahi; ki te kore hoki he tangata kawekawe kōrero, ka mutu te ngangare.
He waro ki ngā ngārahu wera, he wahie ki te ahi; he pērā te tangata totohe ki te tahu i te ngangare.
He rite ngā kupu a te kaikawekawe kōrero ki te maramara reka, tae tonu iho ki ngā wāhi o roto rawa o te kōpū.
He ngutu pukā me te ngākau kino, ko te rite kei te oko oneone i whakakikoruatia ki te para hiriwa.
Ko te tangata mauāhara e whakaware ana ki ōna ngutu, otiia e rongoātia ana e ia te tinihanga ki roto ki a ia;
ki te pai tōna reo, kaua e whakapono ki a ia; e whitu hoki ngā mea whakarihariha kei roto i tōna ngākau.
Ahakoa hīpoki tōna mauāhara i a ia ki te tinihanga, ka whakakitea nuitia tōna kino ki te aroaro o te whakaminenga.
Ko te tangata e keri ana i te rua, ka taka anō ki roto; ā, ko te tangata e huri ana i te kōhatu, ka hoki mai anō ki runga ki a ia.
E kino ana te arero teka ki āna i kuru ai, ā, ko tā te māngai whakapati, he mahi kia ngaro.
Kei whakamanamana koe ki te rā āpōpō; kāhore hoki koe e mōhio ko te aha e puta mai i roto i te rā.
Mā tētahi atu tangata te whakamoemiti mōu, kaua mā tōu māngai ake; mā te tangata kē, kaua mā ōu ngutu ake.
He taimaha te kōhatu, he taimaha anō te kirikiri; he taimaha atu ia i ā rāua tahi te pukuriri o te wairangi.
He mea nanakia te riri, he rūtaki te āritarita; ko wai ia e tū i mua i te hae?
He pai kē te riri matanui i te aroha huna.
Ko ngā patu a te hoa aroha he mea nā te pono; ko ngā kihi ia a te hoariri auau rawa.
E ngaruru ana te wairua mākona ki te honikoma; engari ki te wairua hiakai, reka kau ngā mea kawa katoa.
Rite tonu ki te manu e ātiutiu noa atu ana i tōna kōhanga te tangata e ātiutiu noa atu ana i tōna wāhi.
He whakahari ngākau te hinu me te whakakakara; he pērā anō ngā āhuareka o tō te tangata hoa aroha i ahu mai i ngā tikanga mateoha i whakatakotoria e tōna ngākau.
Ko tōu hoa aroha ake, ā, ko te hoa hoki o tōu pāpā, kaua e whakarērea; kaua hoki e haere ki te whare o tōu tuakana i te rā e mate ai koe. He pai kē hoki te hoa e tata ana i te tuakana i tawhiti.
E tāku tama, kia whakaaro nui, kia koa ai tōku ngākau, kia whakahoki kupu ai hoki ahau ki te hunga e tāwai ana ki ahau.
E kite atu ana te tangata tūpato i te hē, ā, ka huna i a ia; tēnā ko te kūware, haere tonu atu, mamae tonu atu.
Tangohia te kākahu o te kaiwhakakapi mō te tangata kē; tōna taunaha anō hoki mō tā te wahine kē.
Ko te tangata e maranga ana i te atatū, he nui hoki tōna reo ki te manaaki i tōna hoa, ka kīia tāna he kanga.
He māturuturu e pūputu tonu ana i te rā nui te ua, he wahine ngangare, rite tonu rāua;
ko te tangata e mea ana ki te pēhi i a ia, e mea ana ki te pēhi i te hau, ā, ka tūtaki tōna ringa matau ki te hinu.
Ko te rino hei whakakoi mō te rino; waihoki ko te tangata anō hei whakakoi i te mata o tōna hoa.
Ko te kaitiaki o te piki, ka kai i ōna hua; ka whakahōnoretia te tangata e whakaaro ana ki tōna rangatira.
He pērā i te wai, tiro atu, tiro mai he kanohi, ka pēnā anō tō te tangata ngākau ki te tangata.
Ko te rēinga, ko te whakangaromanga, e kore e mākona; e kore anō hoki e mākona ngā kanohi o te tangata.
Ko te oko tahu para mō te hiriwa, ko te oumu mō te kōura; ā, ko te whakanui i a ia, hei whakamātautau mō te tangata.
Ahakoa i tukua e koe te wairangi ki te tuki i roto i te kumete i waenga i ngā wīti pēpē, e kore tōna whakaarokore e riro.
Kia anga nui koa kia mōhio ki te āhua o āu hipi, ā, kia pai te tiaki i āu kāhui kau;
e kore hoki te taonga e mau tonu; e mau ianei te karauna ki ngā whakatupuranga katoa?
Kua whāiti te hei, e kitea ana te tupu hou, ā, e kohikohia ana ngā otaota o ngā maunga.
Hei mea kākahu mōu ngā reme, ā, ko ngā koati hei utu mō te māra.
Ā tērā te waiū koati, he nui noa atu hei kai māu, hei kai hoki mā tōu whare, hei oranga anō hoki mō āu kōtiro.
E rere ana te hunga kino i te mea kāhore he kaiwhai; ko te tangata tika anō ia, ānō he raiona te māia.
He hē nō tētahi whenua i tokomaha ai ōna rangatira; nā, kia ai he tangata e mahara ana, e mātau ana, ka mau roa ai tōna āhua.
Ko te tangata rawakore e tūkino ana i ngā ware, ko tōna rite kei te ua tā e kore ai te kai.
Ko te hunga e whakarere ana i te ture, he whakamoemiti tā rātou ki te tangata kino; ko tā ngā kaipupuri ia o te ture he ngangare ki a rātou.
E kore te hunga kino e mōhio ki te whakawā: ko te hunga ia e rapu ana i a Ihowā, ka mōhio rātou ki ngā mea katoa.
He pai kē te rawakore e haere ana i runga i tōna tapatahi, i te tangata he parori kē ōna ara, ahakoa he whai taonga ia.
Ko te tangata e pupuri ana i te ture, he tamaiti mōhio ia; engari ko te tangata whakahoa ki te hunga kakai, ka whakamā tōna pāpā i a ia.
Ko te tangata e whakanui ana i ōna rawa ki te moni whakatupu, ki te whakapiki utu, e kohia ana e ia ērā mā te tangata e atawhaitia ai te rawakore.
Ko te tangata e tahuri kē ana tōna taringa, ā, kāhore e rongo ki te ture, ko tāna īnoi nei ānō he mea whakarihariha.
Ko te tangata i meinga ai te hunga tika, kia kotiti kē ki te ara hē, ka taka a ia anō ki tāna ake poka; ka whiwhi ia te hunga ngākau tapatahi ki te pai.
Ki te whakaaro a te tangata taonga he nui tōna whakaaro mōhio; otiia e rapua ana tāna e te rawakore whai whakaaro.
Nui atu te ātaahua, ina koa te hunga tika; engari ki te ara te hunga kino, ka huna ngā tāngata i a rātou.
Ko te tangata e hīpoki ana i ōna hē, e kore tāna e kake; ko te tangata ia e whāki ana, ā, e whakarere ana, ka tohungia.
Ka hari te tangata e wehi tonu ana; ko te tangata ia e whakapakeke ana i tōna ngākau, ka taka ki te kino.
E rite ana ki te raiona e hāmama ana, ki te pea e kōpikopiko ana, te tangata kino e kīngi ana ki te iwi rawakore.
Ko te rangatira kore whakaaro he nui anō tāna tūkino; ko te tangata ia e kino ana ki te apo ka roa ōna rā.
Ko te tangata e waha ana i te toto o te tangata, ka rere ia ki roto ki te rua; kaua tētahi e pupuri i a ia.
Ko te tangata he tapatahi nei te haere, ka ora; ko te tangata ia he parori kē ōna ara, hinga tonu iho.
Ko te tangata e ngaki ana i tōna oneone, ka mākona i te taro; ko te tangata ia e whai ana i te hunga wairangi, ka whiwhi nui ki te rawakore.
Ko te tangata pono, ka nui ngā manaaki mōna; ko te tangata ia e hīkaka ana ki te mea taonga, e kore ia e kore te whiwhi i te hē.
Ko te whakapai kanohi ehara i te mea pai – ehara anō hoki i te mea pai kia hē te tangata mō te kongakonga taro.
Ko te tangata he kino tōna kanohi e tākare tonu ana ki te taonga; kāhore hoki ia e whakaaro ka tae mai te kore o te rawa ki a ia.
Ko te tangata i rīria ai te hē o tētahi, ka nui atu te manako ki a ia i muri iho, i te manako ki te tangata i whakapati nei tōna arero.
Ko te tangata e pāhua ana i tōna pāpā, i tōna whaea, ā, e kī ana, "Ehara i te hē," he hoa ia nō te kaiwhakangaro.
Ko tā te tangata ngākau apo he whakapātari pakanga; ko te tangata ia e okioki ana ki a Ihowā ka tetere.
He kūware te tangata e whakawhirinaki ana ki tōna ake ngākau; ko te tangata ia e haere ana i runga i te whakaaro nui, ka mawhiti.
Ko te tangata e hoatu ana ki te rawakore, e kore ia e hapa; ko te tangata ia e kaupare ana i ōna kanohi, ka maha ngā kanga mōna.
Ka ara te hunga kino, ka huna ngā tāngata i a rātou; nā, ki te ngaro rātou, ka tupu te hunga tika.
Ko te tangata he maha nei ngā riringa i tōna hē, ā, ka whakapakeke i tōna kakī ka whatia ohoreretia ia – tē taea te rongoā.
Ka whakanuia te hunga tika, ka koa te iwi; ka kīngi te tangata kino, ka auē te iwi.
Ko te tangata e matenui ana ki te whakaaro nui e whakahari ana i tōna pāpā; ko te tangata ia e piri ana ki ngā wāhine kairau, he maumau taonga tāna.
Mā te whakawā a te kīngi e mau ai te whenua; ka whakatakā ia e te tangata e tango ana i ngā mea hōmai noa.
Ko te tangata e whakapati ana ki tōna hoa, e whakatakoto kupenga ana mō ōna waewae.
He rore kei roto i te hē o te tangata kino; ko te tangata tika ia he waiata tāna, he koa.
E mahara ana te tangata tika ki te take a te rawakore; kāhore o te tangata kino whakaaro kia mōhiotia e ia.
Mā ngā tāngata whakahī e tahu te pā kia mura; ko tā te hunga whakaaro nui ia he whakatahuri atu i te riri.
Ki te totohe te tangata whakaaro nui ki te tangata wairangi, ahakoa riri ia, kata rānei, kāhore he tānga.
E mauāhara ana te tangata whakaheke toto ki te tangata i te ngākau tapatahi; tēnā ko te hunga tika, ka whai rātou kia whakaorangia ia.
E puakina ana e te wairangi tōna riri katoa ki waho; e puritia mai ana ia e te tangata whakaaro nui, e pēhia ana.
Ki te whakarongo te rangatira ki te teka, he kino katoa āna tāngata.
E tūtaki ana te rawakore rāua ko te kaitūkino ki a rāua; ko Ihowā te kaiwhakamārama o ngā kanohi ō rāua tokorua.
Ko te kīngi e pono ana tāna whakawā mō ngā rawakore, ka whakapūmautia tōna torōna ake ake.
Ko te whiu, ko te riri i te hē, he mea hōmai ērā i te whakaaro nui; tēnā ko te tamaiti mahue noa, ka whakamā a ia tōna whaea.
Ka tokomaha te hunga kino, ka nui te hē; ka kite ia te hunga tika i tō rātou hinganga.
Pākia tāu tama, ā, ka whai okiokinga koe i a ia; āe rā, he āhuareka tāna e hōmai ai ki tōu wairua.
Ki te kāhore he whakakitenga, ka kore te iwi e tūpato; ko te kaipupuri ia i te ture, ka hari ia.
Ehara te kupu i te papaki mō te pononga; ahakoa hoki ia mātau, e kore ia e rongo.
Ka kite rānei koe i te tangata kaikā ki te kōrero? Engari, te wairangi ka tōtika ake i a ia.
Ko te tangata e penapena ana i tāna pononga mai o te tamarikitanga, ka waiho ia e ia i te mutunga hei tama tupu.
He whakaoho whawhai tā te tangata pukuriri; he nui rawa hoki te hē o te tangata āritarita.
Ka whakaititia iho te tangata e tōna whakapehapeha; ka whai hōnore ia te tangata ngākau pāpaku.
Ko te tangata e whakauru ana ki tā te tāhae, e kino ana ki tōna ake wairua; e rongo ana ia i te kanga, kāhore e kīkī.
He rore e hōmai ana e te wehi ki te tangata; ko te tangata ia e whakawhirinaki ana ki a Ihowā ka mawhiti.
He tokomaha e whai ana kia paingia e te rangatira; otiia i ahu mai i a Ihowā te whakawā mō te tangata.
He mea whakarihariha ki te hunga tika te tangata whakahaere hē; ā, he mea whakarihariha hoki ki te tangata kino te tangata he tika tōna ara.
Ko ngā kupu a Akuru tama a Iakehe; ko te poropititanga. I kōrero taua tangata ki a Itiere, ki a Itiere rāua ko Ukara:
He pono ko ahau te mea pōauau rawa o ngā tāngata, kāhore hoki he mātauranga tangata i roto i ahau.
Kīhai hoki ahau i whakaakona ki te whakaaro nui, kīhai anō i mōhio ki te Mea Tapu.

Ko wai kua piki atu ki te rangi, ā, heke mai ai anō? Ko wai kua pūpū i te hau ki roto ki ōna ringa? Nā wai i takai ngā wai ki roto ki tōna kākahu? Nā wai i whakapūmau ngā pito katoa o te whenua? Ko wai tōna ingoa, ā, ko wai hoki te ingoa o tāna tama? Ki te mōhiotia e koe!
Ko ngā kupu katoa a te Atua he mea whakamātau; he whakangungu rākau ia ki te hunga katoa e whakawhirinaki ana ki a ia.
Kaua e tāpiritia ētahi kupu ki āna, kei rīria e ia tōu hē, ā, ka kitea koe he tangata kōrero teka.
E rua ngā mea kua īnoia e ahau i a koe; kaua ēnā e kaiponuhia i ahau i mua i tōku matenga:
Whakamataratia atu i ahau te horihori me te kōrero teka; kaua e hōmai te rawakore ki ahau, te taonga rānei; whāngaia ahau ki te kai e rite ana māku.
Kei mākona ahau, ā, ka whakakāhore ki a koe, ka mea, "Ko wai a Ihowā?" Kei rawakore rānei ahau, ā, ka whānako, ka whakahua noa hoki i te ingoa o tōku Atua.
Kaua e kōrerotia te pononga ki tōna ariki, kei kanga ia i a koe, ā, ko koe e hē.
Tērā te whakatupuranga, he kanga tā rātou i tō rātou pāpā, kāhore hoki e manaaki i tō rātou whaea.
Tērā te whakatupuranga, he mā ki tā rātou nā titiro, otirā kāhore anō kia horoia atu tō rātou paru.
Tērā te whakatupuranga, nā, te whakakake o ō rātou kanohi. Kua whakarewaina ake hoki ō rātou kamo!
Tērā te whakatupuranga, ko ō rātou niho ānō he hoari, ko ō rātou niho pūrākau ānō he māripi, hei horo i te hunga iti i runga i te whenua, i ngā rawakore hoki i roto i ngā tāngata.
E rua ngā tamāhine a te ngata, ko tā rāua karanga, "Hōmai, hōmai." E toru ngā mea e kore rawa e mākona, āe rā, e whā ngā mea e kore e kī, "Kāti":
ko te rua tūpāpaku; ko te kōpū pakoko; ko te whenua kīhai i pukuwaitia, ā, ko te ahi e kore nei e kī, "Kāti!"
Ko te kanohi e whakahī ana ki te pāpā, e whakahāwea ana ki te whakarongo ki tōna whaea, mā ngā raweni o te awaawa ia e tīkaro, ā, mā ngā pī ēkara e kai.
E toru ngā mea he whakamīharo rawa, e kore e taea e ahau, āe rā, e whā kāhore e mōhiotia e ahau:
ko te huarahi o te ēkara i te rangi; ko te huarahi o te nākahi i runga i te kāmaka; ko te huarahi o te kaipuke i waenga moana; ā, ko te huarahi o te tangata ki te kōtiro.
He pērā anō te huarahi o te wahine pūremu: ka kai ia, ā, ka horoi i tōna māngai, ā, ka kī, "Kāhore āku mahi hē."
E toru ngā mea e korikori ai te whenua; ā, e whā, he mea e kore e manawanuitia e ia:
ko te pononga ina whakakīngitia ia; ko te wairangi hoki ina mākona i te taro;
ko te wahine whakarihariha ina whiwhi i te tāne; ā, ko te pononga wahine ina tuku iho māna ngā mea a tōna rangatira.
E whā ngā mea ririki i runga i te whenua, he nui noa atu ia ngā whakaaro:
ko ngā pōpokorua ehara i te iwi kaha, heoi e mea ana i te kai mā rātou i te raumati;
ko ngā koni, he iwi ngoikore, heoi e hanga ana i ō rātou whare ki te kāmaka;
ko ngā māwhitiwhiti, kāhore ō rātou kīngi, heoi haere rōpū ana rātou katoa;
ko te mokomoko, ko ōna peke hei pupuri māna; otiia kei roto ia i ngā whare kīngi.
E toru ngā mea, he tau tā rātou hīkoi, āe rā, e whā he huatau ki te haere:
ko te raiona, ko te mea kaha rawa o ngā kararehe, e kore nei e tahuri mai i te aroaro o tētahi;
ko te kurī horo; ko te koati toa anō hoki; ā, ko te kīngi, kāhore nei tētahi e maranga ake ki a ia.
Ki te mea he mahi kūware tau i a koe i whakaneke ake ai i a koe, ki te mea rānei i whakaaro kino koe, kōpania tōu ringa ki tōu māngai.
He pono hoki ki te hurihia te waiū ka puta mai he pata, ā, ki te kōwiria te ihu ka puta mai he toto; waihoki ki te ākina te riri ka puta he whawhai.
Ko ngā kupu a Kīngi Remuera; ko te poropititanga i whakaakona ai ia e tōna whaea:
He aha, e tāku tama? He aha, e te tama a tōku kōpū? Ā, he aha, e te tama a āku kupu taurangi?
Kaua e hoatu tōu kaha ki ngā wāhine, ōu ara hoki ki te mea whakangaro o ngā kīngi.
Ehara mā ngā kīngi, e Remuera, ehara mā ngā kīngi te inu wāina; ehara hoki mā ngā rangatira te mea, "Kei hea he wai kaha?"
Kei inu rātou, ā, ka wareware ki te ture, ā, ka whakapeau kē i te whakawā o te tangata e tūkinotia ana.
Hoatu he wai kaha mā te tangata e tata ana te marere, he wāina hoki ki ngā wairua pōuri;
tukua ia kia inu, kia wareware ai ki tōna rawakore, ā, kore ake he mahara ki ōna mate.
Kia puaki tōu māngai mō te wahangū, i te whakawākanga o te hunga katoa kua waiho mō te mate.
Kia puaki tōu māngai, whakaritea te whakawā i runga i te tika, tohea te tohe a te ware, a te rawakore.
Ko wai e kite i te wahine e ū ana tōna pai? Ko tōna utu hoki kei runga noa atu i tō ngā rupi.
Ka whakapono te ngākau o tāna tāne ki a ia, ā, kāhore ōna hapanga i te taonga.
He pai tāna e mea ai ki a ia, kāhore hoki he kino, i ngā rā katoa e ora ai ia.
E kimi ana ia i te huruhuru hipi, i te muka, ā, ka ngākau nui te mahi a ōna ringa.
Ko tōna rite kei ngā kaipuke o ngā kaihokohoko; e mauria mai ana e ia tāna kai i tawhiti.
E maranga ana hoki ia i te mea e pō tonu ana, ā, hoatu ana e ia he kai mā tōna whare, he mahi hoki e rite ana mā āna kōtiro.
E whakaaroaro ana ia ki tētahi māra, ā, ka hokona e ia; whakatōkia ana e ia he māra wāina, he hua nā ōna ringa.
E whītiki ana ia i tōna hope ki te kaha, e mea ana i ōna tākakau kia pakari.
Ka kite ia he pai tāna i hokohoko ai; e kore tāna rama e mate i te pō.
Ka totoro atu ōna ringa ki te mea tākai miro, ka pupuri ōna ringa ki te pou muka.
Ka wherahia tōna ringa ki te ware; āe rā, ka totoro atu ōna ringa ki te rawakore.
E kore ia e wehi i te hukarere mō tōna whare; nō te mea kua kākahuria tōna whare katoa ki te ngangana.
Oti ake i a ia te whatuwhatu he whāriki mōna; he rīnena pai, he pāpura ōna kākahu.
E mōhiotia ana tāna tāne i ngā kūwaha, ina noho tahi ia ki ngā kaumātua o te whenua.
E hangā ana e ia he rīnena pai, ā, hokona atu ana; e hoatu ana e ia he whītiki ki ngā kaihoko.
He kaha, he hōnore ōna kākahu; ā, e kata ana ia ki ngā rā ō muri atu.
He nui ōna whakaaro ina puaki tōna māngai; kei tōna arero te ture o te atawhai.
Ka āta tirohia e ia ngā ara o tōna whare, e kore anō ia e kai i te taro o te māngere.
Ka whakatika āna tamariki, ā, he kupu manaaki tā rātou mōna; tāna tāne hoki, ka whakamoemiti anō ia ki a ia, ka mea:
"He tokomaha ngā tamāhine i ū te pai o tā rātou mahi, otiia, hira ake tāu i ā rātou katoa."
He mea teka noa te manako, he mea horihori te ātaahua; tēnā ko te wahine e wehi ana i a Ihowā, ko ia e whakamoemititia.
Hoatu ki a ia o ngā hua o ōna ringa; ā, mā āna mahi ia e whakamoemiti i ngā kūwaha.
Ko ngā kupu a te Kaikauwhau, arā a te tama a Rāwiri, i kīngi nei ki Hiruhārama:
"He tino horihori rawa," e ai tā te Kaikauwhau, "he tino horihori rawa; he horihori katoa!"
He aha te pai ki te tangata o tōna māuiui katoa e māuiui ai ia i raro i te rā?
Ko tēnei whakatupuranga e haere atu ana, ko tērā whakatupuranga e haere mai ana; ko te whenua ia, mau tonu.
E whiti ana hoki te rā, e heke atu ana te rā, hohoro tonu atu ki tōna wāhi i whiti mai ai.
E anga ana te hau ki te tonga, nā, ka taka ki te raki; he hanga takataka tonu tāna i tōna ara, ā, ka hoki mai anō te hau ki ōna takatakanga.
E rere ana ngā awa katoa ki te moana, heoi kāhore e kī te moana; ko te wāhi i rere mai ai ngā awa, ka hoki atu anō rātou ki reira.
Māuiui rawa ngā mea katoa, e kore e taea e te tangata te kōrero; e kore te kanohi e ngata i te mātakitaki, e kore te taringa e kī i te whakarongo.
Ko tō mua mea koia anō hei mea āianei, ā, ko te mea i mahia i mua ka mahia anō āianei; kāhore hoki he mea hou i raro i te rā.
Tērā anō rānei he mea e kī ai tētahi, "Titiro, he mea hou tēnei"? He mea ia nō ngā wā ō mua, nō ērā i mua atu i a tātou.
Kāhore he mahara ki ngā whakatupuranga o mua; kāhore hoki e maharatia ngā whakatupuranga e haere mai ā muri nei e te hunga ō muri atu.
Ko ahau, ko te Kaikauwhau, te kīngi o Īharaira i Hiruhārama.

Nā, ka whakaangahia e ahau tōku ngākau ki te whakaaro nui hei rapu, hei kimi i ngā mea katoa e mahia ana i raro i te rangi. Nā te Atua tēnei whakararuraru kino i hōmai ki ngā tama a te tangata hei whakararu i a rātou.
Kua kite ahau i ngā mea katoa e mahia ana i raro i te rā; nanā, he horihori katoa, he whai hoki i te hau.
Ko te mea piko e kore e taea te whakahāngai; ko te mea koha e kore e taea te tatau.

I kōrerorero ahau ki tōku ngākau, i mea, "Nanā, kua whiwhi rawa ahau i te whakaaro nui ki runga ake i ō te hunga katoa i mua atu i ahau i Hiruhārama; āe rā, he maha ngā mea kua kitea e tōku ngākau o te whakaaro nui, o te mātauranga."
Nā, ka whakaangahia e ahau tōku ngākau kia mōhio ki te whakaaro nui, kia mōhio ki te haurangi, ki te wairangi; ā, kua kite ahau he whai anō hoki tēnei i te hau.
Mā te nui hoki o te whakaaro ka nui ai te pōuri, ā, ko te tangata e whakaneke ake ana i te mātauranga e whakaneke ake ana i te mamae.
I mea ahau i roto i tōku ngākau, "Tēnā rā, ka whakamātauria koe e ahau ki te koa; nā, te āhuareka māu." Heoi, he horihori anō hoki tēnei.
Ko te kata, kīia iho e ahau "He haurangi;" ko te koa, "He mahi aha tāna?"

I whai ahau i roto i tōku ngākau me pēhea te whakaahuareka i tōku kikokiko ki te wāina – me te whakahaere anō ia a tōku ngākau i ahau i runga i te whakaaro nui – ā, me pēhea tāku hopu i te wairangi, kia kitea rā anō e ahau he aha rā tēnā mea pai a ngā tama a te tangata e mahia nei i raro i te rangi i ngā rā katoa e ora nei rātou.
I mahia e ahau ētahi mahi nunui māku; i hangā e ahau ētahi whare mōku; i whakatōkia e ahau ētahi māra wāina māku.
I hangā e ahau ētahi kāri māku, me ētahi māra rākau, whakatōkia iho e ahau ki reira ngā tū rākau katoa e whai hua ana.
I hangā e ahau he poka wai māku hei whakamākūkū mai i reira i te ngahere, i te wāhi i whakatupuria ai ngā rākau.
I hokona e ahau he pononga tāne, he pononga wāhine, ā, he pononga anō i whānau ki tōku whare; he tini hoki āku kāhui kau, āku kāhui hipi, maha atu i ā te hunga katoa i mua atu i ahau i Hiruhārama.

I āmenea mai anō e ahau he hiriwa, he kōura, me te taonga i rawe ki ngā kīngi, ki ngā kāwanatanga; i meatia anō e ahau he kaiwaiata, tāne, he kaiwaiata wāhine, me ngā āhuareka anō a ngā tama a te tangata, te tini o te wāhine iti.
Heoi, kua nui ahau, neke noa ake ana āku i ā te hunga katoa i mua ake i ahau i Hiruhārama, me te mau anō hoki tōku whakaaro nui.

Ko ngā mea katoa anō hoki i hiahiatia e ōku kanohi, kīhai i kaiponuhia e ahau i a rāua, kīhai anō i pēhia e ahau tōku ngākau i te meatanga atu ki tētahi whakahari; i hari hoki tōku ngākau i ōku ruhatanga katoa; ā, ko te wāhi tēnei māku o ōku ruhatanga katoa.
Kātahi ahau ka titiro ki ngā mahi katoa i mahia e ōku ringa, ki te ruhatanga hoki i ruha ai ahau i te mahinga; nanā, he horihori katoa, he whai kau i te hau, ā, kāhore he hua pai i raro i te rā.
I anga anō ahau ki te mātakitaki ki te whakaaro nui, ki te haurangi, ki te wairangi; he aha koia te mea e taea e te tangata e haere mai ana i muri i te kīngi? Heoi anō ko te mea kua oti noa ake.
Kātahi ahau ka kite, hira ake te whakaaro nui i te wairangi; he pērā hoki me te mārama e hira ake ana i te pōuri.
Ko te tangata whakaaro nui, kei tōna māhunga ōna kanohi, ā, kei te pōuri te wairangi e haere ana. Otiia, i kite anō ahau kotahi tonu te mea e pā ana ki a rātou katoa.

Kātahi ahau ka kī ake i roto i tōku ngākau, "Ko te mea i pā ki te wairangi ka pā anō ki ahau nei anō hoki; he aha hoki ōku whakaaro i nui ake ai?" Nā, ko tāku kīanga ake i roto i tōku ngākau, "He horihori anō hoki tēnei."

Nō te mea kāhore he maharatanga ki te tangata whakaaro nui, pērā anō i te kore ki te wairangi ā ake ake; inā hoki i ngā rā e haere ake nei kua wareware noa ake ngā mea katoa. Nā, ko tō te tangata whakaaro nui tōna matenga, pērā anō i tō te wairangi!
Nā, kua kino ahau ki te ora; nō te mea he hē ki ahau te mahi e mahia ana i raro i te rā; he horihori katoa hoki, he whai kau i te hau.
I kino anō hoki ahau ki tōku māuiui i māuiui ai ahau i raro i te rā; inā hoki me waiho iho e ahau mā te tangata i muri i ahau.

Ko wai hoki e mōhio ana hei tangata whakaaro nui rānei ia, hei wairangi rānei? Otiia, hei a ia te tikanga mō ōku māuiui katoa i māuiui ai ahau, i nui ai anō hoki ōku whakaaro i raro i te rā. He horihori anō hoki tēnei.
Nā, ka anga ahau, ka mea kia whakaparahako tōku ngākau ki te māuiui katoa i māuiui ai ahau i raro i te rā.

Tēnei hoki tētahi tangata kei runga nei i te whakaaro nui tāna mahi, kei runga i te mātauranga, kei runga i te mōhio; otiia ka waiho e ia hei wāhi mā te tangata kīhai nei i mahi. He horihori anō tēnei, he hē nui.
He aha oti te tukunga iho ki te tangata o tōna māuiui katoa, o te ngana o tōna ngākau i māuiui ai ia i raro i te rā?
He pōuri kau hoki ōna rā katoa, he ngākau mamae tōna raruraru, e kore anō hoki tōna ngākau e okioki i te pō. Nā, he horihori anō hoki tēnei.
Kāhore he mea pai mā te tangata i tua atu i te kai, i te inu, i te mea kia whiwhi tōna wairua i te pai i roto i tōna māuiui. I kite anō hoki ahau i tēnei, nō te ringa o te Atua tēnei.
Ko wai oti e nui atu tāna kai, ko wai e reka ake i ahau?

Ki te tangata hoki e pai ana ki tō te Atua aroaro e hōmai ana e ia he whakaaro nui, he mātauranga, he koa; ki te tangata hara ia e hōmai ana e ia he raruraru, ki te kohikohi, ki te āmene mea mai, hei hoatutanga māna ki te tangata e pai ana ki tō te Atua aroaro. He horihori anō hoki tēnei, he whai i te hau.
He tāima anō kua takoto mō ngā mea katoa, me te wā mō ngā meatanga katoa i raro i te rangi:
he wā e whānau ai, he wā e mate ai; he wā e whakatō ai, he wā e hūtia ai te mea i whakatōkia;
he wā e patu ai, he wā e rongoā ai; he wā e wāwāhi iho ai, he wā e hanga ake ai;
he wā e tangi ai, he wā e kata ai; he wā e auē ai, he wā e kanikani ai;
he wā e ākiritia atu ai ngā kōhatu, he wā e kohikohia ai ngā kōhatu, he wā e awhi ai, he wā e kore ai e awhi;
he wā e rapu ai, he wā e ngaro ai; he wā e tiaki ai, he wā e ākiri atu ai;
he wā e haehae ai, he wā e tuitui ai; he wā e whakarongo puku ai, he wā e kōrero ai;
he wā e aroha ai, he wā e mauāhara ai; he wā e whawhai ai, he wā e mau ai te rongo.
He aha te pai ki te kaimahi i tāna mea i māuiui ai ia?
Kua kite ahau i te raruraru e hōmai ana e te Atua ki ngā tama a te tangata hei whakararu i a rātou.

I hangā e ia ngā mea katoa kia ātaahua i tōna wā anō; ā, i whakanohoia e ia te ao ki ō rātou ngākau, engari kia kaua te tangata e kite i tā te Atua mahi i mahi ai, mai i te tīmatanga ā taea noatia te mutunga.
E mōhio ana ahau kāhore he mea pai atu mō rātou i te ngākau hari, i te mahi i te pai i a rātou e ora ana;
ā, he mea hoki nā te Atua kia kai ngā tāngata katoa, kia inu, kia kite anō hoki i te pai o tō rātou māuiui katoa.

E mōhio ana ahau ko ngā mea katoa e hangā ana e te Atua, ka mau tonu ā ake ake; e kore tētahi mea e honoa mai, e kore anō hoki tētahi wāhi e tangohia atu. I meatia hoki e te Atua kia wehi ai ngā tāngata i tōna aroaro.
Ko tō mua mea koia anō tēnei ināianei; nā, ko te mea e puta mai ā mua kua puta noa ake; e rapua ana anō e te Atua te mea onamata.
Nā, i kitea anō e ahau i raro i te rā, ko te wāhi o te whakawā i reira ia te kino, ā, ko te wāhi o te tika ko te kino i reira.
Ka mea ahau i roto i tōku ngākau, "Tērā e whakawākia e te Atua te tangata tika rāua ko te tangata kino; nō te mea kua takoto te wā i reira mō ngā meatanga katoa, mō ngā mahi katoa."
I mea ahau i roto i tōku ngākau, "Nā te mea mō ngā tama a te tangata, he mea nā te Atua hei whakaatu i a rātou, kia kite ai rātou he pērā noa iho rātou i te kararehe."

Ko te mea hoki e pā ana ki ngā tama a te tangata, e pā ana ki ngā kararehe; kotahi tonu te mea e pā ana ki a rātou; ko te matenga o tētahi rite tonu ki te matenga o tētahi. Āe rā, kotahi tonu anō manawa ō rātou katoa; kīhai hoki te tangata i hipa ake i te kararehe; he horihori hoki te katoa.
E haere ana te katoa ki te wāhi kotahi; nō te puehu nei te katoa, ka hoki anō te katoa ki te puehu.
Ko wai e mātau ana ki te wairua o te tangata, e haere ana rānei ki runga, ki te wairua rānei o te kararehe, mehemea rānei e heke iho ana ki raro ki te whenua?
Nā, ka kite ahau kāhore he pai nui atu i tēnei, arā kia koa te tangata ki āna mahi; ko te wāhi hoki tērā māna; mā wai ia e whakahoki mai, e mea kia kite i ngā mea e puta mai i muri i a ia?

Nā, ka tahuri ahau, ā, ka titiro ki ngā tūkinotanga katoa e mahia nei i raro i te rā. Nā, ko ngā roimata o te hunga i tūkinotia, kāhore hoki ō rātou kaiwhakamārie; ā, he kaha kei te ringa o ō rātou kaitūkino, otiia kāhore ō rātou kaiwhakamārie.
Nā, ko tāku whakamoemiti ki te hunga mate kua mate noa ake, nui atu i tāku ki te hunga ora e ora nei.
Engari ia pai atu i a rāua te tangata kāhore anō i whānau noa, kāhore anō i kite noa i te mahi hē e mahia nei i raro i te rā.
Nā, ka kite ahau i te māuiui katoa, i ngā mahi tohunga katoa, he mea hoki tēnei e hae ai te tangata ki tōna hoa. He horihori anō hoki tēnei, ā, he whai kau i te hau.
Ko te wairangi, kei te kōtui i ōna ringa, ā, kainga ana e ia ōna kikokiko ake.
He pai kē te ringa kī i runga i te āta noho, i ngā ringa kī e rua, ki te mea he ruha, he whai noa i te hau.
Kātahi ahau ka tahuri, ā, ka kite i te horihori i raro i te rā:

he tangata tērā, ko ia anake, kāhore hoki ōna tokorua; āe rā, kāhore anō hoki āna tama, ōna tuākana, tēina rānei; heoi kāhore he mutunga o tāna mahi katoa, e kore anō hoki ōna kanohi e mākona i ngā taonga. Nā, ka mea ia, "Ki a wai tōku whakaaro i ahau ka mahi nei, ka whakatiki nei i tōku wairua ki te pai?" He horihori anō tēnei, he raruraru kino.
Erangi te tokorua i te kotahi; nō te mea ka whiwhi rāua ki te utu pai i tā rāua mahi.
Ki te hinga hoki tētahi, mā tōna hoa ia e whakaara; auē te mate mō te kotahi, ina hinga, ki te kāhore te whakatokorua hei whakaara i a ia!
Ki te takoto tahi anō ngā tokorua, ka mahana rāua; he tangata kotahi ia, mā te aha ka mahana ai tōna kotahi?
Ki te kaha tētahi i a ia kotahi nei, ka māia te tokorua ki a ia. E kore hoki te aho takitoru e motu wawe.
Pai ake te tamaiti rawakore, whakaaro nui i te kīngi kua koroheketia, kua wairangi, kua kore nei ōna mōhio ki te whakarongo ina whakatūpatoria.
I puta mai hoki tērā i roto i te whare herehere, hei kīngi; āe rā, ahakoa i roto i tōna whenua i kīngi ai, i whānau rawakore mai ia.
I kite ahau i te hunga ora katoa e haere nei i raro i te rā, kei te tama rātou, kei te tuarua, kua tū nei i te tūnga o tērā.
Kāhore he mutunga o te iwi katoa, arā o te hunga ko ia nei tō rātou ariki; nā, e kore ō muri iho i a ia e koa ki a ia. He pono, he horihori anō hoki tēnei, ā, he whai kau i te hau.
Tiakina tōu waewae ina haere koe ki te whare o te Atua; he pai kē te whakatata ki te whakarongo i te hoatu i te patunga tapu a ngā wairangi; kāhore hoki rātou e mōhio he mahi kino tā rātou.
Kei pōrahurahu tōu māngai, kei hohoro hoki te puaki o tētahi kupu a tōu ngākau i te aroaro o te Atua; nō te mea kei te rangi te Atua, ā, ko koe kei runga i te whenua; mō reira kia torutoru āu kupu.
Ka puta mai hoki te rekanga kanohi ina nui te raruraru; me te reo o te wairangi ki te maha o ngā kupu.
Ki te kīia taurangitia e koe tētahi mea mā te Atua, kei whakaroa koe ki te whakamana. E kore hoki ia e pai ki ngā wairangi; whakamanā e koe tāu i kī taurangi ai.
He pai kē ki te kore āu kī taurangi, i te puta i a koe o te kupu taurangi, ā, kāhore i whakamana e koe.
Kei tukua e koe tōu māngai kia mea hara mō ōu kikokiko; kaua hoki e kī ki te aroaro o te anahera, "He pōhēhē." Kia riri te Atua ki tōu reo hei aha, ā, hē iho i a ia te mahi a ōu ringa?
Nā konei tēnei mea, nā te maha o ngā rekanga kanohi, o ngā horihori, o ngā kōrero maha; ko koe ia kia wehi i te Atua.

Ki te kite koe i te rawakore e tūkinotia ana, ā, e kāhakina kētia ana te whakawā rāua ko te tika i te kāwanatanga, kaua e mīharo ki taua mea; nō te mea e maharatia ana e tētahi, he tiketike ake nei i te mea tiketike; tēnei anō hoki tētahi e tiketike ake ana i a rātou.
Mā te katoa anō hoki ngā hua o te whenua; ā, ko te kīngi hoki, nā, e mahia ana e te māra he mea māna.
Ko te tangata e aroha ana ki te hiriwa e kore e mākona i te hiriwa; ā, e kore hoki te tangata e whai ana ki ngā mea maha, ki ngā hua. He horihori anō tēnei.
Ki te maha ngā rawa, ka tokomaha anō ngā tāngata hei kai; he aha hoki te pai ki te tangata nāna aua mea? Ko te mātakitaki kau atu a ōna kanohi.
Ka reka tonu te moe a te tangata mahi, ahakoa iti tāna kai, nui rānei; ko te tangata taonga ia, e kore e tukua e āna mea maha kia moe.
Tērā tētahi he ngau kino i kitea e ahau i raro i te rā, arā, he taonga e puritia ana e te tangata nāna, hei whakamamae anō i a ia;
ā, ka pau aua taonga i te raruraru kino. Nā, ka whānau he tama māna, kāhore he mea i tōna ringa.
Ka rite ki tōna haerenga mai i te kōpū o tōna whaea, ka hoki tahanga atu anō ia, ka pērā i tōna haerenga mai, e kore anō e riro i a ia tētahi wāhi mō tāna mahi hei maunga atu mā tōna ringa.
Ā, he hē ngau kino anō hoki tēnei: arā ko tōna haerenga atu ka rite i ngā mea katoa ki tōna haerenga mai; he aha oti te pai ki a ia? Ko tāna i mahi ai mā te hau.
Ā, i ōna rā katoa ka kai ia i roto i te pōuri, ka pororaru tōna ngākau ka pāngia e te mate, ka pukuriri.

Nanā, ko tāku i kite ai, he mea pai, he mea ātaahua, kia kai te tangata, kia inu, kia kite hoki i te pai o tōna māuiui katoa i māuiui ai ia i raro i te rā i ngā rā katoa e ora ai ia, e hōmai nei e te Atua ki a ia; nāna hoki tēnā wāhi.

Ko ngā tāngata katoa hoki i hōmai ai e te Atua he taonga, he rawa, i tukua mai ai ki a rātou te tikanga mō te kai i tētahi wāhi o aua mea, mō te tango i te wāhi mā rātou, ā, kia koa rātou i tō rātou māuiui – he mea hōmai tēnei nā te Atua.
E kore hoki e nui tōna mahara ki ngā rā i ora ai ia; nō te mea he koa mō tōna ngākau tā te Atua i whakahoki ai ki a ia.
Tērā tētahi hē i kitea e ahau i raro i te rā, he mea taimaha anō ki runga ki ngā tāngata.

He tangata i hōmai nei e te Atua ki a ia he taonga, he rawa, he korōria, ā, kīhai tōna wairua i hapa ki tētahi mea i hiahia ai ia, otiia kīhai i tukua e te Atua ki a ia te tikanga mō te kai i tētahi wāhi o aua mea, engari kainga ana e te tangata kē. He horihori tēnei, he mate kino.

Ki te kotahi rau ngā tamariki a tētahi tangata, ā, he maha ngā tau e ora ai ia, maha atu ngā rā o ōna tau, ā, kāhore tōna wairua i ngata i te pai, kāhore hoki ia e whai tanumanga; e mea ana ahau tērā noa atu te pai o te materoto i a ia.
I haere mai hoki tērā i runga i te horihori, ā, haere atu ana i runga i te pōuri, ā, ka taupokina tōna ingoa e te pōuri.
Kīhai hoki ia i kite i te rā, kīhai anō i mōhio ki a ia; nui atu tō tēnei okioki i tō tērā.
Āe, ahakoa kotahi mano tōpū ngā tau i ora ai ia, heoi kāhore he pai i kitea e ia. He teka ianei e haere ana te katoa ki te wāhi kotahi?
Ko ngā mea katoa i māuiui ai te tangata, hei mea anō mō tōna māngai, otiia e kore tōna wairua e mākona.
He aha oti tā te tangata whakaaro nui e hira ake ana i tā te wairangi? He aha hoki tā te ware, e mōhio nei ki te haere i te aroaro o te hunga ora?
He pai kē te kite o ngā kanohi i te kaipaowe o te hiahia; he horihori anō tēnei, ā, he whai i te hau.
Ko ngā mea katoa ō mua kua oti noa ake te hua ki te ingoa, ā, e mōhiotia ana ko te tangata; e kore hoki ia e tau hei totohe ki te mea e kaha atu ana i a ia.
Ka maha nei ngā mea hei whakanui i te horihori, he aha te painga ki te tangata?

Ko wai hoki e mōhio ana he aha te mea pai ki te tangata i a ia nei i te ora, i ngā rā katoa o tōna oranga horihori, e rite nei ki te ātārangi i a ia e mahi nei? Ko wai hoki hei whakaatu ki te tangata ko te aha e puta mai i muri i a ia i raro i te rā?
Ko te ingoa pai, pai atu i te hinu utu nui; ko te rā o te matenga, pai atu i te rā o tō te tangata whānautanga.
Ko te haere ki te whare tangihanga, pai atu i te haere ki te whare hākari; ko te mutunga hoki ia o ngā tāngata katoa; ā, ka rongoātia e te tangata ora ki roto ki tōna ngākau.
Ko te ngākau mamae, pai atu i te kata; mā te pōuri hoki o te mata ka pai ai te ngākau.
Kei te whare tangihanga te ngākau o te hunga whakaaro nui; kei te whare ia o te kata te ngākau o ngā wairangi.
Ko te whakarongo, ina rīria te hē e te tangata whakaaro nui, pai atu i tā te tangata whakarongo ki te waiata a ngā wairangi.
Rite tonu hoki ki te papātanga o ngā tātarāmoa i raro i te kōhua te kata a te wairangi. He horihori anō tēnei.
He pono mā te pāhua ka wairangi ai te tangata whakaaro nui, mā te mea hōmai noa hoki ka kore ai te ngākau mahara.
Ko te mutunga o te mea, pai atu i tōna tīmatanga; pai atu te wairua manawanui i te wairua whakakake.
Kei hohoro tōu wairua ki te riri; kei te uma hoki o ngā wairangi te riri e noho ana.
Kaua e mea, "He aha ngā rangi ō mua i pai ake ai i ēnei?" Kāhore hoki he whakaaro nui ōu i ui ai koe ki tēnā.
He pai tonu te whakaaro nui, ānō he taonga tuku iho; āe rā, he pai rawa ake ki te hunga e kite ana i te rā.
Hei whakamarumaru iho te whakaaro nui, hei pērā hoki i te moni te whakamarumaru; ko te pai ia o te mātauranga koia tēnei, ka ora i te whakaaro nui ngā tāngata nāna.
Whakaaroa tā te Atua mahi; ko wai hoki hei mea kia tika tāna i mea ai kia hape?
I te rā pai kia koa, ā, i te rā kino whakaaro; kua mahia nei hoki e te Atua tētahi kia takoto tahi me tētahi, he mea kia kaua ai e kitea e te tangata tētahi mea i muri i a ia.
Kua kite ahau i tēnei katoa i ngā rā ōku i te horihori; he tangata tika tētahi, ngaro iho ia i runga i tōna tika; he tangata kino tētahi, roa noa iho ia i te ao i runga i tōna kino.
Kaua e whakanuia rawatia tōu tika; kaua hoki e whakanuia rawatia ōu whakaaro; he aha koe i whakangaro ai i a koe?
Kaua e whakanuia rawatia tōu kino, kaua anō hoki e wairangi; kia mate koe hei aha, i te mea kāhore anō tōu wā kia rite noa?
He pai ki te puritia tēnei kupu e koe; kaua hoki tōu ringa e unuhia mai i tērā; ko te tangata hoki e wehi ana i te Atua ka puta mai i roto i ērā katoa.
Ko te whakaaro nui rahi ake tōna kaha mō te tangata whakaaro i tō ngā rangatira kotahi tekau i roto i te pā.
Kāhore hoki he tangata tika i te whenua e mahi ana i te pai, ā, kāhore ōna hara.
Kaua anō e whakarongo ki ngā mea katoa e kōrerotia ana; kei rongo koe ki tāu pononga e kanga ana i a koe;
he maha hoki ngā wā, e mōhio ana tōu ngākau, i kanga ai koe anō i ētahi.
I whakamātauria e ahau tēnei katoa, he mea whakaaro mārie; i mea ahau, "Ka whakaaro nui ahau," otiia i matara noa atu tēnei i ahau.
Ko te mea onāianei he tawhiti rawa, he hōhonu rawa hoki; ko wai hei kite?
I anga tōku ngākau, i mea kia mōhio, kia kimihia, kia rapua ngā whakaaro nui me ngā tikanga, kia mōhio anō hoki he wairangi te kino, he pōrangi te wairangi.

Ā, ka kite ahau i te mea kawa atu i te mate, arā i te wahine, he rore nei, he kupenga tōna ngākau, he rāhiri hoki ōna ringa. Ko te tangata e paingia ana e te Atua ka mawhiti i a ia; ko te tangata hara ia ka mau i a ia.
"Nanā, kua kitea tēnei e ahau," e ai tā te Kaikauwhau, "he mea whakarite tētahi mea ki tētahi, kia kitea ai te tikanga.
He mea e rapua nei anō e tōku wairua, ā, kāhore anō i kitea; kotahi te tangata i kitea e ahau i roto i te mano. Nā, i roto i ēnei katoa kāhore ahau i kite i tētahi wahine.
Nanā, ko tēnei anake i kitea e ahau, arā i tika te tangata i tā te Atua hanganga; engari he maha ngā tikanga i rapua e rātou."

Ko wai hei rite mō te tangata whakaaro nui? Ko wai hoki e mōhio ana ki te tikanga o tētahi mea? Ka ai te whakaaro nui o te tangata hei mea kia tīaho tōna mata, ka puta kē anō hoki te taikaha o tōna mata.
Ko tāku tēnei ki a koe, Puritia te kupu a te kīngi, me whakaaro anō hoki ki tā te Atua oati.
Kei mea wawe koe ki te haere atu i tōna aroaro. Kaua anō hoki e tohe tonu ki te mea kino; ka oti hoki i a ia ngā mea katoa e pai ai ia.
Nō te mea he mana tō te kupu a te kīngi, ā, ko wai hei mea atu ki a ia, "E aha ana koe?"
Ko te kaipupuri o te whakahau, e kore rawa e mōhio ki te mea hē. E mōhio ana te ngākau o te whakaaro nui ki te wā, ki te tikanga.
He wā hoki tō ngā meatanga katoa, he tikanga anō; he nui hoki nō te hē o te tangata i runga i a ia.
Kāhore hoki ia e mōhio, ko te aha e puta ā mua, mā wai hoki e whakaatu ki a ia te pēheatanga o te putanga?

Kāhore he tangata e whai mana ana ki te wairua, ki te pupuri i te wairua; kāhore hoki he mana ki te rā o te mate. I taua pakanga hoki e kore tētahi e tukua atu; e kore anō te kino e whakaora i te mea e tukua atu ki a ia.
I kite ahau i tēnei katoa, i anga anō tōku ngākau ki ngā meatanga katoa e meatia ana i raro i te rā; he wā anō ka whai mana tētahi tangata ki tētahi tangata hei hē mōna.

I kite anō ahau i reira i te hunga kino e tanumia ana, ā, i haere mai rātou ki te wāhi o te tanumanga; ā, ko te hunga i mahi i te tika i haere atu i te wāhi o te tapu, ā, warewaretia ana rātou e te pā; he horihori anō hoki tēnei.
He kore i hohoro te whakaoti i te kupu whiu mō te mahi hē, koia i kī tonu ai ngā ngākau o ngā tama a te tangata i roto i a rātou ki te tohe ki te mahi i te kino.
Ahakoa he rau ngā mahi hē a te tangata hara, ā, ka roa ōna rā; heoi e mōhio ana anō ahau, ka pai te tukunga iho ki te hunga e wehi ana i te Atua, e wehi nei i tōna aroaro.
E kore ia e pai te tukunga iho ki te tangata kino, e kore anō e whakaroaina e ia ōna rā, he ātārangi nei te rite; mōna kīhai i wehi i te aroaro o te Atua.

He horihori tēnei e mahia nei i runga i te whenua; arā he hunga tika ēnei, ā, ko te mea e pā ana ki a rātou pērā tonu i te mea e pā ana ki te mahi a te hunga kino; ā, he hunga kino ēnei, ā, ko te mea e pā ana ki a rātou pērā tonu i te mea e pā ana ki te mahi a te hunga tika; i kī ahau he horihori anō hoki tēnei.

Kātahi ahau ka whakamoemiti ki te koa; nō te mea kāhore he mea pai ake mā te tangata i raro i te rā, ko te kai anake, ko te inu, ko te harakoa. Ko tērā hoki e mau ki a ia i roto i tōna māuiui i ngā rā o tōna oranga, i hōmai nei e te Atua ki a ia i raro i te rā.
I tāku tukunga i tōku ngākau kia mōhio ki te whakaaro nui, kia kite i te raruraru e mahia nei i runga i te whenua; i te ao nei hoki, i te pō kāhore ōna kanohi e kite i te moe.

Kātahi ahau ka kite i te mahi a te Atua, arā, e kore e kitea e te tangata te mahi e mahia ana i raro i te rā; ahakoa māuiui noa te tangata i te rapunga, e kore e kitea e ia. Āe rā, ahakoa mea noa te tangata whakaaro nui kia mōhiotia e ia, e kore e taea kia kitea e ia.

Nā, ko tēnei katoa he mea whakaaro nā tōku ngākau, arā kia āta tirotirohia tēnei katoa; ko te hunga tika, ko te hunga whakaaro nui, me ā rātou mahi, kei roto i te ringa o te Atua. E kore te tangata e mōhio he aroha rānei, he kino rānei; kei tō rātou aroaro ngā mea katoa.

He rite tonu te pānga mai o ngā mea katoa ki ngā tāngata katoa; kotahi tonu te mea e pā ana ki te tangata tika, ki te tangata kino; ki te pai, ki te mā, ki te poke; ki te tangata i te patunga tapu, ki te tangata kāhore nei āna patunga tapu. Ko te tangata pai rite tonu ki te tangata hara, ko te tangata e oati ana, ki te tangata e wehi ana i te oati.

He hē tēnei i roto i ngā mea katoa e meatia ana i raro i te rā, kotahi tonu te mea e pā ana ki te katoa. Ko te ngākau anō hoki o ngā tama a te tangata kī tonu i te kino; kei roto hoki te haurangi i ō rātou ngākau i a rātou e ora ana; ā muri iho ka riro rātou ki ngā tūpāpaku.
Ko te tangata hoki e tūhono ana ki te hunga ora katoa ka whai tūmanakohanga; pai atu hoki te kurī ora i te raiona mate.
E mōhio ana hoki te hunga ora tērā rātou e mate; ko ngā tūpāpaku ia, kāhore ō rātou mōhio ki tētahi mea, kāhore ake hoki he utu i a rātou; ka warewaretia hoki te mahara ki a rātou.
Ko tō rātou aroha hoki, ko tō rātou riri, ko tō rātou hae, kua kore noa ake; kāhore hoki he wāhi i a rātou ā ake ake, o ngā mea katoa e meatia ana i raro i te rā.
Haere, kainga tāu kai i runga i te hari, inumia hoki tāu wāina i runga i te ngākau hari; nō te mea kua manako noa kē te Atua ki āu mahi.
I ngā wā katoa kia mā ōu kākahu; kaua hoki e whakakāhoretia te hinu mō tōu māhunga.

Kia ora tōu ngākau i tōu hoa wahine e aroha nā koe i ngā rā katoa o tōu oranga horihori, i hōmai nei ki a koe i raro i te rā, i ngā rā katoa o tōu horihori. Ko te wāhi hoki tēnā mōu i tēnei ao, i tōu māuiui anō hoki e māuiui nā koe i raro i te rā.

Ko ngā mea katoa e kitea e tōu ringa kia mahia, kia puta tōu uaua ki te mahi; kāhore hoki he mahi, kāhore he tikanga, kāhore he mātauranga, kāhore he whakaaro nui i te rēinga, i te wāhi ka haere atu nā koe ki reira.

I hoki ahau, ā, i kite ahau i raro i te rā, ehara i te mea ko te hunga tere e puta i te oma, ko te hunga mārohirohi rānei e toa i te pakanga, ko te hunga whakaaro nui rānei e whiwhi i te taro, ko te hunga mōhio rānei e whiwhi i te taonga, ko te hunga tohunga rānei e manakohia, engari nā te wā, nā te tūpono noa, i hōmai ki a rātou katoa.

Kāhore hoki te tangata e mōhio ki te wā mōna; he rite ki ngā ika e haoa ana ki te kupenga nanakia, ki ngā manu hoki e mau ana i te māhanga, he pērā anō hoki ngā tama a te tangata, e māhangatia ana i te wā whakarihariha, ina puta whakarere mai ki a rātou.
I kitea anō e ahau te whakaaro nui pēnei i raro i te rā, ā, he mea nui ki ahau.
Tērā tētahi pā iti, me ōna tāngata torutoru i roto. Nā, ka haere mai tētahi kīngi nui ki te tū i reira, whakapaea ana e ia, hangā ana e ia ētahi pourewa nunui hei tatau atu ki reira.
Nā, i kitea tētahi tangata rawakore, whakaaro nui, i roto, ā, nāna, nā tōna whakaaro nui, ka ora te pā. Otiia, kīhai tētahi tangata i mahara ki taua tangata rawakore.
Nā, ko tāku kīanga ake, "Engari rawa te whakaaro nui i te kaha; heoi whakahāweatia iho ngā whakaaro nui o te rawakore, kīhai hoki āna kupu i whakarangona."
Ko ngā kupu a te hunga whakaaro nui, he mea āta kōrero, e rangona nuitia ake ana i te hāmama a te rangatira o ngā wairangi.
Pai ake te whakaaro nui i ngā rākau o te riri; otiia kotahi noa te tangata hara, he nui tāna pai e takakino ai.
Mā ngā ngaro mate ka piro whakahouhou ai te hinu a te kaiwhakananu; ka pērā anō te whakaaro nui me te ingoa nui, he iti noa te wairangi māna e tāmi.
Kei tōna ringa matau te ngākau o te tangata whakaaro nui; kei tōna mauī ia te ngākau o te wairangi.
Āe rā hoki, ka haere te wairangi i te ara, ka taka ōna mahara, ā, ka kōrero ia ki ngā tāngata katoa he wairangi ia.
Ki te ara te wairua o te rangatira, he riri ki a koe, kaua tōu wāhi e whakarērea; ka ai hoki te whakangāwari hei whakamārie mō ngā hara nui.
Tēnei tētahi kino i kitea e ahau i raro i te rā, e rite tonu ana ki te hē i puta mai i te rangatira:
ko te wairangi e whakanohoia ana ki runga ki ngā wāhi tiketike rawa, ā, ko ngā tāngata taonga e noho ana i te wāhi i raro.
I kite ahau i ngā kaimahi i runga i te hōiho, ā, ko ngā rangatira e haere ana, ānō he kaimahi, i runga i te whenua.
Ko te tangata e keri ana i te rua, ka taka anō ki roto; ko te tangata e wāhi ana i te taiepa, ka ngaua e te nākahi.
Ko te tangata e tārai ana i ngā kōhatu, ka mamae anō i reira; ko te tangata e tata ana i te rākau, ka ora noa anō i reira.
Ki te pūhuki te rino, ā, kāhore e whakakoia te mata, kia nui ake anō tōna kaha; he pai ia ngā whakaaro nui hei whakatikatika.
Ki te ngau te nākahi i te mea kīanō i whakawaia, kāhore hoki he painga o te kaiwhakawai.
He ātaahua ngā kupu a te māngai o te tangata whakaaro nui; tēnā ko te wairangi ka horomia a ia anō e ōna ngutu.
Ko te tīmatanga o ngā kupu a tōna māngai he wairangi; ko te mutunga o tāna kōrero, he haurangi, he hē.
He maha anō hoki ngā kupu a te wairangi; engari e kore te tangata e mōhio ko te aha e puta mai. Nā, ko ngā mea e puta mai i muri i a ia, mā wai rā e whakaatu ki a ia?
Hōhā iho ngā wairangi i tāna mahi, i tāna mahi; e kore nei hoki ia e mātau ki te haere ki te pā.
Auē te mate mōu, e te whenua he tamaiti nei tōu kīngi, ā, e kai ana ōu rangatira i te ata!
Ka hari koe, e te whenua, he tamaiti nei nō ngā rangatira tōu kīngi, ā, e kai ana ōu rangatira i te wā e tika ai – hei mea whakakaha, ehara i te mea hei whakahaurangi.
Mā te māngere ka totohu iho ai te tuanui o te whare; mā te ngoikore anō o ngā ringa ka tūturu ai te whare.
Hei mea mō te kata te hākari i tukua ai, he mea whakahari anō te wāina; ā, mā te hiriwa ka rite ai ngā mea katoa.

Kaua e kangā te kīngi, kaua rawa i roto i tōu whakaaro; kaua hoki e kangā te tangata taonga i roto i tōu whare moenga; nō te mea ka kawea te reo e tētahi manu o te rangi, ka kōrerotia hoki taua mea e tētahi mea whai parirau.
Makā tāu taro ki te mata o ngā wai; kia maha hoki ngā rā ka kitea anō e koe.
Hoatu tētahi wāhi mā te tokowhitu, āe mā te tokowaru anō hoki; e kore hoki koe e mōhio ko tēhea kino e puta mai ki te whenua.
Ki te kī ngā kapua i te ua, ka ringihia ki te whenua. Ki te hinga hoki te rākau ki te tonga, ki te raki rānei, ko te wāhi e hinga ai te rākau, ko reira anō ia takoto ai.
Ko te tangata e whai mahara ana ki te hau, e kore e rui; ko te tangata titiro kapua e kore e kokoti.
Nā, ka kore anō koe e mōhio ki te huarahi o te hau, ki te tupu rānei o ngā wheua i roto i te kōpū o te wahine hapū; e kore anō hoki e mōhiotia e koe te mahi a te Atua, a te kaimahi o ngā mea katoa.
I te ata ruia tāu purapura, ā, i te ahiahi kaua e pēpeke tōu ringa; kāhore hoki koe e mōhio ko tēnei rānei e tika, ko tērā rānei, ko rāua rānei e rua ka pai ngātahi.
He pono he āhuareka te mārama, ā, he mea pai ki ngā kanohi te titiro ki te rā.
Āe rā, ki te maha ngā tau e ora ai te tangata, kia hari ia ki aua tau katoa; engari kia mahara ia ki ngā tau o te pōuri, tērā hoki e maha. Ko ngā mea e haere ake ana he horihori katoa.

Kia koa, e te taitamariki, ki tōu taitamarikitanga; kia whakahari anō hoki tōu ngākau i a koe i ngā rā o tōu taitamarikitanga. Haere hoki i ngā ara o tōu ngākau, i te tirohanga anō a ōu kanohi; otiia kia mōhio anō koe, he mea ēnei katoa e riro ai koe i te Atua ki te whakawā.
Nō reira whakawāteatia atu te riri i tōu ngākau, ā, whakanekehia atu te kino i tōu kikokiko; he mea horihori nei hoki te taitamarikitanga, me te houkuratanga.
Kia mahara rā ki tōu Kaihanga i ngā rā o tōu tamarikitanga, i te mea kāhore anō kia tae noa mai ngā rā o te kino, ā, kāhore anō kia tata mai ngā tau e kī ai koe, "Kāhore ōku āhuareka ki ēnei tau";
i te mea kāhore anō kia pōuri noa te rā, te mārama, te marama, me ngā whetū, ā, kāhore anō kia hoki mai ngā kapua i muri i te ua;

i te rā e wiri ai ngā kaitiaki o te whare, ā, ka piko iho ngā tāngata mārohirohi, ka mutu anō hoki tā ngā kaihuri, nō te mea he torutoru rātou, ka pōuri anō hoki ngā mea e titiro mai nei i ngā matapihi.
Ā, ka tūtakina ngā tatau i te huarahi; ā, ka iti te haruru o te huri, ā, ka ara ake tētahi i te tangi o te manu, ka whakahokia iho hoki ki raro ngā kōtiro katoa o te waiata.

Āe rā, ka wehi rātou i te mea tiketike, kei te huarahi hoki ngā mea whakamataku; ā, ka puāwai te aramona, ka taimaha anō hoki te māwhitiwhiti, ka iti haere te hiahia. Ka haere nei hoki te tangata ki tōna whare tūturu, ā, ka hāereere ngā kaitangi i ngā huarahi.
I te mea kāhore anō kia mawheto noa te aho hiriwa, kia pakaru noa rānei te oko kōura, kia pakaru rānei te hāka ki te puna, kia pakaru te wīra ki te poka wai,
ā, ka hoki te puehu ki te whenua, ki tōna āhua ō mua, ā, ka hoki te wairua ki te Atua nāna nei i hōmai.
"He horihori, he tino horihori," e ai tā te Kaikauwhau; "he horihori te katoa."
Nā, nō te mea he tangata whakaaro nui te Kaikauwhau, koia i whakaakona tonutia ai e ia te iwi ki te mātauranga; āe rā, i whakaaroaro ia, i rapu, ā, i āta whakatakotoria e ia ngā whakatauki maha.
I whai te Kaikauwhau kia kitea ngā kupu huatau; he mea tika anō te mea i tuhituhia, he kupu pono.
Ko ngā kupu a te hunga whakaaro nui koia anō kei ngā werowero, ā, ko ngā kupu a ngā kaihuihui o ngā whakaminenga kei ngā whao i titia kia mau, he mea i hōmai e te hēpara kotahi.
Ā, kia ai ēnei hei whakatūpato i a koe, e tāku tama. Ko te tuhi i ngā pukapuka maha kāhore he mutunga; ki te nui hoki te ako ka māuiui te kikokiko.
Ko te whakamutunga tēnei o te mea katoa; kua rangona katoatia. E wehi ki te Atua, puritia āna whakahau; ko ngā mea katoa hoki ēnei hei mahi mā te tangata.
Nō te mea ka whakawākia ngā mahi katoa e te Atua, te mea huna anō hoki, ahakoa pai, ahakoa kino.
Ko te waiata o ngā waiata, ko tā Horomona. Te Wahine
Kia kihia ahau e ia ki ngā kihi a tōna māngai! He pai atu hoki tōu aroha i te wāina.
He kakara pai tō ōu hinu; ko tōu ingoa ānō he hinu kua oti te riringi; nā reira i aroha ai ngā wāhina ki a koe.

Kūmea ahau; ka rere atu mātou, ka whai i a koe; kua oti ahau te kawe e te kīngi ki ōna rūma. Ngā Hoa Ka koa mātou, ka hari ki a koe; engari tōu aroha i te wāina hei maharatanga atu mā mātou. E tika ana tō rātou aroha ki a koe! Te Wahine
He mangu ahau, otiia he ātaahua anō, e ngā tamāhine o Hiruhārama, rite tonu anō ki ngā tēneti o Kerara, ki ngā kākahu tauārai o Horomona.

Kaua e titiro mai ki ahau, nō te mea he parauri ahau, nō te mea kua tahuna ahau e te rā. I riri ngā tama a tōku whaea ki ahau, meinga ana ahau e rātou hei kaitiaki mō ngā māra wāina; ko tāku māra ia, ko tāku ake, kīhai i tiakina e ahau.

Whakaaturia mai ki ahau, e tā tōku wairua e aroha nei, ko hea koe whāngai ai, ko hea koe mea ai i tāu kāhui kia takoto i te poutūmārōtanga. Kia rite ahau hei aha ki te māhunga taupoki i te taha o ngā kāhui a ōu hoa? Ngā Hoa
Ki te kore koe e mōhio, e te mea ātaahua rawa o ngā wāhine, haere atu i runga i ngā takahanga o ngā hipi, ka whāngai i āu kūao koati i te taha o ngā nohoanga o ngā hēpara. Te Tāne
Kua whakaritea koe e ahau, e tāku e aroha nei, ki tētahi o ngā hōiho o ngā hāriata o Parao.
He ātaahua ōu pāpāringa i ngā whiri o ngā makawe, tōu kakī i ngā tautau o ngā mea whakapaipai.
Ka hangā e mātou ētahi mekameka kōura mōu, he mea tia ki te hiriwa. Te Wahine
I te kīngi e noho ana i tōna tēpu, ka puta te kakara o tōku nara.
Ko te rite ki ahau o tāku e aroha nei kei te paihere maira, e takoto nei i waenganui i ōku ū.
He tautau hena ki ahau tāku e aroha nei, i ngā māra wāina o Enekeri. Te Tāne
Nanā, he ātaahua koe, e tāku e aroha nei; nanā, he purotu koe; ko ōu kanohi kei te kūkupa. Te Wahine
Nanā, he ātaahua koe, e tāku kaingākau, āe rā, he āhuareka. Matomato tonu anō hoki tō tāua moenga;
he hīta ngā kurupae o tō tāua whare, he kauri ngā heke.
He puāwai ahau nō Harono, he rengarenga nō ngā awaawa. Te Tāne
He rengarenga i roto i ngā tātarāmoa, ko tāku e aroha nei i waenga i ngā tamāhine. Te Wahine
Kei te āporo i roto i ngā rākau o te ngahere te rite o tāku kaingākau i roto i ngā taitamariki. Āhuareka ana tāku noho iho i raro i tōna taumarumarutanga, ā, he reka āna hua ki tōku ngao.
I kawea ahau e ia ki te whare hākari, ā, ko tōna kara i runga i ahau he aroha.
Whakakahangia ake ahau ki te karepe whakamaroke, whakahauorangia ahau ki te āporo; e mate ana hoki ahau i te aroha.
Kei raro i tōku māhunga tōna mauī, e awhi ana tōna matau i ahau.

He kī tēnei nāku ki a koutou, e ngā tamāhine o Hiruhārama, i te aroaro anō o ngā anaterope, o ngā hāta o te pārae: kaua e whakaohokia, kaua e whakaarahia tāku e aroha nei, ā kia pai rā anō ia. Te Wahine
Ko te reo rā o tāku e aroha nei! Nanā, te haere mai nei ia, e tūpekepeke ana i runga i ngā maunga, e mokowhiti ana i runga i ngā pukepuke.

Rite tonu tāku e aroha nei ki te anaterope, ki te kūao hāta rānei. Tēnei ia te tū mai nei i muri o tō mātou taiepa, e mātakitaki mai ana i ngā matapihi, e whakaata mai ana rā roto i te mea rīpekapeka.
I kōrero mai tāku e aroha nei, i mea mai ki ahau: "E ara, e tāku ipo, e tāku mea ātaahua, ka haere mai.
Nanā, kua pahemo te hōtoke, kua mutu te ua, kua kore.
Kua puta ngā puāwai ki te whenua; kua tata te wā e korihi ai ngā manu, ā, e rangona ana te reo o te kūkupa ki tō tātou whenua.
