Ā, ka ui rātou ki a ia, ka mea, "E te Kaiwhakaako, e mōhio ana mātou he tika tāu e kōrero nei, e whakaako nei, e kore anō e manakohia e koe te kanohi tangata, engari e whakaako pono ana koe i te huarahi o te Atua.
He mea tika rānei te hoatu takoha e mātou ki a Hīhā, kāhore rānei?"
Otirā, i kitea e ia tō rātou hīanga, ā, ka mea ki a rātou, "He aha koutou ka whakamātautau nei i ahau?
Kia kite ahau i tētahi pene. Nō wai tōna āhua me te tuhituhinga?" Nā, ka whakahoki rātou, ka mea, "Nō Hīhā."
Kātahi ia ka mea ki a rātou, "Hoatu rāpea ki a Hīhā ngā mea a Hīhā, ki te Atua anō ngā mea a te Atua."
Heoi, kīhai i taea e rātou te hopu i tētahi kōrero āna i te aroaro o te iwi; nā, ka mīharo rātou ki tāna kupu, ā, whakarongo kau ana.
Nā, ka tae mai ētahi o ngā Haruki e mea nei kāhore he aranga; ka ui ki a ia,

ka mea, "E te Kaiwhakaako, i tuhituhi a Mohi ki a mātou: ‘Ki te mate te tuakana o tētahi tangata, he wahine anō tāna, ā, ka mate urikore ia, me tango te wahine e tōna teina, ka whakatupu uri ai mō tōna tuakana.’
Nā, tokowhitu taua whānau; ka tango tō mua i te wahine, ā, mate urikore āna.
Nā, ka tango te tuarua i te wahine, ā, ka mate urikore anō ia.
Nā, ka tango te tuatoru i a ia; pēnei anō ngā tokowhitu, kāhore ā rātou tamariki i waiho ai, ā, mate iho rātou.
Nā, muri iho i te katoa ka mate hoki te wahine.
Nā, i te aranga, mā wai o rātou te wahine? He wahine hoki ia nā te tokowhitu."
Ka whakahoki a Īhu, ka mea ki a rātou, "E mārena ana, e hoatu ana ki te mārena, ngā tamariki o tēnei ao.
Tēnā, ko te hunga e paingia ana kia whiwhi ki tērā ao, ki te aranga anō i roto i te hunga mate, e kore e mārena, e kore anō e hoatu ki te mārena.
E kore anō rātou e āhei kia mate. E rite ana hoki ki ngā anahera, he tama hoki rātou nā te Atua, he tama nā te aranga.
Nā, ko te aranga o te hunga mate, kua whakakitea mai tēnā e Mohi i tāna mō te Rākau, i karangatia ai te Ariki ‘Ko te Atua o Āperahama, ko te Atua o Īhaka, ko te Atua o Hākopa.’
Nā, ehara ia i te Atua nō te hunga mate, engari nō te hunga ora, e ora katoa ana hoki i roto i a ia."
Nā, ka whakahoki ētahi o ngā karaipi ka mea, "E te Kaiwhakaako, he pai tāu kōrero."
Kīhai hoki rātou i māia ki te ui anō ki a ia i tētahi mea.
Nā, ka mea ia ki a rātou, "Nā te aha rātou i mea ai he tama nā Rāwiri a te Karaiti?
Kua mea nei a Rāwiri i te pukapuka o Ngā Waiata: ‘I mea te Ariki ki tōku Ariki, "Hei tōku matau koe noho ai,
kia meinga rā anō e ahau ōu hoariri hei tūranga waewae mōu." ’
Nā, ka kīia ia e Rāwiri he Ariki, ā, he pēhea i tama ai ki a ia?"
Ā, i te iwi katoa e whakarongo ana, ka mea ia ki āna ākonga,

"Kia tūpato ki ngā karaipi, ko tā rātou nei e rawe ai ko ngā kākahu roroa ina hāereere rātou, e matenui ana ki ngā ohatanga i ngā kāinga hokohoko, me ngā nohoanga rangatira i ngā whare karakia me ngā nohoanga rangatira i ngā hākari.
Pau ake hoki i a rātou ngā whare o ngā pouaru, e īnoi roa ana hoki, he āhua kau. Nui rawa te hē e tau ki a rātou!"
Nā, ka titiro ake ia, ka kite i te hunga taonga, e maka ana i ā rātou moni hoatu noa ki te takotoranga moni.
Ā, ka kite ia i tētahi pouaru rawakore, e maka ana i ngā moni nonohi rawa e rua ki reira.
Nā, ka mea ia, "He pono tāku e mea nei ki a koutou, nui kē tā tēnei pouaru rawakore i maka ai i a rātou katoa.
Ko rātou katoa hoki e makā ana ko tētahi wāhi o ā rātou mea hira noa atu ki roto ki ngā moni tuku noa, ko ia o tōna rawakoretanga e maka ana i tōna oranga katoa."
Ā, i ētahi e kōrero ana ki te temepara, ka oti nei te whakapaipai ki ngā kōhatu papai, ki ngā whakahere, ka mea ia,
"Nā, ko ēnei mea e kite nei koutou; tērā e tae mai ngā rā e kore ai e toe tētahi kōhatu i runga i tētahi kōhatu; engari ka whakahoroa."
Nā, ka ui rātou ki a ia, ka mea, "E te Kaiwhakaako, ko āhea ēnei mea? He aha hoki te tohu ina tata ēnei mea te puta?"
Ā, ka mea ia, "Kia mahara kei māmingatia koutou; he tokomaha hoki e haere mai i runga i tōku ingoa, e mea, ‘Ko ahau ia, kua tata te tāima.’ Nā, kei whai i muri i a rātou.
Nā, ka rongo koutou ki ngā taua, ki ngā whakaoho, kaua e mataku. Kua takoto hoki te tikanga mō ēnei mea kia mātua puta mai; taihoa ia te mutunga."
Kātahi ia ka mea ki a rātou, "Ka whakatika tētahi iwi ki tētahi iwi, tētahi rangatiratanga ki tētahi rangatiratanga.
Tērā hoki e puta ngā rū nunui, ā, i ngā tini wāhi ka pā te matekai me ngā mate urutā, me ngā mea whakamataku hoki, me ngā tohu nunui o te rangi.

"Ā, ko mua ake i ēnei mea katoa pā ai ō rātou ringa ki a koutou, tūkino ai i a koutou, tuku ai i a koutou ki ngā whare whakawā, ki ngā whare herehere, me te ārahi i a koutou ki ngā kīngi, ki ngā kāwana, mō tōku ingoa.
Ā, ka waiho ki a koutou hei tohu whakaatu.
Nā, whakatatūtia iho ki ō koutou ngākau, kia kaua e whakaaroa wawetia tā koutou kupu e whakahoki atu ai.
Māku hoki e hoatu ki a koutou he māngai, he mātauranga, e kore e taea te whakakāhore, te pēhi, e ō koutou hoa whawhai katoa.
Ā, ka tukua atu koutou e ngā mātua, e ngā tēina, e ngā whanaunga, e ngā hoa. Ka whakamatea anō ētahi o koutou.
Ka kino anō ngā tāngata katoa ki a koutou, he whakaaro ki tōku ingoa.
Otiia, e kore e ngaro tētahi makawe o ō koutou upoko.
Mā te manawanui e mau ai ō koutou wairua."
"Otirā, ka kite koutou i Hiruhārama e karapotia ana e ngā taua, ko reira koutou mōhio ai, kua tata tōna whakangaromanga.
Hei reira kia oma te hunga i Hūria ki ngā maunga; me te hunga i waenganui ōna kia haere atu ki waho, kei haere hoki ki reira te hunga i ngā tuawhenua.
Ko ngā rā hoki ēnei o te rapunga utu, e rite ai ngā mea katoa kua oti te tuhituhi.
Otirā, auē te mate o te hunga e hapū ana, o ngā mea e whāngai ana ki te ū, i aua rā! E nui hoki te aituā ki te whenua, me te riri ki tēnei iwi.
Ā, ka hinga rātou i te mata o te hoari, ka riro pārau ki ngā iwi katoa. Ā, ka takahia Hiruhārama e ngā tauiwi, kia rite rā anō ngā wā o ngā tauiwi."
"Ā, ka whai tohu te rā, te marama, me ngā whetū, ā, ki runga ki te whenua he pāwera nō ngā tauiwi, he tūmatatenga ki te haruru o te moana, o te ngaru.
Ka whiti ngā tāngata i te mataku, i te manawapā ki ngā mea e puta mai ana ki te ao, e ngāueue hoki ngā mea kaha o ngā rangi.
Ko reira rātou kite ai i te Tama a te tangata e haere mai ana i runga i te kapua, me te kaha, me te korōria nui.
Ā, nō ka tīmata ēnei mea te puta, titiro ake, kia ara hoki ō koutou mātenga; ka tata hoki tō koutou whakaoranga."
Nā, ka kōrerotia e ia tētahi kupu whakarite ki a rātou: "Titiro ki te piki, ki ngā rākau katoa.
I te mea e pihi ana, nā, ka kite koutou, ka mātau noa ake, kua tata te raumati.
Waihoki, ko koutou, ina kite i ēnei mea e puta ana, ka mātau kua tata te rangatiratanga o te Atua.
"He pono tāku e mea nei ki a koutou, e kore rawa e pahemo tēnei whakatupuranga, kia puta rā anō ēnei mea katoa.
E pahemo te rangi me te whenua; ko āku kupu ia e kore e pahemo."
"Otirā, kia tūpato ki a koutou anō, kei taimaha ō koutou ngākau i te kakai, i te haurangi, i ngā raruraru o te ao, ā, ka puta whakarere mai taua rā, ānō he reti, ki a koutou.
Ka puta hoki ki ngā tāngata katoa e noho ana i te mata o te whenua katoa.
Mō konei rā kia mataara, i ngā wā katoa kia īnoi tonu, kia paingia ai koutou kia mawhiti i ēnei mea katoa meāke nei puta, kia tū hoki i te aroaro o te Tama a te tangata."
Ā, i ia rā e whakaako ana ia i roto i te temepara, ā, i ia pō e haere ana, ka noho i te maunga e kīia nei ko te Maunga o ngā Ōriwa.
Ā, i te atatū ka haere mai ngā tāngata ki a ia ki te temepara, ki te whakarongo ki a ia.
Nā, kua tata te Hākari Taro Rēwenakore e kīia nei ko te Kapenga.
Ā, ka rapu ngā tohunga nui me ngā karaipi ki te pēhea e whakamate ai rātou i a ia, i mataku hoki rātou i te iwi.
Nā, ka uru a Hātana ki a Hūrā, tōna ingoa nei ko Ikariote, ko ia nei tētahi o te tekau mā rua.
Ā, ka haere ia, ka kōrero ki ngā tohunga nui, ki ngā rangatira hōia, me pēhea e tukua ai ia e ia ki a rātou.
Ā, ka hari rātou, ka whakaae kia hoatu he moni ki a ia.
Nā, ka whakaae ia, ka rapu i te wā pai hei tukunga i a ia ki a rātou i te mea e ngaro atu ana te mano.
Nā, ka taka mai te rā o te Taro Rēwenakore i tika nei kia patua te Kapenga.
Ka tonoa e ia a Pita rāua ko Hoani ka mea, "Tīkina, takā te Kapenga mā tātou, kia kai ai tātou."
Nā, ka mea rāua ki a ia, "Ko hea koe pai ai kia takā e māua?"
Ka mea ia ki a rāua "Nā, ka tomo kōrua ki te pā, ka tūtaki he tangata ki a kōrua e mau ana i te kāhaka wai, e aru kōrua i a ia ki te whare e tomo ai ia.
Ka kī atu ki te tangata i te whare, ‘E mea ana te Kaiwhakaako ki a koe, "Kei hea te rūma e kai ai mātou ko āku ākonga i te Kapenga?" ’
Ā, ka whakaaturia e ia ki a kōrua he rūma nui i runga, oti rawa te whāriki; me taka e kōrua ki reira."
Nā, haere ana rāua, ā, rokohanga atu rite tonu ki tāna i kōrero ai ki a rāua, ā, takā ana e rāua te Kapenga.
Ā, ka rite te hāora, ka noho ia, rātou ko ngā āpōtoro kotahi tekau mā rua.
Nā, ka mea ia ki a rātou, "Nui atu tōku hiahia kia kai tahi tātou i tēnei Kapenga, i te mea kāhore anō ahau i mate noa.
Ko tāku kupu hoki tēnei ki a koutou, e kore ahau e kai i tēnei ā muri ake nei, kia tino rite rā anō i te rangatiratanga o te Atua."
Nā, ka mau ia ki te kapu, ka mutu te whakawhetai, ka mea ia, "Tangohia tēnei, tuwhaina mā koutou,
ko tāku kupu hoki tēnei ki a koutou, e kore ahau e inu i te hua o te wāina, kia tae mai rā anō te rangatiratanga o te Atua."
Nā, ka mau ia ki te taro, ka mutu te whakawhetai, ka whawhati, ka hoatu e ia ki a rātou, ka mea, "Ko tōku tinana tēnei e hoatu ana mō koutou; meinga tēnei hei whakamahara ki ahau."
I pērātia anō hoki te kapu, i muri iho i te hapa, ā, i mea ia, "Ko te kawenata hou tēnei kapu i runga i ōku toto e ringihia nei mō koutou.
Otirā, tēnei kei ahau nei, kei te tēpu, te ringa o te kaituku i ahau.
E haere ana hoki rā te Tama a te tangata, e pērā ana me te mea i whakaritea; otirā, auē mō te tangata e tukua ai ia!"
Nā, ka anga rātou, ka rapu ki a rātou anō, mā wai o rātou tēnei e mea.
Ā, ka ara anō he tautohe a rātou, ko wai o rātou e meinga ko te tangata tino nui.
Nā, ka mea ia ki a rātou, "Ko ngā kīngi o ngā tauiwi e whakarangatira ana ki a rātou; ko te hunga whai mana ki runga i a rātou ka kīia, He hunga atawhai.
Otiia, kaua koutou e pērā; engari, kia rite ki tō muri te mea nui o koutou kia rite anō te tino tangata ki te kaimahi.
Ko wai hoki te mea nui, ko ia e noho ana ki te kai, ko te kaimahi rānei? Ehara rānei te tangata e noho ana ki te kai? Tēnei rāia ahau i roto i a koutou te rite nei ki te kaimahi.
"Otirā, ko koutou te hunga i noho tahi tonu me ahau i ōku whakamātautauranga.
Ā, ka whakarite ahau i te rangatiratanga mō koutou, i te pērā me tā tōku Matua i whakarite ai mōku;
kia kai ai, kia inu ai koutou ki tāku tēpu i tōku rangatiratanga, ā, ka noho koutou ki runga ki ngā torōna, whakawā ai i ngā iwi kotahi tekau mā rua o Īharaira."
"E Haimona, e Haimona, nā, kua īnoi a Hātana kia riro koe i a ia, kia tātaritia ai koutou e ia, ānō he wīti.
Otiia, kua īnoi ahau mōu, kei hemo tōu whakapono, ā, ki te tahuri mai anō koe, whakakahangia ōu tēina."
Nā, ka mea tērā ki a ia, "E te Ariki, e pai ana ahau kia haere hei hoa mōu ki te whare herehere, ki te mate hoki."
Anō rā ko ia, "Tēnei tāku kupu ki a koe, e Pita, e kore te tīkaokao e tangi āianei, ka toru āu whakakāhoretanga i tōu mātau ki ahau."
Ā, ka mea ia ki a rātou, "I tāku tononga i a koutou, kāhore he pēke moni, kāhore he pūtea, kāhore he hū, i hapa rānei koutou i tētahi mea?" Ka mea rātou, "Kāhore."
Anō rā ko ia ki a rātou, "Tēnā ko tēnei, ki te mea he pēke moni tā tētahi, mauria atu, me te pūtea anō; me ia hoki kāhore āna hoari, hokona atu tōna kākahu, ka hoko mai ai i tētahi.
Ko tāku kupu hoki tēnei ki a koutou, ko te tikanga tēnei, kia rite i ahau te mea kua oti nei te tuhituhi, arā, ‘Kua huihuia ia ki te hunga hara,’ he tutukitanga hoki tō ngā mea mōku."
Nā, ka mea rātou, "E te Ariki, nā, e rua ēnei hoari." Ka mea ia ki a rātou, "Kāti anō."
Nā, ka puta atu ia, ka haere ki Maunga Ōriwa, ko tāna hanga hoki tērā; me te aru anō āna ākonga i a ia.
Ā, i a ia i taua wāhi, ka mea ia ki a rātou, "Me īnoi kei uru koutou ki te whakamātautauranga."
Nā, ka mawehe atu ia i a rātou, kei tō te taunga kāmaka te matara, ā, ka tuku i ōna turi ka īnoi,
ka mea, "E Pā, ki te pai koe, tangohia atu tēnei kapu i ahau; otirā kauaka e waiho i tāku e pai ai, engari i tāu."
Nā, ka puta mai ki a ia tētahi anahera i te rangi, e whakakaha ana i a ia.
Ā, i te oke o tōna wairua, ka hōhonu ake tāna īnoi; ko tōna kakawa ka pēnā i te tepe toto e turuturu iho ana ki te whenua.
Nā, ka ara ia i te īnoi, ā, ka tae ki āna ākonga, rokohanga atu e moe ana rātou, he ngākau pōuri hoki.
Nā, ko tāna meatanga ki a rātou, "He aha koutou ka moe ai? Whakatika ki te īnoi, kei uru koutou ki te whakamātautauranga."
I a ia e kōrero ana, nā, ko te huihuinga tāngata, ā, ko tērā e huaina rā ko Hūrā, ko tētahi o te tekau mā rua, e haere ana i mua i a rātou; ā, ka whakatata ia ki a Īhu ki te kihi i a ia.
Anō rā ko Īhu ki a ia, "E Hūrā, he kihi tāu hei tuku mō te Tama a te tangata?"
Ā, nō te kitenga o te hunga i tōna taha i ngā mea tērā e tūpono, ka mea rātou, "E te Ariki, me patu rānei e mātou ki te hoari?"
Nā, hāua iho e tētahi o rātou te pononga a te tohunga nui, poroa ana tōna taringa matau.
Nā, ka oho a Īhu, ka mea, "Kāti rā i tēnei." Whakapākia ana tōna taringa, nā kua ora.
Kātahi a Īhu ka mea ki ngā tohunga nui, ki ngā rangatira o te temepara, ki ngā kaumātua, i haere atu ki a ia, "He tāhae ahau i haere mai ai koutou me ngā hoari, me ngā patu?
I ahau e noho ana i a koutou i te temepara i ia rā, i ia rā, kīhai i totoro mai ō koutou ringa ki ahau. Otirā, nō koutou tēnei hāora, ko te kahanga hoki o te pōuri."
Nā, ka hopukina ia e rātou, ka ārahina atu, ā, kawea ana ki roto ki te whare o te tino tohunga. Ko Pita ia i aru mai i tawhiti.
Ā, nō ka oti i a rātou he kāpura te tahu ki waenga marae, i a rātou e noho tahi ana, ka noho hoki a Pita i waenganui o rātou.
Nā, ka kitea ia e tētahi kōtiro, i a ia e noho ana i te mārama o te kāpura; ā, matatau tonu te titiro ki a ia, ka mea, "I a ia anō hoki tēnei."
Nā, ka whakakāhore ia ki a ia, ka mea, "E kō, kāhore ahau e mōhio ki a ia."
Ā, taro kau iho ka kite tētahi atu i a ia, ka mea, "Nō rātou hoki koe." Nā, ka mea a Pita, "E mara, kāhore."
Ā, me te mea kotahi te hāora i muri iho, ka tohe anō tētahi atu, ka mea, "He pono i a ia anō hoki tēnei; nō Karirī hoki."
Ā, ka mea a Pita, "E mara, kāhore ahau e mātau ki tāu e mea nā." Ā, i reira pū anō, i a ia e kōrero ana, ka tangi te tīkaokao.
Nā, ka tahuri te Ariki, ka titiro ki a Pita. Ā, ka mahara a Pita ki te kupu a te Ariki, ki tāna meatanga ki a ia, "E kore e tangi te tīkaokao, ka toru āu whakakāhoretanga i ahau."
Nā, haere atu ana a Pita ki waho, ā, nui atu tōna tangi.
Nā, ka taunu ngā kaipupuri o Īhu ki a ia, ka whiu i a ia.
Ka kōparea ōna kanohi, ā, ka ui rātou ki a ia, ka mea, "Poropiti mai, nā wai koe i papaki?"
He maha hoki ērā atu kupu kino i kōrero ai rātou ki a ia.
Ā, i te aonga tonutanga o te rā, ka huihui ngā kaumātua o te iwi, ngā tohunga nui, me ngā karaipi, ā, ārahina atu ana ia ki tō rātou rūnanga, ka mea rātou,
"Ki te mea ko te Karaiti koe, kōrerotia mai ki a mātou." Anō rā ko ia ki a rātou, "Ki te kōrerotia e ahau ki a koutou, e kore koutou e whakapono;
ki te ui ahau, e kore koutou e whakahoki kupu mai ki ahau.
Haere ake nei ka noho te Tama a te tangata ki matau o te kaha o te Atua."
Nā, ka mea rātou katoa, "Ko te Tama rānei koe a te Atua?" Anō rā ko ia ki a rātou, "Kua kōrerotia mai nā e koutou ko ahau ia."
Nā, ka mea rātou, "Hei aha ake he kaiwhakaatu mā tātou? Kua rongo nei hoki tātou i tā tōna māngai."
Kātahi ka whakatika tō rātou huihui katoa, ā, ārahina ana ia ki a Pirato.
Nā, ka anga rātou, ka whakapā hē ki a ia, ka mea, "Kua mau i a mātou tēnei tangata e kukume kē ana i te iwi, e mea ana kia kaua e hoatu te takoha ki a Hīhā, e kī ana he kīngi ia, ko te Karaiti."
Nā, ka ui a Pirato ki a ia, ka mea, "Ko koe rānei te kīngi o ngā Hūrai?" Ka whakahoki ia ki a ia, ka mea, "Kua kōrerotia mai nā e koe."
Nā, ko te meatanga a Pirato ki ngā tohunga nui, ki ngā mano, "Kāhore tētahi hē o tēnei tangata i mau i ahau."
Ā, nui atu tā rātou tohe ka mea, "E whakatūtehu ana ia i te iwi, e whakaako ana puta noa i Hūria, tīmata mai i Karirī, ā tae noa mai ki konei."
I te rongonga ia o Pirato ki Karirī, ka ui, "Nō Karirī rānei tēnei tangata?"
Ā, i tōna mōhiotanga nō te rangatiratanga ia o Herora, ka tonoa ia ki a Herora, i Hiruhārama hoki ia i aua rā.

Nā, i te kitenga o Herora i a Īhu, nui rawa tōna hari, kua roa ia e hiahia ana kia kite i a ia, he maha hoki ngā mea i rangona e ia mōna. Nā, ka tūmanako ia kia kite i tētahi merekara e meinga ana e ia.
Nā, he maha ngā kupu i ui ai ia ki a ia; heoi, kāhore kau he kupu i whakahokia e ia.
Nā, tū ana ngā tohunga nui me ngā karaipi, kaha rawa hoki tā rātou whakapā hē ki a ia.
Nā, ka whākorekore a Herora rātou ko āna hōia ki a ia, ka taunu, ā, ka oti ia te whakakākahu ki te kahu whakapaipai, ka whakahokia atu ki a Pirato.
I taua rangi anō ka houhia te rongo a Pirato rāua ko Herora; i mua hoki e mauāhara ana ki a rāua.
Nā, ka karangatia e Pirato ngā tohunga nui, ngā rangatira, me te iwi anō,

ka mea ia ki a rātou, "Kua kawea mai nei e koutou tēnei tangata ki ahau, me te kī anō kei te kukume kē ia i te iwi; ā, ka oti nei ia te uiui e ahau i tō koutou aroaro, nā, kīhai i mau i ahau tētahi hē o tēnei tangata i roto i ngā mea i whakapāngia nei e koutou ki a ia.
Ā, kīhai anō hoki a Herora, nāna ia i whakahoki mai ki a tātou, nā, kāhore āna mahi e tika ai kia mate ia.
Nā, me whiu ia e ahau, ka tuku atu ai."
Kua takoto hoki te tikanga kia tukua atu tētahi ki a rātou i te hākari.
Nā, ka pānui rātou ki te karanga, ka mea, "Whakamatea tēnei, ko Parapa te tuku mai ki a mātou."
(Ko tēnei hoki i makā ki te whare herehere mō te nananga i nanā ai ia i roto i te pā, mō te patu tangata.)
Nā, ka mea atu anō a Pirato, he mea hoki nāna kia tukua a Īhu.
Heoi, hāmama ana rātou, mea ana, "Rīpekatia ia, rīpekatia!"
Ka mea anō ia ki a rātou, ko te toru o ngā meatanga, "He aha rā te kino i meinga e tēnei tangata? Kāhore anō i mau i ahau tētahi hē ōna e mate ai; māku ia e whiu, ka tuku atu ai."
Otirā, nui atu ō rātou reo ki te tohe e tono ana kia rīpekatia ia. Ā, riro rawa i tā ō rātou reo.
Nā, ka whakaōtia e Pirato kia waiho i tā rātou i tono ai.
Nā, ka tukua anō ki a rātou te tangata i makā ki te whare herehere mō te nananga, mō te patu tangata, tā rātou hoki i tono ai; ko Īhu ia i tukua ki tā rātou i pai ai.
Ā, i a rātou e ārahi ana i a ia, ka mau rātou ki tētahi tangata o Hairini, ki a Haimona, e haere mai ana i ngā whenua, ā, utaina ana ki a ia te rīpeka, kia amohia i muri i a Īhu.
Nā, he nui te huihuinga o te iwi i aru i a ia, me ngā wāhine hoki e tangi ana, e auē ana ki a ia.
Nā, ka tahuri a Īhu ki a rātou, ka mea, "E ngā tamāhine o Hiruhārama, kaua e tangi ki ahau, engari me tangi ki a koutou anō, ki ā koutou tamariki.
Tērā hoki e puta ngā rā e mea ai rātou, ‘Koa tonu ngā pākoko, me ngā kōpū kāhore i whānau, me ngā ū kāhore i ngotea.’
Ko reira tīmata ai rātou te mea ki ngā maunga, ‘Horo iho ki runga ki a mātou,’ ki ngā pukepuke hoki, ‘Hīpokina mātou.’
Ki te meinga hoki ēnei mea e rātou i te rākau e kaimata ana, ko te aha e meatia i te rākau ka maroke?"
Nā, tērā atu ētahi tokorua, he hunga mahi kino, e ārahina ngātahitia ana me ia kia whakamatea.
Ā, ka tae rātou ki te wāhi e kīia nei ko te Angaanga, ka rīpekatia ia ki reira, me aua kaimahi kino, kotahi ki matau, kotahi ki mauī.
Nā, ka mea a Īhu, "E Pā, houhia te rongo ki a rātou; kāhore hoki rātou e mōhio ki tā rātou e mea nei." Ā, wehewehea ana ōna kākahu e rātou he mea maka ki te rota.

Me te tū anō te iwi mātakitaki ai. Ko ngā rangatira hoki ka tāwai ki a ia, ka mea, "Ko ērā atu i whakaorangia e ia, māna anō ia e whakaora, ki te mea ia ko te Karaiti a te Atua, ko tāna i whiriwhiri ai!"
Ko ngā hōia ētahi i taunu ki a ia, ka haere mai me te kawe mai he winika ki a ia,
ka mea, "Ki te mea ko koe te Kīngi o ngā Hūrai, whakaora i a koe."
Ā, tērā te mea i tuhituhia ki runga ake i a ia, "Ko te Kīngi tēnei o ngā Hūrai."
Nā, ko tētahi o ngā kaimahi kino i whakairia rā i kohukohu ki a ia, i mea, "Ki te mea ko te Karaiti koe, whakaorangia koe, māua hoki."
Nā, ka whakahoki tētahi, ka riri ki a ia, ka mea, "E kore rānei koe e wehi ki te Atua, kei tēnei mate tahi nei hoki koe?
Ka tika rāia tō tāua; ka whiwhi hoki tāua ki ngā mea e tika ana mō ā tāua hanga; ko tēnei ia kāhore āna mahi hē."
Nā, ko tāna meatanga ki a Īhu, "E te Ariki, kia mahara koe ki ahau ina haere mai koe i runga i tōu rangatiratanga."
Anō rā ko Īhu ki a ia, "He pono tāku e mea nei ki a koe, ko āianei koe noho ai ki ahau ki Pararaiha."
Nā, kua tata ki te ono o ngā hāora, ā, ka pōuri a runga o te whenua katoa, tae noa ki te iwa o ngā hāora.
I pōuri hoki te rā, ā, i wāhia te ārai o te whare tapu i waenganui pū.
Ā, nui atu te reo o Īhu ki te karanga; i mea ia, "E Pā, tēnei tōku wairua ka tukua atu nei ki ōu ringa." Ka mutu ēnei kupu, ka hemo ia.
Ā, i te kitenga o te keneturio i taua mea, ka whakakorōria ia i te Atua, ka mea, "He pono he tangata tika tēnei."
Me te hunga katoa hoki i huihui mai ki te mātakitaki, i tō rātou kitenga i aua mea i meatia rā, ka pātuki i ō rātou uma, ā, hoki ana.
Ā, ko te hunga katoa i mōhio ki a ia, rātou ko ngā wāhine i aru mai i a ia i Karirī, i tū mai i tawhiti, mātakitaki ai ki ēnei mea.
Nā, tērā tētahi tangata, ko Hōhepa te ingoa, he tangata noho rūnanga; he tangata pai, he tangata tika.
Kīhai ia i whakaae ki tō rātou whakaaro, ki tā rātou mahi, nō Arimatia ia, nō tētahi pā o ngā Hūrai, ā, he tangata ia e tatari ana ki te rangatiratanga o te Atua.
I haere ia ki a Pirato, ā, tonoa ana e ia te tinana o Īhu.
Nā, ka tangohia iho e ia taua tinana, ā, takaia ana ki te rīnena, ka waiho ki te rua i hāua ki roto ki te kōhatu, kāhore hoki i takoto noa tētahi tangata ki reira.
Nā, ko te rā Takanga hākari ia, ā, meāke pūao te hāpati.
I aru anō ngā wāhine i haere tahi mai nei me ia i Karirī, ā, kite ana i te urupā, i te whakatakotoranga anō o tōna tinana.
Nā, ka hoki rātou, ka mahi i ngā mea kakara, i ngā hinu. Ā, noho ana i te hāpati, he whakaaro hoki ki te ture.
Nā, i te rā tuatahi o te wiki, i te tino ata pō, ka haere mai rātou ki te urupā, me te mau mai i ngā mea kakara kua mahia nei e rātou.
Ā, rokohanga atu e rātou kua hurihia te kāmaka i te urupā.
Ā, ka tomo rātou ki roto, kīhai i kitea te tinana o te Ariki, o Īhu.
Nā, i a rātou e pōkaikaha ana ki tēnei, nā, tū ana ngā tāngata tokorua i ō rātou taha, uira tonu ngā kākahu.
Nā, i a rātou e mataku ana, e kūpapa iho ana ō rātou kanohi ki te whenua, ka mea rāua ki a rātou, "He aha koutou ka rapu ai i te tangata ora i roto i te hunga mate?
Kāhore ia i konei, engari kua ara. Kia mahara ki tāna i mea ai ki a koutou i a ia anō i Karirī,
ki tāna meatanga, ‘Kua takoto te tikanga kia tukua te Tama a te tangata ki ngā ringa o te hunga hara, kia rīpekatia, ā, i te toru o ngā rā ka ara.’ "
Nā, ka mahara rātou ki āna kupu,
ā, hoki mai ana i te urupā, ka kōrero i ēnei mea katoa ki te tekau mā tahi, ki a rātou ko ērā atu katoa.
Nā, ko Meri Makarini rātou ko Hoana, ko Meri whaea o Hēmi, ko ō rātou hoa wāhine, ngā kaikōrero i ēnei mea ki ngā āpōtoro.
Ā, ko te āhua o aua kupu ki tā rātou whakaaro he mea tito noa; kīhai i whakaponohia e rātou.
Kātahi ka whakatika a Pita, ka oma ki te urupā. Ā, ko tōna pikonga iho ka kite, ko ngā kākahu tākai anake e takoto ana; ā, hoki ana ki tōna whare me te mīharo anō i roto i a ia ki taua mea i meatia.
Nā, tokorua o rātou e haere ana i taua rā ki tētahi kāinga, e ono tekau pāronga te matara i Hiruhārama, ko Emāuha te ingoa.
E kōrerorero ana hoki rāua tētahi ki tētahi ki ēnei mea katoa i meinga.
Ā, i a rāua e kōrerorero ana, e uiui ana ki a rāua, nā ko Īhu, ko ia tonu, kua whakatata, ā, haere tahi ana me rāua.
I puritia hoki ō rāua kanohi, i kore ai rāua e mōhio ki a ia.
Nā, ka mea ia ki a rāua, "He aha ēnei kupu e kōrero nei kōrua ki a kōrua, i a kōrua e haere nei?" Nā, ka tū rāua, kīhai i korikori, me te āhua pōuri.
Nā, ka whakahoki tētahi, ko Kereopa te ingoa, ka mea ki a ia, "I Hiruhārama koe e noho ana, ā, ko koe anake kāhore i mōhio ki ngā mea kua meinga nei ki reira i ēnei rā?"
Ka mea ia ki a rāua, "Ki ēhea mea?" Ka mea rāua ki a ia, "Ki ngā mea o Īhu o Nahareta, he poropiti hoki ia, he kaha tāna mahi, tāna kupu, i te aroaro o te Atua, o te iwi katoa.
Ki tōna hoatutanga e ngā tohunga nui, e ō mātou rangatira hoki kia tukua ki te mate, ā, rīpekatia ana ia.
I tūmanako anō mātou ki a ia, māna e whakaora a Īharaira. Nā, i te taha o ēnei mea katoa, ko te toru tēnei o ngā rā i meinga ai ēnei mea.
Ā, mīharo noa iho mātou ki ētahi wāhine o mātou, i haere i te atatū ki te urupā;
heoi, i te korenga i kitea e rātou tōna tinana, ka hoki mai, ka mea, i kitea anō e rātou he putanga anahera, e kī ana mai kei te ora ia.
Nā, ka haere atu ētahi o ō māua hoa ki te urupā, ā, rokohanga atu, rite tonu ki tā ngā wāhine i kōrero ai; otirā, kīhai ia i kitea."
Nā, ko tāna meatanga ki a rāua, "E te hunga whakaarokore, ngākau pūhoi ki te whakapono ki ngā mea katoa i kōrero ai ngā poropiti.
Kāhore ianei i takoto te tikanga kia pā ēnei mea ki a te Karaiti, kia tomo ia ki tōna korōria?"
Nā, ka tīmata ia ki tā Mohi, ki tā ngā poropiti katoa, whakaaturia ana ki a rāua ngā mea mōna o ngā karaipiture katoa.
Ā, ka tata ki te kāinga i haere ai rāua, nā, ka ahu atu ia, me te mea e haere tonu ana ia.
Nā, ka tohe rāua ki a ia, ka mea "E noho ki a māua; kua ahiahi hoki, kua tītaha te rā." Nā, ka tomo atu ia, ka noho ki a rāua.
Ā, i tōna nohoanga iho ki a rāua ki te kai, ka mau ia ki te taro, ka whakapai, ka whawhati, ā, hoatu ana ki a rāua.
Nā, kua kite ō rāua kanohi, ā, ka mōhio ki a ia; ā, ngaro whakarere atu ia i a rāua.
Ā, ka mea rāua ki a rāua, "Kīhai koia ō tāua ngākau i mumura i roto i a tāua, i a ia e kōrero ana ki a tāua i te ara, e whakaatu ana i ngā karaipiture ki a tāua?"
Nā, ka whakatika rāua i taua hāora anō, ā, hoki ana ki Hiruhārama, ā, rokohanga atu kua huihui te tekau mā tahi me ō rātou hoa.
E mea ana, "Koia rawa anō! Kua ara te Ariki, kua puta ki a Haimona."
Nā, ka kōrerotia e rāua ngā meatanga i te ara, tō rāua mōhiotanga hoki ki a ia i te whatiwhatinga o te taro.
Ā, i a rāua e kōrero ana i ēnei mea, nā tērā ia tū ana i waenganui o rātou, mea ana ki a rātou, "Kia tau te rangimārie ki a koutou."
Otirā, koera ana rātou, wehi ana; i mahara hoki he wairua tā rātou i kite ai.
Nā, ko tāna meatanga ki a rātou, "He aha koutou ka pororaru ai? Nā te aha hoki i puta ake ai ngā whakaaroaronga i roto i ō koutou ngākau?
Tirohia ōku ringa me ōku waewae, ko ahau tonu tēnei; whāwhākia ahau, kia kite ai koutou; kāhore hoki o te wairua kikokiko, wheua rānei, pēnei i ōku e kitea mai nā e koutou."
Ā, nō ka kōrerotia e ia tēnei, ka whakakitea e ia ki a rātou ōna ringa me ōna waewae.
Ā, i a rātou kāhore nei i whakapono i te hari, e mīharo ana hoki, ka mea ia ki a rātou, "He kai rānei tā koutou kei konei?"
Nā, ka hoatu e rātou ki a ia tētahi ika, he mea tunutunu.
Nā, ka tango ia, ā, kainga ana e ia i tō rātou aroaro.

I mea anō ia ki a rātou, "Ko ngā kupu ēnei i kōrero ai ahau ki a koutou, i ahau anō i a koutou, me whakarite ngā mea katoa kua oti te tuhituhi i roto i te ture a Mohi, i ngā poropiti, i ngā waiata, mōku."
Kātahi ia ka whakamakoha i ō rātou hinengaro, kia mātau ai ki ngā karaipiture,
ka mea ki a rātou, "Ko te mea tēnei i tuhituhia: ko te tikanga anō tēnei, ko te Karaiti kia whakamamaetia, kia ara anō i te hunga mate i te toru o ngā rā;
kia kauwhautia hoki te rīpenetā me te murunga hara i runga i tōna ingoa ki ngā tauiwi katoa, ki Hiruhārama tīmata ai.
Nā, ko koutou hei kaiwhakaatu mō ēnei mea.
Nanā, māku e tuku ki a koutou te mea i kōrerotia i mua e tōku Matua; otiia, e noho koutou ki te pā, ki Hiruhārama, kia whiwhi rā anō ki te kaha i runga."
Nā, ārahina ana rātou e ia ki waho, ki Petani, nā, kua ara ōna ringa, whakapaingia ana rātou e ia.
Ā, i a ia e whakapai ana i a rātou, ka mawehe atu ia i a rātou, kāhakina atu ana ki te rangi.
Nā, ka koropiko rātou ki a ia, ā, hoki ana ki Hiruhārama, he nui hoki te koa.
Ā, noho tonu ai rātou i te temepara, me te whakapai ki te Atua. Āmine.
I te tīmatanga te Kupu, i te Atua te Kupu, ko te Atua anō te Kupu.
I te Atua anō tēnei Kupu i te tīmatanga.
Nāna ngā mea katoa i hanga; kāhore hoki tētahi mea i kore te hanga e ia o ngā mea i hangā.
I a ia te ora; ko te ora te mārama mō ngā tāngata.
I roto i te pōuri te mārama e whiti ana; heoi, kīhai i mau i te pōuri.
I tonoa mai he tangata e te Atua, ko Hoani tōna ingoa.
I haere mai ia hei kaiwhakaatu, hei whakaatu mō te mārama, kia meinga ai e ia ngā tāngata katoa kia whakapono.
Ehara ia i te mārama, engari, i haere mai hei kaiwhakaatu mō te mārama.
Ko te mārama pono tērā, arā, ko te mārama e mārama ai ngā tāngata katoa e haere mai ana ki te ao.
I te ao ia, i hangā anō e ia te ao, ā, kīhai te ao i mōhio ki a ia.
I haere mai ia ki ōna, ā, kīhai ōna i manako ki a ia.
Tēnā ko te hunga i manako ki a ia i tukua e ia ki a rātou ngā tikanga e meinga ai rātou hei tamariki mā te Atua, arā ki te hunga e whakapono ana ki tōna ingoa.
Ki te hunga ehara nei i te toto, ehara i tā te kikokiko i pai ai, ehara i tā te tangata i pai ai, engari, nā te Atua i whānau ai.
I whakakikokikotia te Kupu, ā, noho ana i a mātou, i kite anō mātou i tōna korōria he korōria e rite ana ki tō te Tama kotahi a te Matua, kī tonu i te aroha noa, i te pono.
I kōrerotia ia e Hoani; i karanga tērā, i mea, "Ko ia tēnei i kōrerotia rā e ahau, ‘Ko ia e haere mai ana i muri i ahau e meinga ana ki mua i ahau; nō mua hoki ia i ahau.’ "
Kua riro hoki i a tātou katoa tētahi wāhi o tōna raneatanga, te aroha noa hono iho ki te aroha noa.
Nā Mohi hoki i hōmai te ture; ko te aroha noa me te pono i ahu mai i a Īhu Karaiti.
Kāhore anō he tangata i kite noa i te Atua; ko te Tama kotahi, kei te uma nei o te Matua, nāna ia i whakapuaki.
Nā, ko te kōrero tēnei a Hoani, i te tononga mai a ngā Hūrai i Hiruhārama i ngā tohunga nui rātou ko ngā Rīwaiti hei ui ki a ia, "Ko wai koe?"
Nā, ka whākina e ia, kīhai i whakakāhore, i whāki hoki, "Ehara ahau i a te Karaiti."
Ā, ka ui rātou ki a ia, "Tēnā, pēhea? Ko Irāia koe?" Ka mea ia, "Kāhore." "Ko te poropiti oti koe?" Ka whakahokia e ia, "Kāhore."
Nā, ka mea rātou ki a ia, "Ko wai koia koe? Hei kupu whakahoki mā mātou ki te hunga i tonoa mai ai mātou. E pēhea ana koe ki a koe?"
Ka mea ia: "He reo ahau nō tētahi e karanga ana i te koraha, ‘Whakatikaia te huarahi o te Ariki!’ " He pērā me tā Ihāia poropiti i mea ai.
Nō ngā Parihi hoki te hunga i tonoa mai rā.
Nā, ka ui rātou ki a ia, ka mea ki a ia, "He aha oti koe i iriiri ai, ki te mea ehara koe i a te Karaiti, ehara i a Irāia, ehara i te poropiti?"
Nā, ka whakahoki a Hoani ki a rātou, ka mea, "He iriiri tāku ki te wai; otiia tēnā te tū nā i waenganui i a koutou tētahi kāhore e mōhiotia e koutou.
Ko ia tēnei e haere mai ana i muri i ahau kāhore hoki ahau e tau hei wewete i te here o tōna hū."
I meatia ēnei mea ki Petapara, ki tāwāhi atu o Horano, ki te wāhi e iriiri ana a Hoani.
I te aonga ake, ka kite ia i a Īhu e haere ana mai ki a ia, ka mea, "Nā te Reme a te Atua, hei waha atu i te hara o te ao!
Ko ia tēnei i kōrero ai ahau, ‘Kei te haere mai i muri i ahau tētahi tangata kua meinga ki mua i ahau; nō mua hoki ia i ahau.’
Ā, kāhore ahau i mātau ki a ia; heoi, hei whakakite i a ia ki a Īharaira, i haere mai ai ahau me tāku iriiri ki te wai."
Nā, ka whakaatu a Hoani, ka mea, "I kite ahau i te Wairua e heke iho ana i te rangi, ānō he kūkupa, ā, noho ana i runga i a ia.

Ā, kāhore ahau i mātau ki a ia; engari i kī mai ki ahau te kaitono mai i ahau ki te iriiri ki te wai, ‘Ko te tangata e kite ai koe i te Wairua e heke iho ana, e noho ana ki runga ki a ia, ko ia tēnā te kaiiriiri ki te Wairua Tapu.’
Ā, kua kite ahau, kua whakaatu nei hoki, ko te Tama tēnei a te Atua."
I te aonga ake i te tū anō a Hoani me āna ākonga tokorua;
nā, ka titiro ia ki a Īhu e haere ana, ka mea, "Nā, te Reme a te Atua!"
Ā, ka rongo ngā ākonga tokorua ki a ia e kōrero ana, ā, aru ana rāua i a Īhu.

Ā, ka tahuri a Īhu, ka kite i a rāua e aru ana, ka mea ia ki a rāua "E rapu ana kōrua i te aha?" Nā, ko tā rāua meatanga ki a ia, "E Rapi" (ko te tikanga tēnei ina whakamāoritia, e te Kaiwhakaako), "kei hea tōu kāinga?"
Ka mea ia ki a rāua, "Haere mai kia kite." Haere ana rāua, ā, ka kite i tōna wāhi i noho ai, ā, noho ana i a ia i taua rā; ko te tekau hoki ia o ngā hāora.
Ko Anaru, teina o Haimona Pita tētahi o taua tokorua i rongo nei ki a Hoani e kōrero ana, ā, aru ana i a ia.
Ko ia kua kite wawe i tōna tuakana ake, i a Haimona, ka mea ki a ia, "Kua kitea e māua te Mīhaia." (Ko te tikanga tēnei ina whakamāoritia, ko te Karaiti).
Nā, ka ārahina mai ia e ia ki a Īhu. Ā, ka titiro a Īhu ki a ia, ka mea, "Ko Haimona koe, ko te tama a Hona, me hua koe ko Kipa." (Tōna whakamāoritanga ko Pita, arā ko Kōhatu).
I te aonga ake ka mea a Īhu kia haere ki Karirī, ā, ka kite i a Piripi; ā, ka mea a Īhu ki a ia, "E aru i ahau."
Nā, ko Piripi nō Petahaira, nō te pā o Anaru rāua ko Pita.
Ka kite a Piripi i a Natanahira, ka mea ki a ia, "Kua kitea e mātou a ia, mōna nei te tuhituhi a Mohi i roto i te ture, tā ngā poropiti hoki, a Īhu o Nahareta te tama a Hōhepa."
Nā, ka mea a Natanahira ki a ia, "E puta koia tētahi mea pai i Nahareta?" Ka mea a Piripi ki a ia, "Haere mai kia kite."
Ka kite a Īhu i a Natanahira e haere ana mai ki a ia, ka puaki tāna kupu mōna, "Nā, he tino tangata nō Īharaira, kāhore ōna tinihanga."
Ka mea a Natanahira ki a ia, "Nō hea koe i mātau ai ki ahau?" Ka whakahoki a Īhu ki a ia, ka mea, "I te mea kīanō koe i karangatia e Piripi, i a koe anō i raro i te piki, i kite ahau i a koe."
Nā, ka whakahoki a Natanahira, ka mea ki a ia, "E Rapi, ko te Tama koe a te Atua, ko te Kīngi koe o Īharaira!"
Nā, ka whakahoki a Īhu, ka mea ki a ia, "Nō tāku meatanga ki a koe, ‘I kite ahau i a koe i raro i te piki,’ i whakapono ai koe? Rahi atu i ēnei ngā mea e kitea e koe."
I mea anō ia ki a ia, "He pono, he pono tēnei kupu āku ki a koutou, tērā koutou e kite i te rangi e tuwhera ana, i ngā anahera a te Atua e piki ake ana, e heke iho ana ki te Tama a te tangata."
Nā, i te toru o ngā rā he mārena i Kana o Karirī, ā, i reira te whaea o Īhu.
I karangatia anō a Īhu rātou ko āna ākonga ki te mārena.
Ā, i te paunga o te wāina, ka mea te whaea o Īhu ki a ia, "Kāhore ā rātou wāina."
Ka mea a Īhu ki a ia, "E tai, he aha tāku ki a koe? Kāhore anō kia taea noatia tōku hāora."
Ka mea tōna whaea ki ngā kaimahi, "Ko tāna e mea ai ki a koutou, meatia."
Nā, i reira ētahi ipu kōhatu e ono e tū ana, he tikanga nā ngā Hūrai mō te horoi, e rua, e toru ngā mēhua o tētahi, o tētahi, ina kī.
Ka mea a Īhu ki a rātou, "Whakakīia ngā ipu ki te wai." Ā, whakakīia ana e rātou, pūrena noa.
Nā, ka mea ia ki a rātou, "Tēnā, utuhia, kawea atu ki te rangatira o te hākari." Ā, kawea ana e rātou.

Ā, nō ka whakamātau te rangatira o te hākari i te wai i whakawāinatia, ā, kīhai i mōhio nō hea rānei (ko ngā pononga ia i utuhia ai te wai i mōhio), ka karanga te rangatira o te hākari ki te tāne mārena hou,
ka mea ki a ia, "E whakatakotoria ana e ngā tāngata katoa te wāina pai i te tīmatanga; ā, ka roa te inumanga, mō reira te wāina he iti iho nei te pai ko koe ia, kua tohu i te wāina pai mō nāianei."
I meatia tēnei tīmatanga merekara e Īhu ki Kana o Karirī, i whakakitea e ia tōna korōria; ā, whakapono ana āna ākonga ki a ia.
Muri iho i tēnei ka haere iho ia ki Kaperenauma, ā, ia, tōna whaea, ōna tēina, me āna ākonga; ā, kīhai i maha ngā rā i noho ai rātou ki reira.
Nā, kua tata te Kapenga o ngā Hūrai, ā, ka haere a Īhu ki Hiruhārama.
Nā, rokohanga atu e ia i roto i te temepara e noho ana ngā kaihoko kau, hipi, kūkupa, me ngā kaiwhakawhitiwhiti moni.
Ā, ka hangā e ia he whiu ki ngā aho nonohi, ka whiua katoatia e ia ki waho i te temepara, ngā hipi, me ngā kau; ringihia ana hoki te moni a ngā kaiwhakawhitiwhiti moni, turakina ake ngā tēpu.
I mea anō ia ki ngā kaihoko kūkupa, "Tangohia atu ēnei i konei; aua te whare o tōku Matua e meinga hei whare hokohoko."
Ā, ka mahara āna ākonga ki te mea i tuhituhia, "Ka pau ahau i te aroha ki tōu whare."
Nā, ka whakahoki ngā Hūrai, ka mea ki a ia, "He aha te tohu e whakakitea ana e koe ki a mātou, inā koe ka mea nei i ēnei mea?"
Nā, ka whakahoki a Īhu, ka mea ki a rātou, "Wāwāhia tēnei whare tapu, ā, kia toru ngā rā ka ara anō i ahau."
Anō rā ko ngā Hūrai, "E whā tekau mā ono ngā tau i hangā ai tēnei whare tapu, e oti rānei te hanga e koe i ngā rā e toru?"
Otirā, ko te whare tapu o tōna tinana tāna i kōrero ai.
Nā reira, i tōna aranga ake i te hunga mate, ka mahara āna ākonga ki tāna kōrerotanga i tēnei; ā, whakapono ana rātou ki te karaipiture, ki te kupu hoki i kōrerotia e Īhu.
Nā, i a ia i Hiruhārama, i te Kapenga, i te hākari, he tokomaha i whakapono ki tōna ingoa, i tō rātou kitenga i āna merekara i meatia e ia.
Otirā, kīhai a Īhu i tuku atu i a ia ki a rātou, i mōhio hoki ia ki ngā tāngata katoa.
Ā, kāhore āna meatanga kia whakaaturia te tangata e tētahi; i mātau hoki ia ki te mea i roto i te tangata.
Nā, he tangata tērā nō ngā Parihi, ko Nikorima tōna ingoa, he rangatira nō ngā Hūrai.

Ka haere mai tēnei ki a Īhu i te pō, ka mea ki a ia, "E Rapi, e mātau ana mātou i haere mai koe i te Atua hei kaiwhakaako, inā hoki e kore tētahi tangata e āhei te mea i ēnei merekara e meatia nei e koe, ki te kāhore te Atua i a ia."
Ka whakahoki a Īhu, ka mea ki a ia, "He pono, he pono, tāku e mea nei ki a koe, ki te kāhore te tangata e whānau hou, e kore ia e āhei te kite i te rangatiratanga o te Atua."
Ka mea a Nikorima ki a ia, "Me pēhea ka whānau ai te tangata i tōna koroheketanga? E taea rānei te tuarua o ngā haerenga ki roto ki te kōpū o tōna whaea, whānau mai ai?"
Ka whakahokia e Īhu, "He pono, he pono tāku e mea nei ki a koe, Ki te kāhore te tangata e whānau i te wai, i te Wairua hoki, e kore ia e āhei te tomo ki te rangatiratanga o te Atua.
Ko tā te kikokiko e whānau ai he kikokiko; ko tā te Wairua e whānau ai he wairua.
Aua rā e mīharo ki tāku i mea nei ki a koe, ‘He mea tūturu tēnei kia whānau hou koutou.’

E pupuhi ana te hau ki tāna wāhi e pai ai, ka rongo hoki koe ki tōna haruru otiia e kore e mōhiotia e koe te wāhi i puta mai ai, e tae atu ai rānei. Ko te ritenga tēnei ki te hunga katoa ka whānau i te Wairua."
Ka whakahoki a Nikorima, ka mea ki a ia, "Me pēhea ka taea ai ēnei mea?"
Ka whakahoki a Īhu, ka mea ki a ia, "Ko koe te Kaiwhakaako o Īharaira, ā, kāhore i mātau ki ēnei mea?
He pono, he pono tāku e mea nei ki a koe, e kōrerotia ana e mātou tā mātou i mātau ai, e whakaaturia ana tā mātou i kite ai; heoi, e kore koutou e tango ki tā mātou whakaaturanga.
Ki te mea kua kōrerotia e ahau ki a koutou ngā mea o te whenua, ā, kāhore koutou e whakapono, me pēhea ka whakapono ai ki te kōrerotia e ahau ki a koutou ngā mea o te rangi?
Kāhore hoki he tangata i kake noa ki te rangi, ko ia anake i heke iho i te rangi, arā ko te Tama a te tangata, e noho mai nei i te rangi.
"Ka rite hoki ki tā Mohi whakairinga i te nākahi i te koraha, kua takoto te tikanga kia pērā te whakairinga o te Tama a te tangata.
Kia kāhore ai e ngaro te tangata e whakapono ana ki a ia, engari kia whiwhi ai ki te ora tonu.
"Koia anō te aroha o te Atua ki te ao, hōmai ana e ia tāna Tama kotahi, kia kāhore ai e ngaro te tangata e whakapono ana ki a ia, engari kia whiwhi ai ki te ora tonu.
Kīhai hoki te Atua i tono mai i tāna Tama ki te ao ki te whakahē i te ao; engari kia ora ai te ao i a ia.
"Ko ia e whakapono ana ki a ia, e kore e tau te hē ki a ia; tēnā ko ia e kore e whakapono, kua whakahēngia noatia ake, mōna kīhai i whakapono ki te ingoa o te Tama kotahi a te Atua.
Ko te whakahēnga hoki tēnei, nō te mea kua tae mai nei te mārama ki te ao, ā, nui atu tō ngā tāngata aroha ki te pōuri i tō rātou ki te mārama, he kino hoki nō ā rātou mahi.
E kino ana hoki ki te mārama ngā kaimahi katoa i te kino, e kore anō hoki e haere mai ki te mārama, kei whakakitea ā rātou mahi.
Tēnā ko te kaimahi i te pono, e haere mai ana ki te mārama, kia kitea ai āna mahi, he mea mahi i roto i te Atua."
Ā, nō muri i ēnei mea ka haere a Īhu, rātou ko āna ākonga, ki te whenua o Hūria; ā, noho tahi ana rātou ki reira, me tāna iriiri anō.
Nā, i te iriiri anō hoki a Hoani ki Ēnona, ki tētahi wāhi e tata ana ki Harema, nō te mea he nui te wai o reira; ā, ka haere mai rātou, ka iriiria.
Kāhore anō hoki a Hoani i pangā ki te whare herehere.
Nā, ka ara he totohe a ngā ākonga a Hoani ki tētahi Hūrai mō te purenga.
Ā, ka haere rātou ki a Hoani, ka mea ki a ia, "E Rapi, ko te tangata i tāwāhi nā kōrua o Horano, ko tāu i whakaatu mai nā, nanā, kei te iriiri ia, e haere ana hoki te katoa ki a ia."
Ka whakahoki a Hoani, ka mea, "E kore tētahi mea e riro i te tangata, ki te kore e hōmai ki a ia i te rangi.
Ko koutou hei kaiwhakaae ki ahau, ki tāku meatanga, ‘Ehara ahau i a te Karaiti, engari i tonoa mai ahau i mua i a ia.’

Ko te tangata i te wahine mārena hou, ko ia te tāne mārena hou. Nā, ko te hoa o te tāne mārena hou, e tū ana, e rongo ana ki a ia, ka hari pū ki te reo o te tāne mārena hou. Nā reira i tutuki ai tēnei hari ōku.
Ko te tikanga tēnei, ko ia kia nui haere, ko ahau kia iti haere."
"Ko ia e haere mai ana i runga, kei runga ake ia i te katoa; ko tō te whenua nō te whenua ia, nō te whenua anō āna kōrero. Ko ia e haere mai ana i te rangi, kei runga ake ia i te katoa.
Ā, ko tāna i kite ai, i rongo ai, ko ia tāna e whakaatu ai; kāhore hoki tētahi tangata e tango atu ki tāna whakaaturanga.
Ki te manako tētahi ki tāna whakaaturanga, kua piri tāna tohu ki te pono o tā te Atua.
Ko tā te Atua i tono mai ai, e kōrero ana ia i ngā kupu a te Atua; kāhore hoki te Wairua e hōmai e te Atua i runga i te mēhua.
E aroha ana te Matua ki te Tama, kua hoatu anō ngā mea katoa ki tōna ringa.
Ko ia e whakapono ana ki te Tama, he ora tonu tōna; ko ia e kore e whakapono ki te Tama, e kore e kite i te ora, engari ka mau tonu te riri a te Atua ki a ia."
Ā, nō ka mōhio te Ariki, kua rongo ngā Parihi, ko ngā ākonga a Īhu i mea ai, i iriiri ai, he tokomaha atu i a Hoani.
(He ahakoa rā ehara i a Īhu nāna i iriiri, nā āna ākonga ia.)
Ka mahue a Hūria i a ia, ā, hoki ana anō ki Karirī.
Nā, ko te ara mōna i tika nā Hamaria.
Ā, ka haere ia ki tētahi pā o Hamaria, ko Haika te ingoa, e pātata ana ki te wāhi i hoatu e Hākopa ki tāna tama, ki a Hōhepa.
Kei reira hoki te puna a Hākopa. Nā, kua ngenge a Īhu i te haerenga, heoi noho ana ia ki te taha o te puna, ā, meāke ko te ono o ngā hāora.
Ka haere mai tētahi wahine o Hamaria ki te utu wai. Ka mea a Īhu ki a ia, "Hōmai he wai mōku."
(Kua riro hoki āna ākonga ki te pā, ki te hoko kai.)
Nā, ko te meatanga a te wahine o Hamaria ki a ia, "He aha koe, he Hūrai nā koe, ka tono mai ai i te wai i ahau, he wahine nei ahau nō Hamaria?" (Kāhore hoki e tātata ana ngā Hūrai ki ngā Hamari.)

Ka whakahoki a Īhu, ka mea ki a ia, "Me i mātau koe ki tā te Atua e hōmai ai, ki tēnei hoki e mea nei ki a koe, ‘Hōmai he wai mōku,’ pēnei kua tono koe ki a ia, ā, kua hoatu e ia te wai ora ki a koe."
Ka mea te wahine ki a ia, "E kara, kāhore āu mea hei utu wai, he hōhonu anō te puna. Nō hea tēnā wai ora āu?
He nui oti koe i tō mātou matua, i a Hākopa, i hōmai ai te puna ki a mātou, inu ana ia i konei, rātou ko āna tamariki, me āna kararehe?"
Ka whakahoki a Īhu, ka mea ki a ia, "E mate anō i te wai te tangata e inu ana i tēnei wai;

tēnā ko te tangata e inu ana i te wai e hoatu e ahau ki a ia, e kore ia e mate i te wai ā ake ake. Engari, te wai e hoatu e ahau ki a ia, hei puna wai tēnā i roto i a ia e pupū ake ana, ā te ora tonu rā anō."
Ka mea te wahine ki a ia, "E kara, hōmai ki ahau tēnei wai, kei mate ahau i te wai, kei haere mai hoki ki konei rawa utu ai."
Ka mea a Īhu ki a ia, "Tīkina, karangatia tō tahu, ka hoki mai ai."
Ka whakahoki te wahine, ka mea, "Kāhore āku tahu." Ka mea a Īhu ki a ia, "He kōrero tika tāu, ‘Kāhore āku tahu’;
inā hoki kua tokorima āu tahu, ko ia i a koe nei ehara i te tahu nāu. He pono tēnei kōrero āu."
Ka mea te wahine ki a ia, "E kara, e kite ana ahau he poropiti koe.
I karakia ō mātou mātua i runga i tēnei maunga; ā, e mea ana koutou, Ko Hiruhārama te wāhi e tika ai te karakia."
Ka mea a Īhu ki a ia, "E tai, whakapono ki ahau, meāke puta te wā, e kore ai koutou e karakia ki te Matua i runga i tēnei maunga, e kore anō i Hiruhārama.
Kāhore koutou e mōhio ki tā koutou e karakia nei; e mātau ana mātou ki tā mātou e karakia nei; nō ngā Hūrai nei hoki te ora.
Otirā, meāke puta te wā, ā, tēnei anō, e karakia ai ngā kaikarakia pono ki te Matua i runga i te wairua, i te pono; e rapu ana hoki te Matua ki te pērā hei karakia ki a ia.
He Wairua te Atua; me karakia hoki ngā kaikarakia ki a ia i runga i te wairua, i te pono."
Ka mea te wahine ki a ia, "E mātau ana ahau kei te haere mai te Mīhaia" (e kīia nei ko te Karaiti) "ka tae mai ia, māna ngā mea katoa e kōrero ki a tātou."
Ka mea a Īhu ki a ia, "Ko ahau anō ia e kōrero nei ki a koe."
Nā, ka puta i reira āna ākonga, ka mīharo ki tāna kōrerotanga ki te wahine; heoi, kīhai tētahi i mea, "He aha tāu e rapu? He aha koe ka kōrero ai ki a ia?"
Nā, ka whakarērea e te wahine tāna ipu, ā, haere ana ki te pā, ka mea ki ngā tāngata,
"Haere mai, kia kite i te tangata i kōrerotia mai ai ki ahau ngā mea katoa i mea ai ahau. Ehara rānei tēnei i a te Karaiti?"
Ka puta rātou ki waho o te pā, ā, ka ahu mai ki a ia.
I taua takiwā anō ka tohe ngā ākonga ki a ia, ka mea, "E te Kaiwhakaako, e kai rā."
Otirā, ka mea ia ki a rātou, "He kai anō tāku hei kai māku, kāhore koutou e mātau."
Nā, ka mea ngā ākonga tētahi ki tētahi, "I kawea mai rānei e tētahi he kai māna?"
Ka mea a Īhu ki a rātou, "Ko tāku kai tēnei, ko te mea i tā tōku kaitono e pai ai, kia whakaotia hoki tāna mahi.
E kore ianei koutou e mea, ‘Kia whā atu ngā marama, ā, ka taea te kotinga?’ Nanā, ko tāku kupu tēnei ki a koutou, kia ara ake ō koutou kanohi, titiro ki ngā māra; kua mā noa ake; ko te kotinga tēnei.
Ka whiwhi te kaikokoti ki te utu, ka kohia anō hoki e ia ngā hua mō te ora tonu; kia hari tahi ai te kairui rāua ko te kaikokoti.
Nā, konei hoki i pono ai taua kī, ‘E rui ana tētahi, e kokoti ana tētahi.’
I tonoa koutou e ahau ki te kokoti i te mea kīhai i mahia e koutou. He tangata kē nāna i mahi, ā, kua uru koutou ki ā rātou mahi."
Ā, he tokomaha ngā Hamari o taua pā i whakapono ki a ia, mō te kī a te wahine i mea rā, "I kōrerotia mai e ia ki ahau ngā mea katoa i mea ai ahau."
Ā, nō ka tae ngā Hamari ki a ia, ka mea kia noho ia ki a rātou; ā, e rua ngā rā i noho ai ia ki reira.
Nā, hira noa ake ngā tāngata i whakapono, he mea hoki nā tāna kupu.
I mea anō ki te wahine, "Ehara i te mea nā tāu kupu i whakapono ai mātou ināianei; kua rongo nei hoki mātou ake, ā, ka mātau, ko te Karaiti pū tēnei, ko te Kaiwhakaora o te ao."
Ka pahure aua rā e rua, ka tūria atu e ia i reira, ā, haere ana ki Karirī.
Ko Īhu tonu hoki nāna te kī, kāhore he hōnore o te poropiti i tōna kāinga ake.
Heoi, i tōna taenga ki Karirī, ka whakamanuhiritia, ia e ngā tāngata o Karirī, i kite hoki rātou i ngā mea katoa i meatia e ia ki Hiruhārama i te hākari; i haere hoki rātou ki te hākari.
Ā, ka tae anō a Īhu ki Kana o Karirī, ki te wāhi i meatia ai e ia te wai hei wāina. Nā, ko tētahi tangata a te kīngi, kei Kaperenauma tāna tama e mate ana.
Ā, nō ka rongo ia kua tae mai a Īhu i Hūria ki Karirī, ka haere ki a ia, ka īnoi ki a ia kia haere ia ki te whakaora i tāna tama; meāke hoki marere.
Nā, ko te meatanga a Īhu ki a ia, "Ki te kāhore koutou e kite i ngā tohu, i ngā merekara, e kore rawa koutou e whakapono."
Ka mea te tangata a te kīngi ki a ia, "E te Ariki, haere iho i te mea kāhore anō kia mate noa tāku tamaiti."
Ka mea a Īhu ki a ia, "Haere; kua ora tāu tama." Nā, whakapono ana te tangata ki te kupu i kōrerotia e Īhu ki a ia, ā, haere ana.
Ā, i a ia e haere ana, ka tūtaki āna pononga ki a ia, ka kōrero, "Kua ora tāu tamaiti."
Nā, ka ui ia ki a rātou ki te hāora i mātūtū ake ai ia. Ka mea rātou ki a ia, "Nōnanahi, nō te whitu o ngā hāora, i mutu ai tōna kā."
Nā, ka mōhio te pāpā, ko te tino hāora ia i mea ai a Īhu ki a ia, "Kua ora tāu tama"; ā, whakapono ana ia, rātou ko tōna whare katoa.
Ko te rua anō tēnei o ngā merekara i meatia e Īhu, i muri i tōna haerenga i Hūria ki Karirī.
Muri iho i ēnei mea he hākari tā ngā Hūrai, ā, haere ana a Īhu ki Hiruhārama.
Nā, kei Hiruhārama tētahi wai kaukauranga kei te tatau hipi, tōna ingoa Hiperu ko Petehera; e rima ōna whakamahau.
Nā, kei roto i ēnei e takoto ana tōna tini o ngā tūroro, o ngā matapō, o ngā kopa, o ngā memenge, e tatari ana ki te pōkarekarenga o te wai.

Heke iho ai hoki tētahi anahera i te wā i rite ai ki te kaukauranga, whakapōkarekare ai i te wai; ā, ko ia kua tae wawe i muri iho o te pōkarekarenga o te wai i ora i tōna mate, ahakoa he aha, he aha.
Nā, kei reira tētahi tangata, e toru tekau mā waru ngā tau e mate ana.
Nō te kitenga o Īhu i a ia e takoto ana, ka mātau kua roa kē te wā ōna e mate ana, ka mea ki a ia, "E pai ana rānei koe kia whakaorangia?"
Ka whakahokia e taua tūroro ki a ia, "E te Ariki, kāhore āku tāngata hei tuku i ahau ki te kaukauranga, ina whakapōkarekarea te wai; heoi, i ahau e haere ana, ka heke iho tētahi i mua i ahau."
Ka mea a Īhu ki a ia, "Whakatika, tangohia ake tōu moenga, haere."
Ā, ora tonu ake taua tangata, ā, tangohia ake ana e ia tōna moenga, haere ana. Ko te hāpati anō taua rā.
Nā, ka mea ngā Hūrai ki taua tangata i whakaorangia rā, "Ko te hāpati tēnei; e kore e tika kia mauria e koe tōu moenga."
Ka whakahokia e ia ki a rātou, "Ko te tangata i whakaorangia ai ahau, nāna i mea ki ahau, ‘Tangohia ake tōu moenga, haere.’ "
Nā, ka ui rātou ki a ia, "Ko wai tēnā tangata i mea nā ki a koe, ‘Tangohia ake tōu moenga, haere’?"
Otirā, kīhai taua tangata i whakaorangia rā i mōhio ko wai ia; i paheno atu hoki a Īhu, he tokomaha hoki ngā tāngata i taua wāhi.
Muri iho i ēnei mea ka kite a Īhu i a ia i roto i te temepara, ka mea ki a ia, "Nā, ka oti nei koe te whakaora. Kāti te hara kei kino rawa iho te mea e pā ki a koe."
Haere ana taua tangata, kōrero ana ki ngā Hūrai, nā Īhu ia i whakaora.
Koia ngā Hūrai i whai ai ki te tūkino i a Īhu, mōna i mea i ēnei mea i te hāpati.
Nā, ka whakahokia e Īhu ki a rātou, "E mahi ana tōku Matua ā taea noatia tēnei rā; e mahi ana anō ahau."
Koia ngā Hūrai i tino whai rawa ai kia patua ia, ehara hoki i te mea ko tāna takahi anake i te hāpati, engari, mōna i mea ko te Atua tōna Matua ake, i mea he rite ia ki te Atua te nui.

Nā, ka whakahoki a Īhu, ka mea ki a rātou, "He pono, he pono tāku e mea nei ki a koutou, e kore e taea e te Tama te mea tētahi mea e ia anake, engari ngā mea e kite ai ia e meatia ana e te Matua; ko tāna hoki e mea ai, e meatia ana hoki e te Tama.
E aroha ana hoki te Matua ki te Tama, e whakakitea ana hoki ki a ia ngā mea katoa e mea ai ia; he nui atu i ēnei ngā mahi e whakakitea e ia ki a ia, kia mīharo ai koutou.
Ko tā te Matua hoki, he whakaara, he whakaora i ngā tūpāpaku; ka pērā anō te Tama, ka whakaora i āna e pai ai.
E kore hoki te Matua e whakawā i tētahi, engari, kua tukua e ia ngā whakawā katoa ki te Tama;

kia rite ai te whakahōnore a ngā tāngata katoa i te Tama ki tā rātou whakahōnore i te Matua. Ki te kāhore tētahi e whakahōnore i te Tama, e whakakāhore ana ia i te hōnore mō te Matua nāna nei ia i tono mai.

"He pono, he pono tāku e mea atu nei ki a koutou, ko te tangata e rongo ana ki tāku kōrero, e whakapono ana hoki ki tōku kaitono mai, he ora tonu tōna; e kore anō ia e riro ki te whakawā, engari, kua whiti i te mate ki te ora.
He pono, he pono tāku e mea nei ki a koutou, meāke puta te wā, ā, tēnei anō ināianei, e rongo ai ngā tūpāpaku i te reo o tā te Atua Tama; ā, ko te hunga e rongo ana ka ora.
Tā te mea he ora tō te Matua kei roto i a ia; waihoki kua hōmai e ia ki te Tama, kia whai ora i roto i a ia;
ā, kua hōmai anō ki a ia he tikanga mō te whakawā, nō te mea ko ia te Tama a te tangata.
"Kaua e mīharo ki tēnei; nō te mea meāke puta te wā, e rongo ai i tōna reo ngā tāngata katoa i roto i ngā urupā,
ā, ka puta; ko ngā kaimahi i te pai ki te aranga o te ora; ko ngā kaimahi i te kino ki te aranga o te whakawā."

"E kore e āhei i ahau te mea tētahi mea e ahau anake; rite tonu tāku whakawā ki tāku e rongo ai. He tika hoki tāku whakawā; kāhore hoki ahau e rapu i tāku i pai ai, engari, i tā tōku kaitono i pai ai."
"Mehemea ko ahau hei whakaatu i āku aha, i āku aha, ehara tāku i te whakaatu pono.
Tērā atu anō tētahi kaiwhakaatu mōku; e mōhio ana anō ahau he whakaatu pono tāna e whakaatu nei mōku.
I tono tāngata koutou ki a Hoani, ā, i whakaaturia e ia te pono.
Kāhore ahau e manako ki tā te tangata whakaatu; engari, e kōrerotia ana e ahau ēnei mea kia ora ai koutou.
He rama kā tērā, he rama mārama tonu; he wā anō i pai ai koutou kia hari ki tōna mārama.
"Otiia, he kaiwhakaatu anō tōku, nui atu i a Hoani. Ko ngā mahi hoki i hōmai e te Matua kia whakaotia e ahau, ko aua mahi e mahia nei e ahau, hei whakaatu mōku, i tonoa mai ahau e te Matua.
Nā, ko te Matua nāna nei ahau i tono mai, kua oti ahau te whakaatu e ia. Kāhore anō koutou i rongo noa i tōna reo, kāhore anō i kite i tōna āhua.
Kāhore anō hoki i mau tāna kupu i roto i a koutou; inā kāhore anō koutou i whakapono ki tēnei i tonoa mai nei e ia.
Whakatakina ai e koutou ngā tikanga o ngā karaipiture; e mea ana hoki koutou kei reira te ora tonu mō koutou; ko ēnei hei kaiwhakaatu mōku.
Heoi, kāhore koutou e pai kia haere mai ki ahau, kia whiwhi ai ki te ora.
"He korōria tāngata, kāhore ahau e manako atu.
Nā, kua mātau ahau ki a koutou, kāhore te aroha o te Atua i roto i a koutou.
Kua tae mai nei ahau i runga i te ingoa o tōku Matua, ā, kāhore koutou e manako mai ki ahau; ki te haere mai tētahi i runga i tōna ake ingoa, ka manako koutou ki a ia.
Me pēhea koutou ka whakapono ai, ka riro nei i a koutou te korōria e puta ana i a koutou anō, ā, kāhore e rapu i te korōria e puta ana i te Atua kotahi?
"Kei mea koutou e kōrerotia tō koutou hē e ahau ki te Matua; tērā te kaikōrero mō tō koutou hē, ko Mohi, ko tā koutou e tūmanako nei.
Me i whakapono hoki koutou ki a Mohi, kua whakapono anō ki ahau; ko tāna hoki i tuhituhi ai he mea mōku.
Otirā, ki te kāhore koutou e whakapono ki āna i tuhituhi ai, me pēhea ka whakapono ai ki āku kōrero?"
Muri iho i ēnei mea ka whiti atu a Īhu i te moana o Karirī, (arā i te moana o Taipiria.)
Ā, he rahi te hui i aru i a ia, i kite hoki rātou i āna merekara i mea ai ia ki ngā tūroro.
Nā, ka haere a Īhu ki runga i te maunga, ā, noho ana i reira rātou ko āna ākonga.
Kua tata hoki te Kapenga, te hākari a ngā Hūrai.
Ā, nō te marangatanga ake o ngā kanohi o Īhu, ka kite i te rahi o te hui e haere mai ana ki a ia; ka mea ia ki a Piripi, "Ko hea tātou hoko ai i ētahi taro, kia kai ai ēnei?"
I pēnei ai tāna kī hei whakamātau mōna; i mōhio hoki ia ki tāna e mea ai.
Ka mea a Piripi ki a ia, "E kore e ranea mā rātou ngā taro o ngā pene e rua rau, kia whiwhi ai tēnei, tēnei o rātou i tētahi wāhi iti."
Ka mea tētahi o āna ākonga ki a ia, a Anaru, teina o Haimona Pita,
"He tamaiti tēnei, e rima āna taro pāre, e rua ika nonohi. Heoi, hei aha ēnei mā tēnei ope nui?"
Nā, ka mea a Īhu, "Meinga ngā tāngata kia noho." (He nui hoki te tarutaru i taua wāhi.) Nā, noho ana ngā tāne ki raro, te tokomaha me te mea e rima mano.
Nā, ka mau a Īhu ki ngā taro; ā, ka mutu te whakawhetai, ka tuwha atu ki te hunga e noho rā; me ngā ika anō, tā rātou i pai ai.
Ā, nō ka mākona rātou, ka mea ia ki āna ākonga, "Kohikohia ngā toenga o ngā whatiwhatinga, kei maumauria tētahi wāhi."
Nā, kohikohia ana e rātou, ā, whakakīia ana ngā kete tekau mā rua ki ngā whatiwhatinga o ngā taro pāre e rima, ki ngā toenga a ngā tāngata i kai rā.
Ā, i te kitenga o aua tāngata i te merekara i meatia e Īhu, ka kī rātou, "Ko ia anō tēnei, ko te poropiti e haere mai ana ki te ao."
Nā, ka mahara a Īhu, meāke rātou haere mai ki te tango i a ia, ki te whakakīngi i a ia, nā, maunu ana anō ia ki te maunga, ko ia anake.
Ā, nō ka ahiahi, ka haere āna ākonga ki te moana.
Nā, ka eke rātou ki te kaipuke, ka whakawhiti ki tāwāhi o te moana, ki Kaperenauma. Ā, kua pōuri noa ake, kāhore anō a Īhu kia tae noa mai ki a rātou.
Nā, ko te tūranga o te moana, he nui hoki nō te pūhanga o te hau.
Nā, i tō rātou hoenga atu, e rua tekau mā rima, e toru tekau rānei pāronga, ka kite i a Īhu e haere māori ana i runga i te moana, e whakatata ana ki te kaipuke; nā ka mataku rātou.
Nā, ka mea ia ki a rātou, "Ko ahau tēnei, aua e wehi."
Nā, ka mea rātou kia eke ia ki te kaipuke; ā, kīhai i aha kua ū te kaipuke ki te wāhi i hoe ai rātou.

I te aonga ake, ka mahara te mano e tū ana ki tērā taha o te moana, kāhore he poti kē atu o reira, ko tērā anake i eke ai āna ākonga, kīhai hoki a Īhu i eke tahi rātou ko āna ākonga ki te poti, engari, ko āna ākonga anake i haere.
He poti kē rā ia i ū mai i Taipiria ki pahaki atu o te wāhi i kai ai rātou i te taro i tā te Ariki whakawhetainga.
Ā, i te kitenga o te mano kāhore a Īhu i reira, kāhore anō hoki āna ākonga, ka eke hoki rātou ki ngā kaipuke, ka rere ki Kaperenauma ki te rapu i a Īhu.
Ā, nō tō rātou kitenga i a ia i tāwāhi o te moana, ka mea ki a ia, "E Rapi, nōnahea koe i tae mai ai ki konei?"

Ka whakahoki a Īhu ki a rātou, ka mea, "He pono, he pono tāku e mea nei ki a koutou, ehara i te mea he kitenga nō koutou i ngā merekara i rapu ai koutou i ahau, engari, nō te mea i kai koutou i ngā taro, ā, ka mākona.
Aua e mahia te kai memeha, engari, te kai e mau tonu ana ā te ora tonu rā anō, ko tā te Tama hoki a te tangata e hoatu ai ki a koutou. Kua oti hoki ia te whai tohu e te Atua, e te Matua."
Nā, ka mea rātou ki a ia, "Me aha mātou e mahi ai i ngā mahi a te Atua?"
Ka whakahoki a Īhu, ka mea ki a rātou, "Ko tā te Atua mahi tēnei, kia whakapono koutou ki tāna i tono mai ai."
Nā, ka mea rātou ki a ia, "Ko tēhea tohu te meatia ana e koe kia kite ai mātou, kia whakapono ai ki a koe? Tēnā koa tāu mahi?
I kai ō tātou mātua i te mana i te koraha; ko te mea hoki tēnā i tuhituhia, ‘I hōmai e ia he taro i te rangi hei kai mā rātou.’ "

Nā, ko te meatanga a Īhu ki a rātou, "He pono, he pono tāku e mea nei ki a koutou, ehara i a Mohi nāna i hoatu tēnā taro ki a koutou i te rangi. Engari, tēnei te hoatu nei e tōku Matua ki a koutou te taro pono o te rangi.
Ko te taro hoki a te Atua ko ia e heke iho ana i te rangi, e hōmai ana i te ora ki te ao."
Nā, ka mea rātou ki a ia, "E te Ariki, hōmai tēnei taro ki a mātou i ngā wā katoa."
Ka mea a Īhu ki a rātou, "Ko ahau te taro o te ora. Ki te haere mai tētahi ki ahau, e kore rawa ia e hiakai; ki te whakapono hoki tētahi ki ahau, e kore rawa ia e matewai.
Otirā, i mea anō ahau ki a koutou, kua kite koutou i ahau, ā, kāhore i whakapono.
Ko ā te Matua e hōmai ai ki ahau ka haere katoa mai ki ahau; ā, ki te haere mai tētahi ki ahau, e kore rawa e pangā e ahau ki waho,
i heke iho hoki ahau i te rangi, ehara i te mea hei mahi i tāku i pai ai, engari, i tā tōku kaitono mai i pai ai.
Ko tā te Matua i pai ai, nāna nei ahau i tono mai, koia tēnei, kia kaua e ngaro i ahau tētahi wāhi o ngā mea katoa i hōmai e ia ki ahau; engari, kia whakaarahia ake e ahau ā te rā whakamutunga.
Ko tā tōku Matua hoki tēnei i pai ai, ko te tangata e kite ana i te Tama, e whakapono ana anō ki a ia, kia whiwhi ia ki te ora tonu; māku anō ia e whakaara ake ā te rā whakamutunga."
Nā, ka kōrero kōmuhumuhu ngā Hūrai ki a ia, mōna i mea, "Ko ahau te taro i heke iho i te rangi."
Ka mea rātou, "Ehara oti tēnei i a Īhu, tama a Hōhepa, e mōhio nei tātou ki tōna pāpā rāua ko tōna whaea? Ha! He pēhea tāna e kī nei, ‘I heke iho ahau i te rangi’?"
Nā, ka whakahoki a Īhu, ka mea ki a rātou, "Kāti te kōmuhumuhu i roto i a koutou.
Kāhore he tangata e āhei te haere mai ki ahau, ki te kāhore ia e kūmea mai e te Matua, nāna nei ahau i tono mai. Ā, māku anō ia e whakaara ake ā te rā whakamutunga.
Kua oti te tuhituhi i roto i ngā poropiti, ‘Ā, ka whakaakona rātou katoa e te Atua.’ Nā, ko te tangata kua rongo ki te Matua, kua ākona hoki, ka haere mai ki ahau.
Ehara i te mea kua kite tētahi i te Matua; ko ia anake i puta mai i te Atua, ko ia kua kite i te Matua.
He pono, he pono tāku, e mea nei ki a koutou, Ki te whakapono tētahi, he ora tonu tōna.
Ko ahau te taro o te ora.
I kai rā ō koutou mātua i te mana i te koraha, ā, i mate rātou.
Ko te taro tēnei e heke iho ana i te rangi, kia kai ai te tangata i a ia, ā, kia kaua e mate.
Ko ahau te taro ora i heke iho i te rangi; ki te kai tētahi i tēnei taro, e ora tonu ia. Āe rā, ko te taro e hoatu e ahau ko ōku kikokiko, e hoatu e ahau hei oranga mō te ao."
Nā, ka totohe ngā Hūrai tētahi ki tētahi, ka mea, "Me pēhea e hōmai ai e tēnei tangata ōna kikokiko kia kainga e tātou?"

Nā, ko te meatanga a Īhu ki a rātou, "He pono, he pono tāku e mea nei ki a koutou, ki te kāhore koutou e kai i ngā kikokiko o te Tama a te tangata, e inu i ōna toto, kāhore he ora i roto i a koutou ake.
Ko ia e kai ana i ōku kikokiko, e inu ana i ōku toto, he ora tonu tōna; ā, māku ia e whakaara ake ā te rā whakamutunga.
He kai pono hoki ōku kikokiko, he mea pono ōku toto hei inumanga.
Ko ia e kai ana i ōku kikokiko, e inu ana i ōku toto, e noho ana i roto i ahau, me ahau hoki i roto i a ia.
Nā te Matua ora hoki ahau i tono mai, nō te Matua anō tōku ora; waihoki ki te kai tētahi i ahau, kei ahau he ora mōna.
Ko te taro tēnei i heke iho i te rangi. E kore e pērā i tā ō koutou mātua i kai rā, ā, mate ana. Ki te kai tētahi i tēnei taro, e ora tonu ia."
I kōrerotia ēnei mea e ia i roto i te whare karakia, i a ia e whakaako ana i Kaperenauma.
Nā, he tokomaha āna ākonga i te rongonga, i mea, "He kupu pakeke tēnei; ko wai e āhei te whakarongo atu?"
Ka mōhio ia a Īhu i roto i a ia, e kōmuhumuhu ana āna ākonga ki tēnei, ka mea ia ki a rātou, "E hē ana koutou ki tēnei?
Ka pēhea rā ki te kite koutou i te Tama a te tangata e kake atu ana ki te wāhi i noho ai ia i mua?
Ko te wairua te whakaora ana; kāhore a te kikokiko wāhi. Ko ngā kupu e kōrero nei ahau ki a koutou he wairua, he ora.
Tēnei anō ia ētahi o koutou kāhore ō rātou whakapono." (I mātau hoki a Īhu nō te tīmatanga ki ngā mea kāhore ō rātou whakapono, ki te tangata anō e tukua ai ia.)
Ā, ka mea ia, "Nā, konei ahau i mea ai ki a koutou, kāhore he tangata e āhei te haere mai ki ahau, ki te kāhore e hoatu ki a ia e tōku Matua."
I taua wā, he tokomaha āna ākonga i hoki ki muri, ā, mutu ake tā rātou haere tahi me ia.
Nā, ka mea a Īhu ki te tekau mā rua, "E mea ana anō rānei koutou kia haere?"
Nā, ka whakahokia e Haimona Pita ki a ia, "E te Ariki, me haere mātou ki a wai? Kei a koe ngā kupu o te ora tonu.
Kua whakapono mātou, kua mātau, ko te Karaiti koe, ko te Tama a te Atua ora."
Ka whakahokia e Īhu ki a rātou, "He teka ianei kotahi tekau mā rua koutou i whiriwhiria e ahau, he rēwera anō tētahi o koutou?"
Ko Hūrā Ikariote tama a Haimona tāna i kōrero ai; ko te tangata hoki ia meāke nei tuku i a ia; ko tētahi hoki ia o te tekau mā rua.
I muri i ēnei mea ka hāereere a Īhu i Karirī; kāhore hoki ia i pai ki te hāereere i Hūria, e rapu ana hoki ngā Hūrai kia whakamatea ia.
Nā, kua tata te hākari a ngā Hūrai, te Hākari Whare Wharau.
Nā, ka mea ōna tēina ki a ia, "Haere atu i konei, anga atu ki Hūria, kia kite ai hoki āu ākonga i āu mahi e mahi nei koe.
E kore hoki tētahi tangata e mea huna i tētahi mea, ki te whai ia kia ara tōna ingoa. Ki te mea koe i ēnei mea, kia kite te ao i a koe."
(Ko ōna tēina tonu hoki kīhai i whakapono ki a ia.)
Nā, ka mea a Īhu ki a rātou, "Kāhore anō kia taea noatia tōku tāima; ko tō koutou tāima ia kei ngā wā katoa.
E kore e āhei kia kino te ao ki a koutou; engari ka kino ki ahau, nō te mea e whakaaturia ana e ahau te kino o āna mahi.
Haere koutou ki tēnei hākari; e kore ahau e haere wawe ki tēnei hākari; kāhore hoki tōku tāima kia āta rite noa."
Ā, ka mutu tēnei kōrero āna ki a rātou, ka noho tonu ia ki Karirī.
Ā, nō ka riro ōna tēina ki te hākari, ka haere anō hoki ia, ehara i te mea whakakite nui, engari i tū-ā-huna.
Heoi, i rapu ngā Hūrai i a ia i te hākari, i mea, "Kei hea ia?"
He nui hoki te kōrero kōmuhumuhu mōna i roto i te mano. Ko ētahi i mea, "He tangata pai ia," ko ētahi i mea, "Kāhore, engari e whakapōhēhē ana ia i te iwi."
Heoi, kīhai i rahi te kōrero a tētahi tangata mōna, he wehi ki ngā Hūrai.
Nā, i waenganui o te hākari, ka haere a Īhu ki roto ki te temepara whakaako ai.
Ā, ka mīharo ngā Hūrai, ka mea, "Nā te aha i hua ai te mōhio o tēnei tangata, ehara nei hoki ia i te mea whakaako?"
Ka whakahoki a Īhu ki a rātou, ka mea, "Ehara i te mea nāku ake tāku e whakaako nei, engari, nā tōku kaitono mai.
Ki te pai tētahi tangata ki te mea i tāna e pai ai, e mātau ia ki te whakaakoranga, nā te Atua rānei, he kōrero nāku ake rānei.
Ko te tangata nāna ake tāna kōrero, e whai ana ia i tōna ake korōria; tēnā ki te whai tētahi i te korōria o tōna kaitono, e pono ana ia, ā, kāhore ōna hē.
He teka ianei nā Mohi te ture i hoatu ki a koutou, ā, kāhore e whakaritea te ture e tētahi o koutou? He aha koutou ka whai nei kia whakamatea ahau?"
Nā, ka whakahoki te mano ka mea, "He rēwera tōu! Ko wai te whai ana kia whakamatea koe?"
Ka whakahoki a Īhu, ka mea ki a rātou, "Kotahi āku mahi i mahi ai, ā, e mīharotia ana e koutou katoa.
I hōmai e Mohi te kotinga ki a koutou (ehara anō ia i te mea nā Mohi ake, engari nā ngā tūpuna), e kokoti ana hoki koutou i te tangata i te hāpati.
Ki te kotia te tangata i te hāpati, kei takahia te ture a Mohi; e riri ana oti koutou ki ahau, mōku i whakaora rawa i te tangata i te hāpati?
Kaua e waiho te whakawā i runga i tā te kanohi, engari kia tika tā koutou whakawā."
Me i reira ka mea ētahi o ngā tāngata o Hiruhārama, "Ehara oti tēnei i a ia e whāia nei e rātou kia whakamatea?
Nā, māia tonu tāna kōrero, ā, kāhore ā rātou kupu ki a ia. E tino mātau ana rānei ngā rangatira, ko te Karaiti pū tēnei?
Otiia, e mātau ana tātou ki te wāhi i puta mai ai tēnei; tēnā ka tae mai a te Karaiti, kāhore he tangata e mātau ki te wāhi e puta mai ai ia."

Nā, ka karanga a Īhu i te temepara i a ia e whakaako ana, ka mea, "E mātau ana koutou ki ahau, e mātau ana anō ki te wāhi i haere mai ai ahau. Ehara i ahau ake tāku haere mai, engari, e pono ana te kaitono mai i ahau; kāhore nei koutou i mātau ki a ia.
E mātau ana ahau ki a ia; i puta mai hoki ahau i a ia, nāna anō ahau i tono mai."
Ā, i whai rātou kia hopukia ia; otiia, kīhai i pā te ringa o tētahi ki a ia, kāhore hoki tōna hāora i taka noa.
Ā, he tokomaha o te mano whakapono ki a ia, i mea, "Ka tae mai a te Karaiti, tērā rānei e maha atu āna merekara e mea ai i a tēnei e mea nei?"
I rongo ngā Parihi i te mano e kōrerorero ana i ēnei mea mōna; nā, ka tonoa mai e ngā Parihi rātou ko ngā tohunga nui he kātipa ki te hopu i a ia.
Nā, ka mea a Īhu ki a rātou, "He iti noa ake te wāhi e noho ai ahau ki a koutou, kātahi ahau ka haere ki tōku kaitono mai.
Tērā koutou e rapu i ahau, heoi, e kore koutou e kite; e kore hoki koutou e āhei te haere ake ki te wāhi e noho ai ahau."
Nā, ka mea ngā Hūrai ki a rātou anō, "E haere oti te tangata nei ki hea, e kore ai e kitea e tātou? E haere oti ia ki ngā manene i roto i ngā Kariki, ako ai i ngā Kariki?
He kī aha tēnei e kī nei ia, ‘Tērā koutou e rapu i ahau, ā, e kore e kite. E kore hoki koutou e āhei te haere ake ki te wāhi e noho ai ahau’?"
I te rā whakamutunga, i te rā nui o te hākari, ka tū a Īhu, ka karanga, ka mea, "Ki te matewai tētahi, haere mai ia ki ahau, kia inu.
Ki te whakapono tētahi ki ahau, ka rite ki tā te karaipiture, ‘ka rere mai ngā wai ora i roto i tōna kōpū.’ "
I kōrerotia tēnei e ia mō te Wairua, meāke nei riro i te hunga e whakapono ana ki a ia; kāhore anō hoki te Wairua Tapu kia hōmai noa; nō te mea kīanō a Īhu i whakakorōriatia noatia.
Ko ētahi o te mano i tō rātou rongonga i tēnei kupu, i mea, "He pono ko te Poropiti tēnei."
Ka mea ētahi, "Ko te Karaiti tēnei." Ko ētahi i mea, "E puta mai rānei a te Karaiti i Karirī?
Kāhore koia te karaipiture i mea, e puta mai a te Karaiti i te uri o Rāwiri, i Pēterehema, i te kāinga i noho ai a Rāwiri?"
Nā, ka waiho ia hei take wehewehenga mā te mano.
Ko ētahi o rātou i mea kia hopukia ia; otirā, kīhai i pā ngā ringa o tētahi ki a ia.
Nā, ko te taenga atu o ngā kātipa ki ngā tohunga nui rātou ko ngā Parihi; ka mea atu ēnei ki a rātou, "He aha ia tē kawea mai ai e koutou?"
Ka whakahokia e ngā kātipa, "Kāhore rawa he tangata i rite āna kōrero ki a tēnei."
Nā, ka whakahokia tā rātou e ngā Parihi, "Kua tinihangatia anō hoki koutou?
Kua whakapono koia tētahi o ngā rangatira, o ngā Parihi rānei ki a ia?
Ko tēnei hunga ia e kore nei e mātau ki te ture, ka oti rātou te kanga."
Ka mea a Nikorima ki a rātou, tērā i haere mai rā ki a ia i mua, ko ia hoki tētahi o rātou,
"Ka whakahēngia rānei te tangata e tō tātou ture, i te mea kāhore anō i whakarongo noa ki a ia, i mātau hoki ki tāna mahi?"
Nā, ka whakahoki rātou, ka mea ki a ia, "Ko koe hoki tētahi nō Karirī? Tēnā rapua, ka kite koe, kāhore kia ara noa tētahi poropiti i Karirī."
Nā, hoki ana rātou ki tōna whare, ki tōna whare.
Ko Īhu ia i haere ki Maunga Ōriwa.
Ā, i te atatū ka hoki anō ia ki te temepara, ā, tae katoa ana te iwi ki a ia. Nā, ka noho ia, ka whakaako i a rātou.
Kātahi, ka ārahina mai ki a ia e ngā karaipi rātou ko ngā Parihi tētahi wahine i hopukia e pūremu ana; ā, whakatūria ana ki waenganui.
Ka mea rātou ki a ia, "E te Kaiwhakaako, i hopukia pūtia te wahine nei e pūremu ana.
I whakahau a Mohi ki a mātou i roto i te ture, kia ākina ngā pēnei ki te kōhatu. Tēnā koa tāu kī?"
I pēnei ai rātou he whakamātautau mōna, kia whai take ai rātou e whakapāngia ai he hē ki a ia. Ka piko a Īhu, ā, tuhituhi ana tōna ringa ki te whenua.
Ā, ka tohe tonu rātou ki te ui ki a ia ka whakatika ake ia, ka mea ki a rātou, "Ko te tangata o koutou kāhore ōna hara, māna te kōhatu mātāmua e āki ki a ia."
Nā, ka piko anō ia, ka tuhituhi ki te whenua.
Ā, i tō rātou rongonga, ka haere takitahi atu ki waho, nā ngā kaumātua i tīmata, ā poto noa ō muri rawa. Ā, ko Īhu anake i mahue, me te wahine e tū ana i waenganui.
Ā, ko te marangatanga ake o Īhu, ka mea ki a ia, "E tai, kei hea rātou? Kāhore he tangata i whakatau hē ki a koe?"
Anō rā ko tērā, "Kāhore, e te Ariki." Ka mea a Īhu ki a ia, "Kāhore anō hoki ahau e whakatau i te hē ki a koe; haere, kāti te hara."
I kī atu anō a Īhu ki a rātou, i mea, "Ko ahau te whakamārama o te ao; ki te aru tētahi i ahau, e kore ia e haere i te pōuri, engari, ka whiwhi ki te mārama o te ora."
Nā, ka mea ngā Parihi ki a ia, "Ko koe anō tōu kaiwhakaatu; ehara tāu i te whakaatu pono."

Ka whakahoki a Īhu, ka mea ki a rātou, "Ahakoa ko ahau anō tōku kaiwhakaatu, he pono tāku whakaatu; nō te mea e mātau ana ahau ki te wāhi i haere mai ai ahau, ki te wāhi hoki e haere atu nei ahau; ko koutou ia kāhore e mātau ki te wāhi i haere mai ai ahau, ki te wāhi anō e haere atu nei ahau.
Nā te kikokiko tā koutou tikanga whakawā; e kore ahau e whakawā i tētahi.
Ā, ki te whakawā ahau, he tika tāku whakawā; ehara hoki i te mea ko ahau anake, engari, ko māua ko te Matua nāna nei ahau i tono mai.
Āe, kua oti anō te tuhituhi i roto i tō koutou ture, He pono te whakaatu a ngā tāngata tokorua.
Ko ahau tēnei hei kaiwhakaatu mōku anō, hei kaiwhakaatu anō mōku te Matua, nāna nei ahau i tono mai."
Nā, ka mea rātou ki a ia, "Kei hea tōu Matua?" Ka whakahokia e Īhu, "Kāhore koutou e mātau ki ahau, kāhore anō ki tōku Matua; me i mātau koutou ki ahau, kua mātau anō ki tōku Matua."
I kōrerotia ēnei kupu e Īhu i te whare takotoranga taonga, i a ia e whakaako ana i roto i te temepara; ā, kāhore tētahi i hopu i a ia; kīanō hoki tōna hāora i taka noa.
Me i reira ka kī atu anō a Īhu ki a rātou, "E haere atu ana ahau, ā, tērā koutou e rapu i ahau, e mate anō hoki i roto i tō koutou hara. E kore koutou e āhei te haere ake ki te wāhi e haere ai ahau."
Nā, ka mea ngā Hūrai, "E whakamate oti ia i a ia anō? Inā ia ka mea, ‘E kore koutou e āhei te haere ake ki te wāhi e haere ai ahau.’ "
Anō rā ko ia ki a rātou, "Nō raro nei koutou; nō runga ahau; nō tēnei ao koutou; ehara ahau i tēnei ao.
Koia ahau i mea ai ki a koutou, e mate koutou i roto i ō koutou hara; ki te kore hoki koutou e whakapono ko ahau ia, e mate koutou i roto i ō koutou hara."
Kātahi rātou ka mea ki a ia, "Ko wai koe?" Nā, ka mea a Īhu ki a rātou, "Ko tāku anō kōrero ai ki a koutou i te tīmatanga.
He maha āku mea e kōrero ai, e whakawā ai mō koutou; otirā, e pono ana tōku kaitono mai; e kōrerotia ana hoki e ahau ki te ao ngā mea i rongo ai ahau ki a ia."
Kīhai rātou i mātau ko te Matua tāna i kōrero ai ki a rātou.

Kātahi a Īhu ka mea ki a rātou, "Kia oti te Tama a te tangata te whakairi e koutou, ko reira koutou mātau ai ko ahau ia, ā, e kore e meatia tētahi mea e ahau ake; engari, ko ā tōku Matua i whakaako mai ai ki ahau, ko ēnei āku e kōrero nei.
Kei ahau nei anō tōku kaitono mai; kīhai ahau i waiho e te Matua ko ahau anake, nō te mea e mahi tonu ana ahau i ngā mea e paingia ana e ia."
Nā, i a ia e kōrero ana i ēnei mea, he tokomaha i whakapono ki a ia.
Me i reira ka mea a Īhu ki ngā Hūrai i whakapono ki a ia, "Ki te mau tonu koutou ki tāku kupu, he tino ākonga koutou nāku;
ā, e mātau koutou ki te pono, mā te pono anō koutou ka rangatira ai."
Ka whakahokia e rātou ki a ia, "He whānau mātou nā Āperahama, kāhore mātou i waiho noa hei pononga mā tētahi tangata. He aha tāu e mea, ‘Ka rangatira koutou’?"
Ka whakahokia e Īhu ki a rātou, "He pono, he pono tāku e mea nei ki a koutou, he pononga nā te hara ngā kaimahi katoa i te hara.
E kore te pononga e noho tonu i te whare; ko te Tama ia e noho tonu ana.
Nā, i te mea ka whakarangatiratia koutou e te Tama, he tino rangatira koutou.
E mātau ana anō ahau, he whānau koutou nā Āperahama; heoi, e whai ana koutou kia whakamatea ahau, he kore hoki nō tāku kupu e mau i roto i a koutou.
E kōrerotia ana e ahau tāku i kite ai ki tōku Matua; e mahia ana e koutou tā koutou i kite ai ki tō koutou matua."
Ka whakahoki rātou, ka mea ki a ia, "Ko Āperahama tō mātou matua." Ka mea a Īhu ki a rātou, "Me he tamariki koutou nā Āperahama, kua mahia e koutou ngā mahi a Āperahama.
Tēnā ko tēnei, e whai ana koutou kia whakamatea ahau, te tangata nāna i kōrero te pono ki a koutou, tāku hoki i rongo ai ki te Atua. Kīhai a Āperahama i pēnā.
E mahi ana koutou i ngā mahi a tō koutou matua." Kātahi rātou ka mea ki a ia, "Kīhai mātou i whānau pōriro; kotahi tō mātou Matua, ko te Atua."

Ka mea anō a Īhu ki a rātou, "Mehemea ko te Atua tō koutou Matua, kua aroha koutou ki ahau; i haere mai hoki ahau i te Atua, ā, kua tae mai nei. Kīhai hoki ahau i haere noa mai, engari, nāna ahau i tono mai.
He aha rā koutou tē mātau ai ki tāku kōrero? Nō te mea e kore koutou e āhei te whakarongo ki tāku kupu.

Nā tō koutou matua koutou, nā te rēwera, e pai ana hoki kia mea i tā tō koutou matua i hiahia ai. He kaikōhuru ia nō te tīmatanga, kīhai hoki i tū i roto i te pono, nō te mea kāhore he pono i roto i a ia. Ki te kōrero teka ia, e kōrero ana i āna; he kōrero teka hoki ia, ko te matua o te teka.
I tāku kōrerotanga i te pono, kāhore koutou e whakapono ki ahau.
Ko wai o koutou hei whakaatu he hara tōku? Ki te pono tāku kōrero, he aha koutou tē whakapono ai ki ahau?
E whakarongo ana te tangata a te Atua ki ngā kōrero a te Atua; koia koutou tē whakarongo ai, nō te mea ehara koutou i te Atua."
Nā, ka whakahoki ngā Hūrai, ka mea ki a ia, "Kāhore koia i tika tā mātou i mea rā, nō Hamaria koe, ā, he rēwera tōu?"
Ka whakahokia e Īhu, "Kāhore ōku rēwera; engari e whakahōnore ana ahau i tōku Matua, ko koutou ia te whakakāhore ana i te hōnore mōku.
Kāhore āku whai i te korōria mōku; tērā anō te kaiwhai, te kaiwhakatikatika.
He pono, he pono tāku e mea nei ki a koutou, ki te pupuri tētahi i tāku kupu, e kore rawa ia e kite i te mate."
Ka mea ngā Hūrai ki a ia, "Kātahi mātou ka mōhio he rēwera tōu. Kua mate a Āperahama rātou ko ngā poropiti, ā, e mea ana koe, ‘Ki te pupuri tētahi i tāku kupu, e kore rawa ia e pāngia e te mate.’
He nui oti koe i tō mātou matua, i a Āperahama kua mate nei? Kua mate anō ngā poropiti. Ki tāu ko wai koe?"
Ka whakahokia e Īhu, "Ki te whakahōnore ahau i ahau anō, he hōnore noa tōku. Ko tōku Matua hei whakahōnore i ahau; ko tā koutou e mea nei ko ia tō koutou Atua.

Heoi, kāhore koutou i mātau ki a ia, ko ahau ia e mātau ana ki a ia, ā, ki te mea ahau, ‘Kāhore ahau e mātau ki a ia,’ he tangata teka ahau, he pēnā me koutou. Otirā, e mātau ana ahau ki a ia, e pupuri ana i tāna kupu.
I hari tō koutou matua, a Āperahama, mōna ka kite i tōku rā; i kite ia, ā, koa ake."
Kātahi, ka mea ngā Hūrai ki a ia "Kāhore noa i rima tekau noa ōu tau, ā, kua kite koe i a Āperahama?"
Ka mea a Īhu ki a rātou, "He pono, he pono tāku e mea nei ki a koutou, kāhore noa anō a Āperahama, ko ahau tēnei."
Nā, ka mau rātou ki ētahi kōhatu hei epa ki a ia, heoi, huna ana a Īhu i a ia, puta ana i roto i te temepara.
Nā, i a Īhu e haere ana, ka kite ia i tētahi tangata i matapō, nō tōna whānautanga mai anō.
Nā, ka ui āna ākonga ki a ia, ka mea, "E te Kaiwhakaako, ko wai i hara, ko tēnei, ko ōna mātua rānei i whānau matapō ai ia?"
Ka whakahokia e Īhu, "Ehara i te mea ko tēnei kua hara, ko ōna mātua rānei; engari, kia ai ia hei whakakitenga mō ngā mahi a te Atua.
Me mahi e tātou ngā mahi a tōku kaitono mai i te mea e ao ana; meāke ko te pō e kore ai e taea he mahi e tētahi tangata.
I ahau i te ao nei, ko ahau te mārama o te ao."
Ka mutu ēnei kōrero āna, ka tūwha ia ki te whenua, ā, pokepokea ana tētahi paru ki te hūware, pania atu ana te paru ki ngā kanohi o te matapō,
nā, ka mea ki a ia, "Haere ki te horoi ki te kaukauranga i Hiroama" (ko Tono te whakamāoritanga). Nā, haere ana ia, horoi ana, ā, hoki titiro ana mai.
Nā, ka mea ngā tāngata e noho tata ana, rātou ko ngā tāngata i kite i tōna matapōtanga i mua, "Ehara ianei tēnei i taua tangata i noho rā, i tono mea rā māna?"
Ka mea ētahi, "Ko ia tēnei." Ko ētahi i mea, "Kāhore, engari rite tonu ki a ia te āhua." Ka mea ia, "Ko ahau rā ia."
Kātahi rātou ka mea ki a ia, "Nā te aha rā i kite ai ōu kanohi?"

Ka whakahoki ia ka mea, "Nā te tangata, e huaina nei ko Īhu, i pokepoke he paru, pania ana e ia ki ōku kanohi, ka mea mai ki ahau, ‘Haere ki Hiroama horoi ai.’ Nā, ko tōku haerenga atu, ko tāku horoinga, kite ana ahau."
Nā, ka mea rātou ki a ia, "Kei hea ia?" Ka mea ia, "E kore ahau e mōhio."
Ka kawea atu ki ngā Parihi taua tangata i matapō i mua rā.
Nā, nō te hāpati i pokepokea ai e Īhu te paru, i meinga ai ōna kanohi kia kite.
Nā, ka ui anō ngā Parihi ki a ia, ki te pēhea i kite ai ia. Ka mea ia ki a rātou, "I pania e ia he paru ki ōku kanohi, nā, horoi ana ahau, kite ana."

Nā, ka mea ētahi o ngā Parihi, "Ehara tēnei i te tangata nā te Atua, inā hoki tē whakarite ia i te hāpati." Ka mea ētahi, "Mā te aha e taea ai ēnei merekara e te tangata hara?" Nā, ka wehewehea rātou.
Ka mea anō rātou ki te matapō, "E pēhea ana koe ki a ia, ki tāna meatanga i ōu kanohi kia kite?" Ka mea ia, "He poropiti ia."
Heoi, kāhore ngā Hūrai i whakapono i matapō taua tangata, kua meinga anō kia kite, karangatia noatia e rātou ngā mātua ōna i meinga nei kia kite,
ā, ka ui rātou ki a rāua, ka mea, "Ko tā kōrua tama tēnei, e mea nei kōrua i whānau matapō mai? Nā te aha rā ia i titiro ai ināianei?"
Ka whakahoki ōna mātua ki a rātou, ka mea, "E mōhio ana māua, ko tā māua tama tēnei, i whānau matapō mai anō.
Ko te mea ia i kite ai ia ināianei, kāhore i mōhiotia e māua; kāhore hoki māua e mōhio nā wai i mea ōna kanohi kia kite. He kaumātua ia; ui atu ki a ia, māna ia e kōrero."
I pēnei ōna mātua, nō te mea i mataku rāua i ngā Hūrai. Kua takoto noa ake hoki tā ngā Hūrai tikanga, nā, ki te whakaae tētahi, ko te Karaiti ia, me pei ki waho o te whare karakia.
Koia ōna mātua i mea ai, "He kaumātua ia; ui atu ki a ia."
Nā, ka karanga tuarua rātou ki te tangata i matapō i mua rā, ka mea ki a ia, "Hoatu he korōria ki te Atua; e mātau ana mātou he tangata hara tēnei."
Nā, ka whakahoki ia, ka mea, "Kāhore ahau e mātau he tangata hara rānei ia; kotahi anō tāku e mātau nei, he matapō ahau i mua, ā, inā kua kite."
Ka mea anō rātou ki a ia, "I aha ia ki a koe? I pēheatia ōu kanohi i meinga ai e ia kia kite?"

Ka whakahokia e ia ki a rātou, "Kua kōrerotia anō e ahau ki a koutou inā tonu nei, ā, kīhai koutou i whakarongo. He aha koutou i hiahia ai kia rongo anō? E mea ana oti koutou kia meinga hei ākonga māna?"
Nā, whakahī ana rātou ki a ia, ka mea, "Ko tāna ākonga koe; ko mātou ia he ākonga nā Mohi.
E mātau ana mātou i kōrero te Atua ki a Mohi; ko tēnei tangata ia kāhore mātou e mātau ki tōna wāhi i haere mai ai."
